reports.text: [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91100) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky ridiculed Alexander Lukashenko's proposal to personally escort him to Moscow for negotiations with Vladimir Putin.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/peskov-european-countries-seek-four-party-talks-in-abu-dhabi/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated European countries want the Abu Dhabi talks held in a four-party format, though Russia does not yet agree.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/trump-names-jay-clayton-acting-national-cyber-director-report-3725930) reported that Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton will hold the post of acting national cyber director until the Senate confirms Kirsten Davies, according to the Washington Post.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90373427) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky responded to Donald Trump's remarks calling Vladimir Putin a friend by stating that Putin is a criminal to them.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/23/he-is-not-america-s-friend-in-ukraine-not-at-all-u-s-intelligence-chief-responds-to-trump-calling-putin-his-friend), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/not-americas-friend-us-intelligence-chief-defends-trump-calling-putin-his-friend/) reported that U.S. Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton defended President Donald Trump's remarks calling Vladimir Putin his friend.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90392843) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump sparked criticism after posting a photo with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/us-intelligence-chief-defends-trumps-comments-calling-putin-his?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton defended President Trump's comments calling Vladimir Putin his friend as appropriate in the context of a summit.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/us-sen-shaheen-slams-trump-for-calling-putin-friend-3725849) reported that US Senator Jeanne Shaheen wrote that Vladimir Putin is anything but a friend to the United States after Donald Trump used the word ahead of talks at the APEC forum in China.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/22/president-sheikh-mohamed-holds-talks-with-us-homeland-security-chief-in-abu-dhabi/) reported that President Sheikh Mohamed held talks with the US Homeland Security Chief in Abu Dhabi.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063867/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90773) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy responded to US President Donald Trump calling Vladimir Putin a friend by stating that for Ukraine, Putin is an enemy and a killer.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/putin-a-killer-zelenskyy-says-after-trump-calls-russian-leader-his-friend) reported that Russian forces launched a major wave of strikes against Ukraine from Thursday night into Friday morning, killing at least seven people in Kyiv.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187030-to-us-he-is-enemy-and-murderer-zelensky-on-putin-whom-trump-called-friend.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he considers Russian dictator Vladimir Putin a murderer and an enemy of Ukraine.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cqevrddp91z8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting called Vladimir Putin a cold-blooded killer during a meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in Kyiv.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/ckvg2nxgjjdgo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky called Vladimir Putin a killer after Donald Trump called the Russian leader a friend.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/trump-defends-ties-with-xi-putin-after-summit-backlash/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/trump-defends-fantastic-ties-xi-putin-after-backlash), [NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/trump-defends-fantastic-ties-with-xi-putin-after-summit-backlash/HL5T2OOGENAYPFU2IWYOSA5X6U/) reported that Trump defended his summit with Xi Jinping and Putin despite backlash from critics.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/estonia-to-close-road-borders-with-russia-in-response-to-sustained-aggression-against-europe/) reported that Estonia plans to close road borders with Russia in response to sustained aggression against Europe.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2222601) reported that Maria Zakharova emphasized that Russia would take all necessary political and diplomatic response measures to secure its national interests.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2222361), a Russian state outlet, reported that a Russian diplomat stated the Ukrainian army is intensifying terrorist activities and striking civilian infrastructure with drones.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/trump-plans-to-meet-separately-with-putin-on-his-china-trip-in-addition-to-their-3-way-talks-with-xi) reported that Donald Trump plans to meet separately with Putin on his China trip in addition to their three-way talks with Xi.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220795), a state-media outlet, reported that Belarusian Foreign Minister Maxim Ryzhenkov stated Belarus's relations with Russia are not a bargaining chip in talks with the West.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/xi-trump-putin-to-discuss-issues-concerning-global-peace-china-says-3725740) reported that China's Foreign Ministry stated the American, Russian, and Chinese presidents will discuss issues concerning global peace at a trilateral summit.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/trump-putin-xi-meet-in-china-to-discuss-global-issues/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping discussed ending Russia's war against Ukraine during talks in Shenzhen.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219937), a state-run outlet, reported that Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova stated Europe is ready to talk about peace only while ignoring Russia's interests.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/politics/ukraine-russia-europe-trump.html) reported that President Trump's envoys are attempting to craft a postwar security agreement in Europe to end the war.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/us-scold-ukraine-strikes-russia-peace-talks-elbridge-colby/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius criticized U.S. remarks regarding deep strikes as stupid.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219803) reported that Russian diplomat Rodion Miroshnik stated Kyiv maintained a high level of terrorist activity and fired at least 8,334 munitions on civilian facilities on Russian soil over seven days.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/russia-plays-for-time-as-europe-and-us-push-for-direct-peace-talks) reported that Russia continues to play down the possibility of face-to-face talks with Europe despite pressure.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/trump-says-he-is-willing-to-hold-separate-talks-with-putin-in-china/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90379) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump stated he would be willing to hold a separate meeting with Vladimir Putin during his China visit.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063252/) reported that following the adoption of new EU sanctions against Russian entities, Moscow officials including Sergei Ryabkov and Dmitry Peskov stated Russia stands against European participation in peace talks.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxNVmhPQUFLblhESV9CWnFmX2ZONzdHOTFMQkhHMW9hUzNoYlp6ZU5BUnE5b1pJZ05TbjFOODNDa2VKTW9UMzRETE5hdVBhSzVmLTJjalRFUjA2RERZdW5GS0lXOUdMM0RLRmIyWndqWUFrUjA3VFZISUMtTHdVMjQzYUJreWdKaGFnSV8xbkR5NWs4b2VBTE1BMVJlZlNvdGl3?oc=5), [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87335196) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated that progress has been made toward signing a peace agreement in Ukraine, though difficult decisions lie ahead.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063172/) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated preparations are underway for a multilateral meeting on the war in Ukraine and that he discussed next steps with Putin's aide Yuri Ushakov.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063176/) reported that Jared Kushner stated any final peace agreement must be agreed by both Russia and Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063174/) reported that Dmitry Peskov backed Donald Trump's remarks about Russia's military actions in Ukraine and confirmed the main topics for an upcoming meeting.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/ukraine-holds-peace-talks-with-us-europe-as-conflict-escalates?traffic_source=rss) reported that Ukraine held peace talks with the US and Europe as the conflict escalates, with Kushner reporting progress towards a deal while Moscow stated it has not agreed to European participation in the next talks.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/16/kremlin-aide-denies-russia-agreed-to-include-europe-in-ukraine-peace-talks-a94279), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/kremlin-says-the-next-u-s-russia-ukraine-peace-talks-will-be-trilateral-without-europe), [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648921-putin-aide-reveals-moscow-stance-europe-talks/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov stated Moscow has not agreed to include a European delegation in upcoming Ukraine peace talks.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063169/) reported that Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov stated Russia was not consulted on Europe's involvement in peace talks and wants Europe to present constructive proposals.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/us-ukraine-europeans-discuss-how-to-draw-russia-into-peace-talks) reported that European officials joined talks with Ukrainian and U.S. negotiators to discuss ways to bring Russia into direct engagement on ending the war.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-ukraine-kaja-kallas-brussels-europe-b3085569.html) reported that European Union countries accused Russia of delaying peace talks in Ukraine while continuing attacks on civilian infrastructure.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8063001/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185002-europe-to-engage-in-ukraine-peace-talks-and-ensure-maximum-pressure-on-russia-von-der-leyen.html) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated Europe will participate in negotiations to end the war through the E5 + EU format while maintaining pressure on Russia.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86782146) reported that Moldova news noted Russia laid out conditions for signing a peace agreement in Ukraine.

reports.text: [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-doit-montrer-ses-tripes-conseille-gerald-darmanin-20261125) reported that Gérald Darmanin criticized David Lisnard's political positioning, which he considers close to the National Rally.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/pour-l-instant-on-ne-bouge-pas-bruno-retailleau-et-david-lisnard-rivaux-d-un-jour-allies-demain-20261124) reported that Cannes mayor David Lisnard's rise in the polls shakes up the presidential campaign of Bruno Retailleau while weakening Édouard Philippe's campaign.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/election-presidentielle-2027/article/2026/11/24/edouard-philippe-a-vote-pour-david-lisnard-a-la-presidence-de-l-amf-mais-fustige-sa-posture-dans-la-course-a-l-elysee_6814832_6205049.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-le-camp-d-edouard-philippe-pointe-le-flou-de-david-lisnard-face-a-l-extreme-droite-20261124) reported that Horizons candidate Edouard Philippe criticized Cannes mayor David Lisnard's posture and approach toward the right and the extreme right in the 2027 presidential race.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-une-enquete-ouverte-pour-detournement-de-fonds-publics-a-l-agglomeration-du-havre-presidee-par-edouard-philippe-20261124) reported that an investigation for public funds embezzlement was opened regarding the agglomeration of Le Havre presided over by Edouard Philippe.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/24/le-congres-des-maires-de-france-s-ouvre-sur-fond-de-course-a-la-presidentielle-et-de-protestations-autour-de-la-double-candidature-de-david-lisnard_6814718_823448.html) reported that the congress of French mayors opened with a focus on the presidential race and protests surrounding David Lisnard's double candidacy.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261123-is-cannes-mayor-david-lisnard-a-dark-horse-for-french-presidential-elections) reported that Cannes mayor David Lisnard surpassed former prime ministers Edouard Philippe and Gabriel Attal in a recent voter intention poll.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/le-nouvel-artiste-qui-monte-sur-les-planches-jordan-bardella-epingle-david-lisnard-en-contrebandier-du-macronisme-20261123) reported that National Rally president Jordan Bardella described David Lisnard as a smuggler of the presidential camp while minimizing his political momentum.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/lisnard-double-philippe-dans-un-sondage-le-pen-perd-jusqu-a-5-points-20261123) reported that a poll showed David Lisnard surpassed Édouard Philippe while Marine Le Pen lost up to 5 points.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261123-france-s-far-right-leader-le-pen-denies-receiving-secrets-from-civil-servant) reported that French far-right leader Marine Le Pen denied receiving confidential information from a civil servant suspected of leaking details of investigations to her party.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/22/french-interior-ministry-rocked-by-probe-into-prefects-leaks-to-national-rally) reported that a top French interior ministry official asked to be relieved of his post after being suspected of informing the National Rally about probes into the party.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/france/20261122-le-pen-denies-receiving-leaked-information-from-french-interior-ministry-official) reported that French far-right leader Marine Le Pen stated she did not receive or ask for confidential information regarding an investigation into her party from a senior interior ministry official.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/ukraine-trump-s-etonne-du-niveau-de-haine-entre-zelensky-et-poutine-mais-affirme-que-le-president-russe-veut-une-issue-diplomatique-a-la-guerre-20261120) reported that US President Donald Trump expressed astonishment at the level of hatred between Volodymyr Zelensky and Vladimir Putin while stating the Russian president wants a diplomatic outcome to the war.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/guerre-en-ukraine-les-europeens-iront-a-moscou-s-ils-ont-bien-desormais-toute-leur-place-dans-les-negociations-indique-l-elysee-20261120) reported that the Elysee stated European participation in negotiations regarding Ukraine is required if they go to Moscow, and providing Ukraine with Article 5-type protection amounts to bringing Kyiv into NATO.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/france/20261120-france-probes-suspected-leak-confidential-information-le-pen-far-right-party) reported that French authorities are investigating whether a former senior interior ministry official leaked confidential judicial investigation details regarding the National Rally party.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/candidats/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-devance-jean-luc-melenchon-s-il-devient-candidat-unique-du-centre-et-de-la-droite-selon-un-sondage-20261120) reported that Edouard Philippe stated he is ready to participate in a meeting allowing four declared candidates to find a single candidate for the center and right.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/guerre-en-ukraine-refuser-enverrait-un-signal-inapproprie-boris-pistorius-estime-que-l-invitation-de-vladimir-poutine-aux-europeens-est-acceptable-20261120) reported that German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius stated that Vladimir Putin's invitation to Europeans is acceptable and refusing it would send an inappropriate signal.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-france-probes-suspected-leaks-from-interior-ministry-to-far-right-national-rally), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/marine-le-pen-national-rally-party-alleged-interior-ministry-leaks/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that France opened an investigation into suspicions that a senior civil servant at the interior ministry leaked confidential judicial information to the far-right National Rally party.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-ca-devrait-pouvoir-se-faire-melenchon-salue-l-offre-faite-par-tondelier-de-discuter-d-une-coalition-20261120) reported that Jean-Luc Melenchon welcomed Marine Tondelier's call to form a coalition.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/20/guerre-en-ukraine-a-berlin-la-reunion-des-allies-de-kiev-miroir-inverse-de-la-rencontre-de-shenzhen-entre-xi-trump-et-poutine_6813557_3210.html) reported that allies of Kyiv met in Berlin to maintain support and honor promised aid for 2026.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/election-presidentielle-2027/article/2026/11/19/yannick-jadot-et-jeremie-iordanoff-quittent-les-ecologistes-apres-l-approche-de-marine-tondelier-vers-jean-luc-melenchon-pour-la-presidentielle_6813385_6205049.html) reported that Yannick Jadot and Jérémie Iordanoff left Les Écolos after Marine Tondelier's overture to Jean-Luc Mélenchon for the presidential election, with Jadot calling the move a betrayal.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-yannick-jadot-annonce-quitter-les-ecologistes-apres-la-main-tendue-de-tondelier-a-melenchon-20261119) reported that Yannick Jadot announced he is leaving Les Écologists following Marine Tondelier's overture to Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/19/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-vladimir-poutine-previent-que-toute-forme-de-cooperation-militaire-entre-kiev-et-l-europe-dans-un-eventuel-accord-de-paix-pose-evidemment-un-probleme_6810982_3210.html) reported that Vladimir Putin warned that any form of military cooperation between Kyiv and Europe during a potential peace agreement poses a problem.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/c-est-la-fin-des-ecologistes-marine-tondelier-tend-la-main-a-jean-luc-melenchon-20261119) reported that Ecologists leader Marine Tondelier stated she is ready to build a coalition around Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-clementine-autain-qui-avait-quitte-lfi-apres-les-purges-de-2024-appelle-a-soutenir-jean-luc-melenchon-20261119) reported that Clémentine Autain called for support for Jean-Luc Mélenchon following Marine Tondelier opening the door to supporting the candidate.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/19/presidentielle-2027-marine-tondelier-tente-de-forcer-la-main-des-ecologistes-en-se-disant-prete-a-rallier-jean-luc-melenchon_6813213_823448.html) reported that on France 2, Ecologists national secretary Marine Tondelier opened the way to her withdrawal from the presidential race.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-c-est-une-bonne-nouvelle-faisons-le-manuel-bompard-salue-le-rapprochement-de-marine-tondelier-avec-lfi-20261119) reported that Manuel Bompard saluted the rapprochement with LFI while Tondelier is credited with 2 to 4 percent of voting intentions.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/programmes/presidentielle-2027-pour-reduire-la-dette-david-lisnard-veut-supprimer-400-000-postes-de-fonctionnaires-20261118) reported that Cannes mayor David Lisnard proposed eliminating 400,000 civil servant posts to reduce debt.

[Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/polityka/art45511031-marine-le-pen-i-jean-luc-melenchon-w-drugiej-turze-co-trzeci-francuz-zostalby-w-domu) reported that an Ifop poll found 38 percent of voters would not go to the polls if Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Melenchon faced each other in the second round of the French presidential election.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/sondages/presidentielle-2027-lisnard-et-attal-se-demarquent-dans-une-hypothetique-primaire-decouvrez-le-sondage-du-figaro-20261118) reported that an Ifop poll for Le Figaro found that nearly four out of ten voters consider participating in a hypothetical primary if it were to take place.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/18/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-met-en-musique-une-partie-de-son-programme-pour-s-extirper-du-debat-sur-la-primaire-et-de-l-etau-rn-lfi_6813202_823448.html) reported that Edouard Philippe staged part of his program to move away from the primary debate and the National Rally-LFI pressure.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/18/de-lfi-a-lr-en-passant-par-le-medef-le-projet-de-reforme-des-retraites-de-marine-le-pen-critique-de-tous-bords_6813010_823449.html) reported that Marine Le Pen's pension reform project was criticized across political boards from LFI to LR and Medef.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/18/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-presente-une-partie-de-son-programme-pour-retablir-l-ordre-et-remettre-la-france-sur-le-chemin-du-progres_6813122_823448.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-promet-une-rupture-de-fond-pour-relancer-sa-campagne-face-a-david-lisnard-20261118) reported that Horizons presidential candidate Edouard Philippe detailed measures and promised a radical rupture to launch his campaign.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/presidentielle-2027-face-a-marine-le-pen-jean-luc-melenchon-gagnera-l-election-assure-darmanin-20261118) reported that Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin stated that Jean-Luc Mélenchon will win the 2027 presidential election against Marine Le Pen, and called on Bruno Retailleau and Gabriel Attal to withdraw in favor of Horizons candidate Edouard Philippe without a primary.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-jean-philippe-tanguy-propose-un-debat-avec-david-lisnard-20261118) reported that Jean-Philippe Tanguy proposed a debate with David Lisnard regarding pensions.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/18/presidentielle-2027-sans-attendre-edouard-philippe-ses-adversaires-posent-la-premiere-pierre-d-une-primaire-de-la-droite-et-du-centre-incertaine_6813083_823448.html) reported that teams for Gabriel Attal, Bruno Retailleau, and David Lisnard held a meeting regarding a potential primary for the right and center.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-on-doit-lui-mettre-la-pression-lisnard-fait-de-la-participation-de-philippe-une-condition-pour-une-primaire-20261118) reported that David Lisnard stated Edouard Philippe's participation is a condition for a primary.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/18/presidentielle-2027-gerald-darmanin-appelle-bruno-retailleau-et-gabriel-attal-a-s-effacer-derriere-edouard-philippe-pour-barrer-la-route-a-jean-luc-melenchon_6813056_823448.html) reported that Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin called on Bruno Retailleau and Gabriel Attal to step aside behind Edouard Philippe to block Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/17/la-ligue-des-droits-de-l-homme-qualifiee-par-marine-le-pen-de-ramassis-de-gauchistes-accuse-la-candidate-rn-de-vouloir-supprimer-tous-les-contre-pouvoirs_6813037_3224.html) reported that the Human Rights League accused National Rally candidate Marine Le Pen of wanting to eliminate all checks and balances after she called the organization a gathering of leftists during a poverty debate.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-les-camps-attal-retailleau-et-lisnard-actent-leurs-premieres-convergences-en-l-absence-d-edouard-philippe-20261117) reported that representatives of Renaissance, Les Républicains, and Nouvelle Énergie parties laid the groundwork for a primary at the end of January in the absence of Édouard Philippe to foster the emergence of a single candidate for the 2027 presidential election.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/17/la-droite-et-le-centre-attaquent-le-projet-de-reforme-des-retraites-de-marine-le-pen_6813010_823448.html) reported that political opponents including Bruno Retailleau and Édouard Philippe criticized Marine Le Pen's pension reform project.

reports.text: [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/eisenkot-bloc-planning-to-form-new-israel-government-by-end-of-next-week-reports-101795598840828.html) reported that the Eisenkot bloc is planning to form a new Israeli government by the end of next week.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1586672/israels-gadi-eisenkot-signs-first-coalition-deal-with-avigdor-lieberman-in-bid-to-form-government/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046976/eisenkot-clinches-first-coalition-agreement-in-bid-to-form-israels-government) reported that Israel’s Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot signed his first coalition agreement with right-wing opposition leader Avigdor Lieberman.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-25/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-allies-doubt-a-government-with-likud-the-democrats-are-done-waiting/000001a2-0f74-d9a3-abea-7f76cd310000) reported that Eisenkot allies doubt a government with Likud will materialize and that The Democrats are done waiting.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/israels-eisenkot-secures-first-coalition-partner-in-bid-to-form-government?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israel's Eisenkot secured his first coalition partner after the Yashar party agreed to sign a coalition pact with Avigdor Lieberman's Our Home party.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israels-democrats-party-pauses-coalition-talks-with-gadi-eisenkots-bloc-yair-golan-101795557258994.html) reported that Israel's Democrats party paused coalition talks with Eisenkot's bloc.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-916020) reported that the Democrats halted coalition talks with Yashar due to progress in unity government talks between Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-916022) reported that Communications Minister Shlomo Karhi warned haredi parties against joining an Eisenkot-led government, stating they would be used and discarded.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-23/ty-article/.premium/yashar-and-likud-meet-again-for-unity-government-talks/000001a2-0998-d7ca-abf6-6fdc550f0000) reported that dozens of protesters gathered outside Gadi Eisenkot's home urging him to keep Netanyahu out of the next government as Yashar and Likud met for unity government talks.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915874) reported that B'Yachad leader Naftali Bennett warned Netanyahu he would face consequences if he deliberately stalled efforts to form a unity government under Eisenkot's leadership.
[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/netanyahu-eisenkot-parties-end-coalition-talks-in-deadlock/) reported that coalition negotiations between Likud and Yashar parties ended in a deadlock.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915811) reported that a right-wing official warned that haredi talks with Eisenkot could end a long-standing political alliance.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915780) reported that Gadi Eisenkot has been holding discussions with Likud, haredi parties, and Arab parties to establish a majority coalition.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/eisenkot-netanyahu-parties-to-meet-again-for-israel-coalition-talks/), [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-23/ty-article/.premium/democrats-party-head-urges-eisenkot-to-stop-deceitful-likud-coalition-talks/000001a2-07a0-d43a-adbe-0fed12bd0000) reported that the parties of caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Gadi Eisenkot resumed coalition talks for a joint government, with Democrats party leader Yair Golan urging Eisenkot to stop the negotiations.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/eisenkot-likud-netanyahu-negocian-formulas-gobernar-arabes_202611236b03ee99f6da642efef8784c.html) reported that Gadi Eisenkot and Netanyahu's Likud negotiated formulas to govern without the Arabs on topics including judicial reform, ultra-Orthodox military recruitment, and a committee.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/netanyahu-and-eisenkot-factions-fail-to-strike-a-coalition-agreement/) reported that caretaker prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud and rival Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party ended another round of coalition talks without reaching an agreement.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-unity-government-with-netanyahu-stab-in-the-back-israeli-opposition-leader/) reported that Israeli opposition leader Yair Golan called for forming a minority government and described forming a unity government with caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as a stab in the back.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/netanyahu-and-eisenkot-still-deadlocked-over-israeli-government-formation/TWVTQHPPU5BLNBH6TZ4NNAEZZA/) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu and Gadi Eisenkot are deadlocked over Israeli government formation and may end up sharing the role.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/netanyahus-likud-eisenkots-yashar-end-coalition-talks-without-deal?traffic_source=rss) reported that the parties remain split over who will lead the next government and whether far-right minister Itamar Ben-Gvir will join.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israels-netanyahu-and-eisenkot-parties-fail-to-reach-agreement-in-second-round-of-coalition-talks-101795376000592.html) reported that representatives from Eisenkot's Yashar Party and Netanyahu's Likud held a four-hour meeting at a hotel in Herzliya, near Tel Aviv.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/netanyahu-eisenkot-parties-resume-talks-to-form-israel-government/article71732120.ece) reported that Likud laid down conditions for a unity government including no Arab parties and rejection of a Palestinian state.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-netanyahus-likud-eisenkots-yashar-end-unity-government-talks-without-deal-israeli-media/) reported that representatives of Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party and Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party ended about four hours of unity government talks without a deal.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/netanyahu-and-eisenkot-parties-resume-talks-form-israel-govt) reported that the parties of caretaker Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and rival Gadi Eisenkot launched a new round of talks on Sunday regarding whether to form a coalition government.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915687) reported that Yashar stated the planned talks were part of efforts to form a new government and exhaust every possible avenue.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-22/gadi-eisenkot-invites-benjamin-netanyahu-israeli-coalition-talks/107413714), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261121-eisenkot-invites-netanyahu-s-party-for-marathon-israeli-coalition-talks), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1121/1600152-israeli-coalition-talks/), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/566b53a9a3ec), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/eisenkot-invites-netanyahus-party-for-israeli-coalition-talks-3013421), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israel-government-formation-eisenkots-yashar-party-reaches-out-to-netanyahus-camp-for-coalition-talks-101795295951548.html) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party has invited Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party to coalition talks.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915647) reported that Naftali Bennett confirmed ongoing talks with Likud, ruled out joining Benjamin Netanyahu, and set three conditions for a coalition while urging Eisenkot's bloc to seek a Zionist unity government.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915581) reported that Yashar is preparing for the possibility that both coalition negotiation tracks will fail.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-19/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-plans-knesset-vote-on-govt-led-by-him-even-if-coalition-talks-fail/000001a1-f454-d287-adbb-f65e3bfb0000) reported that Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot plans to hold a Knesset vote on a government led by him even if coalition talks fail.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915505) reported that the Eisenkot-led bloc and Likud are scheduled to meet on Sunday for continued talks on a potential unity government.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/netanyahus-surprise-meeting-with-bennett-stirs-anger-in-eisenkot-bloc-3725753) reported that figures in Gadi Eisenkot's bloc accused caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of trying to break up their alliance after meeting Naftali Bennett.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045571/eisenkot-bloc-moves-to-reverse-netanyahu-legacy-under-new-speaker) reported that Israel's parliament met under a new speaker from the anti-Benjamin Netanyahu bloc as opponents of the caretaker prime minister began their moves.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/bennett-meets-netanyahu-eisenkot-unaware-coalition-talks/) reported that B'Yachad chief Naftali Bennett held a long Knesset meeting with Benjamin Netanyahu on November 18 while Gadi Eisenkot's spokesperson stated he was unaware of it.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-opposition-rattled-bennett-holds-talks-netanyahu) reported that members of Israel's opposition bloc insisted they remain unified after a meeting between Naftali Bennett and Benjamin Netanyahu.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-18/ty-article/.premium/bennett-meets-netanyahu-ahead-of-talks-with-eisenkot-bloc-leaders/000001a1-ee32-d24f-a1e5-efbfec8b0000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915298) reported that Naftali Bennett and Benjamin Netanyahu held a secret meeting without informing Gadi Eisenkot and Yair Lapid in advance, which delayed planned opposition bloc talks.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-915097) reported that an Eisenkot-led bloc is weighing a unity government and coalition talks with haredi parties following the October election, while Golan and Liberman warned against a Netanyahu-led unity government.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-16/ty-article/.premium/this-likud-mks-protest-tent-is-well-intentioned-but-it-serves-netanyahu/000001a1-e38c-db97-a1e1-e39ebbf50000) reported that Likud and Smotrich representatives appeared at a protest tent calling for unity.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-15/ty-article/.premium/whats-behind-netanyahus-frantic-push-for-a-unity-government/000001a1-e027-d59b-a1f3-f8b72d260000) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is urging Gadi Eisenkot to share power after losing his majority.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/can-netanyahu-and-eisenkot-form-a-unity-government-in-israel?traffic_source=rss) reported that Yashar and Likud are scheduled to hold talks on Sunday.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/netanyahu-again-urges-rival-to-join-him-in-forming-unity-government/) reported that Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu urged rival Gadi Eisenkot to join him in forming a unity government.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/eisenkot-rejects-netanyahus-unity-government-call-as-media-stunt-3725584) reported that Gadi Eisenkot described the call as a media stunt and noted that negotiating teams from his Yashar party and Likud are due to meet.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/15/iran-war-live-israel-vows-gaza-offensive-policy-despite-caretaker-status?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israel has pledged to continue its offensive policy on Gaza.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/new-israeli-gates-could-cut-off-70000-palestinians-in-west-bank-mayor-warns-3725975) reported that the mayor of al-Kum and al-Muwarraq stated the Israeli army installed five iron gates at junctions that could cut off 70,000 Palestinians west of Hebron.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/israeli-army-opens-investigation-into-use-of-palestinians-as-human-shields-3013947) reported that according to Haaretz, Israel has not prosecuted any military member over the use of Palestinian civilians as human shields as the army opened an investigation.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/a2afc6ef6158), a state-media outlet, reported that five new iron gates installed along a key road west of Hebron risk isolating 70,000 Palestinians and restricting movement.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-armys-use-human-shields-extends-lebanon-report) reported that an Israeli investigation into cases of Palestinians used as human shields coincides with a documentary by Israel's public broadcaster.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-24/ty-article/.premium/israeli-lawmakers-seek-to-block-airing-of-probe-into-idf-using-human-shields/000001a2-0e4f-d9a3-abea-7f5f3c660000) reported that caretaker defense minister Katz and Avigdor Lieberman called on Israel's public broadcaster to pull a report on the army's use of human shields.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/haaretz-today/2026-11-24/ty-article/.highlight/arab-mks-face-loyalty-tests-jewish-mks-can-shrug-off-the-use-of-human-shields/000001a2-0dc1-d089-a1fe-2df5fd100000) reported that post-October 7 Israel has accepted the army's use of Palestinians as human shields with concern focused on international exposure.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/west-bank/2026-11-24/ty-article/.premium/israels-top-court-says-west-bank-settlers-are-acting-like-militias/000001a2-0d33-dba8-adea-3d3fac890000) reported that Israel's Supreme Court stated that West Bank settlers act like militias against Palestinians.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-settler-terrorism-surges-42-occupied-west-bank) reported that Israeli settler terrorism in the West Bank increased by 42% in 2026.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-24/ty-article-magazine/.premium/democrats-want-to-sanction-west-bank-settlers-they-disagree-on-how/000001a2-0eb3-db39-a1b3-fff306c30000) reported that Democrats in the U.S. Congress are planning sanctions targeting Israeli settlers.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-915926) reported that data indicates a sharp increase in the number of nationalist crime incidents and an escalation in their severity and geographical spread in the West Bank.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/29d4ce0398a4), a state-media outlet, reported that Chinese President Xi Jinping opposed Israeli land grabs and violations of Palestinian rights in the occupied West Bank while calling for a lasting ceasefire in Gaza.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/france-condemns-violent-settlers-attacks-on-palestinian-localities-3725911), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261123-france-condemns-very-serious-attacks-by-violent-settlers-on-several-palestinian-localities-in-west-bank/) reported that the French Foreign Ministry condemned very serious attacks by violent settlers on Palestinian localities in the occupied West Bank.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/haaretz-today/2026-11-23/ty-article/.highlight/eisenkot-and-bennett-condemned-jewish-terror-what-about-the-forces-behind-it/000001a2-099b-d0d9-a9f6-bdfb08ad0000) reported that Eisenkot and Bennett condemned Jewish terror.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/palestinian-paramedics-face-a-sharp-surge-in-israeli-attacks-in-the-west-bank/), a state-media outlet, reported that Israeli attacks on ambulances, paramedics, and emergency services in the West Bank and East Jerusalem increased dramatically after October 2023.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915855) reported that an NGO PHRI report, based on interviews with 25 paramedics and volunteers, stated Palestinian emergency medical workers are increasingly under attack in the West Bank.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915810) reported that Isaac Herzog condemned Jewish extremist violence in the West Bank at the ELNET Jerusalem Summit.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915805) reported that security sources stated nationalist violence incidents had been prevented wherever the IDF maintained a substantial presence.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/israel-escalates-occupation-of-west-bank-with-50-structures-demolished-and-13-vehicles-torched/), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/illegal-israeli-settlers-torch-palestinian-vehicles-in-occupied-west-bank-village-3725878) reported that Israeli occupation forces and settlers escalated attacks across the West Bank, demolishing approximately 50 residential structures and torching 13 vehicles in Palestinian villages.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/palestine-urges-deterrent-measures-against-occupier-attacks-in-west-bank-3725874) reported that Palestine's Foreign Ministry stated Israeli occupiers set 12 vehicles ablaze and spray-painted racist slogans in several villages.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/22/world/middleeast/israeli-political-leaders-decry-jewish-terrorism-after-west-bank-attacks.html) reported that extremist settlers carried out violent raids in Palestinian villages over the weekend.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-23/israel-gadi-eisenkot-west-bank-arson-attacks/107415280) reported that settlers set fire to vehicles and homes in several Palestinian villages overnight.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-palestine-calls-for-deterrent-measures-against-occupier-terrorism-in-west-bank/) reported that Palestine called on the international community to put an end to the Israeli government's support for occupier terrorism in the West Bank.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/israel-s-eisenkot-condemns-jewish-terrorism-in-west-bank/a-80013861?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot condemned a recent series of arson attacks in the occupied West Bank as Jewish terrorism.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/israeli-settlers-launch-attacks-across-west-bank-as-netanyahu-rival-decries-jewish-terrorism/) reported that Israeli settlers launched a series of attacks across the occupied West Bank, torching at least a dozen cars and vandalizing several homes overnight Sunday.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1122/1600216-west-bank-fires/) reported that Israeli authorities opened an investigation after Palestinian vehicles and properties were torched in four occupied West Bank villages.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/israeli-settlers-attack-several-palestinian-villages-in-occupied-west-bank?traffic_source=rss) reported that attacks in Ramallah and el-Bireh provinces included the burning of 12 vehicles and spray-painting racist slogans on homes.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/israeli-settler-attacks-devastate-palestinian-olive-groves) reported that humanitarian organizations stated more than 400 Israeli settler attacks targeting Palestinians and their property had been documented across the occupied West Bank.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-occupiers-attack-4-palestinian-villages-in-occupied-west-bank-3725848) reported that Israeli occupiers set vehicles and an agricultural room on fire in four Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/eisenkot-calls-occupier-arson-attacks-in-west-bank-jewish-terrorism-3725854) reported that Gadi Eisenkot blamed Ben-Gvir and Smotrich for West Bank arson attacks and urged administrative detention of rioters.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/west-bank/2026-11-22/ty-article/.premium/hebrew-graffiti-found-alongside-arson-in-five-west-bank-palestinian-villages/000001a2-0183-dad7-a9ff-43cb7ce60000), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915667) reported that suspected settler attacks involving arson and Hebrew graffiti were reported across West Bank villages and sites.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/palestinian-authorities-say-man-shot-dead-by-west-bank-settler-guards-3013416), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/palestinian-man-shot-dead-near-ramallah-in-west-bank-3725827) reported that Palestinian authorities stated a man was shot dead by security guards from an Israeli settlement in the central occupied West Bank.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/at-least-eight-palestinians-injured-in-israeli-drone-strike-in-southern-gaza/) reported that at least eight Palestinians, including a child, were injured in an Israeli drone strike in Khan Younis.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/at-least-four-palestinians-killed-in-israeli-attacks-on-gaza?traffic_source=rss) reported that an Israeli drone attack killed three people in Gaza City and another person was shot dead in Jabalia.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168849) reported that the UN stated Israeli settlers carried out more than 400 attacks during this year's olive harvest in the occupied West Bank.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/palestinian-authorities-say-man-shot-dead-w-settler-guards), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/west-bank-settler-guard-shoots-dead-palestinian-man-101795210422505.html) reported that a Palestinian man was shot dead by guards from the Israeli settlement of Beit El near Ramallah in the West Bank.
[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/gaza-civil-defense-says-israeli-strikes-kill-six-3013219) reported that Israeli airstrikes in the Gaza Strip resulted in six casualties.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-settlers-establish-illegal-outpost-pa-run-area) reported that Israeli settlers established a religious outpost on Palestinian land in Area A.

reports.text: [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86332270/Iran-tightens-security-measures-in-Strait-of-Hormuz-Army), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army spokesperson said the military stepped up surveillance and control of the Strait of Hormuz.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249692/Iran-Army-to-impose-stricter-control-over-Hormuz-Strait-Spox), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army spokesman stated the military enhanced its readiness and tightened control over the Strait of Hormuz.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224405), a Russian state outlet, reported that two oil tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz and fire broke out in their engine rooms.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642226/irgc-navy-says-two-oil-tankers-hit-mines-caught-fire-in-strait-of-hormuz-state-media), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249679/Two-more-oil-tankers-explode-in-Strait-of-Hormuz-unsafe-route), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86331897/Two-violating-oil-tankers-explode-on-unauthorized-route-in-Strait) reported that the IRGC Navy said two violating oil tankers struck naval mines and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261124-iran-blacklists-26-tugboats-operating-in-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that Iran blacklisted 26 tugboats operating in the Strait of Hormuz for providing services to vessels using an alternative southern route.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532514/Strait-of-Hormuz-to-become-increasingly-closed-army-chief), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army chief warned the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed and come under increasingly tighter Iranian control until the country's seven conditions are met.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/oil-prices-hit-three-month-lows-as-rising-global-supply-and-surplus-fears-outweigh-strait-of-hormuz-risks-101795523176752.html) reported that oil prices hit three-month lows as rising crude supply, Russian oil imports, and surplus fears outweighed shipping risks in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249668/Fourth-oil-tanker-explodes-east-of-Hormuz-Tues-IRGC) reported that the IRGC Navy reported an explosion and fire aboard an oil tanker east of the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iran-insists-7-demands-hormuz-crisis-deepens-irgc-targets-tankers) reported that Iranian officials insist the US meet seven conditions, including lifting sanctions, before Tehran agrees to terms.

[UK Defence Journal](https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/us-pulls-more-tankers-out-of-europe-and-the-middle-east/) reported that 17 US KC-135 and KC-46 tankers left Europe and the Middle East with only four replacements sent according to flight tracking.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/us-and-qatar-stress-ensuring-freedom-of-navigation-in-the-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that Qatari Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stressed the need to ensure freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261124-qatar-urges-restoration-of-hormuz-navigation-return-to-us-iran-talks/) reported that Qatar called for restoring freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz and a return to negotiations between the US and Iran.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249667/2-violating-oil-tankers-catch-fire-in-east-of-Hormuz-Strait), an Iranian state outlet, reported that the Iranian Army Force announced that two non-compliant oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines on an unauthorized route in the Hormuz Strait.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223805), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86331202/Strait-of-Hormuz-will-remain-closed-until-Iran-s-conditions-are) reported that Iranian Army Chief Commander Major General Amir Hatami stated the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until Iran's conditions are fulfilled.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOX2xsTTJRZjRhMmNKWmRuOG5KN3NKby13a2tqSzk0SktnTnFFRzR4eGJQN29IbkF5MEh2a2R3SkhRVTRZY1liQ1U2di1JV2p5WmZLcmxpemJhRThJXzAySlNDcXhuZ3djcmFQcGdDUkZtODc3WF8zRVBNc2hjVUhjLVFXMTBjbjk2ZVRFaEs4MTRQRGtaN2FtcGVjRWtUVUdVd2tIYmZHTy0?oc=5), [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86330775/Three-more-offending-tankers-hit-mines-in-Strait-of-Hormuz) reported that the IRGC Navy announced three separate oil tanker fire incidents after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/24/live-iran-war-hormuz-tanker/), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249645/Three-oil-tankers-hit-mines-burn-in-Strait-of-Hormuz) reported that the IRGC Navy stated three oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/24/iran-war-live-iran-says-three-ships-catch-fire-after-hitting-hormuz-mines?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iran's Revolutionary Guards stated three oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915899) reported that the IRGC claimed the tankers were being escorted and protected by the US military, but support failed to prevent the incidents from occurring.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/iranian-attacks-in-the-strait-of-hormuz-are-at-the-highest-levels-since-the-conflict-began/) reported that maritime data shows reported attacks on shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz are at the highest levels since the Iran war began.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iran-and-us-trade-threats-tankers-burn-hormuz) reported that Iran and the US have intensified threats regarding returning to all-out war as oil tankers continue to burn in the Hormuz.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915773) reported that maritime data from Kpler shows Iranian attacks on ships in the Hormuz area are at their highest level since the start of the war while the US blockade stops oil exports.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249618/2-violating-supertankers-catch-fire-in-Strait-of-Hormuz-IRGC) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps stated two non-compliant supertankers attempting unauthorized Hormuz transit have caught fire after experiencing explosions.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c95y1gr27xplo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that ocean campaigner Lewis Pugh completed the Hormuz swim challenge and warned of the environmental cost and lasting damage of war.

[The Tide (Nigeria)](https://www.thetidenewsonline.com/2026/11/hormuz-oil-exports-could-decline-amid-inbound-tanker-shortage/) reported that Brent Crude prices slid to around $92 per barrel amid an inbound tanker shortage.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-iran-says-2-supertankers-struck-naval-mines-near-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps stated two supertankers suffered explosions and were brought to a halt after striking naval mines near the Strait of Hormuz.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328803/Army-exercising-sovereignty-over-Strait-of-Hormuz-Iran), a state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia stated that Iranian forces maintain control over the Strait of Hormuz.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/bahrain-industrial-site-us-positions-targeted-by-fresh-iran-strikes) reported that Bahrain stated an Iranian attack struck a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire and injuring two people.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-22/ty-article-magazine/the-athlete-swimming-through-a-war-zone-to-protest-iran-wars-impact-on-wildlife/000001a2-02a2-d9ff-a7b6-93aef6080000) reported that British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh swam across the Strait of Hormuz to protest the impact of the Iran war on wildlife.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261122-bahrain-accuses-iran-of-striking-industrial-site-as-tankers-hit-in-hormuz) reported that Bahrain accused Iran of striking a civilian industrial site.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/a2cfb441d751), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/middle-east/endurance-swimmer-tackles-strait-of-hormuz-20261122-p61g8h.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh swam parts of the Strait of Hormuz to highlight the environmental impact of the conflict with Iran.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/endurance-athlete-lewis-pugh-swims-in-strait-of-hormuz-to-highlight-iran-wars-impact-on-wildlife-3013343) reported that endurance athlete Lewis Pugh swam across the Strait of Hormuz to draw attention to environmental threats and the impact of regional conflict on wildlife.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/maritime-agency-says-2-tankers-struck-in-hormuz-as-iran-says-ship-on-fire-3013341) reported that two tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, with one hit by an unknown projectile and another struck in the engine room.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/uk-man-swims-strait-hormuz-highlight-environmental-damage) reported that a British endurance swimmer swam in the Strait of Hormuz and called for the waterway to be reopened and cleaned up.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249562/Non-compliant-tanker-blasts-after-hitting-mine-near-Oman-port) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps Navy Force stated an oil tanker attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz exploded after hitting a mine.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584814/another-oil-tanker-strikes-naval-mine-as-tensions-persist-in-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that an oil tanker struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz according to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249573/A-tanker-transiting-Hormuz-Strait-hit-by-a-projectile-UKMTO) reported that the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations received a report of an incident 11 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915628) reported that one tanker was hit on its stern 11 nautical miles north of Khasab and another in its engine room 17 nautical miles east about 50 minutes later.
[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584935/gold-and-silver-prices-decline-further/) reported that gold and silver prices recorded further declines in local and international markets.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNSXBvSnRkak5uYmtzMFNqMmE5Q25TMzBWeFh1ZmRhUHlMemIySllSU0FKcXZRQ2FjalhyMWhOZ3k2UWNXN3FjLTZiaUNvRk95S2FzeUlGeVJBQWNnQ19XYTAxd2NxNXNDN01TSWhYNXo0ellDaDBwZ0szdkR6azU5SkdFNWF4SWxiSF80Mi1ZdENoS1RuTWZkUVpCMHk0V0JpcDdz?oc=5), [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-21/ty-article/two-oil-tankers-hit-by-unidentified-projectiles-near-strait-of-hormuz/000001a1-fe7c-dad7-a9fd-fe7f22a00000), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/tankers-hit-in-strait-of-hormuz-as-iran-tightens-grip-on-shipping?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/ukmto-says-2-tankers-struck-hormuz-iran-says-ship-fire) reported that the British maritime agency UKMTO reported two tanker incidents near Oman and the Strait of Hormuz.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/2026-11-21/ty-article/two-oil-tankers-hit-by-unidentified-projectiles-near-strait-of-hormuz/000001a1-fe7c-dad7-a9fd-fe7f22a00000), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/tankers-hit-in-strait-of-hormuz-as-iran-tightens-grip-on-shipping?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/ukmto-says-2-tankers-struck-hormuz-iran-says-ship-fire) reported that Iran stated a tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine, while Reuters could not verify the account.

reports.text: [Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/2026-11-25/ty-article/at-least-11-wounded-in-second-houthi-strike-on-saudi-capital-in-a-week/000001a2-11be-dbde-a3fe-77bfcd3b0000) reported that at least 11 people were wounded in the second Houthi strike on the tallest tower in Riyadh within a week.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/arab-states-mwl-condemn-houthi-attack-on-riyadh-tower-3013920) reported that Arab states and the Muslim World League condemned the Houthi attack on a tower in Riyadh's financial district that injured 11 civilians.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/us-issues-security-warning-for-its-citizens-in-the-middle-east/) reported that the US Department of State urged American citizens in the Middle East to remain vigilant due to increased threats of armed attacks by Iran-backed Houthi forces.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1010661/tallest-skyscraper-in-riyadh-hit-second-time-in-less-than-a-week-witnesses/story/) reported that the tallest skyscraper in Riyadh's business district was hit a second time in less than a week by an unspecified projectile.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/cdd76c8b4bc3) reported that the attack injured Saudi, Indian, Nepalese, and Egyptian nationals.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/at-least-11-injured-in-houthi-attack-on-riyadhs-tallest-skyscraper) reported that at least 11 people were injured when Yemen's Houthi fighters struck the skyscraper.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-issues-fresh-security-alert-for-americans-across-middle-east-over-iran-houthi-attack-threat-101795567184994.html) reported that the US State Department issued a fresh security alert warning of possible attacks on US personnel and facilities across the Middle East due to Iran and Houthi attack threats.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Saudi-Arabia-Sees-Smaller-Economic-Slump-as-More-Oil-Reaches-Market.html) reported that Saudi Arabia now expects its economy to shrink 2.1% this year instead of 3.6% after recovering enough oil exports.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/24/live-iran-war-saudi-arabia-riyadh-tower/) reported that a Riyadh tower was targeted in a terrorist attack according to the Saudi-led coalition.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/world/middleeast/saudi-skyscraper-houthi-strike.html) reported that an Houthi attack on a skyscraper in Riyadh wounded 11 people.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/houthi-attack-in-saudi-capital-riyadh-indians-injured/article71740914.ece) reported that Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence described the incident as a terrorist attack by Houthi militia.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/saudi-skyscraper-hit-again-coalition-slams-terrorist-attack) reported that Riyadh's tallest skyscraper was struck for the second time in days, with the coalition denouncing a terrorist attack.
[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1124/1600490-saudi-attack-houthi/) reported that 11 people were injured in the strike on the Saudi capital's tallest skyscraper.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/least-11-injured-houthi-attack-saudi-pif-tower-what-know), [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2224249) reported that at least 11 people, including two Saudi nationals and nine foreigners, were injured in a Houthi attack on the Saudi PIF Tower in Riyadh.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxNT2lRbHFjYmphSTFEMlhhRmVYd0dzWklmWmxFZFhMVG41LTJWdEZpNW9oYU5JUy1NS1ZORl80Wml6clJ6UnJOenN2TDBjSUpDbHRlVTdWNWpkdXZGejZwdTM4U1J3UWZyYnUzMzhMSGRKZWFwdjZUSFVLdTlRSWlMVVFtQ05kUDlQVGtEY1FXTHRXQmVfSmgzSndIWGxqZ2NRWXM4WjluTTgyallieG9JOXdISmlacFRUUDFiOUplaUZmNC1vUkJLSzZn?oc=5) reported that Saudi Civil Defense stated Houthis hit Riyadh's tallest tower, leaving 11 wounded.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532515/Yemen-targets-tallest-tower-in-Riyadh-11-injured) reported that a projectile launched by Yemen's Ansarallah struck the tallest tower in Saudi Arabia's capital for the second time in less than a week.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/sudan-to-support-saudi-coalition-in-yemen-with-new-troop-deployment/) reported that Sudan's army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan approved sending Sudan Shield Forces fighters to Yemen to support Saudi operations.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/yemens-houthis-say-saudi-attack-kills-17) reported that the Houthis stated a Saudi attack killed 17 people and destroyed buildings in Hodeida.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/17-killed-in-saudi-attack-on-yemeni-city-houthis/article71735986.ece) reported that coalition airstrikes on telecoms facilities killed 17 workers, wounded 11, and caused total destruction of administrative buildings and staff housing.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249613/Yemen-has-been-target-of-5-581-Saudi-air-and-missile-atta) reported that the Yemeni military spokesman stated Yemen has been the target of 5,581 Saudi attacks.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/yemens-houthis-attack-saudi-arabias-rabigh-oil-refinery) reported that the Houthis stated they carried out an operation targeting Saudi Arabia's Rabigh oil refinery.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-us-embassy-warns-americans-in-bahrain-of-growing-threats-from-iran-houthis/) reported that the US Embassy in Bahrain urged Americans to exercise heightened vigilance due to an increased threat of armed attacks by Yemen’s Houthis.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/houthis-report-attack-on-sanaa-as-saudi-arabia-intercepts-drone?traffic_source=rss) reported that Houthi media stated several people were injured in an attack on an oil company as Saudi air defences downed a drone and a missile.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585178/houthi-attacks-on-saudi-arabia-put-regional-stability-at-stake-says-pm/) reported that Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif strongly condemned the Houthi attack on the King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-saudi-led-coalition-intercepts-houthi-drone-targeting-southern-saudi-arabia/) reported that the Saudi-led coalition stated it intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone targeting southern Saudi Arabia.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-915746) reported that Yemen's Houthis stated they attacked the Saudi Rabigh oil refinery with a direct hit.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/houthi-missiles-target-saudi-arabia-iran-drones-strike-bahrain) reported that Houthi missiles targeted Saudi Arabia and Iranian drones struck Bahrain, with Tehran stating its attacks were in response to US strikes.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/saudi-led-coalition-says-it-intercepted-houthi-missile-in-western-region/article71731039.ece) reported that Saudi Arabia's western region contains key energy infrastructure including the Yanbu terminal.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/houthi-missiles-target-saudi-arabia-iran-restates-hormuz-terms) reported that Houthi missiles targeted Saudi Arabia while Iran reiterated its stance on reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641660/saudi-led-coalition-says-it-intercepted-houthi-ballistic-missile-targeting-western-saudi-arabia), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/saudi-led-coalition-says-it-destroyed-houthi-missile-aimed-at-western-saudi-arabia-3725835) reported that the Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by Houthi forces toward western Saudi Arabia.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/saudi-coalition-launches-operation-houthis-vow-reprisals) reported that the Saudi-led coalition attacked the Red Sea port city of Hodeida and other targets in a special operation.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxQdkhaS29lZFRPVnhqN3FVWW1WRkFJWlBMZm40ZlYzR0t4NjJmNHhLeUdkblhZVlRsMEtQVGFwcS1ERWNmUS02N1A0Tko4NExQYldWQ2o3ZWhtUmtfTDBhQlZURWN3bkJzdTJsZmpKbnoydmp1M210NmdmR1NCUS0yZml3QTM0T1dZV0J6R2tXRFlSX1ZVZHVFcnlKM2E4eklTTTJuOURjeE93LXZjeTNyS0QzZ2l6OTFYaDJOTWZ3cXZNQzcy?oc=5) reported that Shehbaz Sharif condemned Houthi strikes on Riyadh and reaffirmed Pakistan's stance.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584674/saudi-coalition-intercepts-three-houthi-ballistic-missiles-and-five-drones/) reported that the Saudi-led military coalition intercepted three ballistic missiles and five drones launched by Yemeni Houthi militants toward southern Saudi Arabia.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/houthis-launch-strikes-after-saudi-led-coalitions-special-op), [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641480/saudi-forces-launch-major-strikes-in-yemen) reported that Yemen's Houthis launched strikes on Riyadh after vowing reprisals for a special operation, targeting Hodeida port.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915599) reported that Israel seeks an expanded Middle East coalition of states for possible strikes against Iran to shorten campaign duration and target key assets.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641500/pm-shehbaz-condemns-houthi-attack-on-riyadhs-king-abdullah-financial-district) reported that Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif condemned the Houthi attack on Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/saudi-led-coalition-intercepts-three-houthi-missiles-headed-for-riyadh?traffic_source=rss) reported that Saudi Arabia issued emergency alerts in Riyadh for the third night in row as the Houthis threaten ports and power stations.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3375314/yemens-houthis-launch-strikes-riyadh-after-saudi-coalition-special-operation) reported that Yemen’s Houthis launched strikes on the Saudi capital Riyadh on Saturday after vowing reprisals for a special operation by the Saudi-led coalition.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249551/Yemen-attacks-Saudi-s-Jizan-in-retaliatory-operation) reported that Yemeni Armed Forces targeted Saudi Arabia's Jizan region in a retaliatory operation following Saudi fighter jet strikes on Sana'a.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1010283/saudi-arabia-says-it-intercepted-three-houthi-missiles-targeting-riyadh/story/) reported that the Saudi-led coalition stated it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired towards Riyadh.
