reports.text: [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188349-injury-toll-in-russian-attack-on-kyiv-rises-to-three.html) reported that the number of people injured in a Russian drone strike on a courtyard of an apartment building in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district rose to three.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064543/) reported that Russia struck an energy site and businesses in Zhytomyr and Poltava oblasts.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064549/) reported that Russian forces struck a power generation facility in Odesa Oblast, damaging utility vehicles and cutting electricity to roughly 9,000 consumers.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064554/) reported that a Russian attack on gas production infrastructure in Poltava Oblast triggered a major halt in operations.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxNVVJGWmhSeU5uWXkwNElJa0F4SFVNaGFObjNhWThIblk0dTkzeW9wVUhwZS0yVzYtQjY3NHd5V3A1MUQ4c1hzQm5WTGhmMXBoQ2R3aDNweHUwalV2bFZJNkZHWGI1akhWMW5sY0VoUVE0SXRDOXN4NWpNRTFyQmFyLUx2b1lhaG9NNWJRTkhjVHV4Z0d6NFliQklkel9SVzhUbGJGY0h0Vzg5czZaYmc?oc=5), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/russian-overnight-strikes-kill-two-in-odesa-set-kyiv-apartment-block-ablaze/articleshow/136151848.cms) reported that Russian overnight strikes killed two people in Ukraine's Odesa region.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/russian-overnight-strikes-kill-two-in-odesa-set-kyiv-apartment-block-ablaze/articleshow/136151848.cms) reported that overnight Russian attacks also set a Kyiv apartment block ablaze.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attack-kills-1-damages-commercial-infrastructure-in-kyiv-oblast/) reported that a Russian attack killed one person and damaged commercial infrastructure in Kyiv Oblast.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188201-russian-drone-hits-energy-repair-crews-vehicle-in-dnipropetrovsk-region.html) reported that a Russian FPV drone hit a vehicle belonging to a DTEK mobile repair crew near a frontline village in Dnipropetrovsk region.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91104) reported that Russian strikes killed a 17-year-old boy and a 41-year-old man in the Odesa region, and injured three others including a 12-year-old girl.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064462/) reported that Russian forces struck a civilian business in the Sarny district in Rivne Oblast, sparking a fire with no casualties reported.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1586275/russian-overnight-attack-injures-22-in-zaporizhzhia/) reported that a Russian overnight attack killed two people and injured 22 others in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia, including two children.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064430/) reported that a Russian FPV drone struck a DTEK energy workers' vehicle inspecting power lines in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast on November 23 with no workers injured.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064444/) reported that Russian forces attacked Dnipro, damaging a high-rise residential building and injuring at least four people according to Governor Oleksandr Hanzha.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064440/) reported that Russian forces attacked a farm and wheat warehouses in Odesa Oblast with no casualties reported.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064502/) reported that Russian attacks on Odesa Oblast killed two people, aged 41 and 17, and injured three others, including a 12-year-old child.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188254-russian-strikes-on-odesa-region-kill-two-including-17yearold-boy-injure-three.html) reported that Russian forces struck the Odesa region, killing a man and a 17-year-old boy and injuring three people.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188043-russian-drone-attack-on-korosten-railway-station-kills-one-injury-toll-rises-to-three.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91047) reported that a Russian drone attack on the Korosten railway station in Zhytomyr region killed one person and injured others.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064366/) reported that a Russian FPV drone attack on Zaporizhzhia injured a woman who is now in serious condition.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attacks-kill-9-injure-77-across-ukraine-over-past-day-zaporizhzhia-residential-building-massively-hit/) reported that Russian attacks killed nine people and injured 81 across Ukraine over the past day, partially destroying a five-story residential building in Zaporizhzhia Oblast.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/ukraine-says-russian-strike-southeast-city-kills-two-wounds-dozens.1137569) reported that a Russian air strike in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region killed two people and wounded 40 others.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxQRl9vM3Z6UzJTZlZjU3JmcDhQem1tVS1rMS1yemtlVjFicVlnZjVqTFRBUGlrWG1LTWU1b29waVI2NEthUnZFZ0VzMVRaclZDaURJNWk0MDNOdWtaQnJwU2RteUhISWdqYXg0R2VoSEd0S0ZKM01hVUxTS2pwbWZSOHdVNkRYUmVkRURSRTN6RmtvemF1bmFFZnUtZXZwU1JkV0hha3lLSGVoaGR2cE5hSTdIZ2pibk1W?oc=5) reported that a Russian attack killed two people in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/24/russian-strikes-kill-two-in-ukraine-s-zaporizhzhia-injure-dozens) reported that Russian forces struck Zaporizhzhia overnight on November 24, injuring dozens according to acting regional military administration head Mykhailo Semikin.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064330/) reported that Russian drones targeted the Pavlohrad, Samar, and Nikopol districts in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, injuring two men and causing fires.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064321/) reported that Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia destroyed a house, partially destroyed a five-storey residential building, and damaged transport infrastructure.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187890-russian-strikes-on-zaporizhzhia-leave-11-injured-houses-destroyed.html) reported that a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia left two people killed, 11 injured, and damaged apartment buildings, private houses, and a transport infrastructure facility.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064183/) reported that Oleksandr Honcharenko stated two people were killed and two injured after Russian forces attacked a marked evacuation vehicle in Kramatorsk.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187828-russian-forces-launch-40-strikes-on-dnipropetrovsk-region-in-one-day-killing-two-and-injuring-three.html) reported that Russian forces launched more than 40 attacks on six districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region, killing two people and injuring three.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attacks-kill-4-including-15-year-old-boy-injure-19-across-ukraine-over-past-day/) reported that Russian attacks across Ukraine killed four people, including a 15-year-old boy, and injured 19 over the past day.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064178/) reported that Russian forces struck a former private clinic in Zaporizhzhia, killing three people and injuring one.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064095/) reported that a Russian guided aerial bomb hit an apartment building in Sloviansk, Donetsk Oblast, damaging nine residential buildings and leaving several casualties.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/russian-air-strike-leaves-sloviansk-health-centre-in-ruins-3725871) reported that a Russian air strike left a health centre in ruins in Sloviansk, Ukraine, with one person trapped beneath the rubble.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187484-russian-forces-strike-sloviansk-killing-two-injuring-three-others.html) reported that Russian forces shelled Sloviansk in the Donetsk region, killing two people and injuring three others.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187359-russians-attack-zaporizhzhia-leaving-one-killed.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90855) reported that Russian shelling in Zaporizhzhia killed a man in the Zavodskyi district.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/russian-kab-500-bombing-hits-residential-buildings-in-sloviansk-3725828) reported that a Russian KAB 500 bomb damaged buildings and left a crater in Sloviansk.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90842) reported that Russian forces carried out an aerial bombardment of Sloviansk using FAB-250 bombs, injuring five civilians and damaging a university and hospital.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187254-three-people-injured-in-russian-attack-on-zaporizhzhia-including-two-children.html) reported that three people, including two children, were injured in a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia.

[Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d9%8a%d9%88%d9%85-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b7%d9%81%d9%84-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b9%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d9%8a-%d8%a8%d8%b9%d9%8a%d9%88%d9%86-%d8%b3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%8a%d9%91%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b4%d9%87%d9%8a/) reported that on Universal Children's Day, Syrian state media noted the anniversary through the cases of Hamza al-Khateeb and Tamer al-Sharai.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190662/%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D9%81%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A-350-%D8%B7%D9%81%D9%84%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%B3%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84) reported that the Palestine Prisoners Studies Center stated that 350 Palestinian children in Israeli occupation prisons face various forms of torture, abuse, starvation, and medical neglect.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187086-injury-toll-in-russian-attacks-on-kryvyi-rih-rises-to-60.html) reported that the number of people injured in Russian attacks on Kryvyi Rih rose to 60, with 28 people remaining in hospital.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063901/) reported that a jet-powered Russian drone struck an industrial facility in Kryvyi Rih overnight, causing a fire.

reports.text: [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1124/1600432-poland-russia-ukraine/) reported that Poland stated a Russian reconnaissance drone briefly entered its airspace during an overnight attack on Ukraine.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90854607) reported that NATO is considering a stronger military presence in Europe and deployed an early warning radar plane following Russian missile and drone breaches of Polish airspace.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/finland-summons-russian-ambassador-over-unacceptable-actions-in-europe-3725931) reported that Finland's Foreign Ministry summoned Russia's ambassador for talks, calling Moscow's dangerous and irresponsible actions in Europe unacceptable.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/24/russia-ukraine-poland-drone-patriots-latest-news-updates), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064344/) reported that Poland's Defence Ministry believes Russia deliberately sent a drone across the Ukrainian border into Polish airspace.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064315/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187891-russian-drone-enters-polish-airspace-during-attack-on-ukraine.html) reported that a Russian drone entered Polish airspace during an attack on Ukraine and the Polish military refrained from shooting it down due to risks.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-unmanned-aerial-vehicle-violates-polish-airspace-days-after-missile-incursion/) reported that Poland's Government Security Center issued an air-attack alert in parts of the Lublin region after a Russian unmanned aerial vehicle violated airspace.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90985) reported that Poland's military authorized the destruction of the drone but withheld firing due to safety risks.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/finland-summons-russian-ambassador-as-it-condemns-russias-dangerous-and-reckless-actions-i) reported that Finland summoned the Russian ambassador after a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating Finnish airspace.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064207/) reported that Poland will summon Russian ambassador Georgy Mikhno following a 20 November airspace violation.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064278/) reported that NATO's allied aircraft will complement ground-based systems following Russian missiles violating Polish airspace.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90373428) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump stated in an interview with Fox News that Vladimir Putin launched several missiles toward Poland by mistake.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/nato-parliamentary-assembly-convenes-amid-russian-airspace-violations/live-80016415?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and German Foreign Minister Wadephul are set to address the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin amid discussions on Russian airspace violations.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90376380) reported that NATO convened an emergency meeting after two Russian missiles and a drone entered Polish airspace.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/23/all-three-flying-objects-that-fell-in-poland-turned-out-to-be-russian-x-101-cruise-missiles) reported that debris recovered in all three Polish towns where objects fell during the overnight attack on Ukraine turned out to be Russian X-101 cruise missiles.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064097/) reported that missile debris recovered at three sites in Poland has been identified as belonging to Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/poland-identifies-russian-cruise-missiles-behind-strikes-near-ukraine-border-nato-to-hold-discussions-101795373162372.html) reported that Poland Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated missile impacts near the Nowa Dęba military training ground were unlikely to be coincidental.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/polish-prosecutors-office-points-that-three-russian-missiles-hit-poland-on-friday/), a state-run outlet, reported that the Prosecutor's Office in Lubin investigating the incident indicated three Russian systems impacted Polish soil.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNM1VMUS1oUkxlYzRWaDg5WjNPbGJoV2t1LTlRNkVMWnF6a3Q3aUljXzlCal9hWmdhWnlkYzdKNjdFVGdwVk1WUFFucGdfbUlnY3RtUjBsdFBxVTdmTGNjcnJ1a0VDNnk5eFh5NDdWaGNWcjNWcFI2WkoxZnFUbkI5UHZ6YTdYZUVMa19Ldk5YTERtX3ZialpvbjI4eFVoQ0Eyd2l0NGxoVQ?oc=5) reported that prosecutors stated three Russian missiles flew into Poland on Friday.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/moldova-finland-report-russian-airspace-violations-day-after-suspected-russian-missiles-flew-into-poland/) reported that Moldova and Finland reported separate instances of airspace violations by Russia.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90845) reported that wreckage from a Russian Kh-101 cruise missile that crashed in Poland was manufactured in Russia in late 2026.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/russian-helicopter-suspected-of-violating-finnish-airspace/a-80010133?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Finland's Defense Ministry thinks a suspected Russian helicopter airspace incursion is linked to an earlier drone strike on a Russian cargo ship.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90848) reported that a jet-powered unmanned aerial vehicle violated Moldova's airspace twice during a Russian aerial attack on Ukraine.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89816890) reported that a new jet-powered drone violated the airspace of the Republic of Moldova amidst Russian attacks on Ukraine.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-three-airspace-violations_n_6b004317e4b0976dc4a2f08e) reported that Poland condemned three airspace violations by Russia as a provocation.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186925-trump-claims-putin-sent-drones-and-little-missiles-into-poland-by-mistake.html), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/trump-says-putin-launched-a-couple-of-small-missiles-into-poland-by-accident-a-couple-of-little-missiles) reported that US President Donald Trump claimed Russian drones and missiles entered Polish territory by mistake.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-airspace-violations?traffic_source=rss) reported that Poland condemned a Russian provocation after airspace violations during European troop exercises.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89556156) reported that Moldova's permanent representative to the OSCE strongly condemned violations of national airspace amid Russian attacks on Ukraine.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-11-20/ukraine-war-spills-over-into-eastern-poland.html) reported that residents of eastern Polish border regions live with SMS alerts about Russian attacks and the sound of fighter jets as the Ukraine war spills over.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186768-ukraine-cooperating-with-poland-in-probe-into-airspace-violation-fm-sybiha.html) reported that Ukraine is working closely with Poland to assist in investigating the airspace violation during Russia's massive attack.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/20/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-3-airspace-violations-a94331) reported that Poland condemned a Russian provocation after three airspace violations.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/unidentified-object-falls-in-eastern-poland-amid-major-russian-attack-on-ukraine), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063740/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90676), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/9f4712724be0), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/poland-reports-airspace-violation-during-russian-attack-on-ukraine-investigates-debris-crash/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186756-poland-investigating-crash-of-unidentified-object-near-border-during-russian-attack-on-ukraine.html) reported that Poland is investigating a possible airspace violation or falling unidentified object during a Russian attack on Ukraine.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90692) reported that Poland evacuated its Rzeszow Airport control tower for the first time during the attack.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89347044) reported that Germany reaffirmed its defense commitments to Moldova and prioritized airspace protection following repeated Russian drone incursions.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89297987) reported that an unidentified drone entered Moldovan airspace from Ukraine, traveling for nine minutes from the Vinnytsia region.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88193791) reported that fragments of a Gerbera-2 drone were discovered near the village of Cuhureștii de Sus following a November 17 incursion.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185880-debris-of-russian-gerbera2-drone-found-in-moldova.html) reported that drone debris was also found near the village of Naslavcea in Moldova's Ocnița district.

[Hungary Today](https://hungarytoday.hu/hungarian-conservatives-condemn-russian-drone-attack-on-ukraines-transcarpathia/) reported that several Russian drones struck Ukraine’s Transcarpathian region, targeting areas around Mukachevo.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88197893) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha condemned the incursion of Russian drones into Moldovan airspace.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88020919) reported that police located aircraft fragments near the village of Pohrebeni in the Orhei district following airspace violations.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87567475) reported that Moldovan Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Affairs Minister Mihai Popsoi condemned the violation of national airspace by a Shahed-type drone.

reports.text: [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/the-debate/20261124-the-bukele-method-will-salvadoran-leader-s-strong-arm-tactics-work-for-haiti) reported that citizens of Haiti are cheering the Salvadoran president's method.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/el-salvador-clears-bukele-third-term/) reported that El Salvador’s Supreme Electoral Tribunal registered Bukele and Ulloa for the February 28, 2027 vote.

[Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/jovenes-se-manifiesta-para-exigir-inversion-social-y-rechazan-el-envio-de-tropas-a-haiti/) reported that young Salvadoran demonstrators took to the streets to demand social investment and reject the deployment of troops to Haiti.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/bukele-vira-heroi-no-haiti-com-guerra-a-gangues-apos-sumico-de-militares-envolto-em-misterio.shtml) reported that four Salvadoran military personnel who were members of an international gang-fighting force instituted by the UN in Haiti disappeared on October 18.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/tribunal-electoral-salvadoreno-oficializa-la-candidatura-presidencial-de-bukele-para-buscar-tercer-mandato-33283296) reported that the Salvadoran electoral tribunal officialized Nayib Bukele's presidential candidacy to seek a third consecutive mandate.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/bukele-shares-details-on-deaths-of-salvadoran-troops-in-haiti-intervention?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bukele shared details on the deaths of Salvadoran troops in the Haiti intervention following the kidnapping of four technicians by gangs in October.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNSEV2cEFJbWwwUnh4OTBzdW1jQTlfdG5MdWxCN2YtaDNmSGpvN2c5MEZYLWwxTkdIYnUtQ0xQYXVYTktNV01Hc3hlTFgtVm9hQkV0ejhqV3pzSXluOFJ2X3RoWHRQLU1CZVR4R1dCVlNPc1pKTHZzMWRVVGlSVDJ5dWpydGFpUUUtaXpMSThxQVFsbV9YNXNDV3QyTDRTQQ?oc=5) reported that El Salvador's President Bukele revealed how three Salvadoran soldiers died fighting gangs in Haiti.
[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/23/what-are-haiti-security-forces/) reported that six main forces are involved in the effort to fight gangs in Haiti.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/bukele-lleva-guerra-pandillas-haiti_202611226b027809c0d5c85b96c4490e.html) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele sent 2,500 soldiers to Haiti following the disappearance of four soldiers.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/22/operacao-militar-de-el-salvador-no-haiti-ignora-mandato-da-onu-e-exporta-modelo-bukele-sob-temor-de-excessos.ghtml) reported that thousands of Haitians marched in Port-au-Prince while El Salvador's military operation in Haiti ignores a UN mandate.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bukele-for-third-consecutive-term-office/) reported that Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy to seek a third consecutive term as president of El Salvador in February 2027 following constitutional reform.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/salvadoran-military-is-teaching-haitis-gangs-a-lesson-bukele/), a Salvadoran state-media outlet, reported that approximately 2,500 Salvadoran soldiers are participating in a mission in Haiti.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/20/nayib-bukele-third-term-el-salvador-haiti-troops/) reported that El Salvador President Nayib Bukele's deployment of 2,500 troops to Haiti draws scrutiny over security and democracy.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/nayib-bukele-va-por-un-tercer-mandato-en-el-salvador-asi-fue-el-camino-de-reformas-que-permitio-su-nueva-candidatura-necesitamos-seis-anos-mas-3602666) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy for the February 2027 elections to seek a third presidential term.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/20/salvador-le-president-bukele-profite-de-sa-reforme-constitutionnelle-pour-se-presenter-a-un-troisieme-mandat_6813581_3210.html) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele formalized his candidacy for a third presidential term after constitutional modifications in 2025.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/el-salvadors-bukele-expected-to-formalise-bid-for-third-presidential-term?traffic_source=rss), [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxPOFQyR3VjRGNVUmZDV3lMOGdubmRvbU1tbTZsMTNLQ2x2QkUwSzVSLUE3RThET0xBQ3RmVEVWZS10b1JKZGxZNUVNNUMzZjROUVN5Yk4xc2ZlbTdhZDlCVUxKX1FFYmctY1huMG9yejFxT3ZxbE92cno3V1RnYWJKUXVPZjRxZmZJRVBkVTNBU0hxNUFzNUJuWmY2d3VYSWlqRnFudXNvcVR6UmhURGRFNw?oc=5) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele seeks a third presidential term while his forces fight gangs in Haiti.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/nayib-bukele-inscribe-su-candidatura-para-las-elecciones-de-2027-en-el-salvador-33223136), [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/apos-retirar-limites-de-mandatos-bukele-registra-candidatura-para-se-manter-no-poder-em-el-salvador.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele registered his candidacy to run for a third term in the February 28 elections.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/19/haitians-brooklyn-rally-bukele-haiti-gangs/) reported that Haitian demonstrators gathered in Brooklyn to support Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele as his forces continued military operations against gangs in Haiti.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261119-haiti-salvador-s-bukele-publishes-video-of-attack-on-gang-leader-s-house) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele stated his troops demolished the lavish home of a prominent gang leader in Haiti known as Jeff Gwo Lwa.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/nayib-bukele-reacciona-a-las-multitudinarias-marchas-de-apoyo-en-haiti-y-promete-una-victoria-contra-las-pandillas-nunca-espere-algo-asi-3602255) El Tiempo reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele reacted to large-scale marches of support in Haiti, promising victory against armed gangs.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/bukele-confirms-airstrike-on-haitian-gang-leader-jeffs-luxury-mansion) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele confirmed an airstrike destroying the luxury mansion of Haitian gang leader Jeff Larose.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/bukele-anuncia-que-militares-salvadorenos-destruyeron-la-casa-de-un-jefe-pandillero-en-haiti-33197904) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele published a video showing military helicopters attacking the house of gang leader Jeff Gwo Lwa in Haiti.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/haiti-formaliza-acordo-com-el-salvador-enquanto-tropas-de-bukele-atacam-gangues.shtml) reported that Haiti formalized a cooperation agreement with El Salvador on the same day thousands marched in Port-au-Prince.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/miles-de-personas-marchan-en-haiti-en-respaldo-a-operaciones-de-tropas-militares-de-el-salvador-en-el-pais-presidente-nayib-bukele-reacciono-3601946) reported that thousands of people marched in Haiti in support of military troop operations by El Salvador.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPMVp1by1yclVIYnJfVnZTOEo0LWk2TFE4ampJMlFTdGVudVRMM2FROVpOUFp3WkZfTU5FVWZYMGx5OUE5d2M1TGU3UEMtUUk4Wk90cGdNeFA5dVJFT3BSSFhUeXM3azg2N1VYUEozVGRMNGw4ZlphRE9xZXRhZjlPZmJnbGx1V2c5WXZOV0pQcnktSGVHc0QtQXhzVkVGaFVURkhFdA?oc=5), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3374964/el-salvadors-bukele-says-his-troops-destroyed-gang-leaders-mansion-haiti) reported that El Salvador’s President Nayib J. Bukele confirmed and celebrated that his troops had destroyed or demolished the home of a key Haitian gang leader known as Jeff.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/18/bukele-strikes-gang-leader-home-vertieres-day/) reported that the operation marks the second reported strike on a gang leader’s residence by Salvadoran forces, following a previous attack on the home of Wilson “Lanmò San Jou”.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/bukele-diz-que-militares-salvadorenhos-destruiram-casa-de-chefe-de-gangue-no-haiti.shtml) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced the destruction of a Haitian gang leader's house during an offensive.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/haitians-rally-in-celebration-of-el-salvadors-anti-gang-troop-deployment?traffic_source=rss), [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/17/haitians-take-streets-support-el-salvador-troops/), [Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/18/haitians-demonstrate-in-support-of-el-salvadors-bukele-and-anti-gang-troops/) reported that thousands of Haitians took to the streets in Port-au-Prince to celebrate and thank El Salvador's anti-gang military troop deployment.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/18/haiti-formalises-security-pact-with-el-salvador-as-thousands-march-in-support-of-bukele) reported that Haiti formalised a security pact with El Salvador as thousands marched in support of Bukele, and noted the UN recorded 4,595 deaths and 2,050 injuries due to armed violence in Haiti in the first 10 months of 2026.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941169) reported that thousands of people poured into the streets of Port-au-Prince and beyond to praise El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261118-haitians-rally-behind-bukele-as-salvadoran-troops-battle-gangs) reported that thousands of Haitians took to the streets to urge El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele to continue fighting gangs as Salvadoran troops bolstered security forces.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/policias-militares-y-soldados-de-bukele-haiti-suma-fuerzas-contra-las-pandillas-pero-sigue-sin-saber-como-recuperar-el-control-3601736) reported that a Crisis Group report warned that a lack of coordination exposes the civilian population and called for strengthening Haitian institutions.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/17/haitians-rally-bukele-salvadoran-troops-haiti/) reported that thousands of people in Port-au-Prince demonstrated to praise Nayib Bukele and Salvadoran troops, as a new report warned that Haiti lacks a long-term plan to confront gangs.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/haiti-praises-salvadoran-troop-deployment-ahead-of-bukele-talks-101794861044668.html) reported that Haiti praised the deployment of Salvadoran troops ahead of talks with President Nayib Bukele.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/haiti-weighs-future-of-salvadoran-troops/) reported that Haiti's prime minister is due in El Salvador on November 16 and 17 to discuss Salvadoran troops, while a gang leader asks the UN for talks.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/bukele-sera-el-salvador-de-haiti-los-riesgos-y-las-alertas-alrededor-de-su-ultima-gran-apuesta-nid14112026/) reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele launched a mission with more than 2,000 soldiers in Haiti.

[The Haitian Times](https://haitiantimes.com/2026/11/14/el-salvador-bukele-model-haiti-gang-offensive/) reported that El Salvador deployed roughly 2,500 troops to Haiti as President Nayib Bukele exports his hard-line security model.
[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/bukele-security-model-haiti/) reported that 2,000 Salvadoran troops deployed to Haiti outside UN command.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/14/mundo/018n2mun?partner=rss), a state-media outlet, reported that Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced that his soldiers, in coordination with Haitian police and military, took control.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/una-operacion-incomoda-para-trump-el-papel-de-estados-unidos-en-la-intervencion-militar-de-nayib-bukele-en-haiti-3600839) reported that the United States has found itself in an awkward position regarding Nayib Bukele's military intervention in Haiti due to a lack of operational coordination.

reports.text: [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915697) reported that police moved to disperse ultra-Orthodox protesters blocking the Jerusalem light rail following the arrest of a draft dodger.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-18/cc-oo-acudira-a-los-tribunales-por-la-actuacion-policial-en-la-huelga-general-buena-parte-de-las-personas-golpeadas-son-de-nuestro-sindicato.html) reported that the Workers' Commissions union will go to court over police actions during the general strike, stating a good portion of the people beaten belonged to their union.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/spain-workers-1-general-strike-14-years/) reported that Spain's unions and tenant groups united across more than 50 cities in a general strike to demand rent caps, higher wages, and price controls.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/spain/2026-11-12/spains-general-strike-draws-uneven-participation-and-large-street-protests.html) reported that demonstrations during Spain's general strike were overwhelmingly peaceful, although clashes were recorded in Madrid and Barcelona.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/marlaska-ordena-ahora-investigar-actuacion-policial-huelga-general_202611126af5837403bbf30bb049669c.html) reported that the Interior Minister ordered an investigation into police actions during the general strike and instructed agents not to use tear gas in demonstrations.

reports.text: [El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-20/the-collapse-of-building-1321-the-tragedy-that-exposed-new-yorks-cracks.html) reported that the collapse of building 1321 in New York led families to seek justice for eight victims and residents to denounce negligent landlords.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/18/remains-ecuadorian-killed-new-york-city-building-collapse-arrive/) reported that the remains of one of two Ecuadorian construction workers killed in a New York City building collapse were returned to Quito.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/brooklyn-building-collapse-lawsuit) reported that Dengane Omari Jack filed a lawsuit against his landlord and multiple construction companies following a fatal building collapse in Brooklyn.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOMjI1ZmhJQVcyOGtfNHFaWDBBTVJkWGF4NFZxaGprVmNieXFfOEFQSXV1RVZQRzF3c0xabzhsVTlEQ2dGU3k4blUxeW5jY0RVbU1RSDNWU3BSc1ViaFBoa3B4ajBkVnB4aXVqVGMyTjM5TmNoX29fMjg0Y3ZiNnlqWmdERS13aGZ6a3NDR0hDdGw4VFhXeW1pY2FvNXJpYkNFN3I3N2ZpdXI0QQ?oc=5) reported that Isaac, a cat missing since the Brooklyn building collapse, was reunited with its young owner.

reports.text: [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046874/imran-asks-pti-to-reach-out-to-fazl-other-parties) reported that the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf core committee was briefed on jailed founder Imran Khan's instructions to expand its political alliance and reach out to Fazlur Rehman and other parties.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642048/imran-asks-pti-to-reach-out-to-fazlur-rehman-expand-opposition-alliance), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046742/imran-wants-pti-to-expand-political-alliance-extend-outreach-to-fazl-and-other-opposition-parties-core-committee-told) reported that incarcerated PTI founder Imran Khan instructed his party's core committee to expand its political alliance and reach out to Fazlur Rehman and other opposition parties.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1586208/imran-bushra-seek-live-coverage-of-190m-case-appeals/) reported that former prime minister Imran Khan and his wife Bushra Bibi sought live streaming of their 190 million pound case appeals in the Islamabad High Court.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046751/pti-moves-ihc-for-live-broadcast-of-al-qadir-trust-case-hearing) reported that the Pakistan Tehreek-i-Insaf filed a petition in the Islamabad High Court seeking a live broadcast of the appeal proceedings in the £190 million reference case.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046539/ptis-zafar-says-karachi-can-become-separate-province-imran-khan-favours-new-administrative-units) reported that PTI parliamentary leader in the Senate Barrister Ali Zafar stated that Karachi could become a separate province and that Imran Khan favors new administrative units.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641909/imran-khan-may-be-engaged-on-new-provinces-if-needed-says-tariq-fazal) reported that Tariq Fazal stated Imran Khan may be engaged on new provinces if needed, while the PPP warned against imposing decisions through referendums.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/ihc-grants-barrister-gohar-more-time-to-submit-reply-in-imran-khans-x-account-case/) reported that the Islamabad High Court granted PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan additional time to submit a reply in a case.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/ex-pakistan-pm-imran-khan-needs-immediate-help-to-prevent-heart-damage-delay-could-lead-to-serious-consequences-101795402560694.html) reported that Pakistan's Imran Khan needs immediate help to prevent heart damage, warning in an open letter that he may not return alive.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585157/ihc-schedules-appeals-in-190m-pounds-case-for-nov-25/) reported that the Islamabad High Court scheduled appeals filed by PTI founder Imran Khan and his wife Bushra Bibi in the 190 million pounds case for November 25.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584955/pti-founder-bushra-bibi-undergo-medical-checkups/) reported that a special medical team examined PTI founder Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi at Adiala Jail.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/imran-khan-bushra-bibi-190-million-al-qadir-trust-case-fixed-for-hearing-on-nov-25/) reported that the Islamabad High Court scheduled appeals filed by Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf founder Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi in the £190 million Al-Qadir Trust case for hearing on Nov 25.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxQbV96NTNUd3dRQ0lPcG5mb1U0UjR5Q2Y2VFhrWVpYQ3JadjZhcFdVWUp4cmpJUFRYVEJUZHBYNlVzVG92ZFRTX3F4dVNEU0xkU3dLMVRzUWp1VTg5dDdONEZOcWFxREJ4cDZ5XzdpR1NYM1JFRjd4c3pIQWlQYmVnaWpxY3dtVmt6OFo0NEUyUzVMVF9yODNMajd5Q2xJOVJyYmI3MVlUbUNkNEl1bTJWODlqUnJZRlBxRWZocmhNdVBvVXM1?oc=5), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/i-call-for-imran-khans-release-un-rights-chief-flags-ex-pakistan-pms-health-jail-conditions/articleshow/136013041.cms) reported that the UN human rights chief urged Pakistan to release Imran Khan and raised alarm over jail conditions.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641245/un-rights-chief-calls-for-imran-khans-release-urges-political-de-escalation) reported that the UN rights chief called for Imran Khan's release and urged political de-escalation while Amnesty stated Imran faces solitary confinement and denial of medical care.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583656/ihc-orders-medical-examination-improved-facilities-for-bushra-bibi/) reported that the Islamabad High Court took serious notice of complaints by Bushra Bibi regarding medical difficulties.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640983/ihc-orders-medical-care-for-bushra-bibi-in-jail-amid-eyesight-concerns), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045411/ps190m-corruption-case-ihc-directs-proper-medical-care-hygienic-living-conditions-for-bushra-bibi) reported that the Islamabad High Court directed prison authorities to ensure proper medical care and hygienic living conditions for Bushra Bibi.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045191/8-pakistan-bar-council-members-call-on-judiciary-to-take-note-of-imrans-plea-for-medical-treatment) reported that eight members of the Pakistan Bar Council called upon the judiciary to ensure implementation of the Supreme Court's order regarding Imran Khan's medical treatment.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxNUm9CVHJndDZlZ0dWQk9mbGJyNmNRcmpsVHRmM3IwYkxtUjl0UFlkUXhyVHNMTjhMSGNnQ0Z1NEd5UmlselRYUUxvQ2ctTV81SEhEMEtWcFU4eDh2NDZxNDZDZXJxOEJKbW5CZnZPME1vUlRKakhiNXNsZ05JV09Ial9ybEl6VDUxOHNHNFVld1JEaGZoWEdVcVY5NkxRQ19yQ1JCMXJ6MXpHcUVYdFdRU1VmT3MxNTZBbEtscW5zVnJVLVQz?oc=5) reported that Azma Bokhari called Imran Khan's medical concerns propaganda.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/imran-khan-sons-accuse-pakistan-govt-of-torturing-former-pm-health-risks-imprisonment-latest-updates-101794892907522.html) reported that Sulaiman Isa Khan and Kasim Khan stated that former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan's health has deteriorated after over three years in solitary confinement and accused the government of torturing him.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/jailed-pakistan-ex-pm-imran-khan-writes-to-judges-seeks-vital-medical-care?traffic_source=rss), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/i-may-not-return-alive-imran-khan-asks-courts-for-treatment-says-22-hour-isolation-is-killing-him/articleshow/135893352.cms) reported that jailed former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan wrote to judges stating he may not return alive and seeking medical care for himself and his wife.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640599/i-may-not-return-alive-imran-urges-top-judges-to-enforce-court-orders-ensure-medical-treatment), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582222/imran-khan-writes-to-top-judges-detailing-severe-health-risks-and-isolation-in-prison/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044922/i-may-not-return-alive-in-open-letter-to-top-judges-imran-pleads-for-medical-treatment-for-him-and-bushra-bibi) reported that Imran Khan wrote an open letter to top judges detailing severe health risks and appealing for medical treatment for himself and Bushra Bibi.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/imran-khan-seeks-medical-treatment-for-himself-and-bushra-bibi-in-open-letter-to-top-judges/) reported that Imran Khan sought medical treatment in an open letter to the chief justice of Pakistan.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582223/lawyers-submit-affidavits-detailing-severe-health-and-sanitary-issues-for-imran-khan-and-bushra-bibi/) reported that lawyers submitted affidavits detailing severe health and sanitary issues for Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582310/imran-khan-expected-to-meet-lawyers-on-tuesday/) reported that Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf submitted a list of six lawyers to jail authorities for an expected meeting with party founder Imran Khan.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044913/lawyers-submit-affidavits-detailing-nov-11-meeting-with-imran-bushra-at-adiala-jail) reported that lawyers for Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi submitted affidavits detailing a jail meeting to the Islamabad High Court.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/imran-khan-asim-munir-deal-sisters-release-from-jail-hospital-visit-spark-buzz-in-pakistan/articleshow/135801979.cms) reported that the release of Imran Khan's sisters from jail and a hospital visit sparked buzz regarding a potential deal in Pakistan.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640124/fact-check-viral-video-of-noreen-and-uzma-is-old-not-of-release-from-kot-lakhpat-jail) reported that a viral video claiming to show Noreen and Uzma's release from Kot Lakhpat jail is old and originated from an August 10, 2026 TikTok clip.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-check/misused-jonvic-remulla-video-bato-dela-rosa-icc-warrant/) reported that an old Remulla interview clip was misused to falsely claim Dela Rosa has no ICC warrant.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxQa2Q2R3V4NmxCVC01TnNYZDUzUzVqNEpOUEphazdhbUlyRHFsQkhlRHFST05tQ2ZhcWtmSGNfYW02SE91RVVwV0d4OHY0WG1PTGcwcXdUYUoxOWh6TUhMY0VfZzdVSmN0eTZMWXN5QXl5MWJoLW1BczlZZ2ZCLWU0MkNXbmFFNmV4VzNyZHZqRi0?oc=5) reported that Imran Khan's two sisters were released after weeks in detention.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580849/imran-khans-sisters-released-from-jail-following-backchannel-political-understandings/) reported that the release followed backchannel political understandings.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/pakistan-releases-two-sisters-of-ex-pm-imran-khan-from-jail?traffic_source=rss) reported that Aleema Khan remains detained nearly two months after their arrest.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639924/uzma-khan-noreen-niazi-released-after-50-days-in-detention) reported that Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi were released after 50 days in detention, while PTI founder's sister Aleema Khan remains incarcerated at Kot Lakhpat Jail.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044037/imrans-sisters-uzma-noreen-released-from-jail-after-extended-detention-orders-withdrawn-says-lawyer) reported that Dr Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi were released from Kot Lakhpat jail following the withdrawal of their extended detention orders.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639913/fazal-chaudhry-rules-out-any-possibility-of-deal-leniency-for-pti-after-imrans-sisters-released) reported that Fazal Chaudhry ruled out any possibility of a deal or leniency for PTI and stated that rumours of backdoor channel talks are baseless.

reports.text: [UK Defence Journal](https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/nato-sends-awacs-forward-after-russian-incursion-into-poland/) reported that NATO forward deployed an AWACS aircraft following Russian missile and drone incursions into Polish airspace.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064413/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that restrictions on the use of SpaceX's Starshield terminals for military personnel continue to be recorded.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223625), a Russian state outlet, reported that NATO announced the deployment of AWACS early warning aircraft to Poland following ambassador discussions on airspace violations.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/poland-russia-airspace-ukraine-drone-b3090416.html) reported that Poland will deploy an early-warning aircraft after an object entered its airspace and that the drone was not shot down due to concerns regarding risks to civilians.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-23-nato-to-send-early-warning-system-aircraft-to-poland-after-missiles-incident/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91000) reported that NATO will deploy an AWACS early-warning system aircraft to Poland following a missile incident.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/23/4983508_nato_izprashta_samolet_za_ranno_preduprejdenie_v/?ref=rss) reported that NATO is sending an early warning aircraft to Poland following a missile incident, according to a Polish deputy defense minister.
[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23983014) reported that NATO will deploy an AWACS military aircraft to Poland as part of its response to the incident involving three missiles.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/polish-authorities-find-russian-missile-remains-at-three-sites-following-airspace-incursion/) reported that the Lublin District Prosecutor's Office announced that debris from Kh-101 cruise missiles was discovered at three sites in eastern Poland following an airspace incursion.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90841) reported that NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte pledged in Warsaw that the alliance will defend every inch of Polish territory.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90830) reported that Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz announced Poland will receive strong support from NATO allies to strengthen border security.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/swedish-gripen-pilot-unable-to-shoot-down-suspected-russian-missile-over-poland-due-to-poor-weather-commander-says/) reported that a Swedish Gripen pilot participating in a NATO air defense deployment was unable to shoot down a suspected Russian missile over Poland due to poor weather.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/nato-pledges-to-defend-poland-after-russian-missile-incursion/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that NATO chief Mark Rutte pledged to defend Poland after two Russian missiles hit its southeast during a meeting of the alliance's council in Brussels.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/russian-missiles-hit-poland-what-happened-and-could-nato-respond?traffic_source=rss) reported that Warsaw accused Moscow of intentional provocation after Russian missiles hit Poland, while the bar for triggering NATO's collective defense clause remains high.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063930/) reported that the pilot of a Swedish Gripen fighter jet patrolling Polish airspace during airspace violations on Friday 20 November was authorized to shoot down a Russian missile but unable to identify it.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90803) reported that a Swedish JAS 39 Gripen pilot received NATO authorization to shoot down a suspected Russian Kh-101 cruise missile during Friday’s airspace violation over southern Poland, but held fire due to weather.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90785) reported that European Union, British, and NATO leaders condemned Russia's overnight violation of Polish airspace.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641478/russian-missiles-land-in-poland-amid-nato-drills), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3375302/russian-missiles-land-poland-europe-holds-military-drills-nearby) reported that two Russian missiles and a suspected drone landed in Poland during European military drills, prompting the Polish prime minister to call it an intentional provocation.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/russia-fires-cruise-missile-into-poland-during-british-troop-drills/3IBFJX7GAZGOLJUZRDPA2ND3PY/) reported that Russia fired a cruise missile into Poland during British troop drills 100 kilometers from the exercise.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPb2dKNkEyLW5VNkNqNmI3U2lRMGcwUzZxUEUzb2FqTmVPYmFSZVhWYXM3Z0VfN3JfVi1FbkZydE5UWkRmNlhSZTFOa1pBLUpMaG5lRzZKbmJRYjdkcHZRYXlwWVlSQ3hoSUxwSzdtZDRld1FCSzVUUThhR1dicE5XbjNiSnc5VThLSGdpUkhrM2xueDRmR19DYg?oc=5), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/russian-missile-incursion-into-poland-seems-intentional-tusk-says/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that the Polish prime minister stated a Russian missile's crash in Poland was likely an intentional provocation.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063854/) reported that Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi was at Rzeszów-Jasionka Airport when Russian missiles and a drone violated Polish airspace.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQVGl6dU85bExfQlhuODY0Rkh6a3M2UVhRTlV1QmRsclI5ZHpRbWo5M3JIbUdydkRzOFNrZkZ6RDBIMHJVNGhqeklnRl9UVVAzRFpFUUk0OTVDVnU3RVh2VjdWZ2ktMUhMNmZZMUZkVDE5RFAtTjJ4UEZjUDlKZWd4YlhSaFBoYXdnYVI1ajFaRkdnTkpyMExkU0U4YjBHMTNSblZkRWt6aUVtTGJ5UWU1RVdrNA?oc=5), [Military.com](https://www.military.com/european-troops-from-11-countries-hold-a-drill-in-poland-for-a-potential-postwar-ukraine-mission) reported that European troops from 11 countries began a two-week military exercise in Poland on November 9 to test the coalition's ability to deploy in Ukraine once the war ends.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqx2x9dklxnro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/warsaw-says-russian-missiles-hit-poland-intentional-provocation.1137425), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/poland-says-russian-missile-that-crashed-in-its-territory-was-a-provocation-20261121-p61g3a.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the incident in which objects hit Poland as an intentional provocation from Moscow.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90744) reported that Donald Trump stated on Fox News that Russian drones and missiles had previously entered Poland by mistake.

[The Cipher Brief](https://www.thecipherbrief.com/washington-should-allow-ukraine-to-hit-russia-s-ballistic-missile-launchers) reported that a traveler to Ukraine visited soldiers and leaders in Kyiv, Dnipro, Pavlohrad, and Kharkiv, arguing that Washington should allow Ukraine to hit Russia's ballistic missile launchers.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/russian-missile-attacks-hit-major-bridges-across-kyiv/) reported that Russian ballistic missiles struck three bridges spanning the Dnipro River in Kyiv, killing six people.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-20/ukraine-russia-crimea-strikes-bridge-kyiv-power-outage-poland/107411538), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/russia-pummels-ukraine-putin-vowed-painful-attack.1137390) reported that Russia pummelled Ukraine with dozens of missiles and hundreds of drones overnight, killing eight people, hours after President Vladimir Putin vowed a painful response.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90708) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Ukraine destroyed one of three Russian ballistic missile launchers and downed 79 cruise missiles.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/89346957) reported that Russia proposed that European representatives travel to Moscow to clarify their position on peace talks concerning Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063766/) reported that the Ukrainian Prime Minister stated energy sites, businesses, and houses in nine oblasts and a wastewater facility in Kyiv were damaged, with the Kyiv death toll rising to six and 28 injured across Ukraine.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/cancilleria-de-peru-investiga-fallas-tecnicas-durante-la-ultima-misa-del-papa-leon-xiv-en-lima-empresas-contratistas-podrian-recibir-sanciones-3601533) reported that the Peruvian Chancellery is investigating technical failures during the Pope's final mass in Lima.

reports.text: [CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-24/DR-Congo-Ebola-deaths-near-5-800-as-infections-rise-1SkCcAykyVG/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that the death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reached 5,779 with 11,793 confirmed infections.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/ebola-death-toll-in-congo-far-higher-than-official-figures-suggest) reported that gravediggers in Bunia have been burying far more people than official Ebola death records indicate.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/25/world/science-health/ebola-violence-women-congo-unicef/) reported that UNICEF stated the Ebola epidemic in Congo has been tied to rising violence against women and girls and has killed more than 5,800 people since May.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/24/japan/japan-first-ebola-response-drill/) reported that the Japanese government held its first infectious disease response drill addressing Ebola amid the outbreak in Congo.
[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168865) reported that WHO staff and Ebola responders remain trapped in a hospital in Ituri province due to heavy fighting.

[The Telegraph](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/global-health/science-and-disease/trapped-ebola-health-workers-rescued-in-congo/) reported that trapped Ebola health workers were evacuated from a hospital under very challenging circumstances after three days of fighting.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-23/DRC-fighting-traps-health-workers-disrupts-Ebola-response-1SiVz3ihhQI/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that the WHO chief called for an immediate cessation of hostilities after heavy fighting broke out near a hospital in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, disrupting Ebola response efforts.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168858) reported that the WHO stated heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri province has disrupted Ebola response work and forced emergency evacuations.

[Reuters](https://news.google.?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/who-chief-calls-for-peace-amid-heavy-fighting-in-ebola-hit-dr-congo-region?traffic_source=rss), [Punch](https://punchng.com/who-chief-pleads-for-peace-in-ebola-hit-dr-congo-area/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the WHO chief stated that fighting near the Ebola outbreak area in the DR Congo disrupts response efforts.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/geography-violence-distrust-hitting-dr-congo-ebola-fight-handicap-international-3013396) reported that Handicap International stated geography, violence, and distrust are three major challenges hampering efforts to quell the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/scientists-are-learning-more-about-the-rare-ebola-virus-in-congo-outbreak-3013248) reported that researchers gained insights into the rare Bundibugyo strain during the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/congo-ebola-outbreak-africa-chidlren-b3088643.html) reported that more than 1,200 children under five contracted the rare Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261118-strain-specific-ebola-vaccines-to-be-trialled-in-drc-who-announces) reported that two vaccines against the Bundibugyo Ebola strain are set to enter trials in the outbreak's epicentre next week.

[Foreign Policy](https://foreignpolicy.com/2026/11/18/congo-ebola-outbreak-budnibugyo-constitution-conflict-m23/) reported that six months in, the out of control Ebola outbreak shows no sign of slowing down.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/a-hunger-crisis-is-making-ebola-even-deadlier-101794971716235.html) reported that an Ebola outbreak sweeping East Africa is fueling a hunger crisis that increases the chances of death for infected individuals.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168827) reported that the UN announced the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo more than doubled in three months, with over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths reported.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/ebola-congo-six-months-radio-children-b3086362.html) reported that children in DR Congo are sharing information on the airwaves to fight myths as the Ebola outbreak passes the six-month mark.

[Reuters](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that Barrick is furloughing some personnel at its Congo mine due to Ebola concerns.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/africa/congo-ebola-community-transmission.html) reported that health teams in eastern Congo struggle against fear and mistrust that drive fatal delays in seeking medical care during the Ebola outbreak.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170097.html) reported that Africa's top public health agency warned that the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo remains out of control six months after it was declared.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/Africa-CDC-warns-of-immense-challenges-over-fragile-Ebola-gains-1S7pjUCAWQ0/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that the Africa CDC warned of immense challenges over fragile Ebola gains as the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak spread to 67 health zones across eight provinces in the DR Congo with over 11,100 confirmed cases and more than 5,400 deaths.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/ebola-who-declares-major-success-as-3000-recover-in-drc-early-outbreak-hotspots-contained/) reported that the World Health Organisation announced that 3,000 people recovered from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and that early outbreak hotspots were contained.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/congo-ebola-outbreak-biggest-in-history-crisis-armed-violence-hunger-healthcare-system-101794807183530.html) reported that over 11,000 people were infected and 5,500 died in Congo's Ebola outbreak, while hunger, armed violence and mistrust hamper control efforts.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/science-health/africa-ebola-outbreak-six-months/) reported that the Africa CDC stated the Ebola outbreak remains out of control due to problems including deadly attacks on health workers, unpaid staff, and a lack of resources.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/african-union-warns-drc-ebola-could-cause-a-large-continental-outbreak/) reported that Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Jean Kaseya warned that the humanitarian crisis and insecurity could cause a large continental Ebola outbreak.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-15-africa-cdc-says-ebola-outbreak-still-out-of-control-six-months-since-it-was/) reported that the Africa CDC stated the Ebola outbreak in Congo remains out of control six months after being declared.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ebola-outbreak-kills-over-5400-in-dr-congo-as-conflict-hampers-response/) reported that over 5,400 people died in an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/health-news/925381-ebola-drc-cases-surpass-11000-insecurity-hampers-response.html) reported that according to the WHO, an armed attack in Cantine-Aloya killed 66 civilians including three health workers and looted three health facilities.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/invit%C3%A9-international/20261115-ebola-l-absence-de-vaccin-explique-l-ampleur-de-cette-%C3%A9pid%C3%A9mie-dit-jean-kaseya-africa-cdc) reported that Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya stated the lack of vaccines explains the scale of the epidemic.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/ebola-outbreak-remains-out-of-control-in-congo-six-months-into-response/article71704179.ece) reported that the Ebola outbreak in Congo is the deadliest of the country's 17 outbreaks and remains out of control six months into the response.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/congo-ebola-outbreak-claims-nearly-half-of-infected-as-cases-cross-11000/articleshow/135849071.cms) reported that the outbreak has resulted in over 11,000 cases with high fatalities and inadequate basic health measures.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/15/ebola-outbreak-not-under-control-amid-dysfunctions-in-response-msf-warns/) reported that MSF warned the Ebola outbreak is not under control due to response dysfunctions.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9GUWp5OWp5ZzEyOERaTnRzZ1kyQjRvOVkzR1FoNWxQUEwyY2NoM3JyOXB0LWJEQlBVVk92R2JST2VYaWQ0MjFzVm1tLUFvdHdJcXM2N3dac0JWd05namhJRmtuRFVzZFplTl9yNzF1RFp3RHZV?oc=5) reported that the UN hailed progress in the Ebola response while citing insecurity as the biggest challenge.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648807-drc-ebola-attacks-health-workers/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that Africa CDC stated deadly attacks on medical teams and facilities are disrupting efforts to contain the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.

[The East African](https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/sustainability/ebola-insecurity-in-eastern-drc-blocks-response-5668350) reported that insecurity in eastern DRC is blocking the Ebola response as deaths pass 5,300.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/ebola-spreads-into-rural-areas-of-drc-as-violence-hampers-response) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading into remote rural communities.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168797), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130262.html) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread amid repeated attacks on civilians and frontline health workers.

[Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/africa/attacks-on-health-workers-hamper-congo-ebola-fight-africa-cdc-warns-5669136) reported that the Africa CDC warned attacks on health workers are hampering the Ebola fight in Congo following an armed group attack in North Kivu that killed 66 people.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx98757ymm6zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training, and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies according to MSF.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261112-funds-for-dr-congo-ebola-fight-not-reaching-front-french-medical-charity-msf-says) reported that six months into Congo's Ebola outbreak, the virus is still spreading out of control and large sums of international aid are not reaching the front line.

reports.text: [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-inec-urges-nigerians-to-test-election-technology-ahead-of-general-elections/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission urged Nigerians to participate in a nationwide mock accreditation exercise ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/nysc-commends-gov-alia-over-security-for-corps-members/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/nysc-urges-corps-members-to-respect-culture-of-host-communities/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Benue State National Youth Service Corps coordinator Veronica Garba commended Governor Hyacinth Alia for his support and urged corps members to respect the culture of host communities.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-nysc-inec-agree-extra-insurance-cover-for-corps-members/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the National Youth Service Corps and the Independent National Electoral Commission agreed on additional insurance coverage for corps members serving in elections.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/utilise-skills-acquired-during-orientation-rivers-nysc-coordinator-urges-corps-members/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Rivers NYSC coordinator Moses Oleghe urged 2026 Batch C Stream II corps members to use skills from the SAED in-camp training after orientation camp.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/20/nysc-to-fact-check-cause-of-delayed-october-2026-allowance-for-corps-members-in-oyo-state/) reported that the National Youth Service Corps noted public concern over delayed October 2026 allowances for corps members in Oyo state and will fact-check the cause.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/20/nysc-applauds-partnership-with-nigerian-army-seeks-sustained-security-for-corps-members/) reported that NYSC Director-General Brig. Gen. applauded the partnership with the Nigerian Army and sought sustained security during orientation exercise camp tours.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/ndic-organises-sensitisation-programme-on-savings-for-a-nysc-members-in-kogi/) reported that the NDIC organised a sensitisation programme on savings for NYSC members in Kogi.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ndic-lectures-corps-members-in-kogi-to-avoid-ponzi-schemes-embrace-saving-habit/) reported that the Nigeria Deposit Insurance Corporation warned corps members in Kogi State to avoid unregulated financial institutions and embrace a saving habit.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/ndic-urges-corps-members-to-embrace-financial-discipline/) reported that the Nigeria Deposit Insurance Corporation urged corps members in Delta State to embrace financial discipline.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/nysc-pays-oyo-corps-members-delayed-allowances-blames-technical-glitch/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the National Youth Service Corps paid delayed October 2026 allowances to Oyo State corps members and blamed a technical glitch.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741830-nysc-camp-crisis-lawmaker-tells-governors-what-overcrowding-worsens/) reported that Labour Party lawmaker Philip Agbese urged Nigerian governors to expand NYSC orientation camps due to overcrowding.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/925791-nysc-seeks-stronger-protection-for-corps-members-in-north-east.html) reported that the NYSC called for stronger security collaboration with the Nigerian Army to protect corps members serving in the North-east.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/17/reciprocate-youth-corps-contributions-to-states-with-befitting-orientation-camps-accommodation-lp-lawmaker-tells-governors/) reported that Benue State Labour Party leader Hon. Philip Agbese called on state governors to reciprocate Youth Corps contributions with orientation camps and accommodation.

[Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/politics/oburu-s-uphill-task-in-uniting-four-rival-camps-in-siaya-governor-race-5672022) reported that competing camps emerged in the Siaya governor race, each advancing its own candidate.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/16/nysc-seeks-army-protection-for-corps-members-during-2027-polls/) reported that National Youth Service Corps Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu sought Army protection for corps members during the 2027 polls.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/15/nysc-boss-urges-corps-members-to-embrace-vocational-skills-for-self-reliance/) reported that National Youth Service Corps Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu urged corps members to embrace vocational skills.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/nysc-records-more-female-corps-members-since-2021-dg/) reported that the National Youth Service Corps has recorded a higher number of female corps members than males since 2021.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/gombe-gets-ultra-modern-nysc-permanent-orientation-camp/) reported that Gombe State Governor Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya completed the construction of an ultra-modern permanent NYSC orientation camp in Boltongo.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-nysc-dg-seeks-security-for-corps-members/) reported that NYSC Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu solicited the support of the Nigerian Army in ensuring security for corps members.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/nysc-dg-urges-state-governors-to-expand-orientation-camps/) reported that NYSC Director-General Brigadier General Olakunle Nafiu appealed to state governors to expand orientation camps.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/12/nysc-camp-congestion-centre-tasks-state-governors-to-rise-to-their-civic-responsibilities-improve-on-corp-members-welfare/) reported that CESJET expressed deep concern over persistent congestion and inadequate accommodation facilities at NYSC camps.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1740957-1-nysc-camps-governors-told-improve-accommodation-sanitation-corps-members/) reported that CESJET urged Nigerian governors to tackle overcrowding after over 4,300 corps members were deployed to a Sagamu facility built for 2,000.

reports.text: [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/cuanto-cuesta-dolar-este-martes-24-noviembre-hay-cotizaciones-distintas-mercados_1795520736) reported that the US dollar exceeds 12 Bolivianos in the informal market in Bolivia.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/economia/dolar-hoy-dolar-blue-vivo-cotiza-oficial-precio-paralelo-minuto-minuto-21-noviembre_0_05LdGBGRij.html) reported that the official dollar trades at 1,600 pesos at Banco Nación boards, while the blue dollar has a selling price of 1,675 pesos.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/dolar/dolar-hoy-y-dolar-blue-hoy-a-cuanto-cotiza-este-domingo-22-de-noviembre-nid22112026/) reported that the quotation of the US dollar in Argentina remained the same as the last business day.
[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/dolar-registro-variaciones-semana-cuanto-cotiza-este-viernes-20-noviembre_1795175513) reported that the dollar registered variations during the week.
[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/economia/dolar-blue-hoy-cotiza-jueves-19-noviembre_0_e8DwQuCfBQ.html) reported on the buying and selling quotations and the gap for the blue dollar.
[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/economia/dolar-blue-hoy-cotiza-martes-17-noviembre_0_wpydZulh60.html) reported on the exchange quotation and trading gap for the blue dollar.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/dolar/dolar-hoy-y-dolar-blue-hoy-a-cuanto-cotiza-este-sabado-14-de-noviembre-nid14112026/) reported that the quotation of the US currency maintained the same rate as the last business day.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/dolar/dolar-hoy-y-dolar-blue-en-vivo-a-cuanto-cotizan-el-oficial-y-el-paralelo-este-viernes-13-de-nid13112026/) reported that the official dollar operates at 1570 pesos for sale at Banco Nación while the blue dollar quotes at 1570 pesos.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/economia/dolar-hoy-dolar-blue-vivo-cotiza-oficial-precio-paralelo-minuto-minuto-13-noviembre_0_PNxldjspJX.html) reported that the official dollar opened at 1,570 pesos on Banco Nación boards while the blue dollar stood at 1,565 pesos on the informal market.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/dolar/dolar-hoy-y-dolar-blue-en-vivo-a-cuanto-cotizan-el-oficial-y-el-paralelo-este-jueves-12-de-noviembre-nid12112026/), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/economia/dolar-hoy-cotizan-oficial-diferentes-tipos-cambio-jueves-12-noviembre_0_NWvqGFBq5Z.html) reported on the exchange rates for the official dollar and other types of currency in Argentina.

reports.text: [EU Council press releases](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/24/special-european-council-of-26-27-november-2026-invitation-letter-by-president-antonio-costa-to-the-members-of-the-european-council/) reported that European Council President António Costa invited leaders to a special meeting of the European Council on November 26-27, 2026, in Brussels, which includes a Euro Summit.

[EU Council press releases](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/16/speech-by-president-antonio-costa-at-the-eu-enlargement-forum-2026/) reported that European Council President António Costa delivered a speech at the EU Enlargement Forum.

[EU Council press releases](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/11/13/remarks-by-president-antonio-costa-at-the-press-conference-following-the-informal-meeting-of-heads-of-state-or-government-of-13-november-2026/) reported that European Council President António Costa delivered remarks at a press conference following the informal meeting of Heads of State or Government.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-pro-palestine-protesters-in-dublin-rally-against-european-political-community-summit/) reported that pro-Palestinian demonstrators staged a protest in Dublin against the European Political Community Summit.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/ireland/2026/11/13/welcoming-taoiseach-finds-hugs-and-kisses-the-first-political-pitfall-at-dublins-epc-summit/) reported that Taoiseach Micheál Martin greeted 50 world leaders individually at Dublin's EPC summit.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/85052928) reported that Moldova's president stated at the summit that Moldova has friends in Europe.
