[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/delta-residents-protest-killing-of-four-ndc-members-demand-arrests/) reported that residents of the Uduere community in Ughelli North Local Government Area staged a protest over the killing of four NDC members and demanded arrests.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/24/reps-member-seeks-urgent-intervention-over-bayelsa-boat-mishap-calls-for-safer-boats/) reported that a member of the House of Representatives urged the House to urgently intervene in the boat mishap.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/bayelsa-reps-direct-nddc-nema-others-to-supply-safer-boats-life-jackets/) reported that the House of Representatives directed the managements of the Niger Delta Development Commission and other agencies to supply safer boats and life jackets.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bayelsa-boat-mishap-victims-get-mass-burial/) reported that 29 victims whose bodies have been recovered were given a mass burial at the Azikoro cemetery in Yenagoa.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/opposition-supporters-now-being-murdered-for-their-political-choices-obi-raises-alarm-over-delta-killings/) reported that Peter Obi raised the alarm over the growing murder of opposition supporters.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-omo-agege-predicts-peter-obis-victory-says-apc-has-no-chance-in-delta/) reported that former Deputy Senate President Ovie Omo-Agege dismissed the possibility of the APC securing electoral victories in Delta State.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/delta-attack-obi-calls-for-probe-protection-of-opposition-supporters/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/delta-killings-obi-demands-justice-for-four-ndc-supporters/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Peter Obi demanded a probe and justice for the deaths of four supporters in a Delta State attack.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742955-2027-presidency-bwala-predicts-apc-victory-south-east-states-concedes-obis-stronghold/) reported that Daniel Bwala predicted the APC will win three South-East states in the 2027 election but could struggle in Abia and Anambra due to Peter Obi's influence.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/24/boat-tragedy-gov-diri-appeals-for-fgs-support-to-complete-senatorial-roads/) reported that Bayelsa State Governor Douye Diri made a fresh appeal to the Federal Government to help complete three senatorial district road projects following a boat tragedy.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/tinubu-orders-aide-end-katsina-party-feud/) reported that Nigerian President Bola Tinubu ordered his political adviser to resolve a party feud with Katsina's governor.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-approves-n250m-for-bayelsa-boat-mishap-victims-families/) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved N250 million in financial assistance for families of victims of the Bayelsa boat accident.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-peter-obi-endorses-smartballot-for-election-monitoring/) reported that Peter Obi endorsed SmartBallot for election monitoring and urged supporters to register.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742693-2027-election-political-analyst-predicts-states-peter-obi-win-nigeria/) reported that political analyst Aninze Ekene predicted Peter Obi's 2027 election performance across various regions.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742705-2027-election-abuja-cleric-shares-vision-peter-obi-prediction/) reported that Abuja-based cleric Reverend Ezekiel Dachomo shared a vision that Peter Gregory Obi would win the 2027 presidential election.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/rev-dachomo-endorses-peter-obi-for-2027-presidential-election/) reported that Plateau State-based clergyman Rev. Ezekiel Dachomo endorsed Peter Obi for the 2027 presidential election.
[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641678/death-toll-from-nigeria-boat-accident-rises-to-24) reported that the death toll from the boat accident rose to 24.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bayelsa-boat-tragedy-nema-deploys-technical-team-as-death-toll-rises/) reported that the National Emergency Management Agency deployed a technical team to Bayelsa State to reinforce search and rescue operations.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/nema-deploys-technical-team-as-bayelsa-boat-accident-death-toll-hits-24/) reported that NEMA deployed a technical team to Bayelsa State to strengthen search and rescue operations following a boat accident.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/tinubu-mourns-victims-of-bayelsa-boat-accident-orders-low-key-oyo-apc-rally/) reported that President Bola Tinubu expressed deep sadness over the tragic incident in Ukubie and ordered a low-key Oyo APC rally.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-apc-women-take-tinubus-campaign-to-oyo-markets-hospital/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that APC women led by Betta Edu took President Tinubu's 2027 re-election campaign to Ibadan markets and Jericho Specialist Hospital, empowering over 3,000 women.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kalu-mourns-victims-of-bayelsa-boat-accident-calls-for-investigation/) reported that Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives, Hon. Benjamin Kalu, commiserated with the government and people over the Bayelsa boat accident.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/boat-mishap-shettima-nema-dg-others-pay-condolence-visit-to-bayelsa/) reported that the number of bodies recovered from the scene of the boat mishap rose to 29 following the recovery of five additional bodies.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/apm-fingers-apc-in-destruction-of-billboards-campaign-materials-in-ibadan/) reported that the APM condemned the destruction of billboards and campaign materials in Ibadan, describing it as an attack on democratic participation.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bayelsa-boat-mishap-tinubu-donates-n250m-to-victims-families-as-shettima-visits-survivors/) reported that President Tinubu donated N250m to the families of victims of the Bayelsa boat mishap and ordered stricter waterway safety measures.
[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bayelsa-boat-mishap-death-toll-rises-to-29/) reported that the death toll in the Bayelsa boat mishap rose to 29.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/video-tinubu-joins-family-for-special-prayers-in-lagos/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Tinubu joined his family for special prayers at the Yoruba Tennis Club in Lagos.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742684-2027-election-i-heavy-heart-tinubu-releases-statement-apc-campaigns-oyo/) reported that President Bola Tinubu explained he arrived at the Oyo State campaign rally with a heavy heart due to the tragedy in Bayelsa State.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/nigeria-on-path-to-prosperity-president-tinubu-assures-nigerians/) reported that President Bola Tinubu assured Nigerians that the country is on the path to prosperity.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/babachir-lawal-predicts-peter-obi-victory-in-2027-dismisses-repeat-of-2023-outcome/) reported that former Secretary to the Government of the Federation Babachir Lawal expressed confidence that Peter Obi will win the 2027 presidential election.

reports.text: [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010678/ph-envoy-presents-credentials-to-north-korean-leader-kim-jong-un/story/) reported that the Philippine ambassador to North Korea presented his credentials to leader Kim Jong Un, marking the first time in more than 30 years that the country's leader received new credentials.

[De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/trump-wil-dolgraag-nog-een-ontmoeting-met-vriend-kim-jong-un-maar-de-noord-koreaanse-dictator-neemt-zelfs-de-telefoon-niet-meer-op/165023765.html) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un is willing to check his agenda for meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, but ignores phone calls from U.S. President Donald Trump.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/asia/kim-jong-un-asegura-que-corea-del-norte-no-busca-la-supremacia-ni-expansion-sino-garantizar-su-seguridad-3603306) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un stated North Korea does not seek supremacy or expansion but aims to guarantee its security while receiving new ambassadors.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/asia/kim-ghosts-trump-while-building-up-nuclear-arsenal-20261123-p61gdg.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the U.S. president did not secure a meeting with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during his Asia tour.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/asia/kim-jong-un-lider-de-corea-del-norte-defendio-la-soberania-de-su-pais-tras-no-concretarse-reunion-con-donald-trump-en-china-3603254) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un stated his country will strengthen relations with states that respect its national sovereignty.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223099), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261123001000315), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3375409/north-korea-seeks-power-security-not-supremacy-kim-says) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un stated that the country does not seek regional dominance or expansion and that its arms buildup is for self-defense.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532426/Kim-Jong-Un-ignores-Trump-outreach-as-North-Korea-expands-its), a state-media outlet, reported that White House officials stationed a team outside North Korea's UN mission in Manhattan to slip a personal letter to try to reach Kim Jong Un.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/kim-jong-un-is-ghosting-trump-while-building-north-koreas-nuclear-stockpile/F4PYIRLLBNAKBNSSLVVRXE4HQQ/) reported that US President Donald Trump has repeatedly tried and failed to engage North Korean leader Kim Jong-un.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2223023), a state-media outlet, reported that Russia's Ambassador to North Korea, Alexander Podyelyshev, presented his credentials to Kim Jong Un.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trumps-renewed-outreach-to-kim-jong-un-stalls-as-north-korea-hardens-nuclear-stance-report-101795330873465.html) reported that Donald Trump made several efforts over the past year to re-establish contact with Kim Jong Un using communication channels and a personal letter.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/21/asia-pacific/politics/why-kim-didnt-meet-trump/) reported that US President Donald Trump visited North Korea to meet Kim Jong Un, but the leader was out at a ski resort and a naval university.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-says-good-chance-of-russia-ukraine-deal-but-hatred-between-putin-and-zelensky-making-it-tough-101795209254883.html) reported that Donald Trump expressed hope for Ukraine peace talks after meeting Putin and Xi while warning against Iran's nuclear weapons program.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/asia-pacific/trump-asia-tour-putin-handshake-fried-chicken-high-stakes-diplomacy/) reported on US President Donald Trump arriving in China for a summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin focusing on nuclear issues.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/trump-says-he-would-not-strike-ukraine-deal-with-putin-without-zelensky-s-input-apec-summit-china-shenzhen-101795054506394.html) reported that Donald Trump stated he would not strike a Ukraine deal with Putin without Zelensky’s input.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90546) reported that in an NBC interview, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized Trump’s one-on-one talks with Putin without Kyiv.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/trump-afirma-que-kim-jong-un-gostaria-de-se-reunir-com-ele-enquanto-ditador-visita-resort-na-coreia-do-norte.shtml) reported that Donald Trump stated Kim Jong Un would like to meet him while North Korean state media released images of Kim visiting a ski resort.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/trump-and-putin-to-meet-one-on-one-in-china-thursday?traffic_source=rss) reported that US and Russia leaders are scheduled to meet one-on-one in China.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063487/) reported that German media stated bilateral negotiations could take place on 19 November, while the Kremlin denied full-scale talks.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.?oc=5) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's daughter went skiing at a resort being redeveloped near the China border.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261118001300315) reported that Russia plans to unveil a monument in Kursk honoring North Korean troops' contribution.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063298/) reported that local authorities in Kursk installed a sculpture dedicated to North Korean military personnel participating in the war against Ukraine.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3374794/trade-deal-rare-earths-and-quad-revival-day-1-trumps-asia-trip) reported that US President Donald Trump arrived in Manila to start a three-day Asian swing.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/donald-trump-manila-philippines-kim-jong-un-vladimir-putin-b3086525.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines to meet regional partners and discuss trade.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/video/former-cia-expert-weighs-in-on-potential-meeting-between-president-trump-and-north-korea-s-kim) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump departed for Asia focusing on economic deals and trilateral nuclear talks involving Russia and China.

[El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-17/un-sillon-de-orejas-en-la-pista-de-esqui-el-lider-norcoreano-kim-jong-un-se-deja-ver-con-su-hija-en-la-frontera-con-china.html) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un was seen with his daughter at a tourist complex under construction in Samjiyon near the Chinese border.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/17/trump-diz-que-kim-jong-un-gostaria-de-encontra-lo-na-china-durante-cupula-da-apec-mas-pequim-nega-ter-informacoes.ghtml) reported that Beijing denied having information regarding a potential meeting between Trump and Kim Jong-un.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-trump-arrives-in-philippines-to-kick-off-asia-trip) reported that US President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines for a Southeast Asian summit.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/asia-pacific/2026/11/17/trump-to-begin-asia-trip-with-talks-in-the-philippines/) reported that the US president was in Manila for a Quad meeting involving the US, Japan, Australia, and India.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/17/trump-to-discuss-iran-war-with-xi-and-putin-as-he-begins-asia-trip/) reported that Trump is set to discuss the Iran war with Xi and Putin as he begins his Asia trip.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/russia-erects-monument-in-kursk-to-north-korean-troops-who-fought-alongside-its-forces-against-ukraine) reported that a monument to North Korean soldiers was erected on Internatsionalnaya Street in Kursk.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/asean-leaders-gather-in-philippines-for-49th-summit-3725662) reported that leaders of ASEAN member states and partner delegations are meeting in Pasay City, Metro Manila, for the 49th ASEAN Summit and related summits.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/trump-attend-quad-summit-before-china-visit/) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump will participate in four-way talks with the Quad before traveling to China.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/trump-kicks-off-asia-tour-ahead-of-major-talks-with-putin-xi-in-china/live-79964719?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that US President Donald Trump began an Asia tour including a Quad meeting in Manila before traveling to China for meetings with Russian and Chinese counterparts.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063179/) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin acknowledged the involvement of North Korean soldiers in battles in Kursk Oblast during a meeting with a senior North Korean official.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/putin-hails-north-korean-troops-role-in-kursk-at-kremlin-talks-3725661) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin praised North Korean soldiers for helping retake parts of Russia's Kursk region during talks in the Kremlin with Jo Yong-won.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261117-trump-asia-nuclear-talks-china-russia), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/17/trump-to-hold-nuclear-talks-with-xi-and-putin-with-kim-jong-un-possibly-joining/) reported that US President Donald Trump headed to Asia for economic talks and a planned trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/north-korea-kim-jong-un-inspects-samjiyon-tourism-zone-6556896), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117002351315) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspected the Samjiyon tourism zone reconstruction, including an airport, railway, and ski resort.

[Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/world/spy-scandal-and-midterm-defeat-heat-up-trump-s-asia-visit-5672324), [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/asia-pacific/spy-scandal-us-midterm-defeat-heat-up-trump-asia-visit/) reported that Donald Trump will visit Manila for meetings with regional leaders before traveling to Shenzhen for the APEC forum.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219253) reported that Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping, and Donald Trump would meet on November 19 at the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/17/asean-apec-summit-2026-live-updates-trump-xi-putin-meeting-schedule-latest-news) reported that world leaders gathered in Manila for the Apec and Asean summits amid protests over the Middle East war and the scrapping of the Pax Silica initiative.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/detained-anti-pax-silica-protesters-released-muntinlupa/) reported that anti-Pax Silica protesters were released after being detained for more than 70 hours at Camp Bagong Diwa in Taguig without charges filed within the prescribed period.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1009982/over-200-asean-protesters-ordered-released-from-camp-bagong-diwa/story/) reported that the Muntinlupa City Prosecutor's Office ordered the release of over 200 protesters arrested during a protest caravan amid the ASEAN Summit.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/nupl-seeks-release-anti-pax-silica-protesters/), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1009904/nupl-276-arrested-asean-summit-protesters-journalists-file-motion-for-release/story/) reported that a lawyers group filed a motion before the Muntinlupa City prosecutor seeking the immediate release of 276 arrested protesters and journalists who have not yet received copies of complaints or witness affidavits.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/metro/1009889/over-200-arrested-asean-summit-protesters-set-for-transfer-to-detention-facility-ncrpo/story/) reported that over 200 protesters arrested in Muntinlupa City during the ASEAN Summit are set for transfer to a detention facility.

reports.text: [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/ukraine-strikes-russian-ships-libya-giorgia-meloni-italy/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni faces worry in Rome that Ukraine's strikes on Russian ships could destabilize Libya.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/video/ukraine-strikes-russian-ships-1-500-miles-from-frontline) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya using sea drones that sank the navy vessel.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/italy-watches-worryingly-as-ukraine-strikes-russian-boats-in-libya) reported that Italy is concerned over Ukraine's naval drone strikes on two Russian vessels in and off Benghazi.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOTzIzWjZLTEdiVXRtR0I1cEJ3MFVCUzF5ZktKdWRUQlNtMEVDTnQ4Mk5xU2tvODVlRUJFeE5KOGlieGxsYkp5c1dhZklONzRZNW1VWTR4OVM1MGFQM0cxRXBaQm93b1lhWG1qR3F0ZGV2VTRRRGxtbTRkU1VYQ2c2dEtHckpXQmJCbmpYZlNKeFVrNW8zVjBldDFEWGc1TmIzRTJTM0ozNy1yanVq?oc=5) reported that Ukraine stated the attack on Russian ships in Libya was an act of self-defense.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/zelenskyy-confirms-ukraine-struck-russian-cargo-ship-in-baltic-waters) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed Kyiv was behind a drone strike on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188087-zelensky-confirms-strike-on-russian-ship-in-gulf-of-finland.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed that Ukraine struck the Russian cargo ship Sparta II with a drone in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPbWEtbTJSQnAySDRBUUhIYkZMdFBILXZkQlptS08xUGdBVnFxTjBrWE0xWlBld1Z2dG1nUUE5bDhrZUlqU01VcnZhVXZVQ1lZay11RTNYYWZOeUtKMUp3UDM2eUdUNDgyNnJuWUJxOENiZVRuRmlsUlAwWkpSdWZ6T2JpMGM3ZmNqRmk3NGx6OVhsekJRS2EydnZ3eVBabktYWU1qWVFwTXBrMDk4eEZyR0IzcDVzRUgxT0E?oc=5), [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2223735) reported that a Russian cargo ship hit by drones was towed to St. Petersburg.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187975-ukraines-right-to-selfdefense-is-not-geographically-restricted-foreign-ministry-says-on-strikes-against-russian-vessels.html) reported that Ukraine's Foreign Ministry stated that the threat to Libya comes from Russian warships and weapons carriers, and its actions are directed solely against the aggressor.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/24/ukraine-invokes-u-n-charter-in-defense-of-its-strike-on-russian-warship-in-libya) reported that Ukraine invoked the U.N. Charter to state the strike on the Russian corvette Merkuriy off the coast of Libya was an exercise of its legitimate right to self-defense.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4188092-sybiha-tajani-discuss-security-in-black-and-mediterranean-seas-following-strikes-on-russian-vessels-off-libya.html) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and Italian counterpart Antonio Tajani discussed security challenges in the Black and Mediterranean Seas following strikes on Russian vessels off Libya.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOTnR2aXdGN1dOTnJ1QmhWQWhjWnEwOHQ3QzJ2VExKcHRVZEE3TlloVi11NnJRajdKaThMRGIxeElNM2ZvWWJ5c2dmT2xLbzA1ZHRra0JHTGdteC03dXA5RWFXWTMxejFtSC1odHJiem9QOTY1eWN6OXVEQjV4eUtXX1duQTFLellMcjBCb0NzLUIwT0c1S1FFZEU5N2ZLc3M?oc=5) reported that a Russian strike on Ukraine killed two people and wounded children as Kyiv explained its naval attack near Libya.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91048) reported that Ukraine defended its naval drone operation against Russian military assets near Libya as a legitimate act of self-defense.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/foreign/927595-un-mission-condemns-ukrainian-attacks-on-russian-ships-in-libya.html) reported that the UN mission condemned the Ukrainian attacks on Russian ships in Libya and urged an investigation.

[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/mideast-africa/2026/11/23/ukraine-confirms-it-sank-russian-corvette-in-libyan-port/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed Ukraine was behind the explosive sinking of the Russian corvette Merkury in the Libyan port of Benghazi.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/world/europe/ukraine-libya-russian-ships.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukrainian naval drones sank a corvette and hit a dry cargo vessel near Libya.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261124-live-tripoli-demands-explanation-from-kyiv-for-striking-russian-ships-in-libyan-waters) reported that the Tripoli-based Libyan foreign ministry condemned the Ukrainian drone attack.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-kyiv-claims-strike-that-sank-russian-ship-off-libya/live-80015859?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/volodymyr-zelenskyy-claims-ukraine-sank-russia-warship-benghazi-libya/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/world/europe/ukraine-libya-russian-ships.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukrainian naval drones sank a Russian warship off Libya.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/benghazi-libya-russian-ship-sunk-drone-ukraine/33903623.html) reported that authorities of the eastern-based Libyan government said a suspected sea drone caused an explosion aboard a Russian ship docked at a naval base near Benghazi.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-kyiv-claims-strike-that-sank-russian-ship-off-libya/live-80015859?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the attack was carried out with Ukrainian-made naval drones.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/teske-optuzbe-iz-libije-ukrajinski-napad-proglasili-objavom-rata-traze-da-se-zelenski-stavi-na-listu-terorista/261123286) reported that Libyan Presidential Council member Musa al-Koni described a Ukrainian attack on the port of Benghazi as an act of war and called for an emergency UN Security Council session.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90949) reported that the strike on the frigate Merkury destroyed one of Russia's most advanced and expensive warships, which was equipped with sophisticated radar systems.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/23/ukraine-releases-footage-of-strikes-on-two-russian-vessels-off-libya) reported that Ukraine released footage showing strikes against two Russian vessels off the Libyan port of Benghazi.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187865-zelensky-ukraine-to-continue-naval-strikes-after-hitting-two-russian-vessels-off-libya.html) reported that Volodymyr Zelensky stated Ukraine is responding appropriately to Russian attacks and that its naval operations will continue.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/ucrania-afunda-navio-de-guerra-russo-de-r-1-bi-na-libia-veja-video.shtml) reported that Ukraine launched an attack with seven maritime drones against a Russian warship in the port of Benghazi.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7324957-zelensky-reivindica-ataques-contra-navios-russos-na-libia.html) reported that Zelensky claimed responsibility for attacks against Russian ships in Libya.

[The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/437247/ukraine-strikes-at-russias-african-supply-lines/) reported that the sinking of a Russian warship in Libya exposes vulnerabilities in Moscow's military logistics network in Africa.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585662/un-urges-probe-after-drone-attacks-hit-russian-and-maltese-ships-off-libya/) reported that the United Nations demanded an immediate, independent investigation following drone attacks on two ships off Libya.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/9e924d295365), a state-media outlet, reported that Tripoli called for an investigation into whether Libyan territory or facilities were used in the operations.

[Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/russian-convoy-idles-off-tunisia-after-sea-drones-hit-benghazi/) reported that three Russian cargo ships escorted by a frigate have been crawling along the coast of Tunisia.

[Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/russian-corvette-reportedly-destroyed-in-blast-at-libyan-port/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90861), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187511-russian-warship-destroyed-in-blast-at-libyan-port-media.html) reported that a Russian Navy guided-missile corvette, identified as the Merkury, caught fire and was destroyed following an explosion at the Libyan port of Benghazi.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894gjz0j0yo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Libya's eastern rival government stated it is working with Russia to investigate a suspected drone attack explosion on a Russian ship at a Libya port.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261122-russian-warship-hit-by-suspected-ukrainian-drone-at-libya-s-benghazi-naval-base) reported that a Russian navy corvette docked at the Benghazi naval base in eastern Libya was hit by a suspected Ukrainian sea drone.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/libya-reports-second-attack-ships-including-russian-vessel) reported that authorities in east Libya said a second ship was hit in a drone attack off Benghazi, hours after a Russian vessel was targeted at the city's port.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-23/zelensky-says-ukraine-struck-russian-ship-near-libya/107418718) reported that the Ukrainian president claims responsibility for a series of drone strikes which sunk one Russian vessel and severely damaged another.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/ukraine-naval-drones-strike-russian-warship-libya) reported that Ukraine's security service stated seven drones were launched from a mothership in an operation that sank the Merkury warship.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90911) reported that a Ukrainian drone attack caused a fire at Lukoil's oil refinery in the Perm region.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/23/ukrainian-drones-kill-1-strike-oil-refinery-in-perm-region-a94347) reported that Ukrainian drones struck a Lukoil-operated oil refinery in the Perm Region.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/23/satellite-images-show-russian-warship-capsized-in-libya-after-suspected-ukrainian-drone-st) reported that satellite images show a Russian naval vessel capsized at the port of Benghazi in eastern Libya following an explosion.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/un-mission-in-libya-urges-probe-after-russian-ship-hit-by-drones-off-benghazi), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261123-live-russian-strikes-kill-at-least-15-people-in-kyiv-region-ukraine-says), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/zelenskyy-says-ukraine-behind-drone-attacks-on-russian-ships-near-libya?traffic_source=rss) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed that Ukraine's military was responsible for drone attacks on two Russian vessels at the Libyan port of Benghazi.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261123-un-warns-libya-must-not-become-stage-for-russia-ukraine-war-after-drone-strikes) reported that the United Nations called for an international investigation into drone attacks on two ships in Libya.

reports.text: [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/pan-en-congreso-cdmx-pide-3-meses-de-parlamento-abierto-para-analizar-plan-general-de-desarrollo-es-indispensable-que-ciudadania-lo-conozca/) reported that PAN in the Mexico City Congress requested a 3-month open parliament to analyze the General Development Plan.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/cesar-cravioto-califica-como-montaje-acusaciones-en-su-contra-tras-violencia-en-congreso-cdmx-pan-exige-su-renuncia/) reported that César Cravioto denied accusations of violence against him in the Mexico City Congress, calling them a montage, while the PAN demanded his resignation.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/24/capital/027n2cap?partner=rss) reported that as part of the General Development Plan discussion, the Iztapalapa mayor's office will deliver a study to the capital's Congress to regularize 28 settlements.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/congreso-cdmx-realizara-parlamento-abierto-sobre-plan-general-de-desarrollo-buscan-exponer-alcances-asi-como-recoger-opiniones-y-propuestas/) reported that Mexico City's congressional Jucopo president Xóchitl Bravo stated the General Development Plan sent to the local legislative power is a project and not the final document, and announced an open parliament to gather opinions and proposals.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/18/capital/030n2cap?partner=rss) reported that members of towns and neighborhoods of Mexico City alerted about modifications made to the general development plan project sent to Congress.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/mininterior-alejandro-ordonez-radico-bases-del-plan-de-desarrollo) reported that Interior Minister Alejandro Ordoñez filed the bases of the Development Plan before Congress.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/congreso-arranca-analisis-de-las-bases-del-plan-nacional-de-desarrollo) reported that the Congress planning commission has until January to issue its concept on the National Development Plan.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/titular-de-metropolis-pide-a-fuerzas-politicas-tener-dialogo-de-altura-por-plan-general-de-desarrollo-documento-ha-sido-bien-cuidado-considera/) reported that the head of Metrópolis called on political forces to have a high-level dialogue regarding the General Development Plan during an appearance before the local Congress.

reports.text: [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/world/americas/ecuador-us-military-operations-trump.html) reported that the Trump administration has halted military operations while it investigates an operation by Ecuadorean forces that killed an accused gang leader.
[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/russian-attack-in-ukraine-leaves-two-dead-and-40-injured/) reported that a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia killed two people and injured 40 others.

[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2223753) reported that municipal head Ruslan Khomenko stated that Ukrainian drone and artillery attacks in the Kherson Region left two civilians dead and seven injured, with 464 artillery and mortar strikes and 440 drone attacks recorded on Alyoshki.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2223101), a state-media outlet, reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump did not discuss the appointment of a Russian ambassador to the U.S. and that the conversation was more conceptual.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4187214-zelensky-names-settlements-where-ukraine-proposes-to-conduct-humanitarian-missions.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky named settlements in the Kherson and Zaporizhzhia regions where Ukraine proposes conducting humanitarian missions.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/21/8063949/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy named 15 settlements in Russian-occupied Kherson and Zaporizhzhia oblasts where Ukraine proposes humanitarian evacuations similar to the Oleshky operation.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/humanitarian-mission-for-kostiantynivka-is-it-a-trap/a-79996772?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin proposed an evacuation of the Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063649/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated that Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin did not discuss a proposed five-day ceasefire in Kostiantynivka.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186206-russian-assault-troops-in-kherson-regions-island-zone-readily-surrender-press-officer.html) reported that Russian servicemen sent to storm the islands in the Dnipro River delta near Kherson readily surrender to Ukrainian forces.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185902-ukrainian-military-ready-to-conduct-further-civilian-evacuations-from-occupied-kherson-region-press-officer.html) reported that Ukrainian military personnel are prepared to carry out further civilian evacuations from temporarily occupied areas of the Kherson region.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-russia-negotiating-another-oleshky-style-humanitarian-mission-lubinets-says/) reported that Ukrainian human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets stated that Ukraine and Russia are negotiating another humanitarian mission.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/13/kremlin-says-ready-for-civilian-evacuation-from-ukraines-kostiantynivka-a94257) reported that the Kremlin stated it is ready for civilian evacuation from Ukraine's Kostiantynivka.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062720/) reported that Ukraine's Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets stated that Kostiantynivka was not raised in talks on humanitarian missions.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062686/) reported that Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets shared updates on 105 animals evacuated from occupied Oleshky.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/12/putin-proposes-joint-humanitarian-operation-with-ukraine-in-kostiantynivka-modeled-on-earlier-evacuation-mission-in-oleshky) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin proposed organizing a humanitarian operation in Kostiantynivka, modeled on an earlier evacuation mission in Oleshky.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4184013-humanitarian-mission-needed-in-occupied-hola-prystan-community-similar-to-oleshky-operation-local-official.html) reported that local officials stated a similar humanitarian mission is urgently needed in the occupied Hola Prystan community.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10944264) reported that Seoul shares plunged more than 5 percent due to losses in technology stocks.

[Nikkei Asia](https://asia.nikkei.com/business/markets/asian-tech-stocks-fall-sharply-after-anthropic-s-blockbuster-ipo), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/asian-stocks-nikkei-kospi-fall-anthropic-ipo-6568101) reported that Asian tech stocks fell sharply as Anthropic's IPO failed to dispel market fears or calm trading floors dealing with Nvidia's crisis.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/anthropics-5-300-employees-are-worth-over-50-million-each-after-blockbuster-ipo-101795109427208.html) reported that Anthropic's IPO sent shares up 34% to $111.50, valuing employee holdings at $59.1 million each on average and founders' stakes at up to $26.8 billion.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/anthropic-compania-creadora-de-claude-debuta-en-la-bolsa-de-wall-street-con-cifras-record-acciones-suben-un-34-y-se-fijan-en-mas-de-110-dolares-3602412) reported that Anthropic's shares rose 34% and were set at more than $110 under the symbol ANT.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/anthropic-ipo-to-generate-550-million-in-fees-for-wall-street-banks-goldman-sachs-morgan-stanley-lead-101795104702392.html) reported that Anthropic's IPO is set to generate $550 million in fees for Wall Street banks, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640763/us-vice-president-vows-trump-will-not-let-iran-conflict-become-another-forever-war), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/jd-vance-says-us-will-not-fight-forever-war-with-iran-defends-donald-trumps-military-action/articleshow/135909834.cms), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045146/trump-is-not-going-to-let-iran-conflict-become-a-forever-war-asserts-vance) reported that US Vice President JD Vance stated that President Donald Trump will not allow the conflict with Iran to become a prolonged military commitment or forever war.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219269), a Russian state outlet, reported that Vice President JD Vance stated that President Donald Trump will get the country out of the conflict with great results.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/jd-vance-says-donald-trump-will-end-iran-war-before-2028-rules-out-forever-war-as-third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-101794879757205.html) reported that JD Vance stated Trump will not let the Iran war become a forever war as a third US aircraft carrier reaches the Middle East.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374663/third-us-aircraft-carrier-reaches-middle-east-trump-weighs-iran-options) reported that US Central Command stated in a social media post that a third American aircraft carrier reached the Middle East.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/iran-war-jd-vance-trump-aircraft-carrier-middle-east-b3085980.html) reported that Vice President JD Vance stated Iran will not be a 'forever war' as the USS Theodore Roosevelt and its strike force arrived in the Middle East.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640643/vance-undecided-on-2028-presidential-run-report), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/vance-undecided-on-2028-presidential-run-axios-reports-3725637) reported that US Vice President JD Vance is undecided about a 2028 presidential run.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/uss-theodore-roosevelt-brings-us-carriers-in-middle-east-to-three-3725641), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-us-increases-carrier-presence-in-middle-east-to-3-as-uss-theodore-roosevelt-arrives-in-region-report/) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt entered the US Central Command area, increasing the number of US carrier strike groups in the region to three.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNYmZiWEcxLU9Xck9JR2h3VDIwa1VETmRCam5zQm1BWmhNcGhZS0pBdi1BZGRZLXhZT3VmUG5wYld2N1gydV8teDVFc0UtNVljakJ5Q1JNRkRUb0dqRDRfX0p4QVBGdkZRaWd3Y1J6aFdZWlZhVGt5LWxzcG9mRHVPYnBXZFFrSXVqYXkxd081YzdlNTN1T05yVTgwZUIzSUhQQWc?oc=5), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/third-american-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-west-asia-as-trump-keeps-options-open-in-iran-war/article71709128.ece) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East, bringing the total number of US aircraft carriers in the region to three.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-the-middle-east-as-trump-keeps-options-open-in-the-iran-war) reported that the flotilla in the Arabian Sea includes 13 destroyers, two cruisers, and a littoral combat ship.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/uss-roosevelt-arrives-in-middle-east-is-the-us-iran-war-about-to-resume?traffic_source=rss) reported that the aircraft carrier USS Roosevelt joined two others operating in the US Central Command area of responsibility.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/16/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-amid-tensions-with-iran?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-iran-says-tankers-hit-mins) reported that a third US aircraft carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, arrived in the Middle East amid tensions with Iran.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/16/iran-escalates-threats-against-us-forces-and-gulf-states-as-third-american-carrier-arrives/) reported that Iran escalated threats against US forces and Gulf states as the carrier arrived.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/podcasts/trending-middle-east/2026/11/16/third-us-aircraft-carrier-reaches-middle-east-death-sentences-over-jordan-attacks-and-lebanon-qatar-gas-talks/) reported that a third US aircraft carrier reached the Middle East alongside death sentences over Jordan attacks and Lebanon-Qatar gas talks.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/2026-11-16/ty-article/reports-third-u-s-aircraft-carrier-deployed-to-middle-east/000001a1-e243-da30-a7fb-faff85dc0000) reported that the deployment of a third U.S. aircraft carrier would bring the American military presence in the Middle East to its highest level since April.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/16/iran-war-live-tehran-warns-it-may-strike-first-before-another-us-attack?traffic_source=rss) reported that Iran warned it would not simply wait for an attack as the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/still-in-state-of-war-says-iran-as-third-us-carrier-arrives-in-west-asia-to-join-blockade-101794793624263.html) reported that three US aircraft carriers are part of a force of more than 20 US Navy ships enforcing a blockade of Iranian ports.
[Al-Masry Al-Youm](https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4411284) reported that the US aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt is preparing to join American forces deployed in the Middle East.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203212/%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B0%D8%A7-%D9%86%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AB%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%81%D9%84%D8%AA/) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt returned to the Middle East to join the USS George HW Bush and USS George Washington already stationed in the region.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/15/iran-war-live-bahrain-nationwide-threat-alert/) reported that Bahrain issued a nationwide threat alert amid Iran attack claims and a Saudi-led coalition intercepting missiles.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-embassy-in-bahrain-issues-security-alert-warns-americans-of-possible-houthi-attacks-101794779378382.html) reported that the US Embassy in Bahrain issued a security alert warning Americans of possible Houthi attacks and urging travelers to stay updated on airport and airline operations.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/uss-theodore-roosevelt-third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-amid-iran-tensions-101794783044980.html) reported that a third US aircraft carrier arrived in the Middle East amid heightened tensions with Iran following claims of strikes on US assets in Bahrain.

[Anadolu Agency](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/dunya/nyt-uss-theodore-roosevelt-ucak-gemisi-orta-dogu-daki-gorevine-basliyor/4126063), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/16/uss-theodore-roosevelt-middle-east-centcom/) reported that the US aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East to begin its mission.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218431) reported according to Axios correspondent Barak Ravid that the US military has three vessels of this type in the CENTCOM area of responsibility.

reports.text: [El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-25/campana-electoral-29-n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that Colau predicted that if Abascal becomes vice president he will deploy an ICE on the streets of Spain.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/elecciones-generales-29n-directo-ultima-hora-campana-electoral-cuatro-dias-urnas_202611256b067265f6da642efefa15da.html) reported that the PSOE defended the government's latest social measures while the PP questioned their approval in the middle of the campaign.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/aluvion-decretos-electorales-gobierno-garantia-ejecutarse_202611256b06412f5cb1082f89b41d1e.html) reported that the Spanish government issued a flood of electoral decrees without guarantees of execution, some of which must pass through the Permanent Delegation.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-23/feijoo-carga-contra-tve-parece-una-television-norcoreana-y-los-informativos-son-una-verguenza.html) reported that PP leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo criticized TVE's news broadcasts during the electoral campaign.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/castilla-y-leon/29n-vox-apela-voto-util-que-sirva-desalojar-sanchez_202611236b048f0750b7057c6d149797.html) reported that Vox appealed for a massive turnout and useful vote to oust Sanchez in the November 29 election.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-23/campana-elecciones-29n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported on the electoral campaign leading up to Spain's general election on November 29.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/elecciones-generales-directo-encuestas-ultima-hora-campana-electoral-29n_202611236b03e554f6da642efef87380.html) reported that the final week of the electoral campaign for the November 29 general election begins with the publication of the latest polls.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/castilla-y-leon/29n-pollan-situa-remigracion-como-eje-vox-carga-voto-util_202611226b0326a55cb1082f89b23ff5.html) reported that Vox parliamentary group president in Castile and León positioned remigration as the axis of Vox's platform.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-22/sanchez-apela-al-voto-joven-en-su-pugna-con-vox.html) reported that Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez appealed for youth votes in Murcia.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/abascal-apela-voto-izquierdas-ensanchar-vox-tambien-caben-ellos_202611226b03090ac0d5c85b96c49619.html) reported that Vox leader Santiago Abascal called for votes against Sánchez in an election he called a national emergency.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/murcia/sanchez-desborda-murcia-feudo-clave-acusa-mala-educacion-vox-tildarle-persona-non-grata-region_202611226b02dcefc0d5c85b96c47ad4.html), [El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-22/campana-electoral-29n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez addressed a rally in Murcia after being declared persona non grata by the regional parliament.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-22/campana-electoral-29n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that opposition leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo urged voters not to be overconfident.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-election-pedro-sanchez-vox-far-right-b3088869.html) reported that Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez called a snap general election amidst protests over a housing crisis.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/abascal-revuelve-apelar-voto-util-exige-respeto-vox_202611216b019868f6da642efef75848.html) reported that Vox leader Santiago Abascal criticized the People's Party over tactical voting and demanded respect for Vox.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-21/campana-electoral-29-n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced the government will extend the bank tax until 2027 and allocate the revenue to housing policies.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-21/sanchez-vuelve-al-ataque-para-dejar-atras-el-debate-mientras-feijoo-intenta-explotarlo-al-maximo.html) reported that Pedro Sánchez returned to the attack following the debate while Feijóo promised to deploy the Armed Forces against immigration.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/feijoo-gano-el-cara-a-cara-contra-sanchez-por-10-puntos-segun-el-sondeo-de-40db-para-el-pais-y-la-ser.html) reported that according to a 40dB poll for EL PAÍS and SER, 43% of respondents favored Feijóo as the winner of the head-to-head debate against Sánchez compared to 33.3% for the socialist candidate.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/campana-electoral-29-n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that according to a 40dB poll for EL PAÍS and SER, Feijóo won the head-to-head debate against Sánchez with a 10-point lead.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/andalucia/vuelve-contencion-euforia-cara-cara-sanchez-presidente-agotado-pero-importante-ganar-29n_202611206b004f2c50b7057c6d1241db.html) reported that Miguel Tellado stated Feijóo swept the debate and described Sánchez as an exhausted president.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/abascal-exige-a-feijoo-que-aclare-si-pactara-con-los-restos-del-psoe-despues-del-29-n.html), [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/abascal-celebra-triunfo-feijoo-sanchez-lanza-advertencia-pacte-restos-psoe_202611206b004b665cb1082f89b0caeb.html) reported that Vox leader Abascal celebrated PP candidate Feijóo's performance against Pedro Sánchez in their debate and urged the Popular Party to rule out any agreements with the Socialists after the November 29 elections.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/cataluna/urtasun-cree-que-derrota-sanchez-feijoo-evidencia-que-frente-amplio-imprescindible_202611206b001ad35cb1082f89b09d5a.html) reported that Urtasun stated Pedro Sánchez's defeat against Alberto Núñez Feijóo shows the Frente Amplio is essential and that the PSOE cannot defeat the right alone.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/quien-ha-ganado-el-duelo-los-analistas-de-el-pais-dan-por-vencedor-a-feijoo-sobre-sanchez.html) reported that seven EL PAÍS experts gave Feijóo the victory over Sánchez in their head-to-head debate before the November 29 elections.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/el-cara-a-cara-entre-sanchez-y-feijoo-resumido-en-un-video-de-cinco-minutos.html) reported that the debate between Sánchez and Feijóo included Sánchez apologizing for train accidents and Feijóo making corruption accusations.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/la-crisis-de-la-vivienda-en-espana-marca-el-debate-electoral-entre-pedro-sanchez-y-alberto-feijoo-33217772) reported that Pedro Sánchez and Alberto Núñez Feijóo debated the housing crisis in Spain, discussing evictions and rising prices.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/mi-gobierno-no-ha-sido-perfecto-pedro-sanchez-admite-errores-en-debate-con-alberto-nunez-feijoo-a-dias-de-las-elecciones-en-espana-3602569) reported that Pedro Sánchez admitted errors during the debate and stated his government has not been perfect.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/cataluna/rufian-mete-dedo-llaga-cara-cara-tengo-que-ser-sincero-feijoo-comio-sanchez_202611206b001936ff6fec292196a4c7.html) reported commentary on the election debate between Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and Alberto Núñez Feijóo, with commentators stating Feijóo won and criticizing Sánchez's improvisation skills.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/elecciones-generales-29n-directo-reacciones-cara-cara-nunez-feijoo-pedro-sanchez-ultima-hora-campana-electoral_202611206afffa9450b7057c6d11f519.html) reported that opposition leader Alberto Nunez Feijoo imposed himself clearly over Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez in their debate.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/duro-ataque-de-feijoo-sanchez-por-alto-costo-de-vida-y-corrupcion) reported that Alberto Núñez Feijóo launched a harsh attack against Pedro Sánchez over the high cost of living and corruption.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261120-pm-s%C3%A1nchez-admits-mistakes-in-key-debate-ahead-of-spain-election) reported that Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez acknowledged shortcomings in his government during a debate against conservative rival Alberto Núñez Feijóo.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/1977d31189bf) reported that Pedro Sanchez and Alberto Nunez Feijoo clashed over the economy, housing, immigration, and corruption.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/actualidad/carlos-herrera-destaca-reaccion-sanchez-feijoo-debate-equipo-sale-entusiasmado-sanchez-queda-solo-b50m_202611206afff65aff6fec29219688a3.html) reported journalist Carlos Herrera's comments on the reactions of the PP team and Sánchez following the debate.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/feijoo-sanchez-gobierno-hecho-todo-tipo-guarradas-bochorno_202611206aff85f5f6b335433bb61a72.html) reported that during a political debate, PP leader Núñez Feijóo accused Pedro Sánchez's government of corruption, while Sánchez defended his administration as one of the cleanest in the history of democracy.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/somos-economia-que-mas-crece-europa-sanchez-baje-cohete-acabemos-infierno-fiscal-deje-usar-mayores-beneficio-feijoo_202611196aff707918c34d33accf3e63.html) reported that Feijóo announced he will create a State Secretariat for the Elderly if he governs, while Sánchez boasted about protecting pensions, the minimum wage, and civil servant salary increases.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/feijoo-pide-sanchez-que-deje-meter-miedo-pensionistas-pero-avisa-que-sistema-esta-punto-estallar_202611196aff76de103a0e0a475074f0.html) reported that Prime Minister Sánchez proposed to the PP leader to enshrine pensions in the Constitution to revalue them with the CPI, while Feijóo asked Sánchez to stop scaring pensioners but warned the system is near a breaking point.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/debate-electoral-entre-pedro-sanchez-y-alberto-nunez-feijoo-en-directo.html) reported that Feijóo arrived first at the studio for the face-to-face debate with Sánchez.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/actualidad/que-significa-corbata-verde-feijoo-cara-cara-sanchez_202611196aff66d8a6f8072789ef1485.html) reported that Feijóo wore a blue suit, light blue shirt, and green tie for the debate.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/90-minutos-cara-a-cara-sanchez-busca-remontar-los-dos-puntos-que-le-separan-del-pp-y-feijoo-repetir-el-exito-de-2023.html) reported that Spanish Socialist candidate Sánchez seeks to bridge a two-point gap against the PP ahead of their face-to-face debate.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-18/video-analisis-en-directo-y-verificacion-a-tiempo-real-asi-podras-ver-el-cara-a-cara-entre-sanchez-y-feijoo-en-el-pais.html) reported that El País deployed an analysis team to cover the debate between Sánchez and Feijóo.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/feijoo-plantea-cara-cara-como-mocion-censura-sanchez_202611196afe5fd018c34d33acce813f.html) reported that candidate Feijóo frames the debate as a motion of censure against Sánchez.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/nunez-feijoo-arranca-debate-ataque-espana-necesita-presidente-decente-sanchez_202611196aff66f918c34d33accf3877.html) reported that PP leader Núñez Feijóo launched attacks during the debate, accusing Sánchez, while recalling corruption cases, railway tragedies, and the Ceuta migration crisis.

reports.text: [Punch](https://punchng.com/17-die-25-injured-in-zamfara-road-crash-frsc/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Federal Road Safety Corps confirmed 17 people died in a road crash at Kisami village along the Gummi-Daki Takwas-Anka Road.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamfara-govt-suspends-campaign-after-road-crash/) reported that the Zamfara government suspended campaign activities in Maru Local Government Area following the accident.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/zamfara-frsc-confirms-death-of-15-people-while-returning-from-maru-campaign-flag-off/) reported that the Federal Road Safety Corps Zamfara State Command confirmed the death of 15 people in a fatal car crash while returning from the Maru campaign flag-off.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/927635-makinde-accuses-apc-of-importing-supporters-for-tinubus-rally-orders-fumigation.html) reported that Mr Makinde alleged during a live radio programme that the APC mobilised supporters from neighbouring states to attend Saturday's rally.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/omo-agege-attack-makinde-campaign-accuses-apc-of-political-violence-2/) reported that the Makinde campaign alleged opposition parties suffered attacks in Sokoto, Kebbi, Edo, Lagos, Cross River, Kaduna, and Kano states.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/24/apc-campaign-council-engages-media-highlights-tinubus-reforms-ahead-of-2027/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council engaged media practitioners in Lagos.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/927466-talata-mafara-agog-as-lawal-flags-off-apc-campaign-in-zamfara.html) reported that the rally brought together major APC stakeholders in the state, including the Director General of the Tinubu/Shettima Presidential Campaign Council.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-apc-flags-off-presidential-guber-campaign-in-zamfara/) reported that the All Progressives Congress in Zamfara State has flagged off its presidential and gubernatorial campaign ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742975-2027-elections-tragedy-15-apc-supporters-die-death-disclosed-party-takes-action/) reported that the Zamfara APC postponed its Maru rally after a road accident killed 15 supporters travelling to a campaign event.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742948-breaking-apc-campaign-turns-bloody-members-die-road-accident/) reported that over 10 APC members died in a road crash after attending a governorship election campaign launch.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927545-15-apc-supporters-killed-27-injured-in-zamfara-road-crash-party-postpones-rally.html) reported that 15 APC supporters died and 27 others were injured in a road crash in Zamfara, according to the FRSC.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/gombe-community-seeks-justice-for-three-killed-by-air-force-personnel/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Lawanti Community Development Foundation demanded an independent probe and prosecution regarding the alleged killing of three residents by Air Force personnel in Gombe.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/926947-enugu-apc-suspends-campaigns-over-finance-directors-death.html) reported that the Enugu State APC suspended campaigns following the death of its finance director Festus Oshaba-Onuh.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/three-killed-13-injured-as-military-residents-clash-in-gombe/) reported that three people were killed and 13 others injured following a clash between the military and residents in Gombe.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/edu-assures-kebbi-women-of-better-days-mobilises-support-for-tinubu/) reported that the All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council Women Mobilisation Directorate, led by Dr Betta Edu, assured Kebbi women of better days and mobilised support for Tinubu.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/926754-apc-campaign-finance-director-dies-in-road-crash.html) reported that Festus Onuh, chairman of Ferotex Construction Company Ltd and an APC campaign finance director, died in a road accident while travelling along Port Harcourt.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/several-injured-vehicles-damaged-as-suspected-thugs-attack-apc-campaign-convoy-in-gombe/) reported that five campaign buses conveying All Progressives Congress supporters were vandalised and several members sustained injuries after suspected thugs attacked an APC campaign convoy in Gombe.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/gombe-apc-chairman-campaign-dg-flown-to-abuja-after-accident/) reported that Gombe State APC Chairman Mohammed Dantata Ndus and the campaign director-general were flown to Abuja after an accident in which two persons died.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-radda-warns-katsina-voters-against-irresponsible-politicians/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Katsina Governor Dikko Radda urged Kankia voters to back the APC, Tinubu, and party candidates in 2027.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/926268-gov-lawal-inaugurates-campaign-council-says-the-mission-to-rescue-zamfara-is-in-progress.html) reported that Zamfara State Governor Lawal inaugurated a campaign council to strengthen the party and build on good governance.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/pdp-delegation-visits-injured-apc-leaders-at-gombe-hospital/) reported that a Gombe State Peoples Democratic Party delegation visited injured APC leaders at a Gombe hospital.

[The Chronicle (Ghana)](https://thechronicle.com.gh/radda-warns-against-419-politicians-as-supporters-rally-for-apc/) reported that Katsina State Governor Malam Dikko Umaru Radda urged voters to reject 419 politicians in the 2027 general elections.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-approves-establishment-of-inland-dry-port-in-kebbi/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu approved the establishment of an inland dry port in Kebbi State following a request by Governor Nasir Idris.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/tinubu-courts-kebbi-support-for-2nd-term-approves-inland-dry-port/) reported that President Bola Tinubu wooed Kebbi voters with development pledges, including approval for an inland dry port.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/1-killed-6-injured-in-road-crash-involving-gombe-apc-leaders/) reported that one person was killed and six others injured in a road accident involving Gombe State APC leaders.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nnorth-east/925953-terrorists-disrupt-apc-campaign-in-borno.html), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741914-just-terrorists-disrupt-apc-campaign-borno-details-emerge/) reported that suspected terrorists launched mortar bombs and IED attacks targeting the campaign team of Mohammed Mungono in Borno State.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/kebbi-apc-rally-tinubu-approves-dry-inland-port-for-kebbi-seeks-support-for-apc-in-2027/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-approves-kebbi-inland-dry-port-promises-completion-of-landmark-projects-improved-security/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/at-apc-presidential-rally-in-birnin-kebbi-tinubu-approves-inland-dry-port-for-kebbi/) reported that President Bola Tinubu approved the operationalisation of the Tsamiya Inland Dry Port in Kebbi State.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/two-die-gombe-apc-chairman-campaign-dg-injured-in-crash/) reported that Gombe State Chairman of the All Progressives Congress Mohammed Dantata Ndus and the director-general of the party's 2027 governorship campaign were injured in a vehicle crash while two people died.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-apc-supporters-throng-kebbi-stadium-for-tinubus-rally/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu's presidential rally in Kebbi State attracted a massive crowd of APC supporters and party loyalists.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/17/kebbi-state-ready-to-receive-tinubu-for-presidential-campaign-launch-info-commissioner/) reported that the Kebbi State Government, the All Progressives Congress, and state residents declared readiness to receive President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for the presidential campaign launch.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/stay-away-from-tomorrows-apc-campaign-rally-itsekiri-youths-warn-oborevwori/) reported that Itsekiri youths warned political leaders and state governor Sheriff Oborevwori to stay away from the upcoming APC campaign rally.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/aibom-gov-seeks-80000-lg-votes-for-tinubu-apc/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Akwa Ibom State Governor Umo Eno tasked voters in Mkpat Enin local government area to deliver 80,000 votes for President Tinubu and APC candidates in the 2027 polls.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/apc-flags-off-2027-campaign-in-abia-kalu-targets-75-for-tinubu/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/abia-apc-kicks-off-presidential-campaign-promises-massive-votes-for-tinubu/) reported that the Abia State chapter of the All Progressives Congress formally kicked off its 2027 presidential campaign rally with assurances to secure massive votes for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/apc-constitutes-over-900-member-gubernatorial-campaign-council-ahead-of-2027-general-elections-in-zamfara/) reported that the Zamfara State chapter of the All Progressives Congress constituted a 900-member gubernatorial campaign council.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kano-yoruba-community-endorses-tinubu-yusuf-for-2027-re-election/) reported that the Yoruba Community in Kano State endorsed President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for re-election in 2027 and supported Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/gov-umo-endorses-wikes-coalition-says-hes-for-re-election-of-tinubu/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-umo-eno-backs-wikes-rainbow-coalition-for-tinubu/) reported that Akwa Ibom State Governor Umo Eno declared support for the Rainbow Coalition led by Federal Capital Territory Minister Nyesom Wike to support President Bola Tinubu's re-election.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/yilwatda-charges-north-central-apc-leaders-to-unite-for-tinubu/) reported that All Progressives Congress National Chairman Prof. Nentawe Yilwatda charged North-Central leaders, governors, and candidates to unite for Tinubu.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/tinubu-jonathan-sanwo-olu-others-honoured-at-herbert-macaulay-colloquium/) reported that President Bola Tinubu, former President Goodluck Jonathan, and Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu were honoured at the Herbert Macaulay colloquium.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/at-apc-presidential-campaign-rally-in-jos-tinubu-orders-decisive-security-action-against-plateau-attackers/) reported that during the APC presidential campaign rally in Jos, President Bola Tinubu ordered decisive security action against attackers in Plateau and pledged to rebuild displaced communities.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-delta-apc-begins-grassroots-mobilisation/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the All Progressives Congress in Delta State began grassroots mobilisation ahead of the 2027 general elections.

reports.text: [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/24/2027-actionaid-challenges-inec-over-voter-register-errors-result-transparency/) reported that ActionAid Nigeria challenged the Independent National Electoral Commission to account for errors in the voters' register.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927454-2027-politics-watch-atikus-withdrawal-denial-tinubus-lagos-turnout-push-seraps-suit-against-inec.html) reported that Atiku Abubakar rejected claims that he had quit the presidential race and Bola Tinubu urged greater voter mobilisation.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/rep-dasuki-inec-under-amupitan-has-worst-voter-data/) reported that House of Representatives Deputy Minority Leader Abdussamad Dasuki raised alarm over the poor state of the Independent National Electoral Commission's voter data.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-under-amupitan-has-worst-voter-data-compromised-register-could-jeopardise-2027-election-rep-dasuki/) reported that Deputy Minority Leader Dasuki stated that compromised voter registers could jeopardise the 2027 election.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/serap-drags-inec-data-protection-commission-to-court-over-alleged-ai-fraud-in-voters-register/) reported that SERAP filed a lawsuit against the National Data Protection Commission and INEC over alleged artificial intelligence fraud in the voters' register.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/serap-sues-ndpc-inec-over-ai-manipulation-of-voters-register/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that SERAP sued NDPC and INEC at the Federal High Court in Abuja seeking an independent probe into AI-generated photos and possible data breaches in the voters' register.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-voter-register-row-sparks-electoral-manipulation-fears/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/serap-sues-ndpc-inec-over-alleged-ai-manipulation-of-voters-register/) reported that AI-generated photos in INEC's preliminary voter register sparked concerns, leading SERAP to file a lawsuit against the National Data Protection Commission and INEC.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/inec-backs-code-for-independent-tabulation-of-2027-election-results/) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission endorsed a voluntary Code of Conduct for independent tabulation and publication of election results.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926632-atiku-asks-inec-to-open-ai-system-for-independent-audit-ahead-of-2027-elections.html) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar asked INEC to open its AI system for an independent audit ahead of the 2027 elections.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-must-open-ai-system-to-independent-audit-atiku/) reported that ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar demanded an independent audit of INEC's artificial intelligence system.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/2027-independent-results-tabulation-cant-replace-statutory-collation-inec-declares/) reported that INEC declared independent results tabulation cannot replace statutory collation.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-atiku-demands-scrutiny-of-inecs-ai-system-for-processing-election-results/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/atiku-demands-independent-audit-of-inecs-ai-system-ahead-of-2027-elections/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742321-2027-elections-atiku-challenges-inec-reveal-ai-technology-source-code/) reported that former Vice President Atiku Abubakar demanded that INEC submit its proposed artificial intelligence system for processing election results to independent scrutiny.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/n11-2tr-opaque-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-military-budget-ndc/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council accused President Bola Tinubu's administration of prioritising opaque spending on a pipeline security bill.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/ndc-raises-the-alarm-over-voter-register-demands-nationwide-audit-by-inec/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress National Campaign Council raised concerns over the integrity of the Independent National Electoral Commission and demanded a nationwide audit.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ndc-alleges-voter-register-inflation-demands-probe-of-n11-2trn-nnpcl-funds/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress raised concerns over the credibility of the 2027 general elections and the handling of public funds.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925913-2027-inec-proposes-code-to-regulate-independent-result-tabulation.html), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170671.html) reported that the Independent National Electoral Commission proposed a code of conduct to regulate independent election result tabulation ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-makinde-campaign-faults-tinubu-over-federal-recruitment-freeze/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/makinde-campaign-slams-tinubu-over-recruitment-embargo/) reported that Seyi Makinde's Allied Peoples Movement Presidential Campaign Organisation criticised President Bola Tinubu over a federal recruitment freeze.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925987-makinde-campaign-group-criticises-tinubu-over-federal-governments-recruitment-freeze.html) reported that Mr Makinde's campaign organisation stated that the employment restriction would worsen Nigeria's high unemployment rate.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ndc-alleges-n11-2trn-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-military-budget/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/ndc-tinubus-n11-2trn-pipeline-security-bill-exceeds-twice-defence-budget/) reported that the Nigeria Democratic Congress accused President Bola Tinubu's administration of presiding over an opaque N11.2 trillion pipeline security bill and demanded a forensic audit.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/924782-makindes-campaign-group-demands-probe-of-tinubus-n11-2trn-crude-oil-backed-loans.html) reported that Makinde's campaign group demanded that the federal government disclose lenders, amounts borrowed, interest rates, management fees, and repayment terms for Tinubu's N11.2trn crude oil-backed loans.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/account-for-n11-2-trillion-crude-oil-advance-sale-mdpco-challenges-tinubu/) reported that the Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation challenged President Bola Tinubu's administration to account for the N11.2 trillion crude oil advance sale.
