reports.text: [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pakistan-security-forces-kill-9-terrorists-in-separate-operations-in-bannu-and-lakki-marwat-101795597503171.html) reported that Pakistani security forces killed nine terrorists in separate operations in Bannu and Lakki Marwat.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641813/two-policemen-among-five-injured-in-lakki-marwat-ied-blast), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/five-injured-in-ied-blast-targeting-police-van-in-lakki-marwat/) reported that an IED blast targeting a police van in Lakki Marwat injured five people, including two police personnel.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585273/15-terrorists-killed-in-major-mastung-security-operations/) reported that security forces killed 15 terrorists in two intelligence-based operations in Balochistan's Mastung district under Operation Radd-ul-Fitna 3.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/blow-to-fitna-al-hindustan-as-pakistani-forces-gun-down-15-terrorists-in-balochistans-mastung/) reported that Pakistani security forces eliminated 15 Fitna al-Hindustan terrorists in two back-to-back operations in Balochistan’s Mastung district.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045905/police-foil-major-terror-attack-in-kps-lakki-marwat-claim-suspected-suicide-bomber-killed) reported that Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police stated they foiled a major terrorist attack in Lakki Marwat district and killed a suspected Afghan-origin suicide bomber.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/security-forces-kill-22-indian-proxy-terrorists-in-kp-operations/) reported that security forces killed 22 terrorists belonging to Fitna-Al-Khwarij in multiple engagements in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583633/another-cop-martyred-in-bannu-four-terrorists-killed-in-lakki-marwat/) reported that a constable was kidnapped and later killed by unknown armed men in the Bannu district on Wednesday.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640998/four-terrorists-killed-during-police-operation-in-lakki-marwat), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583393/four-terrorists-killed-in-lakki-marwat-police-operation/) reported that four suspected terrorists were killed during a police operation in Lakki Marwat after an exchange of fire.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/blow-to-ttp-as-pakistani-forces-gun-down-43-militants-in-kp-operations-ispr/) reported that Pakistan's security forces eliminated 43 militants in intelligence-based operations across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa according to ISPR.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640081/security-forces-kill-31-terrorists-in-balochistan-operations-ispr) reported that security forces killed 31 terrorists in a Balochistan operation according to ISPR.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044260/security-forces-kill-74-terrorists-during-ibos-in-khyber-pakhtunkhwa-balochistan-ispr) reported that ISPR stated security forces killed 74 terrorists during intelligence-based operations in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan.

narratives.label: Brazil fiscal adjustment bill approval

reports.text: [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/economia/2026/11/7325559-entenda-o-pacote-fiscal-que-preve-ajuste-de-ate-rs-56-bilhoes.html) reported that Congress approved and President Lula sanctioned a fiscal package adjusting spending rules and federal transfers.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7325313-camara-aprova-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo-lula-sem-alteracoes.html) reported that Brazil's Chamber approved the government's fiscal adjustment without alterations with 353 favorable votes.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/24/pacote-fiscal-de-lula-quem-foram-os-deputados-do-pl-que-apoiaram-o-governo-e-os-aliados-que-nao-votaram.ghtml) reported that seven deputies from Jair Bolsonaro's PL party contributed to the government's victory in passing the fiscal package.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-congreso-de-brasil-aprobo-el-ajuste-fiscal-de-lula-pero-persisten-las-dudas-de-los-mercados-nid24112026/) reported that although Brazil's Congress approved the fiscal adjustment, market investors consider the measures insufficient and demand reforms.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/apos-criticar-projeto-e-fazer-as-pazes-com-ministro-lindbergh-se-abstem-de-votar-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo.ghtml) reported that deputies Lindbergh Farias and Natália Bonavides decided to abstain from voting on the government's fiscal package.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/congreso-brasil-aprueba-paquete-ajuste-fiscal-gobierno-lula-2027_1795487697) reported that the government had expressed urgency in approving the matter before the presentation of a budgetary planning report.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/24/vitoria-do-governo-na-camara-e-puxada-por-votos-do-centrao-e-ajuda-de-motta-veja-como-cada-deputado-votou.ghtml) reported that the government achieved an expressive victory in the Chamber by approving the fiscal adjustment project without modification.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/24/sancao-e-vigencia-em-2027-entenda-os-proximos-passos-do-pacote-fiscal-de-lula-aprovado-no-congresso.ghtml) reported that the Chamber of Deputies approved a project for fiscal adjustment of public accounts previously passed by the Senate, with sanction and validity set for 2027.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/24/abstencoes-de-lindbergh-e-erika-hilton-chamam-a-atencao-na-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-de-lula-que-conquista-7-votos-do-pl.ghtml) reported that the government achieved a victory with the conclusion of the fiscal package voting in the Chamber, featuring specific party abstentions and votes.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/camara-aprova-texto-base-de-projeto-de-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo-lula-com-impacto-de-ate-r-56-bilhoes-em-2027.ghtml) reported that the Chamber of Deputies plenary approved the base text of the Lula government's fiscal adjustment project with an impact of up to 56 billion reals in 2027.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/sancao-de-lula-e-vigencia-em-2027-entenda-os-proximos-passos-do-projeto-de-ajuste-fiscal-aprovado-na-camara.ghtml) reported that the fiscal adjustment project approved by the Chamber had already been approved by the Senate and awaits Lula's sanction to take effect in 2027.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/ajuste-fiscal-de-lula-vai-de-supersalarios-a-incentivos-tributarios-entenda-o-plano-de-r-56-bi-aprovado-na-camara.ghtml) reported that the fiscal adjustment project presented by Jaques Wagner and written by Lula's economic team ranges from high salaries to tax incentives.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/lider-do-pl-anuncia-que-partido-votara-contra-projeto-de-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo-nao-ajusta-nada.ghtml) reported that PL House leader Sostenes Cavalcante announced the party will vote against the Lula government's fiscal adjustment package.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/camara-comeca-a-analisar-ajuste-fiscal-de-ate-r-56-bilhoes-em-meio-a-pressao-do-governo-por-votacao-rapida.ghtml) reported that the Chamber of Deputies plenary began analyzing the fiscal adjustment project presented by the government.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/bela-megale/post/2026/11/o-placar-da-disputa-pelo-senado-entre-alcolumbre-e-marinho-que-circula-entre-ministros-do-stf.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court ministers evaluate that Davi Alcolumbre is ahead of Rogério Marinho in the Senate leadership dispute.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/23/lula-vai-escolher-tres-nomes-para-o-stj-enquanto-mantem-suspense-sobre-indicacao-a-vaga-aberta-no-stf.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will choose three names for the Superior Court of Justice while maintaining suspense over a Supreme Court vacancy.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/23/lula-deve-se-reunir-com-alcolumbre-nos-proximos-dias-para-tratar-de-formacao-do-governo-e-vaga-no-stf.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre are scheduled to meet to discuss government formation and the Supreme Court vacancy.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/camara-analisa-ajuste-fiscal-entenda-o-que-esta-em-jogo-para-o-governo-e-as-contas-publicas.ghtml) reported that the Chamber is scheduled to vote on the fiscal adjustment proposed by the government and approved by the Senate.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/23/fim-da-escala-6x1-governo-publica-hoje-primeira-com-regras-da-nova-jornada-veja-o-que-falta-definir.ghtml) reported that the government of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is to publish its first ordinance with rules for the new 6x1 work schedule.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/22/moretti-e-durigan-ganham-confianca-de-lula-com-pacote-fiscal-entenda-por-que-isso-nao-garante-que-continuarao-no-governo.ghtml) reported that Dario Durigan and another official gained Lula's confidence with the fiscal package.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/21/lula-critica-ala-da-esquerda-que-se-opos-ao-ajuste-fiscal-e-diz-que-faria-lima-nao-vai-ensina-lo-a-governar.ghtml) reported that President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva criticized leftist factions opposing his government's fiscal adjustment package.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/em-busca-de-reeleicao-alcolumbre-e-motta-acenam-ao-planalto-por-ajuste-fiscal-e-a-oposicao-com-beneficio-a-bolsonaro.ghtml) reported that House President Hugo Motta and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre intensified gestures toward the Planalto and the opposition regarding fiscal adjustment.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/proposta-de-ajuste-fiscal-do-planalto-vira-estopim-e-psol-racha-sobre-relacao-com-governo-lula.ghtml) reported that the PSOL entered an internal dispute over how to react to the government's fiscal adjustment package ahead of the Chamber vote.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/bela-megale/post/2026/11/os-dois-votos-do-pl-que-rogerio-marinho-ja-considera-perdidos-na-disputa-pela-presidencia-do-senado.ghtml) reported that Rogério Marinho already discounted two votes from his own party in the dispute for the presidency of the Senate.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/relator-na-camara-divulga-parecer-de-pacote-fiscal-e-nao-faz-alteracoes-no-texto-para-acelerar-aprovacao.ghtml) reported that Mauro Benevides Filho, the rapporteur of the fiscal adjustment project drafted by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government, released his opinion without making changes to the text in order to accelerate approval in the Chamber.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/pacote-fiscal-senado-suaviza-corte-de-repasses-a-estados-e-texto-vai-a-camara.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate concluded voting on the government's fiscal adjustment package with a gesture to states, softening cuts to transfers.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/votacao-do-governo-em-projeto-de-ajuste-fiscal-expoe-disputa-entre-alcolumbre-e-marinho-pelo-comando-do-senado.ghtml) reported that the Senate vote on the government's fiscal adjustment package exposed a dispute between Davi Alcolumbre and Rogério Marinho for control of the Senate.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/19/pacote-fiscal-passa-no-senado-entenda-os-proximos-passos-antes-de-medida-entrar-em-vigor.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate concluded voting on the government's fiscal adjustment package, though the measures are not yet in force.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-aprova-projeto-que-estabelece-novas-regras-para-uso-de-postes-por-empresas-de-internet.ghtml) reported that the Senate approved a bill establishing new rules for the sharing of electricity poles by internet companies.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323780-senado-rejeita-mudancas-no-texto-e-aprova-ajuste-fiscal-do-governo.html), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/alcolumbre-ve-influencia-de-disputa-eleitoral-em-criticas-ao-ajuste-fiscal-e-diz-que-dialogo-prevaleceu-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate rejected changes to the text and approved the government's fiscal adjustment project, sending it to the Chamber of Deputies.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/brasil/noticia/2026/11/18/pena-maior-para-quem-matar-dirigindo-sob-efeito-de-alcool-e-aprovada-no-senado-e-projeto-vai-a-camara.ghtml) reported that the Senate approved a bill increasing penalties for homicide and serious bodily injury caused by drunk drivers, sending the project to the Chamber.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/chefe-da-articulacao-politica-diz-que-governo-acertou-com-motta-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-na-camara-ate-terca-feira.ghtml) reported that Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães stated he agreed with Chamber President Hugo Motta to vote on the fiscal package in the Chamber by Tuesday.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mantem-teto-para-compensacao-previdenciaria-a-estados-e-municipios-no-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Brazilian Senate maintained the provision in the fiscal adjustment project limiting social security compensation transfers to states and municipalities to 3 billion reals per year between 2027 and 2030.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mantem-restricao-ao-uso-de-creditos-tributarios-por-empresas-em-projeto-do-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Senate kept the section of the fiscal adjustment package authorizing the government to restrict companies from using tax credits for settlements.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/senado-mudancas-no-pacote-fiscal.ghtml) reported that the Senate resumed discussion of the government's fiscal adjustment project after it was postponed due to a lack of agreement.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/lauro-jardim/post/2026/11/julgamento-dos-beneficios-fiscais-da-atem-volta-a-estaca-zero-no-stf-e-pressao-cresce.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court Minister Luiz Fux requested a review of the direct unconstitutionality action regarding tax benefits for the Manaus Free Trade Zone benefiting Atem.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/ala-bolsonarista-do-pl-ve-gesto-eleitoreiro-de-motta-e-alcolumbre-ao-pedir-a-moraes-julgamento-sobre-lei-que-beneficia-bolsonaro.ghtml), [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323484-motta-e-alcolumbre-pedem-a-moraes-julgamento-da-lei-da-dosimetria.html) reported that Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre asked Supreme Federal Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to judge the sentencing reduction law for January 8 prisoners this year.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/governo-conta-votos-e-aposta-em-articulacao-de-alcolumbre-para-concluir-votacao-de-ajuste-fiscal-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva government is working to secure votes to conclude the fiscal adjustment package vote in the Senate with the backing of Davi Alcolumbre.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/18/sem-acordo-entenda-o-que-travou-a-votacao-do-pacote-fiscal-de-lula-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the Senate postponed concluding the vote on President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's fiscal measures package due to a lack of agreement with the opposition and guaranteed votes.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/alcolumbre-diz-que-tem-votos-para-concluir-votacao-do-ajuste-fiscal-nesta-quarta-feira.ghtml) reported that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre stated there are enough votes to conclude the fiscal adjustment package vote.

narratives.label: North Korea national flag proportion revision

reports.text: [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/russias-changing-positions-on-north-korea-sanctions-and-denuclearization/) reported that Russia's positions on North Korea sanctions and denuclearization have shifted over time.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/north-korea-changes-national-flag-for-first-time-in-78-years-under-kim-jong-un-world-war-ii-101794725314504.html) reported that Article 166 of North Korea's revised constitution changes the national flag's height-to-width ratio from 1:2 to 1:1.65.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261113001800315) reported that North Korea revised its constitution to change its national flag's aspect ratio.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90125) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that US envoys brokered an agreement with Moscow to exchange 1,200 to 1,300 POWs.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90103) reported that US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner began preparing for what could become the largest prisoner exchange since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/kushner-largest-prisoner-exchange-russia-ukraine-war-nears) reported that Jared Kushner's remarks followed Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy welcoming news of European presence at US-brokered peace talks.

reports.text: [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1090178/video-snazno-nevrijeme-pogodilo-mostar-ulice-pod-vodom-moguc-nestanak-struje) reported that a severe storm hit Mostar, leaving streets underwater and risking power outages and structural damage.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Izdato-narandzasto-upozorenje-zbog-vjetra/993640), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/udari-vjetra-do-75-kilometara-na-sat-izdato-narandzasto-upozorenje/) reported that an orange weather warning was issued in Bosnia and Herzegovina due to southern winds with gusts from 55 to 75 kilometers per hour.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089372/snazno-nevrijeme-poharalo-bih-voda-preplavila-saobracajnice-vjetar-rusio-stabla-odroni-ugrozili-vozace-vise-gradova-ostalo-bez-struje), [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Nevrijeme-izazvalo-probleme-sirom-BiH-Vjetar-odnio-krov-drvo-palo-na-vozilo/993372) reported that a severe storm with strong winds and heavy rain caused floods, downed trees, power outages, and damage across parts of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/olujni-vjetar-poharao-dijelove-bi-h-mjesta-ostala-bez-struje-stizu-prvi-detalji/) reported that a stormy wind battered parts of Bosnia and Herzegovina, leaving places without power.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/banjaluka/Jako-nevrijeme-u-Banjaluci-Kisa-pljusti-olujni-vjetar-polomio-drvo/993305) reported that a severe storm accompanied by strong wind gusts and heavy rain struck Banja Luka.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vremenska-prognoza/rhmz-se-oglasio-novim-upozorenjem-uskoro-stize-orkanski-vetar-jacine-110kmh/tm86eyx) reported that Serbia issued an urgent warning for severe weather expected during evening hours, with the Republic Hydrometeorological Institute forecasting hurricane-force winds up to 110 kilometers per hour.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089219/olujni-vjetar-zahvata-bih-u-narednim-satima-ocekuju-se-olujni-i-orkanski-udari-vjetra-do-90-kilometara-na-sat) reported that stormy and hurricane-force wind gusts reaching up to 90 kilometers per hour are affecting Bosnia and Herzegovina, with heavier rain expected in Herzegovina and the south.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Stizu-pljuskovi-i-olujni-vjetar-RHMZ-izdao-upozorenje-za-Republiku-Srpsku/993168) reported that the Republic Hydrometeorological Institute issued a warning for the Republika Srpska regarding strong to stormy winds with powerful gusts in certain areas.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1088771/meteorolozi-upozorili-veceras-stizu-olujni-udari-juga-tokom-noci-ocekuje-se-kisa-sirom-bih) reported that meteorologists warned that stormy southern wind gusts will arrive, with rain expected across Bosnia and Herzegovina during the night.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/u-narednim-satima-u-bi-h-stizu-olujni-udari-vjetra-ocekuje-se-i-kisa/) reported that BH Meteo issued warnings for upcoming stormy wind gusts and rain in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/nauka-tehnologija/okolina/Toplo-ali-varljivo-Danas-u-BiH-udari-vjetra-do-70-kmh-uvece-stize-kisa/992743) reported that temperatures in Bosnia and Herzegovina would reach 19 degrees with southerly wind gusts up to 70 kilometers per hour, followed by evening rain.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/ekonomija/trziste/Ispunjeni-uslovi-da-gorivo-u-BiH-dodatno-pojeftini-Kada-stizu-nove-cijene/992635) reported that experts stated conditions are met for additional price drops for fuel in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1088468/olujni-udari-juga-stizu-u-bih-poznato-kada-ce-vjetar-biti-najjaci) reported that stormy southerly wind gusts are arriving in Bosnia and Herzegovina, with the strongest winds expected on Tuesday and Thursday.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/bi-h-ceka-velika-promjena-vremena-nakon-obilne-kise-i-olujnog-juga-stize-snijeg/) reported that Bosnia and Herzegovina is expecting a weather change from warm temperatures and stormy southerly winds to snow.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/drustvo/Nevrijeme-stize-u-BiH-Olujni-vjetar-do-90-kmh-obilna-kisa-i-snijeg/992176) reported that meteoalarm issued warnings for winds up to 90 km/h, heavy rain in Herzegovina, and snow in higher elevations.

reports.text: [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/sheinbaum-contradice-a-trump-niega-que-planteara-en-china-tema-de-los-carteles-del-narcotrafico-en-mexico-33273781) reported that Mexican President Sheinbaum contradicted Trump, stating she only discussed commerce with the US president in China and that the cartel issue had only been mentioned previously.

reports.text: [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/isplata-depozita-alta-banke-postanska-stedionica-isplatila-185-miliona-evra/ew3067m) reported that Banka Postanska stedionica paid out about 185 million euros, which is more than half of the total insured funds of Alta banka in bankruptcy.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/postanska-stedionica-prodala-deo-drzavnih-obveznica-i-povecala-dinarsku-likvidnost/5pqkgbh) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica confirmed the acceptance of its bid to sell part of the government bonds of the Republic of Serbia at an early repurchase auction.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/dva-fonda-intesa-invest-izlozena-u-alta-banci-direktor-otkrio-sta-su-ga-prvo-pitali/14wn1n1) reported that Intesa Invest funds had a cumulative exposure of less than 1 percent toward Alta banka according to executive director Srdjan Maletic.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/isplata-depozita-alta-banke-slobodno-jos-14200-termina/5p87ptf) reported that over 25,000 depositors of bankrupt Alta banka scheduled an appointment through the Banka Poštanska štedionica portal to collect insured deposits.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/banka-postanska-stedionica-raspoloziva-gotovina-na-9872-odsto-bankomata/jb7rzys) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica announced available cash was confirmed on 98.72 percent of ATMs.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/postanska-stedionica-isplatila-vise-od-sedam-odsto-osiguranih-depozita-klijentima/6rqnc0h) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica continued the payout of insured deposits to Alta banka clients using funds provided by the Deposit Insurance Agency.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/rusi-cekaju-isplatu-novca-iz-alta-banke-kupili-smo-stanove-a-novac-stoji-na-racunu/5gz25z4) reported that the beginning of insured deposit payouts to bankrupt Alta banka clients brought relief to many savers while creating uncertainty for those with funds on accounts tied to apartments.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/postanska-stedionica-isplatila-sve-zakazane-klijente-alta-banke-prvog-dana-nastavak-i/6q0l3ml) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica announced it paid out all scheduled clients of Alta banka on the first day of insured deposit payouts despite a system failure.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/banka-postanska-stedionica-produzen-rad-zbog-isplate-depozita-alta-banke-termin/4mt6466) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica extended working hours for branches handling insured deposit payouts to Alta banka clients, with 16,450 clients having scheduled appointments.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/biznis/finansije/pocela-isplata-osiguranih-depozita-klijentima-alta-banke-u-srbiji/261113085) reported that Banka Poštanska štedionica began paying out insured deposits to clients of Alta banka in Serbia after its operating license was revoked.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/pocela-isplata-osiguranih-depozita-u-alta-banci-prijavilo-se-14-419-klijenata/) reported that 14,419 clients applied for payouts up to 50,000 euros per depositor.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/bahrain-strongly-condemns-irans-continued-attacks-calls-for-reparations/) reported that the Kingdom of Bahrain condemned Iranian air attacks on its territories, including a strike on a civilian industrial facility.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249601/IRGC-downs-20th-US-MQ-1-drone-in-eastern-Hormuz-Strait) reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps announced it shot down the 20th US MQ-1C ER drone in the eastern Strait of Hormuz.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/22/live-bahrain-attack-iran-war/) reported that Bahrain stated a civilian industrial facility was damaged in an Iran attack.

[Profit by Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxOQTdRRVdxQklZR3g3WHFTazQ4NGc2TXRCSzRHLWp6U2tkNURLWGtPQ0FmcWtwRXJQTm1iemc1SlE3aU1SX1k2Y1FEUi00THNWRm1KVUdOck43czAybDFabldWTVBKWUVHWTBSZUhpVmJydHhwLXJEd0d5SDRVREpnU0JlUGlEbFl3aUNkNGhVLUpWdXV0bmVJUHJmMzdnblVoX3pDMkhDemRPclFCTG8ybjZrSmw1dEQ0R3l5WXBXNXdpVkZB?oc=5), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045456/pakistans-mango-exports-fall-36pc-amid-us-iran-war-exporters-association) reported that Pakistan's mango exports fell 36 percent as Middle East tensions and the US-Iran war disrupted shipping routes and drove up freight costs.

reports.text: [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/25/8064533/) reported that Ukrainian air defences intercepted 88 Russian drones overnight, with strikes recorded at 18 locations and falling debris at 13 others.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4188315-air-defenses-down-88-of-112-russian-drones-targeting-ukraine-overnight.html) reported that Russian forces attacked Ukraine with 112 attack drones overnight on November 24-25.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-drones-reportedly-strike-russian-oil-refineries-in-massive-attack/) reported that monitoring channels stated Ukrainian forces struck two Russian oil refineries and set them ablaze in a massive overnight attack.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/24/355-ukrainian-drones-flew-toward-moscow-overnight-prompting-flight-restrictions-at-two-airports) reported that Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin stated 355 Ukrainian drones flew toward the capital overnight on November 24 and air defense forces shot down most of them.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/russia-says-it-shot-down-699-ukrainian-drones-overnight-including-355-targeting-moscow-region-101795505024950.html) reported that Russia stated its air defences intercepted 699 Ukrainian drones overnight, including 355 targeting the Moscow region.
[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2223681) reported that Russian air defenses shot down 10 Ukrainian drones headed for Moscow according to the mayor.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/23/ukrainian-drones-strike-two-russian-oil-refineries-and-pumping-station-in-overnight-attacks) reported that Ukrainian forces struck oil infrastructure facilities in Almetyevsk and Novoshakhtinsk overnight.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/russia-says-it-shot-down-192-ukrainian-drones-in-overnight-attacks/) reported that Russia's Defence Ministry announced air defence systems shot down 192 Ukrainian drones during overnight attacks.
[TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2222867), a Russian state-media report, stated that Russian air defenses intercepted 464 Ukrainian UAVs over the past day.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQYlNPelhjZnJORzRJbU5hclNnbDFfeTdBNDVhVnQxMTJodlRRazFIdlFlOFRJb0JGZFFlMHZWRmtaNTg4VExVaHBmU2JISGdnQ09EVW1DamJ1WF9zRDNCdUlYbTN5SGR3blFhVHpfZ3VqcF9lOGJVbW0yZVVyNFhUMDFUb1loc0lx?oc=5), [Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/russia-shoots-down-275-ukrainian-drones/) reported that Russia's Defence Ministry announced the interception and destruction of 275 Ukrainian drones overnight.
[TASS](https://tass.com/defense/2222839), a Russian state outlet, reported that air defenses destroyed 275 Ukrainian UAVs over 12 regions overnight.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90751) reported that the Council of the EU approved another €1 billion in military assistance for Ukraine covering joint purchases of drones and air defense equipment.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063768/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186737-ukraines-air-defenses-down-82-missiles-380-russian-drones-overnight.html) reported that Ukrainian air defenses intercepted or downed numerous missiles and drones launched by Russian forces overnight.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063559/) reported that Russia launched Oniks anti-ship missiles and 98 attack drones overnight, and Ukrainian forces destroyed 69 drones.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4186118-zelensky-discusses-support-for-ukraines-combat-aviation-with-portuguese-foreign-minister.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky met with Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel to discuss support for Ukraine's combat aviation.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90475) reported that Canada announced a new military package for Ukraine worth hundreds of millions of Canadian dollars, including funding for the Czech ammunition initiative and air defense.

[UK Defence Journal](https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/uk-to-send-ukraine-more-than-a-thousand-air-defence-missiles/) reported that Britain will send Ukraine more than 1,000 short-range air defense missiles from Thales Belfast and over a dozen radars in a £240m winter package.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063455/) reported that Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel stated Portugal cannot supply F-16 fighter jets to Ukraine due to domestic airspace and maritime defence needs.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/uk-to-supply-ukraine-with-more-than-1000-short-range-air-defense-missiles-3725721), a local outlet, reported that Defense Secretary Wes Streeting announced a £240 million package of missiles, launchers, and radars for Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063360/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called on Western partners to accelerate air defence deliveries and highlighted ongoing Russian attacks with jet-powered weapons.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063378/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185864-air-defence-neutralises-126-russian-drones-used-to-attack-ukraine-overnight.html) reported that Ukrainian air defense forces destroyed or jammed 126 out of 141 drones launched overnight by Russia, with strikes recorded at seven locations.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185832-canada-to-allocate-120m-in-military-aid-to-ukraine.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063366/) reported that the Canadian government announced a new military assistance package for Ukraine including ammunition, specialised air defence sensors, and winter military equipment.

[National Defence (Canada)](https://www.canada.ca/en/department-national-defence/news/2026/11/minister-mcguinty-announces-new-military-aid-to-ukraine-at-ukraine-defense-contact-group-meeting.html) reported that Canadian National Defence Minister David McGuinty announced new military aid to Ukraine at the 37th Ukraine Defense Contact Group meeting.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063307/) reported that the UK anticipates a number of announcements on weapons for Ukraine at the Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063323/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy requested 40 more F-16 fighter jets and proposed an air defence missile exchange at the Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063305/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185706-over-1000-air-defense-missiles-uk-announces-gbp-240m-military-aid-package-for-ukraine.html) reported that the UK government announced a £240 million military aid package providing over 1,000 short-range air defense missiles for Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063265/) reported that starting the evening of 16 November, Russia launched over 300 UAVs and missiles against Ukraine, with air defences downing 205 drones.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219745) reported that the Russian Defense Ministry claimed its air defenses set a single-day record by shooting down nine Flamingo cruise missiles, a guided air bomb, and 2,256 drones.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185432-fire-breaks-out-at-a-petrochemical-complex-after-attack-in-russias-bashkortostan-media.html) reported that an attack targeted the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat petrochemical complex in the Republic of Bashkortostan, causing a fire.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/fire-reported-at-major-russian-petrochemical-complex-in-bashkortostan-amid-drone-attack/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90314) reported that Ukrainian drones targeted the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan, causing a fire.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90314) reported that Moscow claimed a record 1,441 drones had been downed.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063109/) reported that Ukraine's Defence Ministry stated private businesses have helped expand air defence capabilities since spring 2026 through groups operating under military command.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQVFRjc0toOVM1UmJiaXJrMTA4MU43ZmY2Yjc1QTlwcTQwUVA3TGZ5MVZuSzNRSmRwR2J3TkVHWWE0OWNlX3lkeU5pQnNQcWk5Q19Ua2k3ME5BalMyMEp1RzUyZ3FQdTFxdDZ1TWJLaVNmcWljSl9qMkVZaHdXbFhsUEk0OVJ5OVI5eUVVMm5haW5qanpUdW8yZDN5cw?oc=5) reported that Brazil's former president Jair Bolsonaro was taken to the ICU.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/brazils-former-president-jair-bolsonaro-has-been-hospitalized-again-son-says/) reported that Brazil's former president Jair Bolsonaro is back in the hospital for abdominal pain.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/flvio-bolsonaro-says-he-will-run-again-denies-fleeing-brazil-after-defeat/articleshow/135799066.cms), [The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/brazil-flavio-bolsonaro-ready-to-run-again-new-election-2026/) reported that Flávio Bolsonaro stated he will run again and denied fleeing Brazil after his defeat.

reports.text: [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/obrazlozenje-odluke-o-simbolima-armije-rbih-mogu-ih-ukinuti-samo-institucije-bih-nsrs-nema-to-pravo/261123250) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina stated that only state-level institutions can repeal the symbols of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina, and the National Assembly of Republika Srpska lacks the right to do so.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Valerija-Galic-nije-saglasna-sa-odlukom-Ustavnog-suda-o-vetu-Zeljke-Cvijanovic/993877) reported that Constitutional Court Vice President Valerija Galic disagreed with the court's decision regarding Zeljka Cvijanovic's veto.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/biznis/ekonomija/bingo-ostaje-vlasnik-hotela-zenit-ustavni-sud-bih-odbio-apelacije-hnk-i-neuma/261123179) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina rejected the appeals of Herzegovina-Neretva Canton and Neum regarding Hotel Zenit.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/ustavni-sud-bih-detaljno-objasnio-zasto-je-srusio-veto-zeljke-cvijanovic-valerija-galic-dala-izjavu-o-neslaganju/261123253) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina explained its decision to overturn Zeljka Cvijanovic's veto regarding the Commission to Preserve National Monuments.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/ademovic-ustavni-sud-bi-h-je-jedini-bedem-pred-secesionistickom-politikom-iz-rs/) reported that legal expert Ademović stated the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the only bulwark against secessionist policy from Republika Srpska.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1090081/sanja-vulic-udarila-na-ustavni-sud-bih-odavno-je-vrijeme-da-stranim-sudijama-kazemo-goodbye) reported that SNSD Caucus Head Sanja Vulić criticized the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina and stated that it is time to say goodbye to foreign judges.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/kovacevic-o-odluci-ustavnog-suda-bi-h-ovo-je-napad-na-prava-srba/) reported that SNSD delegate Kovačević commented on a Constitutional Court decision concerning Bosnia and Herzegovina.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/nedim-ademovic-u-rs-u-su-odluke-ustavnog-suda-bih-samo-izgovor-za-blokadu-drzavnog-sistema/261121066) reported that constitutional law expert Nedim Ademovic considers that decisions of the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina are used only as an excuse for blockades of the state system in Republika Srpska.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/opozicija-u-rs-u-nazvala-odluku-ustavnog-suda-bih-provokacijom-traze-odlazak-stranih-sudija/261121004) reported that political leaders Draško Stanivuković and Ognjen Bodiroga described the Constitutional Court's decision as unacceptable.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/becirovic-entitetski-zakoni-ne-mogu-osporavati-upotrebu-obiljezja-armije-r-bi-h/) reported that BiH Presidency member Denis Bećirović stated that entity laws cannot challenge the use of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina insignia.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/historijski-presedan-ustavni-sud-bi-h-prvi-put-preispitao-veto-u-predsjednistvu/) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina reviewed a veto in the Presidency for the first time and annulled Cvijanović's veto.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Minic-Nema-formiranja-vlasti-na-nivou-BiH-dok-se-rusi-Srpska/993552) reported that Republika Srpska President Savo Minic stated there will be no talks on forming government levels in Bosnia and Herzegovina until issues regarding state property and the OHR are resolved.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/sda-zadovoljna-odlukom-ustavnog-suda-pod-ljiljanima-je-branjena-nasa-drzava/) reported that the SDA expressed satisfaction with the Constitutional Court's decision.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/hoce-li-komisija-za-ocuvanje-nacionalnih-spomenika-postati-prvi-test-za-buduce-odnose-u-predsjednistvu-bih/261120290) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina left the appointment of four members of the Commission to Preserve National Monuments in force.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/stanivukovic-tvrdi-da-odluka-o-zastavi-armije-r-bi-h-ponovo-otvara-ratne-rane/), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089646/odluka-ustavnog-suda-bih-izazvala-reakciju-stanivukovica-ponovo-otvaraju-rane) reported that Stanivuković stated that the decision of the Constitutional Court of BiH regarding the Army of RBiH flag reopens war wounds and is unacceptable.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/snsd-krece-s-ucjenama-najavljena-potpuna-blokada-vijeca-ministara-zbog-odluke-ustavnog-suda-o-zastavama-armije-bih/261120261) reported that SNSD President Milorad Dodik stated no member of the BiH Council of Ministers from that party will make any decision until the Constitutional Court's decision is withdrawn.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089634/sda-pozdravila-odluku-ustavnog-suda-ljiljani-i-simboli-armije-rbih-predstavljaju-dio-historijskog-i-drzavnog-naslijedja-bih), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/sda-odluka-ustavnog-suda-bih-potvrdila-da-ljiljani-i-simboli-armije-rbih-ne-mogu-biti-zabranjeni/261120312) reported that SDA welcomed the Constitutional Court's decision, stating that the lilies and symbols of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina represent part of the historical and state heritage of BiH.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089638/dodik-se-oglasio-i-na-drustvenim-mrezama-nakon-odluke-ustavnog-suda-danas-je-umrla-bosna-i-hercegovina) reported that Dodik posted on social media that Bosnia and Herzegovina died today.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/ustavni-sud-srusio-veto-cvijanovic-komisija-za-zastitu-nacionalnih-spomenika-imenovana-u-skladu-sa-zakonom/261120219) reported that the Constitutional Court of BiH set aside Željka Cvijanović's statement on the vital interest of Republika Srpska and the National Assembly decision confirming it.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/zestoka-reakcija-iz-rs-nikada-ovdje-nece-postaviti-zastavu-armije-r-bi-h/) reported a fierce reaction from Republika Srpska regarding the Constitutional Court decision.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/dodik-da-dode-100-ustavnih-sudova-nece-postaviti-nijednu-zastavu-armije-rbih-u-rs-neka-probaju/261120242) reported that SNSD President Milorad Dodik reacted to the Constitutional Court of BiH ruling by stating that no flag of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina would be placed in Republika Srpska.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/odluka-ustavnog-suda-bih-zabrana-simbola-armije-rbih-je-neustavna/261120215), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1089543/ustavni-sud-bih-ukinuo-zabranu-simbola-armije-rbih-u-rs-oboren-veto-zeljke-cvijanovic) reported that the Constitutional Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina ruled that the provision of the Republika Srpska Criminal Code punishing the display of Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina symbols is unconstitutional.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/vijece-ministara-ukinulo-odluku-o-kupovini-zgrade-za-smjestaj-drzavnih-institucija-u-istocnom-sarajevu/261120277), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/vijece-ministara-bi-h-ponistilo-odluku-o-kupovini-zgrade-u-istocnom-sarajevu/) reported that the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina annulled the decision to purchase a building in East Sarajevo for state institutions.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/covic-najavio-da-ce-nova-vlada-fbih-biti-formirana-do-kraja-februara/261118278), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/covic-najavio-kada-bi-bi-h-mogla-dobiti-novo-vijece-ministara-i-vladu-f-bi-h/) reported that HDZ BiH President Dragan Čović stated that talks on forming the government are intensive and expressed expectations for the legislative authority to be established by the end of February.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Covic-otkrio-s-kim-je-razgovarao-o-formiranju-vlasti-i-najavio-rokove/993122) reported that HDZ BiH President Dragan Čović stated talks had been held with SDA, SDP, and SNSD on government formation.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/covic-do-kraja-novembra-najavio-teske-razgovore-o-formiranju-vlasti-u-bi-h/) reported that HDZ BiH leader Dragan Čović announced difficult talks on government formation by the end of November.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/covic-najavio-smjenu-generacija-u-hdz-u-tako-smo-poceli-s-clanicom-predsjednistva-bih/261113122) reported that Dragan Čović announced a generational shift in the HDZ after a session of the HDZ Presidency in Mostar.

reports.text: [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/benue-apc-crisis-why-alia-akume-reconciliation-ll-not-work-factional-chair-agada/) reported that Benue State APC factional chairman Austin Agada declared that a reconciliation between Governor Hyacinth Alia and George Akume will not work.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-court-sacks-agbo-as-apc-benue-south-senatorial-candidate-declares-alapa-winner/) reported that Justice Salim Ibrahim sacked Agbo as the APC Benue South senatorial candidate and declared Alapa the winner.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/927092-again-apc-moves-to-reconcile-akume-and-alia-in-benue.html) reported that Benue Governor Hyacinth Alia and SGF George Akume have a long-running dispute over party leadership in the state.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/alia-akume-suswam-others-meet-over-benue-apc-crisis/) reported that Benue State Governor Hyacinth Alia reiterated his commitment to reconciliation and unity within the All Progressives Congress.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/apc-cancels-cross-river-campaign-kick-off/) reported that the All Progressives Congress in Cross River cancelled its campaign kick-off and directed candidates to continue ward-to-ward campaigns.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/apc-senatorial-candidate-pledges-to-connect-osun-central-to-opportunities/) reported that Osun Central Senatorial Candidate on the platform of the APC, Barrister Kunle Rasheed Adegoke, pledged to connect Osun Central to opportunities.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kwara-south-apc-candidate-adewoye-confident-of-victory/) reported that Prince Olalekan Adewoye, the All Progressives Congress senatorial candidate for Kwara South in the 2027 general election, expressed confidence in victory.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nnorth-east/926442-court-dismisses-suit-challenging-taraba-apc-chairmans-emergence.html) reported that a court dismissed a suit challenging the Taraba APC chairman's emergence, which was filed by chairmanship aspirant Abdulhadi Lau.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/just-in-court-upholds-yahaya-bellos-emergence-as-apc-senatorial-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/926397-court-strikes-out-suit-challenging-yahaya-bellos-apc-senatorial-candidacy.html) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja upheld Yahaya Bello as the APC candidate for Kogi Central, dismissing Momoh Obaro's suit.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/apc-kwara-south-senatorial-candidate-adewoye-seeks-policies-to-protect-indigenous-investors/) reported that All Progressives Congress Kwara South senatorial candidate Prince Olalekan Adewoye called for policies to protect indigenous investors.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/kwara-south-apcs-adewoye-advocates-improved-security-framework/) reported that APC candidate Prince Lekan Adewoye advocated an improved security framework for Kwara South.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/benue-north-east-court-declares-suswam-as-apc-valid-senatorial-candidate/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/breaking-court-affirms-suswams-victory-in-benue-apc-primary/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/benue-court-affirms-gabriel-suswam-as-winner-of-apc-senatorial-primary/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja declared former Governor of Benue Gabriel Suswam as the valid candidate of the All Progressives Congress for the senatorial primary.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/supreme-court-reserves-judgment-in-zamfara-north-apc-senatorial-dispute/) reported that the Supreme Court reserved judgment in the legal dispute concerning the All Progressives Congress primary election for Zamfara North.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741673-2027-election-court-takes-action-suit-challenging-cross-river-apc-candidate/) reported that a legal battle over the APC candidate in Cross River State took a new turn ahead of the 2027 election.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/emir-of-kano-congratulates-jaji-on-zamfara-apc-primary-victory/) reported that the Emir of Kano, Muhammadu Sanusi II, congratulated Aminu Sani Jaji on his victory in the Zamfara APC primary.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1741398-just-sanusi-reacts-winner-emerges-apc-rerun-primary/) reported that the Tijjaniyya of Nigeria commented on the outcome of the APC's rerun National Assembly primary election.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/jaji-wins-zamfara-apc-rerun-primary-with-26646-votes/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741218-apc-announces-winner-zamfara-house-reps-rerun-primary/) reported that Aminu Sani Jaji won the All Progressives Congress court-ordered rerun primary in Zamfara State.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/criver-central-stakeholders-hail-affirmation-of-ewa-as-apc-primary-winner/) reported that APC stakeholders in Cross River State urged party members to unite behind Oden Ewa following affirmation of his primary win.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/13/court-affirms-oden-ewas-apc-senatorial-primary-victory/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja affirmed Oden Ewa as the APC candidate for the Cross River Central Senatorial District.

reports.text: [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/alberto-nunez-feijoo-one-step-away-from-running-spain/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Alberto Núñez Feijóo styles himself as an unflashy, sober manager in contrast to Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/comunidad-valenciana/feijoo-carga-alicante-feminismo-pedro-sanchez-vispera-25n_202611246b05e82ec0d5c85b96c65e33.html) reported that PP president Feijóo gathered 1,000 people at the Archaeological Museum gardens in Alicante.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-24/feijoo-en-espana-no-habra-sitio-para-quien-no-respete-a-las-mujeres-ni-a-las-personas-lgtbi.html) reported that PP leader Feijóo stated in Alicante that Spain will have no place for anyone who does not respect women or LGTBI people.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/elecciones-en-espana-quienes-son-alberto-nunez-feijoo-y-santiago-abascal-los-que-podrian-sacar-del-poder-a-pedro-sanchez-esto-dicen-las-encuestas-3603466) reported that Spain will hold elections on November 29, with incumbent Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez seeking a fourth term while challengers Alberto Núñez Feijóo and Santiago Abascal aim to return the right to power.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/mexico-arranca-las-votaciones-para-las-elecciones-generales-espanolas-del-29n-33249233), [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/elecciones-espana-argentina-mexico-abren-votaciones-29n_1795295988) reported that voting opened in countries including Mexico and Argentina for Spanish citizens ahead of the general elections on November 29.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-20/montero-y-rufian-sacan-musculo-en-madrid-en-un-acto-con-un-duro-discurso-contra-psoe-y-frente-amplio.html) reported that Podemos gathered 3.5k supporters at its central campaign rally with a sharp speech against PSOE and Frente Amplio.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/echenique-acusa-frente-amplio-pedir-voto-psoe-desata-nuevo-choque-izquierda-tires-voto_202611206b006e94f6da642efef6c249.html) reported that former Podemos leader Pablo Echenique criticized Alberto Garzón's statements on strategic voting.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/abascal-advierte-de-que-sanchez-no-se-ira-de-rositas-si-pierde-las-elecciones.html) reported that Vox leader Santiago Abascal warned that Pedro Sánchez will not get off lightly if he loses the elections.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/que-propone-partido-popular-inmigracion-politica-exterior-elecciones-29n_202611196aff5c5bf6b335433bb604ca.html) reported that Feijóo's election proposals include a more restrictive migration model, quick returns, and a pro-European and pro-Atlanticist foreign policy.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/que-propone-psoe-politica-social-servicios-sociales-29n_202611196aff454b18c34d33accf241e.html) reported that the PSOE aims to reinforce social policies and improve social service benefits with sports and education as axes.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/sanchez-olvida-urda-feijoo-recuerda-que-tiene-70-muertos-alta-velocidad-mundo_202611196aff7201f6b335433bb61048.html), [El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-19/feijoo-recrimina-a-sanchez-los-muertos-en-urda-y-adamuz-y-el-se-disculpa-es-un-dolor-que-llevare-conmigo.html) reported that Feijóo brought up high-speed railway tragedies including Urda and Adamuz during the debate and demanded Sánchez apologize to victims, while Sánchez apologized and stated it is a pain that will accompany him for life.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-18/campana-electoral-29-n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that Prime Minister Sánchez expressed confidence in forming a government with a broader progressive majority during the sixth day of electoral campaigning.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/elecciones-generales-29n-directo-ultima-hora-campana-debate-sanchez-feijoo_202611186afd320b21e74551e81db3cc.html) reported that candidates are preparing for a debate while issues include the minimum wage and civil servant salaries.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-17/abascal-advierte-de-que-el-no-pide-el-voto-al-senado-para-el-pp-en-canarias.html) reported that Abascal warned he will not ask for Senate votes for the People's Party in the Canary Islands, while People's Party member Tellado asked to support the ultra party in provinces where it does not present a candidate.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-16/frente-amplio-busca-desmarcarse-del-psoe-con-un-programa-que-blinda-la-vivienda-y-estimula-la-redistribucion-de-la-riqueza.html) reported that Frente Amplio leader Bustinduy challenged Sánchez to approve a universal child-rearing benefit before the elections.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/feijoo-cambia-agenda-guipuzcoa-agresion-borrokas-candidato-calle-vuestra_202611156af9d6daea8d89799786925b.html) reported that People's Party leader Alberto Nunez Feijoo changed his campaign schedule to visit Guipuzcoa after an attack on his candidate.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-15/feijoo-hara-campana-en-guipuzcoa-tras-la-agresion-a-jovenes-de-nuevas-generaciones-en-hernani.html) reported that PP leader Alberto Nunez Feijoo reiterated his proposal to exempt first-time job holders from paying income tax during their first year of employment.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/sanchez-encuestas-vende-mayoria-absoluta-pide-frenar-involucion-pero-psoe-invoca-fantasmas-guerra-civil_202611156af9af7103bbf30bb04d23a7.html) reported that Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez claimed an absolute majority and called for efforts to halt regression during a campaign rally.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-15/campana-electoral-29n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party condemned attacks committed against the People's Party candidate in Hernani, while Alberto Núñez Feijóo campaigns in Gipuzkoa.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/patxi-lopez-confia-triunfo-psoe-frente-involucion-que-proponen-vox_202611146af85d904196933d7edd33dc.html) reported that Patxi Lopez expressed confidence in a PSOE triumph against the opposition.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/cuatros-modelos-dos-bloques-muchos-reproches-pocas-ideas-nuevas_202611136af78eab03bbf30bb04b8a7e.html) reported that the economic representatives of PSOE, PP, Vox, and Frente Amplio held an election debate without a declared winner.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/2026-11-13/psoe-y-frente-amplio-cierran-filas-en-el-primer-debate-a-cuatro-ante-la-critica-del-pp-a-la-gestion-del-gobierno-y-un-vox-centrado-en-la-inmigracion.html) reported that the debate covered housing, salaries, and pensions with few new proposals.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-14/sanchez-pide-el-voto-europeista-para-frenar-a-abascal.html) reported that Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez asked for votes to stop Abascal during the election campaign.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/gobierno-activa-subida-pensiones-2027-primer-dia-campana-electoral_202611136af700a8d3bddc0868b05ce0.html), [El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/campana-elecciones-29n-y-actualidad-politica-en-directo.html) reported that the Council of Ministers approved the urgent processing of a decree to revalue pensions between 3% and 4%.

reports.text: [Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/blogs-opinion/blogs/building-collapses-expose-crisis-of-accountability--5681484) reported that building collapses expose a crisis of accountability demanding drastic action.

[Pajhwok Afghan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOU0M5d05ZUzVoNUxpQXJiUFlTcGRKWFpFN29RTkxFd2hoMktvSHVBUTBZZ3EwRnJRSnVyY3p2QV84TjJQLXVkbi00S2s5d3VyV3VMb21HaHlIUlBwZUpyRl9LXzk0ci1vYWhsYnFHVlhqbTFOWV9jbVhCVlNsVFZqQlgyVmVocnR2MzZiVmhpSVdVUQ?oc=5) reported that six people were killed in an explosion at a residential building in Georgia.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/six-killed-in-suspected-gas-explosion-at-georgia-apartment-building?traffic_source=rss), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/6-dead-including-child-after-suspected-gas-explosion-levels-building-in-georgia/articleshow/136009645.cms) reported that six people, including a child, were killed in a suspected gas explosion that caused a part of an apartment building to collapse in Tbilisi.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375125/3-dead-3-trapped-georgia-building-collapses-after-gas-blast) reported that a suspected natural gas explosion in a residential block in Tbilisi killed three people and left three others trapped.

[El País](https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-13/las-seis-horas-de-jordi-wild-con-sanchez-feijoo-colau-y-el-fary-en-su-casa-esto-es-una-vez-en-la-vida.html), [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/mentiras-sanchez-jordi-wild_202611136af77949d3bddc0868b0de81.html) reported on statements and interviews involving Spanish political leaders including Pedro Sánchez and Alberto Núñez Feijóo.

reports.text: [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/ils-ne-me-font-pas-peur-le-prefet-demissionnaire-hugues-moutouh-veut-rendre-coup-pour-coup-20261125) reported that outgoing Loiret prefect Hugues Moutouh stated that he is not afraid and wants to fight back, as he believes he is the victim of a political operation.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/24/budget-un-premier-texte-adopte-par-le-parlement-sebastien-lecornu-reve-desormais-d-un-compromis-pour-2027_6814842_823448.html) reported that Parliament validated the management closure law for 2026.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/budget-sebastien-lecornu-tend-la-main-aux-parlementaires-pour-un-compromis-sans-toucher-au-deficit-20261124) reported that Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced he will receive parliamentary group presidents next week to continue budget discussions.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/soupcons-de-fuites-vers-le-rn-c-est-un-lynchage-mediatique-qui-est-commande-le-prefet-hugues-moutouh-annonce-deposer-plainte-20261123) reported that Central-Val de Loire prefect Hugues Moutouh, suspected of leaking investigation information to the National Rally, announced he is filing a complaint.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/soupcons-de-fuites-au-profit-du-rn-un-mail-du-service-du-prefet-hugues-moutouh-decouvert-en-perquisition-chez-un-proche-de-marine-le-pen-20261122) reported that investigators discovered an email from the service of prefect Hugues Moutouh during a search at an associate of Marine Le Pen.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/soupcons-de-fuites-vers-le-rn-marine-le-pen-dit-n-avoir-jamais-recu-d-information-confidentielle-de-la-part-du-prefet-hugues-moutouh-20261122) reported that Marine Le Pen stated she never received confidential information from prefect Hugues Moutouh.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/21/hugues-moutouh-le-prefet-soupconne-de-fuites-d-informations-confidentielles-vers-le-rn-a-demande-a-etre-releve-de-ses-fonctions_6814056_3224.html) reported that prefect Hugues Moutouh, suspected of leaking confidential information to the National Rally, asked to be relieved of his duties.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/soupcons-de-fuites-au-profit-du-rn-le-prefet-hugues-moutouh-dans-la-tempete-20261120) reported that Hugues Moutouh was summoned by Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez regarding suspicions he informed the National Rally on ongoing cases.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/en-direct-colere-sociale-laurent-nunez-appelle-les-prefets-a-la-vigilance-20261121) reported that Laurent Nuñez called on prefects to be vigilant ahead of a sixth day of social mobilization.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2026/11/20/fuites-en-provenance-du-ministere-de-l-interieur-vers-le-rn-des-faits-extremement-graves-s-ils-sont-averes-juge-laurent-nunez_6813604_3224.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/soupcons-de-fuites-au-profit-du-rn-si-les-faits-concernant-le-prefet-moutouh-sont-averes-ils-sont-tres-graves-reagit-laurent-nunez-20261120) reported that judicial authorities are investigating suspected leaks of ongoing investigation elements concerning the National Rally from the interior ministry, prompting Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez to call the facts extremely grave if proven.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/conjoncture/un-peu-plus-d-un-milliard-d-euros-le-cout-de-la-hausse-du-smic-et-des-bas-salaires-des-fonctionnaires-devoile-par-le-gouvernement-20261115), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/15/les-revalorisations-du-smic-et-des-bas-salaires-des-fonctionnaires-couteront-un-peu-plus-de-1-milliard-d-euros-aux-finances-publiques-selon-le-gouvernement_6811009_823448.html) reported that Public Accounts Minister David Amiel stated that the revaluation of the minimum wage and civil service low salaries will cost public finances just over 1 billion euros, impacting public service expenditures.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/13/salaires-des-fonctionnaires-les-mesures-d-urgence-du-gouvernement-jugees-insuffisantes-par-les-syndicats_6809348_823448.html) reported that trade unions deemed the French government's emergency measures regarding civil service salaries to be insufficient.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/13/mobilisations-sociales-sebastien-lecornu-ouvre-une-discussion-d-un-mois-avec-les-syndicats_6809324_823448.html) reported that Sébastien Lecornu opened a month-long discussion with civil service unions, following which the CFDT announced it will join a public strike and mobilization.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/ne-pas-baisser-la-garde-laurent-nunez-promet-un-gros-dispositif-reactif-et-percutant-pour-un-nouveau-samedi-de-colere-sociale-a-hauts-risques-20261113) reported that Laurent Nuñez promised a large security deployment for a new Saturday of social unrest.

reports.text: [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/woke-significado-gobierno-abelardo-de-la-espriella-JI43965590) reported that the Council of State ordered President Abelardo de la Espriella to recognize that 'wokism' is not an enemy of the nation's values.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/el-hijo-de-nicolas-maduro-convoca-a-celebrar-el-cumpleanos-de-su-padre-en-venezuela_0_FWfTrJ8oin.html), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/hijo-de-nicolas-maduro-convoca-festejo-de-cumpleanos-para-su-padre-en-venezuela-llama-a-cantarle-cumpleanos/) reported that the son of detained former Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro called for public celebrations and birthday gatherings in communes across Venezuela while his father remains detained in the United States.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/venezuela/la-poderosa-red-de-corrupcion-chavista-que-sobrevivio-a-nicolas-maduro-en-venezuela-millones-de-dolares-estan-bajo-investigacion-3602503) reported that an analysis delivered to the New York prosecutor's office reveals how the capture of Nicolás Maduro leaves a Chavista corruption network under investigation.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/benedetti-sabia-atentado-miguel-uribe-tarazona-advertencia-exministro-miembro-congreso-MH43886138) reported that Tarazona spoke about whether Benedetti knew of the assassination plot against Miguel Uribe and mentioned a warning given to a member of Congress.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/maria-claudia-tarazona-quien-dio-orden-magnicidio-miguel-uribe-gustavo-petro-PI43878711) reported that Maria Claudia Tarazona, widow of Miguel Uribe Turbay, made statements regarding the assassination.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/en-el-sitio-del-atentado-uribe-turbay-habia-personal-de-dni-tarazona) reported that the widow of Miguel Uribe Turbay stated National Intelligence Directorate personnel were present at the site of the attack against him and that the prosecutor's office has a video showing two individuals.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/magnicidio-miguel-uribe-funcionarios-dni-grabacion-escena-del-crimen-denuncia-maria-tarazona-LN43825538) reported that Maria Claudia Tarazona claimed there were people from the National Intelligence Directorate present on the day Miguel Uribe was killed.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/consejo-de-estado-ordena-expresidente-petro-borrar-acusaciones-contra-registrador) reported that the Council of State ordered former president Gustavo Petro to delete 12 publications containing accusations against the registrar.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/maria-claudia-tarazona-senala-autores-asesinato-miguel-uribe-segunda-marquetalia-GJ43684057) reported that Maria Claudia Tarazona claimed the order to assassinate Miguel Uribe came from Gustavo Petro and Nicolas Maduro.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/consejo-de-estado-ordeno-gustavo-petro-retirar-fraude-electoral-DI43697040) reported that the Council of State ordered Gustavo Petro to remove publications regarding alleged electoral fraud.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/gustavo-petro-fue-complice-en-el-fraude-electoral-de-nicolas-maduro-en-venezuela-paz-total-y-agenda-energetica-entre-las-claves-3600661), [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/petro-ayudo-a-maduro-a-sostenerse-tras-fraude-electoral-segun-informe-FG43542601) reported that a report from the Miranda Center for Democracy stated that Gustavo Petro was complicit in Nicolás Maduro's electoral fraud in Venezuela.

reports.text: [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642067/israeli-airstrikes-artillery-shelling-hit-southern-lebanon-as-violations-of-us-deal-continue) reported that Israeli airstrikes and artillery shelling hit areas in Nabatieh, Marjayoun, Bint Jbeil and Tyre districts in southern Lebanon.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-strikes-hit-southern-lebanon-despite-us-mediated-deal-3725945) reported that Israeli airstrikes, shelling and machine-gun fire hit southern Lebanon despite a US-mediated framework agreement with no casualties reported.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/23/israeli-military-accused-of-exploiting-lebanese-schoolchildren-in-propaganda-video/) reported that the Israeli military was accused of exploiting Lebanese schoolchildren in a propaganda video.

[Naharnet](https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/323948-lebanon-denounces-israeli-military-official-s-visit-to-school-in-south) reported that Lebanese officials denounced a visit by an Israeli military spokesperson to a school in a Christian village in an Israeli-occupied area of southern Lebanon.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/lebanon-pm-condemns-israeli-army-over-use-of-schoolchildren-in-propaganda-video/), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261123-lebanon-condemns-israeli-army-raid-on-southern-school-as-hostile-show/) reported that Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam condemned the Israeli army's entry into Debel Public School in southern Lebanon.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/23/israeli-forces-continue-house-demolitions-in-southern-lebanon?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israeli forces continue house demolitions in southern Lebanon.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-army-attacks-southern-lebanon-towns-on-saturday-3725824), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261121-israeli-army-launches-renewed-attacks-on-southern-lebanese-towns/) reported that the Israeli army carried out artillery shelling and gunfire on towns across Nabatieh, Bint Jbeil, and Marjayoun in southern Lebanon.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/unifil-records-2840-israeli-artillery-shells-90-airstrikes-in-southern-lebanon-in-october-alone-3013261) reported that the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon stated Israeli violations continued across southern Lebanon in October, including 2,840 artillery shells and 90 airstrikes.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261120-israeli-attacks-hit-4-districts-in-southern-lebanon-cause-fires-damage/) reported that Israeli forces carried out attacks across four districts in southern Lebanon causing fires and material damage.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222611), a state-media outlet, reported that Israeli reconnaissance drones were heard flying over Beirut at medium altitude for several hours.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261119-israeli-airstrikes-hit-eastern-lebanon-target-homes-buildings-in-south/) reported that Israeli warplanes carried out five airstrikes on a mountainous area in eastern Lebanon while additional airstrikes, drone attacks, and artillery shelling hit the south.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261120-israeli-airstrikes-hit-southern-lebanon-as-drones-fly-over-beirut-sidon/) reported that Israeli warplanes carried out two airstrikes on a town in southern Lebanon and an Israeli military drone flew at medium altitude over Beirut and Sidon.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/15/israeli-drone-filmed-flying-low-outside-homes-in-southern-lebanon?traffic_source=rss) reported that video showed an Israeli drone flying at low altitude over a residential area in southern Lebanon.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-forces-shell-5-southern-lebanon-towns-as-drones-fly-low-over-beirut-3725535), [Naharnet](https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/323762-low-flying-drones-buzz-beirut-as-israeli-shelling-targets-southern-towns) reported that Israeli forces shelled five southern Lebanon towns and low-flying drones buzzed Beirut.
