narratives.label: Serbia National Assembly consultations

reports.text: [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucic-sam-sedi-u-poslanickim-klupama-opozicije-otkrio-razlog/byvw2em) reported that Serbian Progressive Party parliamentary group head Aleksandar Vučić remained sitting alone in opposition benches after a recess in the National Assembly.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-uzivo-danas-se-raspravlja-samo-jedna-tacka-dnevnog-reda/h73jbdp) reported that the National Assembly continued its constitutive session with a discussion on parliamentary delegations while students observed from the gallery.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/studenti-usli-na-sjednicu-narodne-skupstine-srbije-i-dobili-gromoglasan-aplauz-vucic-ih-ogorceno-posmatrao/261124091) reported that representatives of the Student Movement entered the hall of the National Assembly of Serbia during its session.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/stanovi-aleksandra-cupica-vucic-spominje-milione-evo-sta-kaze-novi-predsednik/mxy5sqb) reported that Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić criticized the statement of National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić regarding property ownership.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/cupic-najavio-konsultacije-oko-formiranja-skupstinskih-odbora/s6ggxg7) reported that National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić announced consultations regarding the formation of parliamentary committees ahead of the continuation of the constitutive session.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/u-utorak-nastavak-konstitutivne-sednice-skupstine-srbije/m21fnxe) reported that the constitutive session of the National Assembly will continue on Tuesday, November 24.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/rastislav-dinic-i-zoran-lutovac-komentarisali-odluku-studentske-liste-o-skupstini/qrz2vqg) reported that the fact that the Student List did not give any parliamentary vice-president position to either the SNS or minority parties has been a topic of discussion for days.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-za-pevnicom-u-crkvi-u-raski-povodom-slave-arandjelovdan/qp0bsvm) reported that National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić attended a liturgy in Raška and sang church songs with believers.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-sastao-sa-sefom-delegacije-eu-u-srbiji-foto/64zqtng) reported that the EU Delegation's charge d'affaires in Serbia, Julian Vassallo, met with newly elected National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/kosta-cestitao-cupicu-imenovanje-za-predsednika-skupstine/txwtk3m) reported that European Council President António Costa congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his appointment as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/pogledajte-sta-je-aleksandar-cupic-radio-dan-nakon-izbora-za-predsednika-skupstine/4x82b6x) reported that newly elected National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić removed graffiti with students the morning after his election.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/nesvakidasnja-scena-ispred-skupstine-srbije-cupic-zapevao-sa-poslanicima/ryqtxrj) reported that the new president of the National Assembly of Serbia, Aleksandar Čupić, sang outside the parliament building with gathered citizens and deputies.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/studenti-odgovorili-na-dodikovu-cestitku-novom-predsjedniku-skupstine-srbije-sreca-pa-ne-zaboravljamo/261120039) reported that students from Serbia responded to Milorad Dodik's congratulatory message to the new president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089376/izglasano-sest-potpredsjednika-narodne-skupstine-republike-srbije) reported that six vice presidents of the National Assembly of Serbia were elected, with all functions going to deputies of the Student List "Students win".

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/obratili-se-predstavnici-studentske-liste-nakon-sednice-skupstine-medju-njima-i-cupic/86s66k5) reported that Student List representatives held a press conference after the constituent assembly session, where Čupić stated he would be the president of all deputies.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Cupic-objavio-imena-kandidata-za-potpredsjednike-Skupstine-Srbije/993285) reported that Aleksandar Čupić, president of the National Assembly of Serbia, read the names of candidates for six vice presidents during the continued constituent session.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/stevandic-prvi-cestitao-novom-predsjedniku-skupstine-srbije-pozvao-ga-da-dode-u-nsrs/261119159) reported that Republika Srpska National Assembly President Nenad Stevandic congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his election as president of the National Assembly of Serbia and invited him to visit.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089228/ko-je-aleksandar-cupic-profesor-koji-je-ugostio-studente-u-plasteniku-a-danas-vodi-skupstinu-srbije) reported that Aleksandar Čupić is a faculty assistant professor who was proposed by student representatives.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/zvanicnici-crne-gore-cestitali-cupicu-izbor-za-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/x5h5s39) reported that officials of Montenegro congratulated Aleksandar Čupić on his election as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Aleksandar-Cupic-novi-predsjednik-Narodne-skupstine-Republike-Srbije/993241) reported that Aleksandar Čupić was elected as the new president of the National Assembly of the Republic of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/prvi-govor-aleksandra-cupica-kao-predsednika-skupstine/8d6lsk9), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089225/novi-predsjednik-skupstine-srbije-odrzao-prvi-govor-izvinio-se-pastoru-i-lidiji-vukicevic) reported that newly elected Serbia National Assembly President Aleksandar Čupić delivered his first parliamentary speech and apologized to Lidija Vukićević and Bálint Pásztor.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1089177/treci-dan-konstitutivne-sjednice-skupstine-srbije-zastupnici-biraju-predsjednika-parlamenta) reported that the National Assembly session continued for its third day to choose a parliament president.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sandzacka-demokratska-partija-podrzala-cupica-za-predsednika-skupstine/d8q6zev) reported that the Sandžačka demokratska partija announced that its deputy Dženan Palamar will support the candidate Studentski for the president of the Assembly in tomorrow's vote.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/zavrsen-i-drugi-dan-zasjedanja-skupstine-srbije-vucic-moze-pricati-jos-10-dana/) reported that the second day of the National Assembly session concluded without electing a parliamentary president and will continue on Thursday.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/potpuni-haos-na-kraju-dana-u-skupstini-srbije-vucic-pobjesnio-uslikaj-ih-sve-zapisi-ih-sve/261118290) reported that the session ended in uproar with Aleksandar Vučić demanding individuals be recorded and photographed.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucica-provocirao-novinar-pitanjem-o-bratu-andreju-dobio-zestok-odgovor-video/85h9d7t), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/region/tenzije-u-holu-skupstine-srbije-vucic-izgubio-nerve-nesreco-sram-te-bilo/) reported that tensions occurred in the lobby of the National Assembly involving Aleksandar Vučić and a journalist.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/vucic-rekao-da-ga-poslanik-studentske-liste-seksualno-uznemirava-ja-nisam-od-tih-imate-tu-kolega-drugih-koliko-hocete/261118157), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088957/video-vucic-tvrdi-da-ga-poslanik-studentske-liste-seksualno-uznemirava-nemam-nista-protiv-tih-ljudi-ali-nisam-od-njih) reported that Aleksandar Vučić told Studentska lista deputy Zlatko Kokanović during a session of the National Assembly not to send him kisses, alleging sexual harassment.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/aleksandar-cupic-o-sednici-skupstine-svojoj-imovini-i-vucicu/9tdz2vx) reported that Aleksandar Čupić, a candidate for president of the National Assembly from the Student List, announced plans to submit a property report following a parliamentary session where Aleksandar Vučić spoke for five hours.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/kamberi-sda-ce-glasati-za-aleksandra-cupica-za-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/0lg50wn) reported that MP Shaip Kamberi stated the SDA will vote for Aleksandar Čupić as president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/oglasili-se-studenti-o-govoru-jugoslava-gasica-u-skupstini-srbije/wj1j0ls) reported that students from the Faculty of Media and Communications reacted on social media to criticism directed at Student List MP Jugoslav Gašić.

reports.text: [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/oyo-2027-i-wont-step-down-for-anyone-adc-guber-candidate-vows/) reported that African Democratic Congress governorship candidate in Oyo State Adegboyega Adegoke dismissed rumours that he plans to withdraw from the race.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-how-we-plan-to-present-a-common-front-adc-apm-ndc-sdp/) reported that major opposition parties pledged to present a common front to wrest power from the APC ahead of the 2027 general elections.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-crisis-gombe-mocks-atiku-as-feud-deepens/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that ADC faction chairman Nafiu Bala Gombe urged Atiku to register in his ward and promised to consider him for 2027 campaign council chairman.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/atiku-to-launch-adc-presidential-campaign-in-jigawa-nov-27/) reported that African Democratic Congress presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar is expected in Jigawa State for a campaign launch on November 27.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/court-declares-aiguobarueghian-as-ndc-candidate-for-ovia-federal-constituency/) reported that the Federal High Court in Benin City declared Charity Iguodala Aiguobarueghian as the Nigeria Democratic Congress House of Representatives candidate for Ovia Federal Constituency.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926855-court-orders-removal-of-tukur-ribadu-as-adc-governorship-candidate.html) reported that a court ordered the removal of Tukur Ribadu as the ADC governorship candidate for Adamawa State and restrained him from parading himself as the candidate.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/court-sacks-ribadu-declares-suleiman-adamawa-adc-governorship-candidate/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja removed Tukur Ribadu and declared Suleiman the African Democratic Congress governorship candidate for Adamawa State.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742472-breaking-drama-court-sacks-adc-governorship-candidate/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-court-sacks-adc-governorship-candidate-in-adamawa/) reported that a Federal High Court in Abuja ordered the removal of Tukur Ribadu as the ADC Adamawa governorship candidate.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-ndc-pdp-others-halt-campaigns-sign-common-agreement-nov-30/) reported that member parties of the Coalition for Democracy, including the African Democratic Congress, the Nigeria Democratic Congress, and a faction of the Peoples Democratic Party, agreed to halt campaigns and sign a common agreement on November 30.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/group-asks-inec-to-list-abidikugu-as-oyo-adc-reps-candidate/) reported that an African Democratic Congress support group urged INEC to implement a judgment regarding the Oyo ADC Reps candidate.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/adc-crisis-deepens-as-bot-orders-atiku-others-to-halt-campaigns/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Board of Trustees aligned with Nafiu Bala Gombe demanded that Atiku and others halt campaigns.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742326-court-sacks-atiku-inec-announces-final-decision-adc-crisis/) reported that INEC has disclosed when it will take a final decision on the leadership crisis rocking the ADC.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-crisis-bot-faction-asks-inec-to-delist-mark-candidates/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Nafiu Gombe-led ADC Board of Trustees faction urged INEC to enforce a Federal High Court judgment and delist uploaded candidates.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/tinubus-interview-with-us-strategist-london-sparks-debate-over-access-to-nigerian-media/) reported that President Bola Tinubu's decision to grant an exclusive interview to American political strategist Diana London has triggered public debate over access to Nigerian media.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/fresh-scandal-rocks-tinubus-us-lobbying-team-as-interviewers-2018-theft-conviction-emerges/) reported that questions have emerged regarding the professional background of individuals involved in President Bola Tinubu's American lobbying campaign following revelations about an interviewer's past.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/diana-london-tinubu-should-grant-interviews-to-nigerian-journalists-osinbajos-ex-aide/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-should-grant-interviews-to-nigerian-journalists-akande-says/) reported that Laolu Akande, a former spokesman for ex-Vice-President Yemi Osinbajo, urged President Bola Tinubu to grant interviews to Nigerian journalists.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-tinubu-atiku-obi-contest-a-family-civil-war-lamido/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Sule Lamido stated that the 2027 presidential contest between Tinubu, Atiku, and Obi is a family civil war because the three share similar political backgrounds.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ndume-accuses-politicians-of-using-poor-youths-for-political-violence/) reported that Senator Ali Ndume accused politicians of exploiting poor youths to perpetrate political violence ahead of the 2027 elections.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-ndume-warns-political-violence-could-threaten-nigerias-elections/) reported that Senator Ali Ndume warned that rising political violence and intolerance could threaten Nigeria's 2027 general elections.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/rising-political-violence-could-threaten-2027-elections-ndume/) reported that Senator Ndume proposed the establishment of special courts to handle electoral violence cases.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/19/atiku-to-tinubu-tell-nigerians-if-recorded-interview-was-part-of-4-5m-lobbying-deal/) reported that former Vice President Atiku Abubakar demanded to know whether President Bola Tinubu's recorded interview was part of a $4.5 million lobbying deal.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/diana-london-denies-4-5m-payment-for-tinubu-interview-as-atiku-demands-full-disclosure/) reported that American political strategist Diana London denied receiving $4.5 million from the Nigerian government.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-tinubu-atiku-obi-in-us-lobbying-controversies/) reported that a widening row over American lobbying activities embroiled President Bola Tinubu, Atiku Abubakar, and Peter Obi.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/us-strategist-denies-4-5m-payment-for-tinubu-interview/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that American political strategist Diana London denied receiving 4.5 million dollars from the Nigerian government or anyone else in the country.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-strategist-restricts-x-comments-after-tinubu-interview-backlash/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/american-strategist-restricts-x-comment-after-backlash-over-tinubu-interview/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that American political strategist Diana London restricted access to comments on her X account and deleted posts praising the Nigeria-US security partnership following backlash over her interview with President Bola Tinubu.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nigeria-is-uss-greatest-ally-in-africa-american-strategist-says-as-tinubu-grants-interview-to-london/) reported that American political strategist Diana London described Nigeria as the United States' greatest ally in Africa.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-tinubu-grants-interview-to-american-political-strategist-diana-london/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Tinubu granted an exclusive interview to American political strategist Diana London.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adc-pcc-asks-inec-to-postpone-mock-accreditation-faults-irev-plan/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-faults-inec-over-short-notice-for-mock-accreditation-exercise/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/18/adc-pcc-demands-postponement-of-inecs-november-28-mock-accreditation-exercise-alleges-bias/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council asked the Independent National Electoral Commission to postpone its mock accreditation exercise, citing short notice and alleging bias.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742114-2027-election-inec-takes-decision-retaining-atiku-final-list-adc-crisis/) reported that INEC provisionally retained Atiku Abubakar on the final presidential candidate list amid the ADC leadership crisis.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-campaign-accuses-inec-of-bias-demands-postponement-of-mock-election-test/) reported that the ADC campaign accused INEC of bias and demanded the postponement of a mock election test.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742124-peter-obi-tinubu-atiku-tertiary-institution-students-announce-preferred-presidential-candidate/) reported that students across tertiary institutions in a Nigerian state disclosed the presidential candidate they intend to support in the 2027 elections.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/926007-adc-challenges-judgement-on-leadership-crisis-seeks-injunction-against-inec.html) reported that the ADC challenged a judgment regarding its leadership crisis and is seeking an injunction against INEC.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adc-seeks-injunction-against-inec-changing-party-records/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/adc-asks-court-to-stop-inec-from-altering-party-candidates-records/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the African Democratic Congress asked the Court of Appeal to restrain the Independent National Electoral Commission from altering party and candidate records.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/i-have-resumed-as-adc-chairman-nafiu-bala-says/) reported that factional African Democratic Congress National Chairman Hon. Nafi'u Bala Gombe notified the Independent National Electoral Commission of his resumption.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/senate-orders-probe-of-attacks-on-tinubu-obi-atiku/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-elections-senate-moves-against-rising-political-violence-orders-probe-of-attacks-on-political-leaders-supporters/) reported that the Nigerian Senate ordered security agencies to investigate attacks on political leaders and supporters ahead of the 2027 elections.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741898-2027-elections-coalition-raises-alarm-rising-political-violence-nigeria/) reported that a civil society coalition gave major political parties a 48-hour warning over rising political violence.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741909-tinbubu-atiku-peter-obi-delta-born-millionaire-announces-preferred-presidential-candidate/) reported that Amaju Pinnick disclosed his preferred presidential candidate for the 2027 general elections.

reports.text: [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/ponernos-de-pie-los-vecinos-de-lanus-marchan-para-pedir-justicia-a-una-semana-de-la-tragica-nid21112026/) reported that residents of Lanús marched to demand justice one week after the gas explosion, coinciding with the patronal feast of the Virgin of the Rosary.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/tragica-explosion-remedios-escalada-muertos-victimas-fatales_0_pAhLnCZKXm.html), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/explosion-y-muerte-fallecieron-otras-dos-personas-por-el-escape-de-gas-en-remedios-de-escalada-y-ya-nid21112026/) reported that two outsourced workers who were hospitalized following a gas pipe explosion in Remedios de Escalada died of their injuries, raising the death toll to four.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/entre-escombros-miedo-y-reclamos-asi-se-vive-a-una-semana-de-la-explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-nid19112026/) reported that one week after the explosion in Remedios de Escalada, concerns persist regarding new leaks and suspended works.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/seis-dias-despues-de-la-explosion-el-adn-confirmo-que-la-primera-victima-fatal-es-el-operario-de-nid19112026/) reported that DNA testing confirmed that missing Metrogas worker Marcelo García was the first fatality in the Remedios de Escalada tragedy, alongside the death of another worker.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-murio-otro-operario-de-metrogas-y-ya-son-dos-las-victimas-fatales-nid19112026/) reported that a second Metrogas worker injured in the gas pipeline explosion in Remedios de Escalada died in a Buenos Aires clinic.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/metrogas-respondio-al-enojo-de-los-vecinos-tras-la-explosion-de-gas-y-defendio-el-trabajo-de-los-nid17112026/) reported that Metrogas responded to neighborhood anger following a gas explosion and defended the work of operators.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/vivir-volcan-miedo-vecinos-remedios-escalada-animan-cocinar_0_GjkdF2xw94.html) reported that three days after a gas explosion that left one dead and 30 injured, fears and gas leak alarms persist among residents in Remedios de Escalada.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/es-un-desastre-protesta-y-enojo-de-los-vecinos-de-remedios-de-escalada-tras-la-explosion-de-gas-nid14112026/) reported that residents in Remedios de Escalada protested and expressed anger following a gas explosion, denouncing a lack of information and demanding assistance while entry to homes remains restricted.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/un-muerto-y-siete-heridos-graves-tras-la-explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-confirman-que-el-incendio-nid14112026/) reported that Metrogas cut off the gas leak that caused the fire, allowing firefighters to extinguish it while the municipality organized the return of evacuated families.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-ordenaron-trasladar-a-dos-directivos-de-metrogas-nid13112026/) reported that the judiciary ordered the transfer of two Metrogas executives as part of the investigation into the Remedios de Escalada explosion.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/habia-muchisimo-olor-a-gas-el-dramatico-relato-de-los-vecinos-afectados-por-la-explosion-en-remedios-nid13112026/) reported that residents in Remedios de Escalada reported a strong smell of gas and feared an explosion hours before fires continued burning above commercial properties.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/explosion-remedios-escalada-obra-haciendo-metrogas-derivo-incendio-20-heridos_0_JOS19K03yU.html), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/fuerte-explosion-en-remedios-de-escalada-estaban-trabajando-y-rompieron-un-cano-de-gas-nid13112026/) reported that a gas pipe was damaged during renovation work by Metrogas in Remedios de Escalada, triggering an explosion and fire that left at least 20 people injured.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/japan/politics/quad-leaders-summit-takaichi-trump/) reported that the grouping expressed grave concerns about economic coercion, including arbitrary export restrictions.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640859/trump-meets-key-us-regional-allies-in-manila-ahead-of-china-visit), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582803/trump-arrives-in-manila-ahead-of-china-visit/) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump arrived in Manila to begin a three-day Asian tour and attend a regional leaders' summit.
[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582803/trump-arrives-in-manila-ahead-of-china-visit/) reported that protests against Trump's policies continued across the city during his arrival.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/india-news-modi-proposes-e-visas-for-asean-tourists/live-79964913?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi proposed e-visas for ASEAN tourists while speaking at the ASEAN summit in Manila.

[RTHK Local](https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1878135-20261117.htm) reported that Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee arrived in Shenzhen to attend the Apec Economic Leaders' Meeting.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/443203/prabowo-attends-asean-india-summit-co-chaired-by-pm-modi) reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto attended the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit co-chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/canada-china-agree-to-ease-tariffs-amid-trade-rows-with-us/a-79964912?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/business/20261117-china-canada-agree-to-further-reduce-tariffs-at-apec-summit-in-shenzhen) reported that Canada and China agreed to further reduce tariffs and enhance economic cooperation during the APEC summit in Shenzhen.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/17/us-president-trump-arrives-in-manila-ahead-of-asean-summit?traffic_source=rss), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1009755/us-president-donald-trump-arrives-in-manila-for-asean-summit/story/) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump arrived in Manila ahead of a special ASEAN-US meeting and the 49th ASEAN Summit.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/asean-india-summit-manila-november-2026-quad-live-updates-pm-modi-trump-meeting-latest-news/article71710382.ece) reported that Prime Minister Modi is expected to meet U.S. President Trump, Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi, and Australian Prime Minister Albanese in the first Quad Summit since 2024.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-13/China-looks-to-APEC-leaders-declaration-at-Shenzhen-meeting-1S2u2xsPhSw/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=China), a state outlet, reported that China is looking forward to the APEC leaders' declaration at the Shenzhen meeting.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-12/What-to-watch-as-Shenzhen-prepares-to-host-APEC-leaders-1S0RYXsxm4o/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a Chinese state outlet, reported that leaders of the 21 member economies of APEC will gather in Shenzhen on November 18 and 19.

reports.text: [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611230163.html) reported that Cape Verde's elections were loud while its voters are increasingly silent.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/21/jose-maria-neves-e-reeleito-presidente-de-cabo-verde-com-quase-64percent-dos-votos.ghtml) reported that Cape Verde's National Electoral Commission confirmed the re-election of President Jose Maria Neves for a second five-year term with nearly 64 percent of the vote.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/Cape-Verde-s-incumbent-president-declares-re-election-victory-1S7pTVdY97q/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that Cape Verde's incumbent president received 80,018 votes, or 63.8 percent, with nearly 97 percent of polling stations reporting.

[Le Pays (Burkina Faso)](https://lepays.bf/victoire-du-president-sortant-au-cap-vert-ces-defis-qui-attendent-jose-maria-neves/) reported that incumbent President José Maria Neves was elected without surprise in the first round with nearly 64 percent of the vote.

[AMAP (Mali)](https://amap.ml/2026/11/16/cap-vert-le-president-sortant-jose-maria-neves-en-tete-avec-pres-de-64-des-voix/), [Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/international/infos-afrique/cap-vert-le-president-sortant-jose-maria-neves-reelu-pour-un-second-mandat/) reported that incumbent President José Maria Neves won re-election with 63.8 percent of the vote.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/16/cape-verdes-president-neves-projected-to-win-re-election-with-64-of-vote/) reported that preliminary results based on 98 percent of counted ballots showed incumbent President Jose Maria Neves won re-election with 64 percent of the vote.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNcWxnVEpfWXdSVkNERnExVXJGbFJzUW5MTFR3MEtGWHBYMFZWZkZHRldTal9oLS00VnJQdnM1MmNJVkhkRFlkVjJEYjVMLWo4Tk5xUzV1OG9Xa1BxYUdmZ3FSaVp5Q0htZGYwcFpZSFZCYnFrR0szX1FRRk1yNHcteXRWWkpvZkFvck5scnFydzRnME55WktPVngxTklNSWxwVUl5Z3B3TWJHZVQwNDY0NG5CbGNuNmphV0o4?oc=5), [Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/africa/cape-verde-president-neves-wins-second-term--5672296) reported that challenger Joana Rosa conceded defeat in the Cape Verde presidential election.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/jos-maria-neves-re-elected-president-of-cape-verde-for-second-five-year-term-101794809266807.html) reported that José Maria Neves was re-elected for a second five-year term in a campaign focused on jobs for young people.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648895-cape-verde-president-wins-second-term/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that provisional results show Cape Verdean President Jose Maria Neves won a second presidential term.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261116-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-au-cap-vert-jos%C3%A9-mar%C3%ADa-neves-rempile-pour-un-second-mandat-de-cinq-ans) reported that provisional results from the presidential election in Cape Verde gave incumbent President Jose Maria Neves a victory for a second five-year term in the first round.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/svijet/Istorijski-izbori-Zelenortska-Ostrva-dobijaju-prvu-predsjednicu/992509), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/zelenortska-ostrva-bi-mogla-dobiti-prvu-predsjednicu-od-nezavisnosti-1975/261115164) reported that presidential elections were held in Cape Verde, with former justice minister Joana Rosa running as a candidate to potentially become the first female head of state since independence in 1975.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cape-verde-election-jose-maria-neves-set-to-win-second-term/a-79952606?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/afrique/article/2026/11/16/au-cap-vert-jose-maria-neves-reelu-president-des-le-premier-tour_6811072_3212.html) reported that provisional results showed incumbent President Jose Maria Neves won a second term in office, winning over 63% of the vote in the first round.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/15/presidential-polls-open-in-cape-verde-with-first-female-candidate/) reported that presidential polls opened in Cape Verde with incumbent Jose Maria Neves favored to win a second term.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQUWI3OGxfWTRxVTVMY3diaEZFMWZmRlZGYnZ0dnJKSzZqYjN4U2xmMTIyMVJ4U3QxcnI1VEVSblhZck40NTZCaGVhamRFQ2l0VDZnNXhYLTRTRUNRSDNqVW9FQ2pHZXRfQzNQOUEzRG9vaU82Q094M2J0eGo4T3N3QWdadEVmQ3BJR3FPRGNHUXdmcWpWcWItVl9LVERRUQ?oc=5) reported that Cape Verde voted in an election with emigration in focus.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNNEZaaVg2di1CeGcyQlpLZjBmeHpaYXQ5YTRGMk8xM0NyZkVtSmFuX2d1ckFqOExOMVhmbzk4U0lEYk96VVd3OENPVTd6bERTNTJDQl8tR3ZxS2JZX2xER3JfSHdCRF9JQkxLMm11bnFTYmN1LUN4R3lfRy15MmJsSS04VUEzX183SDFYSVFDaHJIaTJFT1VQeHljX2FFbkYwV0hmY1VB?oc=5) reported that Cape Verde voted in an election that could yield its first woman president since independence in 1975.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/cabo-verde-polls-open-neves-favored-rosa-challenger/) reported that voting is underway in Cabo Verde with President José Maria Neves favored among six candidates, and a potential run-off scheduled for 29 November.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/cape-verde-heads-to-the-polls-in-presidential-election), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/polls-open-in-cape-verde-in-race-with-first-female-presidential-candidate?traffic_source=rss) reported that voters in Cape Verde went to the polls for a presidential election where incumbent President José Maria Neves faces opposition candidates including Joana Rosa.

reports.text: [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190961/%D8%A8%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%BA%D8%B1%D9%82-1000-%D9%85%D9%88%D9%82%D8%B9-%D9%88%D9%85%D8%AE%D9%8A%D9%85-%D9%84%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B2%D8%AD%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%AE%D9%84-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A) reported that the Union of Gaza Strip Municipalities warned that approximately 1,000 locations, camps, and displaced persons' shelter centers face the risk of flooding and rainwater accumulation during the winter season, and demanded urgent international intervention.

[Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d9%85%d9%86%d8%b8%d9%85%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b5%d8%ad%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b9%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d8%aa%d8%ad%d8%b0%d9%91%d8%b1-4-%d9%81%d8%a6%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a3%d9%83%d8%ab%d8%b1) reported that the World Health Organization warned of seasonal influenza risks and serious health complications leading to death for vulnerable groups.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203937/%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%82%D9%8A-%D9%88%D9%81%D8%AF-%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%AB-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin met with Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya in Istanbul to discuss developments in Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190673/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%AB-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B6%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin met with a high-level Hamas delegation led by Khalil al-Hayya to discuss the situation in Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190365/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%AE%D8%A7%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B6%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA) reported that the World Health Organization warned of an increase in antimicrobial resistance threatening routine surgeries and childbirth.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190375/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%AC%D8%A8-%D8%A3%D9%84%D8%A7-%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%88%D8%AA-%D8%A3%D9%8A-%D8%B7%D9%81%D9%84-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%B1%D8%AF-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated an 8-month-old infant died in the Gaza Strip due to the cold.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190322/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%AD%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D9%85%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A-%D8%A5%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B6%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%AE%D8%B7%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-) reported that Hamas welcomed a joint statement by the foreign ministers of Britain, Australia, Canada, and Italy regarding the humanitarian crisis in the Gaza Strip.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/reports/202950/%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B8%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B6-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/), [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190139/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D9%87%D9%88%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B6%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that the World Health Organization warned of an increase in respiratory illnesses among displaced people in Gaza living in flood-prone tent areas.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217953), a Russian state outlet, reported that Mossad chief Gofman arrived in Washington for consultations on Iran and will meet with CIA Director John Ratcliffe.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eisenkot-netanyahus-campaign-against-arabs-is-racist-he-says/) reported that prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot accused caretaker Netanyahu of running a racist campaign against Arabs.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/sarajevo/tuzilastvo-trazi-pritvor-za-advana-kosarica-zbog-sumnje-na-djeciju-pornografiju/) reported that the prosecutor's office requested detention for Advan Košarić due to suspicion of child pornography.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/marko-kricak-saslusan-zbog-sumnje-da-je-mucio-deset-osoba-u-garazi-vlade-srbije/604mwfl) reported that a public prosecutor in Belgrade interrogated Marko Kričak, who is suspected of abusing and torturing ten individuals in a garage belonging to the Serbian government, while the prosecution requested custody.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/slucaj-ubistva-na-dolac-malti-tuzilastvo-ks-trazi-pritvor-za-emila-semira-tahirovica-i-njegovog-oca/261115055), [Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/crna-hronika/za-emila-semira-tahirovica-i-njegovog-oca-zatrazeno-odredivanje-pritvora/), [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/hronika/Traze-pritvor-za-sina-i-oca-nakon-ubistva-u-Sarajevu/992464) reported that the Canton Sarajevo Prosecutor's Office requested a one-month detention order from the Canton Court in Sarajevo for Emil Semir Tahirović and his father.

reports.text: [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bakassi-port-border-reforms-to-unlock-cross-rivers-economic-potential-customs-boss/) reported that Comptroller-General of Customs Bashir Adewale Adeniyi stated that the proposed Bakassi Deep Sea Port and planned modernisation of strategic border reforms will unlock Cross River's economic potential.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/24/fg-targets-500m-annual-research-investment-from-2027/) reported that the Federal Government plans a major overhaul of Nigeria's research and innovation funding system with an annual investment of 500 million dollars from 2027.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/23/ndelta-coastal-communities-seek-increased-investment-in-blue-economy/) reported that stakeholders from Nigerian creek communities called for a special development plan and increased investment in the blue economy.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-tinubu-must-win-all-18-cross-river-lgs-minister/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Minister John Enoh urged Cross River residents to deliver all 18 local government areas for Tinubu in 2027.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bakassi-port-border-modernisation-to-position-cross-river-as-international-trade-gateway-customs-cg/) reported that Comptroller-General of Customs Bashir Adewale Adeniyi stated the proposed Bakassi Deep Sea Port and border modernization will position Cross River as an international trade gateway.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/bakassi-deep-seaport-to-boost-criver-blue-economy-attract-investments/) reported that Cross River State Governor Bassey Otu stated the Bakassi Deep Seaport would strengthen the state's position in Nigeria's blue economy and attract investments.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/business-news/925125-tinubu-flags-off-construction-of-3-5bn-bakassi-deep-seaport.html) reported that Governor Otu stated the project faced political, environmental, and legal obstacles before the Tinubu administration supported its realization.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/tinubu-flags-off-3-5bn-bakassi-deep-seaport-targets-lagos-port-congestion/) reported that Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu flagged off the construction of the $3.5 billion Bakassi Deep Seaport in Cross River State to target Lagos port congestion.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bakassi-deep-seaport-will-redefine-nigerias-maritime-economy-tinubu/) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu described the groundbreaking of the Bakassi Deep Seaport as a defining milestone in Nigeria's economic diversification.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/tinubu-flags-off-3-5bn-bakassi-deep-seaport-targets-44bn-annual-maritime-revenue/) reported that President Bola Tinubu flagged off the construction of the $3.5 billion Bakassi Deep Seaport.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/cross-river-tinubu-flags-off-3-5bn-bakassi-deep-seaport-targets-regional-trade-expansion/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/tinubu-fags-off-bakassi-deep-seaport-says-project-will-redefine-nigerias-maritime-economy/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-flags-off-bakassi-seaport-in-cross-river/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu performed the groundbreaking ceremony for the Bakassi Deep Seaport in Cross River State to expand maritime trade and create jobs.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinubu-flags-off-3-5bn-bakassi-deep-seaport-construction/) reported that Tinubu stated he came to break ground and break centuries-old jinx rather than to cut a ribbon and dance.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwe89y2r5j20o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the New Orleans port filed a $1m lawsuit requesting that the tanker involved in the collision be seized and sold.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/dozens-rescued-from-water-after-cruise-ship-sinks-20261115-p61e7f.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that dozens of people were rescued from the water after a cruise ship sank following a collision with a tanker in New Orleans.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNZDhuVzNmcEY1UURKMFdwOE85cTRTeS1hV1gwTmd6NEZlRzhBZjlsUVFzNTdCb19QX0dSSUVBR1VjcW5KZFktTmt1OEc4QzF5SGJsbG1xNVFTRHhyMHFVbkFlUmpSeG5iUG0yME9GTXgwMU45bWdyNHB3N3kwNlRqYnEwUVg2ZVlYUmJGaERYTmlaRDNmc1Jz?oc=5), [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/14/nola-port-sues-get-control-tanker-crashed-cruise-ship-mississippi/) reported that the Port of New Orleans sued for control of the tanker that crashed into the cruise ship.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/13/rescue-underway-tanker-hits-riverboat-129-passengers-port-new-orleans/) reported that a tanker crashed into a docked American Cruise Lines boat on the Mississippi River at the Port of New Orleans.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/14/new-orleans-mississippi-river-tanker-crash-lawsuit) reported that New Orleans port officials filed a lawsuit seeking $1 million and succeeded in seizing the tanker Atlantic Asphalt.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/14/new-orleans-cruise-ship-passengers-crew-survive-crash-tanker/) reported that all passengers and crew survived the crash after a tanker apparently lost its steering.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/usa-all-passengers-survive-after-tanker-hits-docked-river-cruise-ship-in-new-orleans) reported that a portion of the Mississippi River remains closed following a collision between an oil tanker and a riverboat.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/us/2026/1114/1599198-vessel-new-orleans/) reported that a tanker ship collided with a luxury paddle wheeler docked in New Orleans on the Mississippi River, causing the cruise vessel to roll over.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640266/tanker-collides-with-cruise-ship-in-new-orleans-32-hospitalised) reported that 32 people were hospitalised after a tanker collided with a cruise ship in New Orleans.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/cruise-ship-lists-and-partially-sinks-after-tanker-collision-near-new-orleans-bridge/) reported that the cruise ship American Heritage carried about 129 passengers and was struck on the Mississippi River near the Port of New Orleans.

[De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/riviercruiseschip-met-150-mensen-aan-boord-kapseist-in-haven-van-new-orleans-door-aanvaring-met-tanker/164545109.html) reported that an American Cruise Lines paddlewheel river cruise ship with around 150 people on board capsized in the port of New Orleans following a collision with a tanker.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/13/rescue-efforts-under-way-after-tanker-strikes-river-cruise-boat-in-us?traffic_source=rss) reported that the American Heritage paddleboat had 129 passengers on board and was left partially submerged.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/tanker-collides-with-cruise-ship-on-mississippi-in-new-orleans/a-79945080?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a freighter collided with a cruise ship carrying around 130 people in New Orleans, causing the paddlewheel vessel to capsize.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/tanker-collides-with-new-orleans-river-cruise-carrying-129-passengers-rescue-operation-und), [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPd0V2MmU4SUFIMmtTR091bTZlaG96X29GdVRIVjc4c1JaMWdYVldWa09rVFVnNjI3aWszdnh5Vlhadm1relhMSV9sT2xHVkZ4c2lQMjZ6bnZvX3BCbmJ4LVdNY3c5aXhlcnNyZFc0QjNZS2V3anZfSDZsVmdJdnNUazdlbHlIUXBZLU5FQWNZM2hnS2oyeEVWag?oc=5), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/ck4gn4y77m40o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/tanker-collides-with-cruise-ship-on-mississippi-near-new-orleans/a-79945080?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/us/new-orleans-cruise-ship-crash.html), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/13/mississippi-river-crash-new-orleans), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/new-orleans-river-boat-crash-129-passengers-b3084807.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/mississippi-river-crash-american-cruise-line-boat-and-oil-tanker-collision-near-new-orleans-port-leave-several-in-the-water-101794600922214.html), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3374410/tanker-hits-new-orleans-cruise-boat-carrying-129-passengers), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/cruise-ship-hit-by-tanker-in-new-orleans-passengers-in-water-20261114-p61e41.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that a tanker collided with a river cruise boat carrying around 129 passengers near New Orleans, prompting a rescue operation.

[El País](https://elpais.com/us/2026-11-13/un-buque-choca-contra-un-crucero-con-129-personas-a-bordo-en-el-rio-misisipi.html), [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/petrolero-choca-crucero-129-pasajeros-bordo-rio-misisipi_202611136af76fcbea8d89799784c51f.html), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/petrolero-choca-contra-crucero-en-el-puerto-de-nueva-orleans-autoridades-atienden-incidente/), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/buque-colisiona-con-crucero-y-lo-deja-parcialmente-sumergido-en-el-rio-misisipi_0_5sjCxZkkBS.html), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/emergencia-en-ee-uu-tras-choque-de-buque-contra-crucero-con-129-personas-a-bordo-videos-muestran-pasajeros-aferrados-a-la-embarcacion-inclinada-3600929) reported that emergency services and authorities responded to the collision between a tanker and the American Heritage cruise ship in New Orleans.

reports.text: [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642232/oil-slips-over-1-as-supply-glut-prospect-offsets-middle-east-disruption-fears) reported that Brent crude futures dropped 1.35 dollars, or 1.5 percent, to 90.05 dollars a barrel as supply glut prospects offset Middle East disruption fears.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/qatari-pm-warns-middle-east-cannot-afford-more-us-iran-tensions-3725917) reported that Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani warned that the Middle East cannot afford another round of tensions between the United States and Iran.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2642028/oil-prices-near-three-month-lows-as-rising-supply-offsets-hormuz-threat), [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Prices-Hold-Near-Three-Month-Lows-Despite-Hormuz-Mine-Claims.html) reported that oil prices traded near three-month lows as rising supplies offset Hormuz threat claims.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/oil-prices-fall-as-rising-supplies-offset-middle-east-tensions/) reported that oil prices fell due to rising supplies and the reopening of a Libyan oil pipeline.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/oil-prices-slip-as-iran-war-middle-east-shipping-attacks-support-brent-crude-and-wti-despite-weekly-losses-101795431644052.html) reported that Brent crude and WTI oil prices slipped despite support from Middle East shipping attacks and Strait of Hormuz tensions.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585610/trump-claims-iran-launched-highest-number-of-drone-and-missile-attacks-in-a-year/) reported that Donald Trump stated Iranian aggression surged following recent midterm results and that Iran launched the highest number of drone and missile attacks in a year.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915744), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-warns-iran-of-fresh-attacks-after-new-year-if-negotiations-fail-to-produce-a-deal-101795389992076.html) reported that Donald Trump warned Iran of fresh attacks after the new year if negotiations fail and threatened to sink vessels.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223073), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-trump-inclined-to-resume-strikes-on-iran-after-new-year-if-no-deal-reached/) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he is inclined to resume military strikes against Iran after the New Year if negotiations fail to produce an agreement.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/21/iran-war-live-iran-targets-us-military-in-bahrain-houthi-strikes-continue?traffic_source=rss) reported that Bahrain condemned Iran's strikes on US military assets in the country while Houthi strikes continue.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/how-war-has-shifted-irans-missile-ambitions-beyond-middle-east) reported that the conflict has battered Iran's military capabilities and shifted its leadership's missile ambitions beyond the Middle East.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328605/Iran-will-take-all-necessary-measures-to-break-US-blockade-Deputy) reported that Iran's deputy foreign minister stated the country considers the US economic blockade an act of war and will take all necessary measures to break it.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/trump-dice-que-iran-quiere-un-acuerdo-y-mas-noticias-de-oriente-medio_0_6NgQglcy32.html) reported that President Donald Trump stated Iran wants a real deal while responding with attacks in Kuwait and Bahrain, intensifying regional tension.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/explosion-irans-qeshm-island-linked-disposal-unexploded-munitions-tasnim-reports) reported that an explosion and smoke on Iran's Qeshm Island were linked to the disposal of unexploded munitions.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915601) reported that local sources indicated a blast heard over Qeshm Island was possibly caused by air defenses intercepting an enemy aircraft.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2221047) reported that Iranian strikes damaged 15 hangars, warehouses, and at least ten other facilities at a US air base in Kuwait.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cw4gn9jeqjq7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Kuwait and Bahrain stated they were attacked by Iran following a US air strike on Qeshm island.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/gulf-nations-attacked-after-us-strikes-iranian-island), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/iran-allies-hit-gulf-countries-after-us-attack-on-island/) reported that Bahrain and Kuwait said they repelled air attacks launched against them after US strikes on an Iranian island.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iran-fires-kuwait-widening-strikes-after-us-hit-iranian-island) reported that Iran stated it targeted US drone and missile sites in Kuwait overnight.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/17/paises-do-golfo-entram-em-alerta-apos-ataques-dos-eua-a-ilha-do-ira.ghtml) reported that Kuwait announced it repelled drone attacks following United States bombings against an island in Iran.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941167) reported that the United States struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz after Tehran's Revolutionary Guards launched actions.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/paises-del-golfo-en-alerta-tras-ataques-de-eeuu-en-la-isla-irani-de-qeshm_0_TBK6HJ0Dve.html) reported that Kuwait detained drone attacks after US bombings on a base in Qeshm Island, and Bahrain alerted its population.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/iran-strikes-gulf-neighbors-following-us-attack-on-qeshm-island/) reported that missiles and drones crossed Gulf skies as regional militaries reported interceptions linked to Iran and Houthi allies following a US attack on Qeshm Island.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-us-strikes-iranian-island-after-tehran-targets-bahrain) reported that the US and Iran exchanged fire, with the US striking an Iranian missile launch site after Iran targeted a US military radar system in Bahrain.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532307/Iran-reports-strikes-on-US-military-assets-in-Kuwait-and-Bahrain), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's military targeted US military assets at a base in Kuwait and shot down an American drone east of the Strait of Hormuz.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1118/1599631-iran-us/) reported that Gulf countries intercepted missiles and drones from Iran and its Houthi allies in Yemen after the United States struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249501/Iran-army-attacks-U-S-Patriot-launch-sites-in-Kuwait), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's Army stated its combat drones targeted U.S. Patriot defense systems and launch platforms at Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait.
[Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/iran-attacks-kuwait-and-bahrain-overnight-with-drones/) reported that Iran fired drones at a U.S. air base in Kuwait and launched attacks on Bahrain overnight.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640955/iranian-army-says-drone-strikes-targeted-us-installations-at-kuwait-air-base) reported that the Iranian army stated drone strikes targeted US installations at a Kuwait air base.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86325322/Iranian-Army-targets-US-Patriot-systems-at-Kuwait-s-Ali-Al-Salem), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/irans-army-says-drones-targeted-us-systems-at-kuwait-air-base-3725711) reported that the Iranian army targeted US Patriot air defense systems and drone and missile launch platforms at Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374869/bahrain-and-kuwait-repel-drone-attacks-after-us-strikes-iranian-island) reported that Bahrain and Kuwait stated they repelled air attacks launched against them following US strikes on an Iranian island.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQVkpMQk5Ha1FZNG45Vmt6WWxWeUtMS3lSU0hON0F0b0ItSHlWY0NnUHFyQ1JTWFBPSWViZTFVZHpKNWI3V3R1TjM0b25HWTNEZGZ2Q1ItZG5hdXNGcG03M3FjZlJKNmE5SC1lYTJERmRETERvdGJOUGlsMG9pQjVVU2dEWkJxOEY2eXJYd1RtVmNlN2pIcGlLcHJlaw?oc=5), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/after-us-hits-qeshm-iran-targets-us-bases-kuwait-and-bahrain) reported that Iran targeted US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain following US strikes.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/iran-army-says-it-targeted-us-military-base-in-kuwait/article71715048.ece) reported that the Iranian army claimed it targeted air defense systems and drone and missile launch platforms in Kuwait.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261118-middle-east-live-kuwait-bahrain-report-drone-and-missile-attacks), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/18/live-iran-war-bahrain-kuwait-drone-attack/) reported that Kuwait stated it was countering hostile drone attacks while Bahrain accused Iran of attacks.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/kuwait-reports-drone-attacks-as-iran-us-trade-attacks-on-qeshm-and-bahrain?traffic_source=rss) reported that Kuwait's military stated its air defence intercepted hostile drone attacks.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/us-strikes-targets-in-qeshm-island-after-iranian-mines-hit-five-ships-in-hormuz) reported that Iran stated the US military carried out attacks on Qeshm Island and at least five ships were set on fire by mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/iran-targets-bahrain-slams-fabricated-dirty-bomb-report/4EZO5NMT3JBMNK6O7WEOPTHKEI/) reported that Iran stated a US strike on an island in the Strait of Hormuz caused no serious damage.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/estados-unidos-ataca-base-irani-de-misiles-en-isla-de-qeshm-33180781) reported that the United States attacked an Iranian missile base on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz in response to Tehran's aggression.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/eeuu-ataco-una-base-de-misiles-irani-en-la-isla-qeshm-en-represalia-por-los-ataques-a-bahrein-nid17112026/) reported that a US official confirmed the bombing of a military installation on Qeshm Island in retaliation for attacks on Bahrain.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxNWENzVXNRVjR0NU9lejlJWll3U01GOENvbnlKVWJuZG9ZSmwtdVRXSDRPZ3JGcGZnSGhfQmYzNnFRQ0p4d2ZaZk80Q0NKUEgtdTI3cmFwb2JxT1FOamJYVllwTFR3UV9ZN2xfMTNTTFZiS0gtSjU2Q3B6dkVLUmgyYzlpcHprNXdCMEdST0RqNkdkTEgycGFEQkVwY01yWENOcVNpYWpFYlRrRG1waGlwVHNKM3h5UHBidHpMcXlkcw?oc=5), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-fighter-jets-strike-missile-launch-site-on-iran-s-qeshm-island-101794945503003.html), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/17/us-jets-strike-irgc-missile-launch-site-on-irans-qeshm-island-in-self-defence/) reported that US fighter jets carried out airstrikes against an Iranian missile launch site on Qeshm Island.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219877) reported that Hormozgan Province Deputy Governor Ahmad Nafisi stated the US strike on Qeshm Island caused no damage and the situation remains stable.

reports.text: [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/preocupante-leon-xiv-cuestiono-fracaso-cop31-advirtio-crisis-climatica-compromete-generaciones-futuras_0_YMCAumBO2v.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV questioned the failure of COP31 and warned that the climate crisis compromises future generations.

[Diario Co Latino](https://www.diariocolatino.com/jefe-de-onu-expresa-decepcion-por-resultado-de-cop31/) reported that UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres expressed disappointment with the result of the 31st UN Climate Change Conference.
[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/24/mundo/023n3mun?partner=rss) reported that China expressed disappointment over the failure of the UN climate conference to reach an agreement.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa-disappointed-with-cop31-outcome), [Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/24/caricom-disappointed-outcome-cop31/) reported that the COP31 climate summit in Turkey failed to reach an agreement, exposing divisions over fossil fuels and climate finance.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fracaso-de-la-cop31-desata-criticas-y-reclamos-de-reforma-de-las-negociaciones-climaticas-33278860) reported that the COP31 climate summit's failure sparked criticism and calls to reform climate negotiations over petrostate vetoes on fossil fuel references.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/is-no-deal-better-than-a-bad-deal-why-some-see-hope-in-cop31s-collapse), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/spotlight/20261124-collapse-of-cop31-this-deal-was-a-bad-deal-and-better-no-deal-than-a-bad-deal) reported that COP31 collapsed after the EU, UK, and small nations rejected a pact that promoted carbon capture and omitted fossil fuel phase-outs.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/turkeys-erdogan-says-cop31-laid-groundwork-more-climate-talks-despite-lack-deal) reported that Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan stated the COP31 climate summit established a valuable foundation for more climate talks despite lacking a deal.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/audio/2026/nov/23/cop31-collapses-why-did-climate-talks-fall-apart-the-latest) reported that countries at the COP31 climate summit failed to reach a keystone agreement for the first time in 17 years.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/science/video/2026/nov/23/cop31-failed-what-happens-now-video) reported that the longest ever COP climate talks ended in failure with the key sticking point being the omission of fossil fuels.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/23/cop31-ends-without-agreement-as-divisions-deepen-over-fossil-fuels/) reported that UN climate chief Simon Stiell expressed disappointment over the outcome.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/cop31-ends-without-deal-on-fossil-fuel-transition/) reported that nearly 40 countries rejected the proposed outcome over fossil fuel commitments and climate finance.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/cop31-ends-deal-eu-not-endorse-text-omitting-fossil-fuels.1137494), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/eu-will-not-endorse-climate-deal-throwing-cop31-outcome-into-doubt/article71731355.ece) reported that Ireland's Climate and Energy Minister Darragh O'Brien stated that the EU and its member states object to the pact because it omits fossil fuels.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/23/cop31-ends-in-deadlock-as-guterres-blasts-fossil-fuel-interests-demands-urgent-climate-action-2/) reported that United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres expressed deep disappointment over the failure of the climate change conference.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/cop31-president-closes-climate-summit-without-deal-blames-some-countries-3725882) reported that COP31 President Murat Kurum closed the summit without a deal and stated that some countries failed to show the required effort and flexibility.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/europe-today-cop31-talks-collapsed-over-omission-of-fossil-fuels) reported that the COP31 meeting in Antalya ended without reaching consensus after talks collapsed over the omission of fossil fuels.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/environment/20261121-latest-cop31-deal-sidesteps-fossil-fuels-amid-growing-divisions) reported that COP31 ended without a deal as the EU rejected the text for omitting any mention of fossil fuels.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cop31-turkiyes-final-draft-doesnt-mention-the-words-fossil-fuels-that-cause-global-warming/article71730648.ece), a local outlet, reported that COP31 President Murat Kurum gave negotiators about three hours to make objections or ask for changes before the wording goes before the conference plenary.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261122-cop31-draft-deal-sparks-backlash-as-france-warns-of-step-backward) reported that France warned the last-ditch agreement at the Cop31 climate summit was a step backward.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261123-cop31-climate-talks-collapse) reported that EU member states objected to adopting an 11th-hour deal that omitted explicit references to fossil fuels.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/la-cumbre-climatica-cop31-fracasa-y-refleja-las-fisuras-del-multilateralismo-33263826) reported that the COP31 climate summit concluded without a global pact and revived debate over reforming consensus.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/mas-regiones/la-cop31-fracasa-por-falta-de-cosenso-sobre-combustibles-fosiles-en-un-duro-golpe-para-la-lucha-contra-el-cambio-climatico-muy-decepcionante-3603138) reported that Climate Change Summit co-president Chris Bowen assumed his quota of responsibility after COP31 failed due to a lack of consensus on fossil fuels.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fracasa-cumbre-climatica-cop31-financiamiento-clave-en-el-estancamiento/) reported that leaders failed to agree on measures to combat global warming, leading to the failure of the COP31 climate summit.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/cumbre-clima-borde-fracaso-union-europea-rechaza-acuerdo-menciona-salida-combustibles-fosiles_0_iKvfHaF62A.html) reported that the European Union rejected the COP31 draft agreement in Turkey because it did not mention the exit from fossil fuels.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/reino-unido-puede-revertir-el-brexit-y-regresar-a-la-union-europea-3602883) reported that Prime Minister Andy Burnham raised the debate on whether it is convenient for the United Kingdom to reverse Brexit and return to the European Union.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/d3d58f2cabbb), a state-run outlet, reported that COP31 chief Murat Kurum stated Türkiye exhausted all possibilities to secure consensus during two weeks of negotiations at the Antalya summit.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/climate-conference-ends-without-agreement-20261123-p61gcg.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the COP31 climate conference ended in Turkey with no agreement reached.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cq7827z2841zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the UN COP31 meeting in Turkey entered a second day of overtime as countries struggled to reach an agreement.
[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/22/new-cop31-draft-deal-tabled-as-countries-scramble-to-salvage-climate-talks) reported that the latest draft again failed to mention fossil fuels.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/countries-react-after-cop31-climate-talks-end-in-collapse?traffic_source=rss) reported that oil-producing countries opposed the term 'fossil fuels' in the draft text.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cop31-fails-to-agree-on-climate-deal-in-chaotic-finale/article71731651.ece) reported that COP31 President Murat Kurum announced there was no agreement on the text and the decisions were not adopted.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/climate-deal-collapses-chaotic-end-cop31), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261122-cop31-climate-talks-collapse-as-eu-rejects-deal-that-omits-fossil-fuels), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/22/climate-talks-collapse-without-deal-at-cop31-in-turkey/), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/article/3375393/cop31-climate-talks-collapse-eu-and-others-reject-deal), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/environment-and-climate-change/article-915721) reported that the COP31 climate talks collapsed after the European Union and several other countries rejected a proposed global agreement that failed to mention fossil fuels.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/climat/article/2026/11/22/climat-l-ue-et-ses-membres-s-opposent-a-l-adoption-de-la-decision-finale-proposee-a-la-cop31_6814199_1652613.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/sciences/cop31-l-union-europeenne-s-oppose-frontalement-au-dernier-projet-de-declaration-finale-20261122) reported that Turkey's COP31 presidency announced the rejection of the final decision draft because it omitted the phaseout of fossil fuels.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/22/climate/cop31-climate-summit-ends-climate.html), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10945295) reported that European and vulnerable nations rejected a proposed agreement after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked mention of phasing out fossil fuels.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-climate-deal-not-adopted-summit-president-says/live-79999516?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/cop31-summit-becomes-longest-ever-un-climate-conference-as-eu-rejects-cover-decision-agreement-omitting-fossil-fuels-101795345916381.html) reported that COP31 became the longest-running UN climate summit as nations failed to reach an agreement.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/environment/20261121-latest-cop31-deal-sidesteps-fossil-fuels-amid-growing-divisions), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/cop31-ends-deal-eu-not-endorse-text-omitting-fossil-fuels.1137494) reported that the EU and its member states rejected and refused to endorse the COP31 text for omitting mentions of fossil fuels.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/cop31-ends-deal-eu-not-endorse-text-omitting-fossil-fuels.1137494) reported that Ireland's Climate and Energy Minister Darragh O'Brien stated the EU objects to the pact.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261122-cop31-draft-deal-sparks-backlash-as-france-warns-of-step-backward) reported that the latest COP31 agreement at the summit in Turkey drew criticism from France for failing to explicitly address fossil fuels.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-22/cop31-at-odds-over-fossil-fuels/107414330), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-fossil-fuels-still-missing-from-draft-deal-at-un-climate-summit/live-79999516?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/fossil-fuels-still-missing-latest-cop31-draft-deal.1137485), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/cop31-turkiyes-final-draft-doesnt-mention-the-words-fossil-fuels-that-cause-global-warming/article71730648.ece), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/cop31-faces-collapse-threat-as-latest-draft-fails-to-mention-fossil-fuels/) reported that the latest COP31 draft text released by Turkey and Australia omits explicit references to fossil fuels as negotiations extend past the deadline.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/no-headway-even-in-overtime-cop-chief-seeks-compromise-101795312540164.html) reported that the second draft of the summit dropped both proposed fossil fuel references and the annual adaptation finance target.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/cop31-nouveau-projet-de-decision-finale-toujours-sans-mention-des-energies-fossiles-20261122) reported that a new COP31 final decision draft does not contain an explicit call to phase out coal, oil, or fossil gas.

reports.text: [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/25/katsina-suspends-emir-of-daura-over-sexual-harassment-allegation/) reported that the Katsina State government suspended the Emir of Daura over sexual harassment allegations involving a foreign tourist, while Governor Radda set up a committee to probe the claims.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/daura-emir-suspended-tourist-assault-claim-nigeria/) reported that Katsina State suspended the Emir of Daura's engagements and opened a committee probe after a tourist's allegation, which the palace disputes.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmglrz462nn6o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the Emir of Daura, a 92-year-old monarch, was suspended after sexual assault claims.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/katsina-suspends-emir-of-dauras-engagements-over-assault-allegation-launches-investigation/) reported that the Katsina State Government constituted an investigative committee to probe allegations involving Alhaji Umar Faruk Umar.

reports.text: [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/general-staff-russia-has-lost-1-643-580-troops-in-ukraine-since-feb-24-2022/) reported that the General Staff stated Russia has lost 1,643,580 troops in Ukraine since February 24, 2022, including 2,091 casualties suffered over the past day.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russia-breaks-yearly-troop-losses-record-in-ukraine-at-432-519-casualties-general-staff-says/) reported that the General Staff stated Russia broke its yearly troop losses record in Ukraine with 432,519 casualties.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187920-war-update-161-combat-clashes-reported-on-front-line-over-past-day.html) reported that 161 combat engagements between Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian troops were recorded along the front line on November 23.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187894-lithuania-provides-ukraine-with-over-usd-1b-in-military-aid-since-2022-general-staff.html) reported that Lithuania has provided Ukraine with over $1 billion in military assistance since 2022.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187530-war-update-149-clashes-on-front-lines-over-past-day-heaviest-fighting-on-kostiantynivka-pokrovsk-axes.html) reported that Ukraine's Defense Forces engaged in 149 combat clashes with Russian troops along the front line on November 22, with the heaviest fighting on the Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk axes.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187253-war-update-116-clashes-on-front-line-russian-forces-pressing-hardest-in-pokrovsk-kostiantynivka-sectors.html) reported that 116 combat engagements took place along the front line, with Russian forces launching nearly 25 assaults in the Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka sectors.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/general-staff-russia-has-lost-1-633-130-troops-in-ukraine-since-feb-24-2022/) reported that total Russian troop losses reached 1,633,130, including 2,150 casualties over the past day.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186670-war-update-278-clashes-on-front-line-over-past-day-pokrovsk-sector-hottest.html) reported that 278 combat engagements were recorded along the front line on November 19, with the highest number in the Pokrovsk sector.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186183-war-update-205-clashes-on-front-line-80-russian-troops-neutralized-on-pokrovsk-axis.html) reported that 205 combat engagements were recorded along the frontline on November 18, with 80 Russian troops neutralized on the Pokrovsk axis.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185400-war-update-135-combat-engagements-on-front-line-over-past-day.html) reported that 135 combat engagements were recorded along the frontline between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invading forces on November 16.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185350-war-update-133-combat-engagements-on-front-line.html) reported that 133 combat engagements were recorded along the front line, with Russian forces attacking Ukrainian positions 13 times in the Pokrovsk sector.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185037-war-update-141-clashes-on-front-lines-over-past-day-kostiantynivka-axis-hottest.html) reported that 141 combat engagements were recorded on the front line, with the Kostiantynivka axis being the most active.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062929/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff recorded 171 combat clashes on November 14, with the Pokrovsk front experiencing the highest number of attacks.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184540-war-update-243-clashes-on-front-line-fiercest-fighting-in-pokrovsk-sector.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062835/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff recorded hundreds of combat clashes along the front line over the past day, with the heaviest fighting in the Pokrovsk sector.
