reports.text: [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91134) reported that the Kremlin accused Estonia of aiding Ukrainian drone strikes and warned that the countries were brought to the brink of open war.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-tax-increases-putin-ukraine-b3091143.html) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin has increasingly sought to squeeze tax revenue out of businesses and consumers to support his war in Ukraine.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90696711) reported that Moscow's Foreign Ministry accused Estonia of a series of hostile actions that are on the verge of triggering an open war, according to Reuters.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-nato-estonia-warship-casualties-map-b3090337.html) reported that Estonia decided to close its border with Russia for six months starting from December 1.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Geopolitics/Europe/US-Weighs-NATO-Style-Security-Guarantees-for-Ukraine-as-Russia-Pushes-Back.html) reported that US President Donald Trump may consider offering Ukraine security guarantees modeled on NATO's collective-defense commitments.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/cards/putin-is-reportedly-open-to-article-5-style-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-but-what-does-article-5-actually-say-would-the-guarantees-require-nato-members-to-go-to-war-if-russia-attacks-again) reported that sources close to the U.S. negotiating team stated Putin is open to Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/russia-warns-estonias-moves-are-close-to-spark-an-open-war/) reported that rhetoric between Moscow and Tallinn spiked sharply after Estonia moved to shut down key border crossings.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90370831), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187592-kushner-says-trump-ready-to-back-article-5like-security-guarantees-for-ukraine-only-if-they-serve-us-interests.html) reported that U.S. presidential envoy Jared Kushner stated that President Donald Trump would approve NATO Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine only if they serve American national interests.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/kushner-trump-nato-ukraine-russia-security/33903834.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064102/) reported that US presidential envoy Jared Kushner stated that US President Donald Trump would consider NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine if they served American national interests and wider European security.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223081), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that U.S. presidential envoy Kushner shared his vision for future relations between Russia and the North Atlantic Alliance.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/putin-prelomio-uz-jedan-uslov-pristaje-na-garancije-u-stilu-nato-a-za-ukrajinu/), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/putin-navodno-pristao-na-snazne-bezbednosne-garancije-za-ukrajinu-po-ugledu-na-nato/xfb82pn) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin has privately agreed to the idea of post-war security guarantees for Ukraine from the United States and Europe under certain conditions.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187146-zelensky-ukraines-nato-membership-being-discussed.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Ukraine's membership in NATO would be the best security guarantee for the country.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4187167-zelensky-says-ukraine-not-yet-received-official-security-guarantees-equivalent-to-nato-article-5.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has not yet officially been offered security guarantees equivalent to NATO Article 5.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/internationalrussia-ukraine-war/article-915627) reported that according to The Wall Street Journal, Jared Kushner discussed offering Ukraine NATO membership if it cedes Donbas to Russia during peace talks.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/us-zelensky-ukraine-russia-land-swap-b3088764.html) reported that Donald Trump previously ruled out NATO membership for Ukraine while struggling to reach a breakthrough in mediated talks.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90709) reported that the Wall Street Journal stated Washington discussed giving Ukraine full NATO membership if it relinquished part of its territory.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222305) reported that Finnish politician Armando Mema stated the EU pushes Ukraine's NATO membership while ignoring Russia's concerns.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/c8f00a762b65) reported that Washington is exploring alternative peace arrangements involving territorial concessions or front-line freezes coupled with NATO membership or international security guarantees.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222153) reported that lawmaker Alexander Dubinsky stated Zelensky lied about coalition support for Ukraine's NATO membership, noting Germany's statement mentioned only security guarantees and continued support.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90651) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner said President Donald Trump wants Europe involved in any Ukraine peace agreement rather than imposing a unilateral settlement.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/the-debate/20261116-should-ukraine-trade-donbas-for-nato-membership) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the United States asked him about a swap where Russia gets the Donbas and the rest of Ukraine gets NATO membership.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/zelenskyy-us-proposal-donbas-withdrawal-nato-membership/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated US negotiators raised the possibility of Ukraine withdrawing from the eastern Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-volodymyr-zelensky-annonce-la-preparation-d-une-reunion-de-la-coalition-des-volontaires-qui-pourrait-s-averer-historique_6810982_3210.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced the preparation of a coalition of volunteers meeting to define the European position in future talks with Moscow.

[TASS](https://tass.com/russias-foreign-policy/2218325), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov stated that all participants in the Abu Dhabi talks viewed them positively, with the exception of Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218191), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Moscow believes staying out of EANA and other European forums serves the interests of Russian organizations.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-donbas-russia-war-map-frontline-update-b3085148.html) reported that fresh peace talks in Abu Dhabi failed to reach a meaningful breakthrough.

[Burkina 24](https://burkina24.com/2026/11/15/guerre-en-ukraine-washington-evoque-le-donbass-en-echange-dune-adhesion-a-lotan-selon-zelensky/) reported according to Zelensky that Washington raised a possible withdrawal of Ukrainian forces from Donbas in exchange for NATO membership.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/give-donbas-take-nato-seat-could-new-us-pitch-work-for-ukraine-russia?traffic_source=rss) reported that a US pitch involving Ukraine ceding Donbas to take a NATO seat is being considered.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/europe/us-floated-ukraine-ceding-donbas-nato-membership/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Kyiv would not concede territory but would put the question to a national referendum if Ukraine received security guarantees.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218183), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov took part in a conference on political affairs in Abu Dhabi.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218209), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian and UAE foreign ministers met in Abu Dhabi to discuss bilateral relations and Persian Gulf tensions.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/finland-rejects-reported-russian-demand-to-leave-nato-as-part-of-peace-talks/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Finnish Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen called the reported Russian demand for Finland to leave NATO outrageous.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90105) reported that Russia revived late-2021 security demands during peace talks with US envoys in Moscow, calling for NATO to withdraw troops to its 1997 borders.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218103) reported that Russia’s permanent representative to the OSCE Dmitry Polyansky stated that Europeans came with old talking points and were mum on Abu Dhabi talks.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062819/) reported that a document presented by Russian officials during negotiations with US envoys in Abu Dhabi calls for NATO to return to its 1997 military positions.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640123/russia-demands-finland-leave-nato-in-abu-dhabi-talks-report), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/14/russia-demands-finland-leave-nato-bild-reports-moscow-denies-it-and-helsinki-is-outraged) reported that the German newspaper Bild stated Russia demanded Finland leave NATO during Abu Dhabi talks, while Moscow denied the report and Helsinki expressed outrage.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/us-suggested-ukraine-cede-parts-of-donbas-to-russia-to-become-part-of-nato?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-suggested-ukraine-cede-land-nato-zelensky-says) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the US suggested Ukraine cede parts of Donbas to Russia to join NATO.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-asked-ukraine-to-cede-donbas-in-exchange-for-nato-membership-zelensky-says-101794649702111.html) reported that Volodymyr Zelensky said he would put the question to a referendum if Ukraine received a comprehensive security package including security guarantees.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/14/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-les-dernieres-informations-au-14-novembre-2026_6808609_3210.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/flash-actu/guerre-en-ukraine-les-etats-unis-ont-propose-a-kiev-des-concessions-territoriales-en-echange-d-une-adhesion-a-l-otan-annonce-zelensky-20261114) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that the United States proposed territorial concessions to Ukraine in exchange for NATO membership.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261114-us-negotiators-suggest-ukraine-cedes-territory-in-exchange-for-nato-membership) reported that President Zelensky said the US had proposed ceding Ukraine's eastern city of Donbas to Russia in exchange for Ukrainian membership of NATO.

reports.text: [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223759), a state-run outlet, reported that Pakistan's ambassador to Russia Faisal Niaz Tirmizi stated Pakistan hopes President Vladimir Putin will attend the 2027 SCO summit.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-offers-evidence-based-talks-with-india-on-terrorism/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046343/any-talks-with-india-on-terrorism-must-be-evidence-based-says-musadik-malik) reported that Pakistani Federal Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik stated in New Delhi that any bilateral talks on terrorism with India must be based on evidence.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585180/climate-change-enemy-of-civilisations-pakistan-tells-sco-moot-in-india/) reported that Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik declared climate change an enemy of civilisations at the SCO moot in India.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641524/malik-warns-of-climate-threat-to-civilisation-heritage-at-sco-forum-in-new-delhi) reported that Musadik Malik warned of climate threats at the SCO forum in New Delhi and met Tajik and Iranian officials.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/musadik-malik-calls-for-dialogue-to-resolve-issues-during-india-visit/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584860/musadik-malik-urges-evidence-based-solutions-in-delhi/) reported that Pakistani Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr Musadik Malik called for resolving regional issues through evidence-based solutions rather than mutual accusations during his visit to India.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/no-cultural-diplomacy-in-india-as-pakistani-minister-malik-blocked-from-visiting-historic-sites/) reported that Pakistani Federal Minister for Climate Change Musadik Malik was blocked from visiting historic sites in New Delhi.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-to-promote-shared-heritage-through-sco-civilisational-dialogue/) reported that Pakistan's participation in the SCO Civilizational Dialogue in New Delhi offers an opportunity to promote shared heritage.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584347/musadik-malik-arrives-in-india-for-sco-dialogue/) reported that Federal Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik arrived in New Delhi for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/india-pakistani-minister-visits-delhi-for-sco-forum-amid-frozen-ties/live-79999264?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/776aabd4c635) reported that Pakistan Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik arrived in New Delhi for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in the first high-level visit since 2023.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641334/musadik-malik-arrives-in-new-delhi-to-lead-pakistan-delegation-at-sco-forum), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045878/musadik-malik-arrives-in-new-delhi-to-attend-sco-dialogue-forum), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/musadik-malik-arrives-in-india-to-lead-pakistans-delegation-at-sco-forum/) reported that Pakistan's Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Malik arrived in New Delhi to lead a delegation at the SCO forum.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584154/musadik-to-lead-delelgation-for-sco-forum-in-india/) reported that Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Masood Malik will lead the Pakistan delegation to the first Shanghai Cooperation Organisation forum in India.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583771/pakistani-delegation-led-by-musadik-malik-to-attend-sco-civilizations-dialogue-forum-in-india/) reported that Federal Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Masood Malik will lead a Pakistani delegation to India for the SCO Civilizations Dialogue Forum.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641093/musadik-malik-set-for-delhi-visit) reported that Musadik Malik's visit to Delhi will be the first by a Pakistani federal minister to India since May 2023.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/pakistan-confirms-first-federal-ministerial-visit-to-india-in-over-three-years-for-sco-moot/) reported that Federal Minister Dr. Musadik Malik will visit New Delhi for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in the first ministerial visit in over three years.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640294/musadik-malik-to-represent-pakistan-at-new-delhi-sco-dialogue-fo), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044492/fo-says-climate-minister-musadik-malik-nominated-to-represent-pakistan-at-sco-moot-in-new-delhi) reported that Pakistan's Foreign Office announced that Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik has been nominated to represent Pakistan at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation dialogue in New Delhi.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581453/pakistan-to-attend-sco-meeting-in-india/) reported that Pakistan has decided to participate in the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation meeting in New Delhi.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/pakistan-climate-minister-sco-summit-india-visit-new-delhi/article71701699.ece) reported that the upcoming visit marks the first high-level visit by a Pakistani minister to India in three years.

reports.text: [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249684/Most-Americans-want-Iran-conflict-to-end-Poll), a state-media outlet, reported that a survey conducted by the University of Maryland and Ipsos found that 55 percent of Americans want to end the war on Iran immediately.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/ukraine-takes-war-russia-far-from-borders/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Kyiv admitted to striking Russian ships far from its borders.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/24/estonia-s-interior-minister-suggests-petitioning-putin-to-end-war-in-ukraine-after-narva-resident-launches-petition-to-keep-border-with-russia-open-for-family-visits) reported that an Estonian resident launched a petition asking Estonia to keep its border with Russia open for family visits.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/22/us-and-iran-could-still-reach-deal-says-egyptian-foreign-minister/) reported that the Egyptian Foreign Minister stated the US and Iran could still reach a deal.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532392/Araghchi-Iran-s-enriched-uranium-to-be-used-solely-in-line-with), a state-media outlet, reported that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi reaffirmed that Iran's enriched uranium stockpiles will remain under the country's control and be used in accordance with national needs.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iran-wants-diplomacy-end-war-trump-says-terms-unacceptable) reported that Abbas Araghchi stated Tehran still hoped diplomacy could end its war with the United States, while Donald Trump said Iran's terms were unacceptable.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249560/Any-deal-must-be-honorable-lasting-prevent-a-return-to-war), a state-media outlet, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated Iran's uranium reserves are consumed in compatibility with the country's needs.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-21/Iran-signals-openness-to-diplomacy-as-Trump-rejects-its-terms-1SfbQV8Myxq/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi stated Tehran hoped diplomacy could end its war with the US while Donald Trump rejected its terms.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/21/world/politics/iran-diplomacy-terms-unacceptable/) reported that Abbas Araqchi stated Tehran wanted guarantees that Washington was serious about negotiations.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/araqchi-says-iran-wants-diplomacy-end-war-trump-says-terms-unacceptable), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/a80616400e18), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915613) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi stated that Tehran still hopes diplomacy can end its war with the United States and seeks guarantees against future war.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/trump-says-putin-expressed-his-desire-for-end-of-ukraine-war-3013188) reported that US President Donald Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin expressed a desire for a diplomatic end to the Ukraine war during their recent meeting.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/20/8063876/) reported that US President Donald Trump claimed the hatred between Vladimir Putin and Volodymyr Zelenskyy is substantial.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/19/8063562/) reported that during talks with Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, Donald Trump said the US and China wanted to help bring the war in Ukraine to an end.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/19/us-china-can-help-end-ukraine-war-trump-tells-xi-before-trilateral-with-putin-a94307) reported that Kremlin foreign policy aide Yury Ushakov said Vladimir Putin's mood after the meeting was simply excellent.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/trump-says-us-needs-no-help-from-china-russia-to-end-iran-war-3725749) reported that Donald Trump told Fox News in Shenzhen that Iran wants to make a deal.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/nikki-haley-urges-us-allies-in-middle-east-to-help-end-iran-war/) reported that former US UN Ambassador Nikki Haley urged US allies in the Middle East to help end the war with Iran.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86321045/Russia-and-China-urge-immediate-end-to-war-against-Iran-stress), a state media outlet, reported that the Russian and Chinese ambassadors to the United Nations expressed concern over US and Israeli threats against Iran and urged an immediate end to the war.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581471/russia-china-seek-diplomatic-solution-to-iran-conflict/) reported that Russia and China called for an immediate end to the war against Iran and urged diplomatic efforts.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/news/audio/2026/nov/19/brejoin-is-andy-burnham-going-to-reverse-brexit-podcast) reported that Jessica Elgot and David McAllister discussed the prospect of the UK rejoining the European Union ahead of a UK-EU summit.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/19/andy-burnham-will-sign-a-brexit-reset-deal-tomorrow-the-real-battle-comes-next/) reported that Brussels remains wary of letting Britain cherry-pick the benefits of EU membership from outside the club as Andy Burnham prepares to sign a Brexit reset deal.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/18/david-lammy-andy-burnham-campaign-rejoining-eu-election-brexit) reported that former foreign secretary David Lammy urged Prime Minister Andy Burnham to fight the next election on rejoining the EU ahead of a summit in Brussels.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/invest-international-rail-services-boost-uk-eu-reset-andy-burnham) reported that campaigners urged investments in international rail services to boost the UK-EU reset.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/ukeu-reset-will-take-time-any-decisions-to-follow-next-elections-says-british-pm-andy-burnham-101794902431647.html) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated any UK-EU relationship changes will take time and follow the next election.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/17/burnham-says-brexit-has-dramatically-diminished-britains-global-standing), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/britain-lost-more-than-it-gained-since-brexit-pm-burnham-says-3725664) reported that British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated at the Lord Mayor's Banquet that Britain has lost more than it gained from Brexit and that global standing has diminished.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOZGVhQnh3ZDFYZ0JqbnFKazRlM2RDblBURFRPZ2VLZTJSeUY5RmpreVJ5Sk14Qk5wWDJsaWZ0N3JSVVJvV1pCOXV4YVoxUDM4UFpLY2t1RWYwVmhNUHJuTXdraDNWbDAtN0otbXZXakg2bE5SNHpFRnZKNkUwVFJlVFBHLVd1akIxb2w4YmJ0VXF4dm9FWUdlZmlQSHpVNmxETWJhYTRlRjA?oc=5), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/uk-leader-andy-burnham-says-brexit-hasnt-worked-ahead-of-reset-summit-with-eu) reported that UK political figure Andy Burnham stated that Brexit has not worked and failed to deliver on promises to take back control of borders, laws, and the economy ahead of an EU reset summit.
[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uk/2026/11/17/britain-lost-its-moral-compass-over-gaza-says-burnham/) reported that Andy Burnham stated Britain lost its moral compass over Gaza.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/world/politics/brexit-leave-burnham-eu-reset/) reported that former Prime Minister Boris Johnson insisted the UK would back Brexit again in another referendum despite polls suggesting otherwise.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374654/uk-pm-andy-burnham-says-brexit-has-not-worked-ahead-reset-summit-eu) reported that UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that Brexit has not delivered for the country and that a much closer relationship with the EU is needed.

reports.text: [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/eie-faults-apc-absence-as-lagos-senate-reps-candidates-unveil-manifestos/) reported that candidates contesting seats in the Senate and House of Representatives in Lagos State outlined plans to address challenges in education, healthcare, and unemployment.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/tinubu-has-earned-ndigbos-support-says-kalu/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Deputy Speaker Benjamin Kalu urged Abia voters to re-elect President Bola Tinubu in 2027, citing the South-East Development Commission and key federal appointments.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/2027-tinubu-takes-re-election-battle-to-ndigbo-secures-lagos-endorsement/), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/24/tinubu-woos-ndigbo-in-lagos-seeks-support-for-2027-re-election/) reported that President Bola Tinubu secured an endorsement from Ndigbo leaders and traders in Lagos during his re-election campaign visit.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adc-pcc-slams-tinubu-over-fuel-subsidy-comment/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council faulted President Bola Ahmed Tinubu over his fuel subsidy comments.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/subsidy-removal-you-cant-wish-away-nigerians-hardship-adc-pcc-tells-tinubu/) reported that the African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council tackled President Bola Tinubu over his stance on the hardship faced by Nigerians following subsidy removal.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/2027-peter-obi-is-nigerias-only-hope-says-ndc-chairman/) reported that NDC National Chairman urged Nigerians to vote out Tinubu in 2027 and described Peter Obi as the country's only hope.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/22/2027-aisha-buhari-throws-weight-behind-tinubu-radda-son/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1742664-tinubu-atiku-aisha-buhari-signatory-announcement-2027/) reported that former First Lady Aisha Buhari threw her weight behind President Bola Tinubu and other political figures ahead of the elections.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/927103-2027-peter-obi-is-nigerias-hope-says-ndc-national-chairman.html) reported that Moses Cleopas said Peter Obi, if elected, would prioritise protecting lives, repositioning the economy, and providing the leadership needed to rebuild the country.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/nigerians-cant-endure-another-tinubu-term-obi-is-our-hope-ndc-chairman/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/2027-peter-obi-only-hope-for-nigeria-says-ndc-chairman/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-obi-nigerias-only-hope-says-ndc-chairman/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027-peter-obi-is-only-hope-nigeria-has-this-time-cleopas/) reported that Nigeria Democratic Congress national chairman Senator Moses Zuwoghe urged Nigerians to vote out President Bola Tinubu in 2027 and described Peter Obi as the country's only hope.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/stop-recycling-falsehoods-against-tinubu-lagos-apc-tells-pearse/) reported that the Lagos State chapter of the All Progressives Congress slammed Dr. Adetokunbo Pearse over media interviews.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/anthem-row-fashola-faults-obis-handling-of-supporters/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that former Lagos State Governor Babatunde Fashola questioned the leadership capacity of Nigeria Democratic Congress presidential candidate Peter Obi.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/singing-old-national-anthem-not-a-crime-apc-chieftain/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that APC chieftain Dr Josef Onoh stated neither the 1999 Constitution nor the National Anthem Act 2024 criminalises singing the old national anthem.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/15/keyamo-insists-ndc-erred-in-singing-old-national-anthem-during-townhall-meeting-in-lagos/) reported that Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development Festus Keyamo stated that the Nigeria Democratic Congress erred in singing the old national anthem at a town hall meeting in Lagos.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/lagos-apc-faults-obi-ndc-over-singing-old-national-anthem/) reported that the Lagos State chapter of the All Progressives Congress criticized Peter Obi and the Nigeria Democratic Congress over the singing of the old national anthem.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/old-national-anthem-keyamo-gives-dickson-48-hours-to-clarify-ndcs-position/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/keyamo-gives-dickson-48-hours-to-clarify-ndcs-anthem-position/) reported that Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo gave Seriake Dickson 48 hours to clarify the NDC's position on the old national anthem.

reports.text: [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/bienvenue-a-phnom-penh-why-cambodias-francophonie-summit-matters/) reported that political divisions overshadowed the 20th Francophonie summit hosted in Cambodia.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20261117-report-de-l-%C3%A9lection-du-secr%C3%A9taire-g%C3%A9n%C3%A9ral-de-l-oif-des-n%C3%A9gociations-tendues-et-des-r%C3%A9formes-en-attente) reported that leaders of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie prolonged discussions and postponed the election of the secretary-general due to a lack of agreement.

[The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/cambodian-sins-overshadow-global-francophonie-summit-in-phnom-penh/) reported that French President Emmanuel Macron urged Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet to investigate the assassination of former Cambodian lawmaker Lim Kimya.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/invit%C3%A9-afrique-midi/20261116-report-de-l-%C3%A9lection-du-secr%C3%A9taire-g%C3%A9n%C3%A9ral-de-l-oif-sur-le-fond-la-position-de-la-rdc-a-gagn%C3%A9) reported that regarding the postponement of the election of the secretary-general of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie, the position of the DR Congo has gained ground.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-francophonie-summit-avoids-major-disaster-after-clash-over-leadership) reported that the Francophonie summit postponed the election of a new chief following a row between DR Congo and Rwanda.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/dr-congo-rwanda-row-derails-francophone-summit-vote-6555176) reported that the DR Congo-Rwanda row derailed the vote for a new secretary general of the Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie during talks in Phnom Penh.

[Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/actualites/arts-et-culture/francophonie-lelection-du-secretaire-general-reportee-a-novembre-2027/) reported that the election of the secretary-general of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie was postponed to November 2027.

[La Presse (Tunisia)](https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/11/15/a-phnom-penh-au-royaume-du-cambodge-la-tunisie-au-sommet-de-la-francophonie-aujourdhui/) reported that Dhia Khaled led the Tunisian delegation to the International Organization of La Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh.

[Le Pays (Burkina Faso)](https://lepays.bf/20e-sommet-de-la-francophonie-sur-fond-de-tensions-entre-kigali-et-kinshasa-une-gueguerre-qui-pourrait-couter-a-lafrique-le-poste-de-secretaire-general-de-linstitution/) reported that the 20th Francophonie Summit opened on November 15, 2026, in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261115-tensions-and-economic-turbulence-in-cambodia-as-it-hosts-francophonie-summit) reported that the 20th Francophonie summit opened on November 15 in Phnom Penh amidst rising tensions with Thailand and declining tourism.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261115-francophone-summit-opens-in-cambodia-overshadowed-by-tensions-in-africa) reported that the 20th Francophonie Summit opened in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, overshadowed by a leadership dispute.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/francophone-summit-opens-in-cambodia-amid-rwanda-dr-congo-rift?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Francophone summit opened in Cambodia amidst a clash between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda over leadership.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/15/world/politics/francophone-summit-congo-rwanda/) reported that the Organisation Internationale de la Francophonie summit opened with a Congo-Rwanda clash.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-leadership-as-francophone-summit-opens/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a summit of French-speaking nations opened amid a clash between DR Congo and Rwanda over the organization's leadership, with DR Congo threatening to quit.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/85895265), [Al Wihda (Chad)](https://www.alwihdainfo.com/phnom-penh-accueille-la-48e-conference-ministerielle-de-la-francophonie/) reported that Moldovan Prime Minister Vasile Tofan will attend the International Organization of La Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophonie-vote/) reported that DR Congo stated it will consider dropping its Francophonie candidate while Rwanda refused, and spokesman Patrick Muyaya responded ahead of the leadership vote.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261114-dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophonie-leadership-as-macron-seeks-compromise), [Punch](https://punchng.com/dr-congo-rwanda-clash-over-francophone-top-job/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that DR Congo and Rwanda clashed over the leadership of the Francophonie.

reports.text: [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/periodista-colombiana-estefany-rodriguez-quien-estuvo-16-dias-detenida-por-ice-en-estados-unidos-recibio-premio-internacional-del-cpj-en-nueva-york-3602665) reported that Colombian journalist Estefany Rodríguez received an international CPJ award in New York after being detained for 16 days by ICE.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/washington/kirsten-davies-llega-a-la-direccion-nacional-de-ciberseguridad-tras-una-serie-de-fallas-en-eeuu-nid20112026/) reported that Kirsten Davies will replace Sean Cairncross as national cybersecurity director following failures affecting services in the United States.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/jefe-de-ciberseguridad-de-la-casa-blanca-dejara-su-cargo-en-medio-de-fallas-tecnologicas-que-afectaron-a-empresas-y-agencias-de-estados-unidos-3602610) reported that Kirsten Davies will assume the national cybersecurity directorship following her appointment by Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/casa-blanca-despide-al-jefe-de-ciberseguridad-tras-una-serie-de-fallos-tecnologicos-33221131) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced the appointment of Kirsten Davies.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/reportan-despido-del-jefe-de-ciberseguridad-de-la-casa-blanca-tras-serie-de-fallas-tecnologicas-kirsten-davies-asume-sus-funciones/) reported that the removal of Sean Cairncross follows disruptions affecting air traffic, automated teller machines, emails, and alert services.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/avion-hercules-c130-colombia-estados-unidos-fuerza-aerea-donacion-fac-1019-BH43770166) reported that U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth delivered a C-130 Hercules aircraft to Colombia, restoring its fleet to six such planes.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/captura-trillizos-colombianos-ee-uu-ice-advierte-tener-solicitud-pendiente-no-da-estatus-legal-FD43738904) reported that U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement issued a warning after detaining 19-year-old Colombian triplets, stating that a pending application grants no legal status.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/esta-es-la-enfermedad-que-padece-la-mama-de-los-trillizos-colombianos-detenidos-por-ice-en-ee-uu-fue-sometida-a-una-cirugia-y-esta-en-recuperacion-3602082) reported that family testimony indicated the 19-year-old individuals arrived in the United States to provide financial support for their recovering mother.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/que-hay-detras-de-la-inquietante-ola-de-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-nid18112026/) reported that a succession of technology disruptions in airlines, banks, and intelligence networks exposed digital vulnerabilities in the United States.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/marco-rubio-hablo-sobre-las-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-y-descarto-interferencia-extranjera-no-estamos-bajo-un-ataque-cibernetico-3601898) reported that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that technology outages affecting Microsoft, Chase, airlines, and the NSA were unrelated and not caused by a foreign cyberattack.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/la-caida-de-la-red-secreta-de-la-nsa-se-suma-a-una-ola-de-fallas-tecnologicas-en-estados-unidos-coincidencia-o-amenaza-cibernetica-3601808) reported that disruptions in bank and technology platform services coincided with cyberattacks affecting approximately 200 websites.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-hit-sudden-system-outage/) reported that United Airlines suffered a widespread system outage that left planes unable to take off.
[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2219263) reported that a major outage hit United Airlines affecting a system related to flight departures.
[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/drama-na-americkim-aerodromima-pao-sistem-united-airlinesa/npgmhe1) reported that United Airlines confirmed a system failure occurred on Monday afternoon.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/jpmorgan-chase-atribuye-los-fallos-a-un-error-de-software-y-descarta-un-ciberataque-33166828) reported that JPMorgan Chase attributed banking service outages affecting thousands of customers to a software error and ruled out a cyberattack.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/united-airlines-reporta-interrupcion-generalizada-sus-sistemas_202611176afb8b9903bbf30bb04e2f1a.html) reported that United Airlines experienced a widespread system disruption in the United States attributed to instability in communications and radar systems.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/united-airlines-restablece-sistema-tras-falla-tecnologica-interrupcion-provoco-retrasos-en-vuelos/) reported that on November 13 the FAA ordered flights to remain on the ground because a new router failed and saturated the system.
[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-system-outage) reported that United Airlines acknowledged a technology issue that delayed flight departures.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/united-airlines-hit-by-widespread-system-outage-days-after-faa-ground-stop-disrupted-us-air-travel-101794867751137.html) reported that the carrier clarified the issue was not affecting flights already in the air or services operated by United Express.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/united-airlines-reports-widespread-outage-just-days-after-nationwide-ground-stop/CHU2RQYJERCJNHQAEB4INTZEGY/) reported that old network equipment was overloaded, disrupting 17 of 22 major control centres.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/united-airlines-resolves-tech-outage-that-delayed-flights/a-79964387?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that United Airlines said a system outage that delayed departures has been resolved.
[TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219271), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that there was no indication that the United Airlines electronic system outage was a cybersecurity-related issue.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/article-915107) reported that there was no indication that United's outage was connected to the Federal Aviation Administration shutdown.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/16/united-airlines-relata-falha-generalizada-dias-depois-da-suspensao-de-voos-nos-eua.ghtml) reported that United Airlines reported a widespread system outage days after nationwide flight cancellations due to technical problems.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-recupera-la-normalidad-aerea-tras-miles-de-cancelaciones-y-una-falla-en-el-sistema-de-nid16112026/) reported that more than 18,000 flights were canceled and 28,000 suffered delays over three days due to an FAA router issue before normal operations resumed.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/estados-unidos-united-airlines-reporta-falla-generalizada-sistemas_0_H77eHnDPQG.html) reported that United Airlines reported a generalized failure in its systems days after the national flight suspension.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/sitios-de-bancos-en-eeuu-presentan-fallos-pero-no-hay-ciberataque-segun-jpmorgan-chase_0_gtsuRx0yIe.html) reported that JPMorgan Chase stated there was no ciberattack despite users reporting banking app failures.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/bancos-de-eu-reportan-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso/) reported that Zelle also registered interruptions in its transfer services alongside bank platform issues.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/se-desploman-las-acciones-de-grandes-bancos-en-wall-street-tras-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-en-estados-unidos-3601471) reported that shares of JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and Capital One registered losses on Wall Street following digital platform failures.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/chase-bank-of-america-us-bank-and-wells-fargo-among-banks-down-today-users-report-mobile-banking-outages-101794855031957.html), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/caida-de-bancos-en-estados-unidos-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo-presentan-fallas-en-sus-servicios-digitales-3601448), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso-a-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo_0_giCFGzhtEk.html) reported that users of Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and US Bank experienced digital service outages and difficulties accessing online accounts.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/aeroportos-dos-eua-comecam-a-voltar-a-normalidade-apos-caos-aereo-mas-ainda-ha-atrasos.shtml) reported that the US aviation sector began returning to normality following three days of cancellations and delays caused by a system outage.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/15/voos-nos-eua-devem-ser-normalizados-ate-o-fim-de-domingo-promete-faa-passageiros-ainda-devem-enfrentar-transtornos.ghtml) reported that the FAA administrator promised US flights would be normalized by Sunday evening.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/14/caos-nos-eua-mais-de-12-mil-voos-foram-cancelados-entre-sexta-feira-e-sabado.ghtml) reported that official FlightAware data showed more than 12,000 flights were cancelled between Friday and Saturday in the United States.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/troca-de-cabos-causou-suspensao-que-cancelou-mais-de-16-mil-voos-nos-eua.shtml) reported that a cable swap caused a suspension that cancelled more than 16,000 flights in the United States.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7322457-anac-sete-voos-previstos-para-os-eua-foram-cancelados-e-14-atrasaram.html) reported that the head of the US Federal Aviation Administration forecasted between 4,000 and 5,000 flight cancellations on Saturday.

reports.text: [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1010019/tech-outages-attributed-to-rapid-software-patching-us-officials-experts/story/) reported that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated software patching efforts are sometimes creating short-term disruptions.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/technology/surge-software-patches-likely-behind-recent-tech-outages/) reported that bank regulators are on alert as software patches are linked to recent tech outages.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/us/sean-duffy-ground-stop-faa-trump.html) reported that current and former officials stated Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's push to rapidly modernize aviation systems during President Trump's second term could have contributed to the ground stop.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/faa-chris-sununu-federal-aviation-administration-dot-bedford-b3087468.html) reported that U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy continues to blame a contractor for the events leading to the Federal Aviation Administration ground stop.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/18/faa-sean-duffy-flight-stoppage) reported that the head of the Federal Aviation Administration urged people to blame him rather than Sean Duffy for the flight stoppage.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/washington/marco-rubio-sobre-las-fallas-tecnologicas-en-eeuu-no-hay-motivos-para-creer-que-esten-relacionadas-nid18112026/) reported that Marco Rubio stated there are no reasons to believe technological failures in the United States are related to hackers or a foreign state.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/marco-rubio-bomb-plot-tech-outages-b3086955.html) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated some intelligence sources are liars and criminals.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/18/microsoft-flights-banks-and-now-the-nsa-a-week-of-tech-outages-in-the-us?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that the classified network used by the US National Security Agency for internal communications went down on Tuesday.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crkgvxxwpwz2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there was zero evidence supporting online theories that recent technical disruptions affecting Microsoft, banks, and flights are connected.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/18/zero-evidence-recent-tech-outages-linked-marco-rubio), [Punch](https://punchng.com/no-evidence-of-coordinated-cyberattack-behind-us-outages-rubio/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there is zero evidence linking the recent technical disruptions and outages to any coordinated cyberattack or malign actor.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/18/rubio-rules-out-cyberattacks-or-links-between-tech-outages?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated there is no evidence linking technical outages to each other or to cyberattacks.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10941144) reported that technology outages shut down email for many companies and grounded thousands of flights over several days before extending to the US government.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/marco-rubio-says-zero-information-that-us-outages-are-linked-or-caused-by-a-malign-actor/article71714357.ece), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/zero-evidence-of-any-malign-actor-marco-rubio-dismisses-link-between-faa-ground-stop-microsoft-and-other-outages-101794969511572.html) reported that Marco Rubio stated there is zero information or evidence linking the U.S. service outages to any malign actor and dismissed connections between the FAA ground stop and Microsoft outages.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/faa-routers-ground-stop.html) reported that federal officials stated a router made by Juniper Networks caused a data overload that disrupted communications.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-administration-proposes-50-billion-plan-to-upgrade-faa-infrastructure-after-nationwide-ground-stop-101794956678150.html) reported that the Trump administration proposed a $50 billion plan to upgrade FAA infrastructure.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/faa-suspends-installation-of-routers-blamed-for-nationwide-air-traffic-control-ground-stop-101794957621094.html) reported that the malfunctioned routers are being tested in a lab at the headquarters of L3Harris.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/17/faa-halts-new-router-installations-nationwide-ground-stop/) reported that the Federal Aviation Administration stopped installing new network routers and disabled a function on 60 similar units following a nationwide ground stop.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/us-senators-urge-faa-to-halt-router-upgrades-after-nationwide-flight-chaos-demand-probe/articleshow/135934901.cms) reported that US senators urged the FAA to halt router upgrades following nationwide flight chaos.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/faa-halts-installations-of-routers-to-assess-ground-stop-trigger/6247EY54KBCVPJM2M2BUCUX2LE/) reported that the FAA halted installations of routers to assess the ground stop trigger, while officials have yet to pinpoint the cause of the Arkansas router malfunction.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/us-senators-demand-faa-pause-upgrades-linked-to-nationwide-ground-stop?traffic_source=rss) reported that US senators demanded an FAA pause on communications system upgrades linked to the nationwide ground stop.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/16/g-s1-153841/up-first-newsletter-faa-ground-stop-democratic-leaders-congress-trump-asia-trip) reported that U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated things could be back to normal at the end of Monday following the FAA ground stop.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/frustrated-flyers-drive-thousands-miles-faa-ground-stop/) reported that frustrated air passengers drove thousands of miles to get around the Federal Aviation Administration ground stop.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/thanksgiving-flights-unlikely-to-be-affected-after-faa-ground-stop-disrupts-over-12-400-us-flights-101794912127516.html) reported that Thanksgiving flights are expected to remain unaffected after the FAA ground stop disrupted 12,400 flights.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-refuses-to-take-responsibility-for-nationwide-faa-ground-stop-blames-biden-and-outdated-equipment-101794853144497.html) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he takes no responsibility for the nationwide flight ground stop and blamed old equipment and Democrats.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/US-transportation-secretary-refuses-to-apologize-for-FAA-ground-stop-1S6PigDFnPy/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy refused to apologize for the Federal Aviation Administration's nationwide ground stop.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/us-flight-disruptions-may-continue-until-monday-trump-administration/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/us-aviation-crisis-flight-cancellations-may-continue-until-monday/) reported that the Trump administration stated flight disruptions and cancellations across the United States caused by a system upgrade failure may continue until Monday.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/us/sean-duffy-ground-stop-trump-faa.html), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-sean-duffy-flight-delays-cancellations-faa-b3085303.html) reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy offered new details on the nationwide ground stop caused by a fix and refused to apologize or guarantee a similar meltdown will not happen again.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/15/trump-atribui-falha-no-controle-aereo-dos-eua-a-gestao-biden-e-cobra-recursos-do-congresso.ghtml) reported that US President Donald Trump commented on the telecommunications interruption in the air traffic control system.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914962) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced investigators determined a contractor's error or faulty router caused the disruption.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-biden-flight-delays-cancellations-faa-b3085211.html) reported that transportation secretary Sean Duffy blamed a defense contractor for Saturday flight cancellations exceeding 6,000.

reports.text: [Long War Journal](https://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2026/11/iraqi-forces-enter-jurf-al-sakhar-militia-stronghold-as-pm-seeks-to-consolidate-power.php) reported that Iraqi security forces entered Jurf al Sakhar on November 20 following an investigation.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532383/Iraq-s-government-and-Kataib-Hezbollah-agree-on-middle-ground), a state-media outlet, reported that the Iraqi government and Kataib Hezbollah reached a middle ground and the government backed down from threats to deploy the army and forcibly remove Kataib Hezbollah members from a town near Baghdad.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/21/iraqi-governments-control-of-jurf-al-sakhar-marks-rare-success-but-key-issues-remain/) reported that the Iraqi government's control of Jurf Al Sakhar marks a rare success while key issues remain.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261121-iraq-reopens-key-road-linking-jurf-al-nasr-to-karbala/) reported that Iraq reopened a key road linking the Latifiya area, Jurf al-Nasr district, and Karbala.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/will-iraqs-return-jurf-al-sakhar-weaken-iran-backed-kataib-hezbollah) reported that the town of Jurf al-Sakhar and surrounding agricultural areas had been under the control of Iran-backed armed factions since 2014.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261120-iraq-opens-security-command-headquarters-in-jurf-al-nasr-as-troops-redeploy/) reported that Iraq's Federal Police announced the opening of a headquarters for security and army forces in the Jurf al-Nasr area of Babil province.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-iraqi-forces-strike-compromise-with-powerful-pro-iran-militia) reported that three senior security officials stated Iraq reached a compromise with the Iran-backed militia Kataib Hezbollah.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/iraqi-forces-enter-iran-backed-kataeb-hezbollah-stronghold-3725803) reported that Iraqi government forces moved into Jurf al-Sakher, the main base of Kataeb Hezbollah.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261120-iraqi-security-forces-to-deploy-in-hezbollah-stronghold-under-compromise-deal), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/20/iraqi-security-forces-move-into-iran-backed-militia-stronghold-of-jurf-al-sakhar/) reported that Iraqi security forces deployed in the Kataib Hezbollah stronghold of Jurf al-Sakhar under a compromise deal.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraqi-security-forces-deploy-iran-backed-militia-stronghold-security-officials) reported that Iraqi security forces will deploy in Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/20/world/middleeast/iraq-militia-iran-kataib-hezbollah.html) reported that Iraqi army and police units were deployed into territory controlled by Kataib Hezbollah for the first time in over a decade.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/iraqi-forces-strike-compromise-powerful-pro-iran-militia-security-officials-say) reported that Iraq has reached a compromise with the Iran-backed militia Kataib Hezbollah according to security officials.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraqi-forces-enter-militia-stronghold-jurf-al-sakhr-friday) reported that Iraqi forces will begin deploying on Friday in the main stronghold of Kataeb Hezbollah as Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi steps up efforts to rein in the faction.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraqi-pm-delays-lebanon-visit-amid-jurf-al-sakhr-standoff) reported that Iraq's prime minister delayed a visit to Lebanon amid a standoff over Kataib Hezbollah vacating Jurf al-Sakhr.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/18/nx-s1-6043167/iraq-environmentalist-marshes-iran-backed-militia-kidnapped) reported that an Iraqi environmentalist was kidnapped and tortured by Iran-backed militias while working to save the marshes.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/18/iraqi-pm-delays-lebanon-visit-amid-standoff-with-iran-backed-militia/) reported that Iraq's Prime Minister delayed a visit to Lebanon amid a standoff with an Iran-backed militia.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-iraqs-kataib-hezbollah-rejects-government-ultimatum-to-withdraw-from-jurf-al-sakhr/) reported that Iraq's Kata'ib Hezbollah stated it would not withdraw from its stronghold in Jurf al-Sakhr despite a government ultimatum.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648958-iraq-militia-oil-smuggling/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Iraq ordered troops into a militia-controlled area over alleged oil smuggling.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/iraq-moves-reclaim-jurf-al-sakhr-militias-after-12-years) reported that Iraq deployed tanks and troops ahead of a planned operation to retake Jurf Al-Sakhr from Kataib Hezbollah.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-iraq-establishes-special-security-force-to-combat-oil-smuggling-protect-pipelines/) reported that Iraq established a specialized security force to combat oil smuggling and protect its pipeline network.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/iraq-pm-sacks-officials-over-oil-smuggling-in-pro-iran-group-bastion-3011926) reported that the Iraqi Prime Minister dismissed nine officials following an investigation into oil smuggling linked to Kataeb Hezbollah.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/horror-in-niger-as-bandits-invade-community-behead-village-head-burn-his-household/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/bandits-behead-niger-village-head-kill-five-others/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that suspected bandits invaded a community in Borgu Local Government Area of Niger State, beheading the village head, killing five other residents, and burning houses.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/shehu-sani-warns-northerners-against-celebrating-attacks-on-southern-leaders/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Shehu Sani warned northerners against celebrating attacks on southern leaders to prevent ethnic hostility.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/bandits-abduct-six-rustle-livestock-in-sokoto/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that bandits abducted six people and rustled livestock in Dukkuma, Sabon Birni, Sokoto.
[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/bandits-kill-zamfara-govs-aide-abduct-worshippers/) reported that suspected bandits killed Nasiru Sani Kaura during an attack in Kaura Namoda, Zamfara State.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/925368-shehu-sani-calls-zamfara-mosque-attack-genocide-decries-public-silence.html) reported that Shehu Sani called the Zamfara mosque attack genocide and expressed outrage over public silence.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/zamfara-mosque-attack-kaura-namoda-party-official/) reported that a dawn raid on a mosque in Kaura Namoda killed a ruling-party registration supervisor and left worshippers abducted.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/bandits-kill-three-abduct-residents-in-sokoto/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that bandits killed at least three people, abducted residents, and rustled livestock in an attack on the Yartsakuwa community.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925372-three-killed-many-abducted-in-sokoto-attack-police.html) reported that the police confirmed three deaths from the attack in Sokoto State, while residents reported four fatalities.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925270-bandits-attack-zamfara-mosque-kill-apc-e-registration-supervisor-abduct-worshippers.html) reported that attackers stormed the Lowcost Mosque in Kaura Namoda town, killing an APC e-registration supervisor and abducting worshippers.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/over-40-killed-as-vigilantes-clash-with-bandits-in-zamfara/) reported that over 40 people, including suspected bandits and local vigilantes, were killed in a gun battle in Zamfara.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/over-50-killed-in-clashes-between-bandits-vigilantes-in-nigeria) reported that at least 53 people were killed in clashes between criminal gangs and local vigilantes in Zamfara state.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/clashes-between-gangs-vigilantes-kill-over-50-in-zamfara-report/), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/clashes-between-gangs-vigilantes-kill-over-50-in-northern-nigeria-residents-3011866) reported that clashes between criminal gangs and local vigilantes left more than 50 people dead in northwestern Nigeria's Zamfara state.

reports.text: [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-916053) reported that a second Hamas internal security chief was killed in an IDF strike in northern Gaza.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/25/israeli-strike-kills-four-people-in-gaza?traffic_source=rss), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249681/Family-of-four-killed-in-Israeli-strike-on-their-apartment) reported that an Israeli airstrike on an apartment building in the Shati refugee camp in Gaza killed four people from the same family.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-25/Israeli-strike-in-Gaza-brings-aid-worker-death-toll-to-600-UN-1SlQQNjaLHq/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that the UN stated an Israeli airstrike near a water well in Gaza's Jabalia area killed a staff member of UNRWA, bringing the aid worker death toll to 600.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-915998) reported that Israeli Katz stated the IDF is ready to evacuate West Bank areas in response to Palestinian terror and that a Shin Bet report will help address legal objections.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6rrg7ggq190o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that an Israeli air strike killed Hamas internal security chief Naeem Abu Nahel in western Gaza City.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/israeli-strike-kills-hamas-internal-security-chief-in-gaza-source-tells-afp) reported that two policemen died when a police station in southern Gaza was hit.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/hamas-security-official-killed-in-israel-strikes-in-gaza/article71738279.ece) reported that the Israeli military and the Shin Bet domestic security service said in a joint statement they had struck a senior Hamas member without identifying him.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-915749) reported that the IDF identified three PIJ operatives targeted in Gaza and rejected claims that they were aid workers, while World Central Kitchen denied current ties to the men.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/hamas-seeks-urgent-mediators-meeting-after-strike-kills-3-gaza-soup-kitchen-workers-3725850) reported that Hamas requested an urgent meeting of Gaza ceasefire mediators and guarantors after an Israeli strike killed three soup kitchen workers in Gaza City.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641671/hamas-seeks-emergency-talks-after-israeli-strike-killed-3-gaza-aid-workers), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585264/hamas-seeks-urgent-talks-after-israeli-strike-kills-gaza-aid-workers/) reported that Hamas called for urgent discussions with ceasefire mediators following an Israeli strike that killed three humanitarian workers in the Gaza Strip.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915611) reported that IDF forces and local security responded to a West Bank incident where a local security coordinator fired into the air before aiming at a suspect.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915561) reported that Israeli activists protested at the Erez Crossing against Gaza aid deliveries, accusing the government of violating Defense Minister Israel Katz's commitments.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/guerre-au-proche-orient/article/2026/11/18/l-armee-israelienne-annonce-le-lancement-d-une-operation-dans-une-zone-de-la-bande-de-gaza-controlee-par-le-hamas_6813156_6325529.html) reported that the Israeli army announced the launch of an operation beyond the yellow line in a Hamas-controlled area of the Gaza Strip.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/gaza-l-armee-israelienne-affirme-avoir-lance-une-operation-dans-une-zone-controlee-par-le-hamas-20261118) reported that the Israeli army stated it launched an operation in the center of the Gaza Strip with tanks seen near a refugee camp.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-915265) reported that an IDF officer stated that targeted killings of Hamas officials make it easier for soldiers on front lines.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/israel-mata-comandante-do-hamas-em-ataque-no-sul-de-gaza.shtml) reported that the Israeli military stated it killed a Hamas commander in a southern Gaza strike.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-915056) reported that the IDF and Shin Bet identified three Hamas members killed in the Nasser Hospital strike.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/israel-kills-senior-hamas-commander-in-gaza-two-months-after-killing-his-predecessor-as-ceasefire-stagnates/) reported that Israel killed a senior Hamas commander involved in planning the October 7 attacks.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-15/news-1S5GggBdc7S/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Hamas confirmed the death of a senior military commander in an Israeli airstrike.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-914964) reported that UN ambassadors entered Gaza for the first time and toured a Hamas tunnel with Israeli envoy Danny Danon.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxPcENPOW1qRkNiUFR6VHJ4ZGI2T1d5UGl1aFZFUVh1WmV5WmZZdVl6eTZJYVZTT0RKUkxDcEg4UWZXVWFpS0Vkb3R5ZVlneVVTVXVOeVpValUzNFhCNzdBN3Y1dTZ5NkxHMVNhZ05DN1BTVHBxOC0zYTZuQk9PLURjNTMtV1VIMUFTVUZ5QzE5WlJQT2dIOVFiTTd0TTkxZ2hRN2UxZkxjN05KM1N5SXRrOEpkY2JVV19rT1JNcWN6aUhXX2pLcWc?oc=5) reported that the Gaza peace board called for urgent action after an Israeli strike killed six people at a hospital.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxQN0lIYjU0OG55Z253dDhlYmdmSURkRWZWU3NnWUdwVk5iekp3aXJDbGVQM0RfMUpGRnVQbkowUHBNdEtFaWFYMjRwN2Z5VU04WURFcEhzUTEtcWRMclhYcHlQc0hLV0QxZmNZR0ZMS3RpdkpnNnNMdjhRN0hodGgzaGVHS0N3cjhrcjNPUDNpbTVGNnZzQlhSMnEyelczQVdZLVI5SlFtVzhFUQ?oc=5), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqrkg4r6mg7xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that both Hamas and Israeli Defense Forces officials confirmed the death of Samir Abu Younis, commander of the Rafah Brigade.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184769-israel-strikes-hamas-military-wing-killing-senior-commander.html) reported that Israel carried out a strike against Hamas's military wing, killing a senior commander and injuring several others.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPYUhZd1pxN2d0N3pmR2RCbjhCQk9teURKLThfYzR0bC1rVWJpVGUwNkpJelBNeVNLY3hxS1B0c0p2bTk5VmhCeFVGUWpHSFVNdHFKZjcydUdYNDEyMThuQ3hTRmFNSTQ0Z05ZSWRSd1A3QnM3eTRjWkNJbkN2Z2E5M1FQaUdrdUtaYzVNcWtVMC1LOU1yUkpoUk82d0ZQejM5cDR3YXVqcE5xMlJkTVU2dGduMDdsUWp2UG5ERFZUZw?oc=5) reported that Hamas stated a senior armed commander was killed in an Israeli strike.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/israeli-air-strike-kills-senior-hamas-commander-in-gaza?traffic_source=rss) reported that Hamas confirmed the death of Rafah brigade commander Samir Abu Younis in an attack on Khan Younis.

reports.text: [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/EU-to-Seek-Overhaul-of-UN-Climate-Consensus-Decisions-After-COP31-Failure.html) reported that the European Union will propose to the UN a review of the COP climate conferences' consensus decision-making model following the summit's failure.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/business-news/927413-cop31-african-climate-coalition-says-no-deal-better-than-empty-text-sets-demands-for-cop32.html) reported that the Pan African Climate Justice Alliance stated that no deal is better than an empty text and set demands for COP32.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/cop31-african-trade-unions-reject-climate-loans-demand-debt-relief/) reported that African trade unions rejected climate loans and demanded debt relief and increased grant-based funding.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/from-cop31-antalya-to-copenhagen-un-climate-summits-where-no-agreement-was-reached) reported that UN climate summits since 1995 have often experienced deadlock and delays.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/23/failure-cop31-calls-urgent-reform-un-climate-summits) reported that the failure at Cop31 prompted former US vice-president Al Gore and other climate leaders to demand a change to the consensus rule.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/cop31-in-antalya-hosts-joint-declaration-press-conference-3725812) reported that ministers and officials from multiple countries attended a joint declaration press conference at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/20/turkey-activists-chant-shame-as-cop31-negotiations-falter) reported that climate activists denounced the proposed outcome of COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, accusing governments of failing to deliver meaningful measures.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/at-cop31-conflict-over-climate-science-slows-action-on-global-warming/a-80004894?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that attacks on climate science and disinformation risk delaying key measures at COP31 in Antalya.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/cop31-global-climate-challenge-imperative-of-intl-action/) reported that the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference is being held in Antalya, Turkiye, from 9 to 20 November 2026.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/20/african-negotiators-at-cop31-demand-concrete-measures-on-climate-justice/) reported that the African Group of Negotiators called for concrete measures on climate justice at COP31 as UN climate talks went into overtime.
