reports.text: [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/south-korea-cannot-police-its-way-out-of-ai-cheating/) reported that the top scorer on the tax exam confessed to AI cheating and 111 more alleged cases surfaced at the college entrance exam.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3375480/south-koreas-education-chief-has-gone-its-ai-exam-headache-has-not) reported that South Korea's education minister resigned days after the national university entrance exam.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641688/south-korean-education-minister-offers-to-resign-amid-ai-assisted-cheating-controversy) reported that South Korean Education Minister Kyo-jin offered to resign and took responsibility for last-minute anti-cheating measures that caused confusion.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cw3dgk29d37no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin admitted last-minute measures to stop AI-assisted cheating during the college entrance exam caused chaos.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/22/south-korea-education-minister-resigns-after-ai-cheating-scandal-engulfs-university-exams), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/south-korea-education-minister-choi-kyo-jin-resigns-amid-ai-cheating-scandal-101795322293412.html), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10945089), [Punch](https://punchng.com/south-korea-education-minister-resigns-over-ai-cheating-scandal/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261122001051315), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3375362/south-koreas-education-minister-quits-amid-backlash-over-anti-cheating-exam-checks) reported that South Korean Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned following an AI-assisted cheating scandal and last-minute exam rule changes.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm3vgw1xevvwo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that 111 students were caught with banned smart devices while taking the high-stakes Suneung exam in South Korea.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10944168) reported that 111 test-takers were caught possessing or using smart devices during South Korea's annual college entrance exam.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261120005100315) reported that South Korean President Lee Jae Myung called for a complete overhaul of the state exam system to combat AI-assisted cheating.
[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/south-korea-university-exams-ai-cheating-6566301) reported that South Koreans are sitting for the annual nine-hour Suneung college exam.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/man-accused-of-ai-assisted-exam-cheating-found-dead-in-seoul/) reported that a South Korean man suspected of using artificial intelligence to achieve a perfect score on the law school entrance examination was found dead in Seoul.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/man-accused-of-ai-cheating-in-south-korean-exam-found-dead/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Lee Jin-woo, a 32-year-old accused of using AI to cheat in South Korea's LEET law school exam, was found dead in a Seoul motel.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261119010100315) reported that 98 test-takers were caught cheating on the college entrance exam, including 5 using smart devices.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/south-korea-tightens-security-for-national-exam-over-ai-cheating-scandal) reported that over 550,000 candidates sat South Korea's Suneung university entrance exam under extraordinary security following an AI cheating scandal.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/lifestyle-culture/article/3375067/glasses-buttons-south-koreas-anti-cheating-exam-checks-raise-eyebrows) reported that students in South Korea faced strict anti-cheating checks on items such as glasses and clothing buttons during the annual college entrance exam.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/19/asia-pacific/society/south-korea-college-exam-cheating/) reported that South Korea held its annual nine-hour college entrance exam with strict curbs following a cheating scandal.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261119001152315) reported that twenty-two test-takers were caught possessing smartphones at the college entrance exam through disaster alert messages.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/world/asia/south-korea-cheating-college-exam-suneung.html) reported that South Korea is sending emergency alerts to every phone in the country as part of an anti-cheating campaign during the college entrance exam.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/south-korea-to-send-disaster-alert-during-exam-to-catch-ai-cheating-3725739) reported that South Korea's Interior Ministry announced it will issue a disaster alert during the annual college entrance exam to detect AI cheating.

[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261118003900315) reported that Prime Minister Han Seong-sook asked for the public's understanding regarding alert messages to be sent during college entrance exams, while police raise their alert level to guard against AI cheating.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10940994) reported that recent AI-assisted exam cheating scandals in South Korea reveal a growing willingness to bend the rules, with psychologists stating technology is making dishonesty easier.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009880/south-korea-tightens-exam-security-after-ai-cheating-scandal/story/) reported that South Korea will deploy thousands of extra personnel to prevent cheating on college entrance exam sites this week.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPNGE1NWg5RXYzeVZBS3VzUGptS2I4ODBKd1FaUjF1R0hpVHpXeEpkcFF2U1lpWU42QmZGYzZYZ2NZV05QRVVfXy04T1dpeGpKM0lXNmVnMHhOc05abFZ6NEZUYjIxTTFybk5zcFRUVWdmeHM4TGp5QV83OVZVVjE0cmtjY1RYbHJERVJLeDV2ZXdhTWR2SkRGYVVHQjFxLXkwalJMNGk0YnVwd1RIcnI3VDJwSDg1Q1VQRmM0RA?oc=5) reported that South Korea tightened university exam checks to screen for hidden cameras.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10940334) reported that an unusually sharp increase in candidates scoring 90 or higher in an accounting subject on this year's tax accountant qualification exam raised cheating suspicions.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/south-korea-cheating-scandal-are-ai-smart-glasses-a-threat-to-exams?traffic_source=rss) reported that a student with near-perfect scores on two tests confessed to using artificial intelligence.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117006200315) reported that an education ministry official reaffirmed that the government ruled out postponing the college entrance exam.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10940048), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/lifestyle-culture/article/3374703/south-korea-checks-glasses-and-collars-hidden-ai-university-exam) reported that South Korean education officials and Prime Minister Han Seong-sook took measures to prevent artificial intelligence-assisted cheating ahead of the nationwide college entrance exam.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117003600315) reported that the leader of the ruling Democratic Party stated the party will push for a 10-year exam ban for AI-assisted cheating.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117003200315), a local outlet, reported that Prime Minister Han Seong-sook vowed again to root out AI cheating in this week's college entrance exam.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117003100315) reported that the top scorer of this year's certified tax accountant exam apologized for cheating before police questioning.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/glasses-worn-by-exam-candidates-come-under-scanner-in-south-korea-after-ai-cheating-scandal-101794803535654.html), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/south-korea-national-exam-ai-cheating-scandal-6554101) reported that South Korea's Education Minister announced the ministry will inspect all glasses worn by candidates in the college entrance exam following an AI cheating scandal.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQTGplSkhGeTJ3YnFIQkF5S21vemk1MFNZaGx1SmpvWmtVajFhdGw5REpGSGVJSWJ0a1pzTjEzWnV2WDRDVHNQbzdNc0tpODVfYThGXzNNZmxYbVAyMm5QYWJudkVmMUJKUnhfSHMtQ3d1dVFuZnRhcllkUkJvbHJLR2p1ODBlMjdmWmhIUExJNU5lOE13N0piMjZPeXhYQUtRUWNadUdxVFo?oc=5) reported that AI cheating fears are affecting South Korea ahead of college entrance exams.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3374538/south-korea-cracks-down-online-exam-pill-sales-ahead-national-college-exam) reported that South Korea's drug safety agency flagged online posts illegally selling prescription drugs under study-enhancing labels.

[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261116005500315), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10938746) reported that South Korea is scrambling to crack down on AI-assisted cheating ahead of the national college entrance exam.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPVjJtaVF1ZGdVTmRVNlB2Mk5GeEVtaTk2UHIxbW16RHU2M0hNQ1hTZW1XTkVPTzlYQnNYV2FDMlZGQjZpMXdySHZhMDFUMDkxOWJybnE4ekV6LVRuV3p5bHZiU3dTVWsyNkpOTkdaV3gxR3plNTF1TTdyVDlIUklCekFkNG5yaFdQZ3lQVjhyQXNxX09UQnVuYlhLMjNoMVVDZFk4R2xhQVd4T2xjaWNfdVZFZW4?oc=5), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581863/south-korea-investigates-top-exam-scorer-over-ai-cheating/) reported that South Korean police launched an investigation after the top scorer confessed to cheating with AI.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/15/ai-cheating-south-korea-college-entrance-exam), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10937594) reported that the top scorer admitted to using a miniature camera and AI tool to cheat on the examination.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10937538) reported that the top scorer on South Korea's state-administered tax accountant examination admitted to using artificial intelligence to cheat.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/15/asia-pacific/south-korea-ai-test-cheating/) reported that the candidate scored 397.5 out of 400 points in the first round with only one wrong answer out of 160 questions.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10937374) reported that the top scorer in South Korea's tax accountant qualification exam turned himself in to the police and admitted to cheating using AI-powered smart glasses.

reports.text: [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223387), a state-media outlet, reported that a NATO Bombardier Artemis II reconnaissance aircraft conducted 79 multi-hour flights over the Black Sea since the start of the year.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/second-tanker-in-two-days-sinks-off-bulgarias-black-sea-coast-search-operation-under-way) reported that a second tanker sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast.

reports.text: [Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/thomas-markle-formally-charged-in-us-over-possessing-child-sexual-abuse-material-13616074) reported that Thomas Markle has been formally charged on two counts of possessing child sexual abuse material in Los Angeles.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime/thomas-markle-charged-child-sex-abuse-material-b3091071.html) reported that Markle was arrested earlier this month after FBI agents seized material from two storage units.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/us/2026/11/24/meghan-markles-father-charged-with-possession-of-child-sex-abuse-images/) reported that Thomas Markle snr was reported to the FBI and police in the Philippines by his son last month.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/meghan-markle-accused-of-possessing-illegal-child-sexual-abuse-images/) reported that a Los Angeles grand jury filed charges accusing Thomas Markle of possessing illegal child sexual abuse images.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/bbc/acusan-ee-uu-padre-meghan-markle-esposa-principe-harry-posesion-imagenes-abuso-sexual-infantil_1795570977) reported that the Central District of California prosecutor's office presented a formal indictment accusing Markle of knowingly possessing recordings of child sexual abuse.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/world/europe/thomas-markle-indicted.html), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/meghan-markle-accused-of-possessing-child-sexual-abuse-images-authorities-say/) reported that a Los Angeles grand jury indicted Thomas Markle on two felony counts of possessing child sexual abuse materials.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/jurado-de-eu-acusa-al-padre-de-meghan-markle-de-posesion-de-pornografia-infantil-33297308) reported that a US jury accused Meghan Markle's father of possessing child sexual abuse material.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/25/il-padre-di-meghan-incriminato-per-possesso-di-pornografia-infantile_e953748f-0c8a-4f5f-acf9-4aba353eb65b.html), an Italian local outlet, reported that Thomas Markle faces up to 40 years in prison if found guilty.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/thomas-markle-padre-de-meghan-markle-es-acusado-de-posesion-de-material-de-abuso-sexual-infantil-en-un-tribunal-de-estados-unidos-3603972) reported that the decision came after a psychiatrist determined during a hearing that the accused is mentally competent.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/acusan-al-padre-de-meghan-markle-esposa-del-principe-harry-del-reino-unido-de-poseer-pornografia-nid25112026/) reported that Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan Markle, faces two child pornography charges and is under custody in Florida.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/elon-musks-companies-sued-by-us-states-over-flood-of-sexualised-images-made-with-grok-ai/article71737074.ece) reported that two Democratic attorneys general filed lawsuits against Elon Musk's companies over the Grok AI chatbot's ability to generate sexualized images.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/world/europe/harry-meghan-royal-family-uk.html) reported that the Sussexes are back in the UK arranging a program of public appearances.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/elon-musk-grok-sued-child-sexual-abuse-ai-b3090098.html) reported that Elon Musk's companies were sued over the AI Grok profiting from child abuse images and explicit content.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/23/us-states-sue-spacex-over-grok-ais-creation-of-child-sexual-abuse-material?traffic_source=rss) reported that Virginia and Oregon filed separate lawsuits accusing SpaceX of promoting Grok's spicy mode.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585677/king-charles-excludes-prince-harry-and-meghan-markle-from-royal-christmas-plans/) reported that King Charles finalized the royal family's Christmas guest list without Prince Harry and Meghan Markle.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/21/thomas-markle-father-law-prince-harry-deemed-competent-stand-trial/) reported that a judge declared Thomas Markle, the estranged father of the Duchess of Sussex, mentally competent to stand trial on child pornography charges.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/thomas-markle-fit-to-stand-trial-over-child-abuse-images-us-court-rules-13614172) reported that a US court ruled Thomas Markle fit to stand trial on charges of possessing child sexual abuse material.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime/thomas-markle-hearing-mental-competency-florida-b3087970.html) reported that Thomas Markle faces a mental competency hearing in a US criminal case in federal court in Tampa, Florida.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/19/thomas-markle-mentally-competent) reported that a judge in Florida stated an expert determined Thomas Markle is mentally competent to face charges.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/ukraine-russia-california-british-army-london-b3087564.html) reported that Britain's Prince Harry offered a veiled criticism of the US government's policy toward Ukraine, saying he believes there is a big separation between the administration and the public.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/corte-de-eu-fija-para-este-jueves-una-nueva-audiencia-para-el-padre-de-meghan-markle-33198640), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/corte-de-eu-fija-para-este-jueves-nueva-audiencia-del-padre-de-meghan-markle-se-determinara-su-capacidad-mental/) reported that a US court scheduled a hearing to determine if Thomas Wayne Markle Sr. has the mental capacity to understand criminal proceedings against him.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4185733-prince-harry-presented-with-book-unbreakable-kherson-during-visit-to-ukraine.html) reported that during his visit to Ukraine, Britain's Prince Harry was presented with a copy of the book 'Unbreakable Kherson' and drawings by a nine-year-old girl.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063156/) reported that Britain's Prince Harry met Kostiantyn Vlasenko, a Ukrainian soldier evacuated from a frontline position, at Superhumans Lviv.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/video/prince-harry-visits-lviv-to-attend-trials-for-invictus-games-ukraine-team) reported that Britain's Prince Harry attended trials for the Invictus Games' Ukraine team in Lviv and called wounded veterans role models.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/prince-harry-says-youre-going-to-win-on-surprise-weekend-visit-to-ukraine) reported that Prince Harry spoke at a conference for medics at the Superhumans clinic in Lviv.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90217) reported that Prince Harry made an unannounced weekend visit to Lviv to meet wounded veterans and attend Invictus Games trials.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/16/il-principe-harry-partecipa-agli-invictus-games-dellucraina-a-leopoli_4b174b7b-10a6-4890-bd72-b956d97a6b90.html) reported that Britain's Prince Harry attended the Invictus Games in Lviv and told wounded military personnel that they would win the war.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374521/prince-harry-salutes-wounded-ukrainian-veterans-role-models-surprise-ukraine-visit) reported that Britain's Prince Harry met wounded Ukrainian veterans during a surprise trip and stated they need continued support from Kyiv.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-16-britains-prince-harry-visits-war-wounded-in-ukraine/) reported that Prince Harry met soldiers wounded in action during a two-day visit to Ukraine and expressed confidence that the country could win the war.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4184939-prince-harry-attends-allukrainian-invictus-games-in-lviv.html) reported that Prince Harry attended the All-Ukrainian Invictus Games in Lviv.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPcklqVi1XWjFZOWg4YVhVUWZkVFI3OXk3cGdSQmNKX1J3ZlpCRm9ZeGw1UFlhSURfNmhLUHFndzQyNWN3SVdTczA5Z3ZuYWNMcWp2cDJCN25hQjVvTVRMamlOM1RsLVh1Q0dtY2ZGQ3Rqeno1UkZ0WVluNElRMVFFNU93M1BuYU9WNkprYmlBNDcxM3FvY1lrTjBaN0tmclBkWVBpX2JQV2cyMmZ1NXlGR0JuR1M?oc=5) reported that Prince Harry saluted wounded Ukrainian veterans as role models during a surprise visit.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/15/prince-harry-ukraine-war-surprise-trip-invictus-games) reported that Prince Harry told Ukrainian soldiers they are going to win the war during a surprise trip to Lviv, where he met wounded veterans and said the country could one day host the Invictus Games.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/prince-harry-in-ukraine-meeting-invictus-2027-hopefuls?traffic_source=rss) reported that Prince Harry made his fourth visit to Ukraine to meet wounded veterans and Invictus 2027 hopefuls.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062969/) reported that Invictus Games founder Prince Harry visited Lviv to cheer on wounded Ukrainian service members in wheelchair rugby.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/4184766-prince-harry-visits-lviv-for-first-superhumans-war-trauma-conference.html), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581860/prince-harry-visits-ukraine-for-war-trauma-conference/) reported that Prince Harry visited Lviv in Ukraine to participate in the first international Superhumans War Trauma Conference.

reports.text: [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/estonian-prime-minister-closing-the-railway-border-crossing-with-russia-could-be-the-next-step-ca83bu9) reported that Estonia's prime minister indicated that closing the railway border crossing with Russia could be the next step in response to threats from Moscow.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/estonia-closing-border-russia-attacks-b3090839.html) reported that Estonia is closing its border with Russia on December 1 and urging Europe to take Vladimir Putin's aggression more seriously.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/91102) reported that Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Tallinn could suspend railway traffic with Russia as a further response to Moscow's hostile activities.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/24/latvia-mulls-possible-border-closure-with-russia-a94359) reported that Latvia is discussing a possible border closure with Russia as neighboring Estonia prepares to shutter its checkpoints in response to an alleged Russian sabotage plot.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/estonia-foreign-minister-margus-tsahkna-close-border-russia/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/24/why-is-estonia-closing-its-border-with-russia-estonian-foreign-minister-margus-tsahkna-explains-in-a-column-for-politico) reported that Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna explained that Estonia is closing its land border crossings with Russia starting December 1 in response to an attempted arson attack.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064254/) reported that Russia summoned Estonia's chargé d'affaires to protest Tallinn's decision to close border crossings from December 1 following an attempted arson attack.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064275/) reported that Russia's Foreign Ministry claimed Estonia is deliberately allowing Ukrainian drones to use its airspace to target north-western Russia.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/24/russia-protests-estonia-s-planned-land-border-closure-and-again-accuses-it-of-letting-ukrainian-drones-use-its-airspace) reported that Russia summoned Estonia's acting chargé d'affaires Marek Juhtegi to lodge a strong protest over border closures and airspace accusations.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/649254-estonia-border-closure-plan/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state media outlet, reported that Moscow summoned Estonia's chargé d'affaires in protest of the looming border closure announced by Tallinn.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90373426) reported that Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova reacted to Estonia's decision to close road border crossings with Russia starting December 1.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/russia-complains-of-new-iron-curtain-as-estonia-shuts-its-borders?traffic_source=rss) reported that Russia complained of a new Iron Curtain after Estonia shut road border crossings following an attack on a drone manufacturer.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/estonia-to-close-all-road-crossings-with-russia) reported that Estonia's government decided to temporarily close its road border crossings with Russia starting December 1 citing national security.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/estonia-to-shut-border-with-russia-over-gru-linked-sabotage-attack) reported that Estonia will close five checkpoints on the border with Russia from 1 December with a possible review in six months after an attempted arson at a defence facility near Tallinn.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/estonia-to-close-border-with-russia-moscow-decries-new-iron-curtain/article71725791.ece) reported that Estonia accused Russian security services of staging an attempted arson attack on an Estonian defense company prior to closing its border.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/20/narva-mayor-calls-for-humanitarian-corridors-for-emergency-trips-to-russia-as-estonia-prepares-to-close-the-border-december-1) reported that Narva's mayor called for humanitarian corridors for emergency trips to Russia as Estonia prepares to close the border.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/internationalrussia-ukraine-war/article-915583) reported that Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova accused Estonia of planning to erect a new Iron Curtain and stated Moscow would respond.

[Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/estonia/estonia-to-close-all-land-border-crossings-with-russia-epak7xr) reported that Estonia will close all land border crossings with Russia from December 1, citing security threats and Russian-linked sabotage attacks.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-estonia-iron-curtain-border-closure-b3088663.html) reported that Moscow accused Estonia of erecting a new Iron Curtain after Tallinn announced plans to close road crossings with Russia.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375264/estonia-close-border-russia-least-6-months-over-foiled-sabotage) reported that Estonia will close its road border crossings with Russia on security grounds from December 1.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222377), a Russian state outlet, reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal noted the government will be able to reassess the situation and decide on further actions regarding the border closure in six months.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185798-moldova-temporarily-closes-six-border-crossing-points-with-ukraine-following-russian-drone-attack.html) reported that Moldova temporarily closed six border crossing points with Ukraine following a Russian drone attack.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/estonia-s-president-urges-government-to-weigh-consequences-of-closing-russian-border) reported that Estonian President Ülle Madise urged the government to weigh the consequences of closing the border with Russia and avoid letting emotions drive the decision.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261117-estonia-closes-its-border-with-russia-but-can-it-keep-moscow-out), [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87486196) reported that Estonia will close border crossing points with Russia starting December 1 for national security reasons.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87330337) reported that Estonia will close its border with Russia on December 1 and that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda warned Lithuania is not ruling out similar measures.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-estonia-to-close-russian-border-crossings-after-attempted-arson-attack-on-drone-maker), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/16/estonia-is-closing-its-border-with-russia-after-an-alleged-sabotage-attempt-and-preparing-to-move-government-services-to-the-cloud-in-case-of-invasion) reported that Estonia will close all border crossings with Russia starting December 1 following a suspected sabotage attack at Threod Systems.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063116/) reported that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda stated Lithuania may consider closing all border crossings with Russia if destabilisation efforts continue.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/estonia-to-close-russia-border-after-sabotage-bid-on-drone-maker-foreign-minister-says), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90202) reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal stated the GRU ordered a sabotage attempt at defense company Threod Systems.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063038/) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha praised Estonian security services for thwarting the attack.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/estonia-russia-border-sabotage-bid/) reported that Estonia's decision to close its border with Russia marked an escalation in regional tensions linked to Moscow's war against Ukraine.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-crime/4184944-eight-people-detained-in-estonia-over-attempted-arson-attack-on-defense-industry-plant-allegedly-commissioned-by-russia.html) reported that the Estonian Prosecutor General's Office stated eight people were detained over an attempted arson attack on a Threod defense industry building in Viimsi commissioned by Russia.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218361) reported that Interior Minister Igor Taro stated Estonia will decide on closing its border with Russia next week on a temporary or permanent basis.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOVkhQYlBYSGp1OG16aUlIS0JBcWpXQnpYbDlDaVFqb0V4cG04dm9wbnptbW1WRnI1bmh2ck0tTmM2Vl9pYVN2dG5NVmpTM2liUG9JWDNkVTZPVUxQc0swQ3FuN3UyZ2tyanRHVENpeUQtbTl0Z3RYSlIzVFB3QnFtdzVvWURCWDlCVjhlclpUTlpWaVhxektwaEFtY2Z2ZGRUYmJ1Z0ozUW9jY0lSOURycDkxSktlRnc?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/15/estonia-to-close-border-crossings-with-russia-after-alleged-arson-attack?traffic_source=rss), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/estonia-to-close-border-with-russia-after-moscow-linked-sabotage-attempt-on-drone-maker/) reported that Estonia is closing its border crossings with Russia following an alleged or attempted arson attack on a drone manufacturer.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218399), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian diplomat Maria Zakharova stated Moscow will check information about Estonia's plans and view it as Russophobia if confirmed.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/estonian-drone-maker-targeted-by-gru-ordered-sabotage-attempt-pm-says) reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Estonia was preparing to potentially close its border with Russia.

reports.text: [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/uk-announces-fresh-myanmar-sanctions-following-icj-genocide-ruling/) reported that London announced fresh sanctions against Myanmar following the ICJ genocide ruling and stated it will work with international partners to ensure meaningful action.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/myanmar-urged-to-comply-with-international-law-after-icj-genocide-ruling-3725925) reported that foreign ministers of 14 countries urged Myanmar to comply with international law following the ICJ judgment.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6wy4ng1rznxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the UK joined several other nations in sanctioning top Myanmar military leaders following the ICJ genocide ruling.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261123-14-countries-acknowledge-icj-ruling-of-genocide-against-rohingya) reported that 14 countries from Europe, Africa, and Oceania acknowledged the ICJ ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.
[Aravot](https://en.aravot.am/2026/11/23/383020/) reported that Armenians in Armenia and the diaspora have a particular stake in welcoming affirmations of international justice regarding genocide.

[Global New Light of Myanmar](https://www.gnlm.com.mm/president-u-min-aung-hlaing-and-spouse-daw-kyu-kyu-hla-open-2026-tazaungdine-mathoe-lotus-robe-weaving-contest/) reported that Myanmar President U Min Aung Hlaing and his wife opened the 2026 Tazaungdine Mathoe lotus robe-weaving contest.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375529/uk-sanctions-myanmar-president-military-figures-after-genocide-ruling) reported that Britain announced sanctions against five people under its Myanmar and global human rights sanctions regimes, including senior members of the military government, following the genocide ruling.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3375454/how-will-chinas-ties-myanmar-change-icjs-genocide-ruling) reported that an international court genocide ruling against Myanmar might complicate Beijing's diplomatic engagement with Naypyidaw and cast a shadow over Belt and Road Initiative projects.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/law/2026/nov/23/icj-ruling-duty-to-prevent-genocide-international-court-of-justice) reported that experts stated the ICJ ruling on the duty to prevent genocide closes an incoherent gap and has implications for countries such as the UK and Germany regarding arming Israel.

[The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/how-asean-responded-to-the-icjs-myanmar-genocide-ruling/) reported that the region's response to the November 19 judgment against Naypyidaw has been muted.

[Le Soleil (Senegal)](https://lesoleil.sn/actualites/genocide-des-rohingyas-la-cij-condamne-le-myanmar-a-linitiative-de-la-gambie/) reported that the International Court of Justice recognized that Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya in Rakhine State, following an initiative by Gambia.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/malaysia-to-engage-un-oic-asean-after-icj-myanmar-genocide-ruling-3725855) reported that Malaysia's Foreign Ministry stated that Kuala Lumpur respects the International Court of Justice judgment holding Myanmar responsible for genocide.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/rohingya-groups-urge-global-action-after-icj-genocide-ruling-on-myanmar-3725837) reported that Rohingya organizations worldwide, in a statement endorsed by 64 groups, demanded immediate international action to enforce the International Court of Justice ruling.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/3358955/ties-with-myanmar-stay-despite-icj-ruling-pm) reported that Thailand's Prime Minister stated relations with Myanmar will be maintained despite the ICJ ruling.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915642) reported that France stated it would seek UN Security Council action after Myanmar refused to accept an ICJ ruling finding that its military committed atrocities against the Rohingya.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/azhar-welcomes-historic-international-court-of-justice-ruling-on-genocide-against-rohingya-muslims/) reported that Al-Azhar welcomed the historic International Court of Justice ruling regarding Myanmar's genocide against Rohingya Muslims.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/suljagic-nakon-presude-mijanmaru-sud-u-hagu-ne-bi-dosudio-u-korist-bih-ni-da-su-nas-sve-pobili/261121059) reported that Srebrenica Memorial Center Director Emir Suljagic stated the International Court of Justice would not have ruled in favor of Bosnia and Herzegovina against Serbia.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/bih/sta-bi-icj-danas-odlucio-o-genocidu-i-predmetu-bi-h-protiv-srbije/), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/slucaj-mijanmar-otvorio-pitanje-drukcijeg-ishoda-tuzbe-bih-protiv-srbije-mozda-bi-genocid-bio-utvrden-i-u-prijedoru/261121040) reported that the International Court of Justice ruling holding Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya raised questions about a different potential outcome in Bosnia's lawsuit against Serbia.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/rohingya-who-escaped-myanmars-genocide-tell-their-stories) reported that Rohingya survivors who escaped Myanmar's genocide recounted rivers red with blood and burning nearby villages.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/analysis-myanmar-genocide-judgment-may-bolster-gaza-case-against-israel) reported that the International Court of Justice's ruling that Myanmar committed genocide may bolster the Gaza case against Israel.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/world-news/asia-and-australia/2026-11-20/ty-article-magazine/.premium/the-icj-has-found-a-country-guilty-of-genocide-israel-should-be-worried/000001a1-f85f-d5b4-a3bd-f97f72a30000) reported that the International Court of Justice has found a state responsible for genocide for the first time in history, worsening Israel's legal standing.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6ly58ndgd0no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the BBC's international editor wrote that the Myanmar genocide verdict is historic and could have far-reaching implications.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/myanmar-rohingya-genocide-un-icj-6568711), [UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168853) reported that UN General Assembly President Khalilur Rahman told Rohingya refugees that a judgment on paper must be given effect.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/what-does-the-icjs-rohingya-genocide-ruling-mean-for-gaza?traffic_source=rss) reported that the ICJ Rohingya genocide case sets a precedent for establishing a state's intent to commit genocide beyond explicitly written orders.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/a9cd79db6b18) reported that Dhaka stated Rohingyas must be able to return safely and demanded reparations from Myanmar.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/myanmar-genocide-ruling-rohingya-say-struggle-for-justice-not-over/a-80003365?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the ICJ held Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya and ordered restitution and reparations.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/turkiye-welcomes-landmark-icj-ruling-on-myanmars-rohingya-genocide/news), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/turkiye-welcomes-icj-ruling-holding-myanmar-responsible-for-genocide-3725800) reported that Türkiye's Foreign Ministry welcomed the ICJ ruling holding Myanmar responsible for genocide against Rohingya Muslims.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQLTNLWmdYdncxbDRfcFZhVlRFeVRfN3Jic2JSb252SkQ4djE0ckRoaGpqcnZKWDU5Wm4tUXdjTHdPZVNtWkVRWVNSN29EcFNQQkhVeVF6WWQ5NFB2WUFURVFyWjI3dmRGeEJNSDJrMk1HYTdMMXVTMkZqZl9ZVjlJMVlhSWRTR0Nha0NJZ3J0TVBpVndia25nVXNDZi1GcnVxYTFtdklydElZQy1FMHo5TGhJcUpjcG5rWDZJaQ?oc=5) reported that rights groups urged sanctions after the top UN court found Myanmar committed genocide.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/83475e748a6f) reported that Israeli legal scholars stated the International Court of Justice's approach to assessing genocidal intent in the Rohingya ruling could influence proceedings concerning Israel's war in Gaza.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611200105.html) reported that a rights group called for a criminal probe into South Africa's arms sales to Myanmar between 2017 and 2021 following the International Court of Justice ruling.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641224/inside-icjs-historic-rohingya-genocide-ruling-against-myanmar) reported that the UN court ruled Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in 2017.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/20/asia-pacific/politics/rohingya-crisis-icj-myanmar/) reported that more than 1.3 million Rohingya remain displaced across South and Southeast Asia, including 1.2 million in refugee camps in Bangladesh.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641226/un-officials-world-leaders-welcome-icjs-rohingya-genocide-ruling-against-myanmar) reported that world leaders and UN officials welcomed the ruling.

reports.text: [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/462319/) reported that the Al-Anbar Provincial Council discussed mechanisms for returning displaced persons to areas including Jurf al-Sakhr and Al-Uweisat.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204117/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%87%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A8%D8%AD-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D9%86%D9%85%D9%88%D8%B0%D8%AC%D8%A7-%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD-%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9/) reported that government forces entering Jurf al-Sakhr reflect institutional shifts in state control over security.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204020/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A5%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A8%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%B9-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AD%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD/) reported that the spokesperson for the Commander-in-Chief of the Iraqi Armed Forces stated that security formations in Jurf al-Sakhor are subject to unified command and control to accelerate weapons containment.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461856/) reported that energy police commenced procedures to secure oil pipeline bundles in the Jurf al-Nasr area. [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203815/%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D8%B6%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B3/) reported that Prime Minister Ali al-Zeidi asked security forces entering Jurf al-Sakhor to exercise self-restraint.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/20/kataib-hezbollah-faces-deadline-to-leave-iraqi-stronghold?traffic_source=rss) reported that Kataib Hezbollah faces a deadline to leave an Iraqi stronghold.

[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461787/), [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203784/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1/) reported that Iraqi authorities opened a controlling headquarters in the Jurf al-Sakhr area north of Babylon province.

reports.text: [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/al-caer-la-noche-calles-vacias-y-temor-en-guasave-tras-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-violencia-cambia-rutina-de-sus-habitantes/) reported that nighttime activities and routines in Guasave have been disrupted following the capture of narcotics trafficker Chapo Isidro.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/chapo-isidro-permanecera-en-mexico-mientras-se-define-su-situacion-juridica-y-la-solicitud-de-extradicion-a-eu-33297994) reported that the FGR stated Fausto Isidro Meza Flores will not be expelled to the United States and his extradition process will be carried out.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/senado-rinde-homenaje-a-militares-caidos-en-operativo-contra-el-chapo-isidro-guardan-un-minuto-de-silencio/) reported that the Senate held a moment of silence and paid tribute to military personnel who died in the operation against Chapo Isidro.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/americas/mexico-defies-us-extradition-bid-for-drug-lord-el-chapo-isidro) reported that a senior Mexican official stated Mexico will prosecute alleged drug lord Fausto Isidro Meza despite a U.S. extradition request.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/mexico-oo-maxkamadeyn-doonta-el-chapo-isidro-inkastoo-mareykanka-uu-codsaday-in-la-soo-dhiibo/) reported that Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro, will be tried in Mexico despite a US extradition request.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/despiden-a-militares-caidos-en-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-veracruz-honra-su-servicio/) reported that Veracruz held a farewell ceremony for two military personnel killed in the operation in Guasave, Sinaloa, to capture Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261124-us-flew-surveillance-drone-over-mexico-to-help-capture-top-drug-lord) reported that Mexican officials stated the United States flew a surveillance drone over Mexican territory to help locate and capture a drug trafficker.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/mexico-took-down-a-top-drug-kingpin-can-it-dismantle-his-cartel-101795490045058.html) reported that U.S.-backed raids are delivering tactical victories against crime groups that remain deeply embedded in Mexican politics, society, and the local economy.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/mexico-to-try-el-chapo-isidro-despite-us-extradition-request?traffic_source=rss), [The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10947449) reported that Mexico will try alleged drug lord Fausto Isidro Meza, known as 'El Chapo Isidro', at home despite a US extradition request.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/mire-la-bala-cruzar-con-un-destello-amarillo-reportero-de-meganoticias-relata-como-vivio-la-violencia-en-guasave-tras-la-detencion-de-chapo-isidro/) reported that Meganoticias reporter Jesús Adrián Ibarra recounted experiencing violence and gunfire spreading in Guasave following the arrest.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/asi-ingresaron-fuerzas-especiales-al-escondite-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-guasave-lo-encontraron-sentado-en-un-sillon-y-sin-resistirse/) reported that the Secretary of Defense presented a video showing special forces entering the hideout of El Chapo Isidro in Guasave, where he was found sitting in a chair without resisting.

[El País](https://elpais.com/mexico/2026-11-23/361-militares-operaron-el-ataque-al-bunker-del-chapo-isidro.html) reported that 361 military personnel operated the three-month planned attack using US drones to capture cartel leader El Chapo Isidro.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5rmgkv2lk73o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that eight suspects were arrested after firing on soldiers attempting to re-establish order following the arrest of El Chapo Isidro.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/fgr-descarta-extradicion-del-chapo-isidro-por-el-momento-sera-juzgado-en-mexico-dice-godoy-33278626) reported that the FGR dismissed the extradition of Chapo Isidro for the moment and stated he will be tried in Mexico.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/mexico-juzgara-chapo-isidro-pese-solicitud-extradicion-estados-unidos_1795477374) reported that Meza Flores was detained on November 20 during a federal operation in the municipality of Guasave in Sinaloa.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/garcia-harfuch-corrupcion-y-omision-de-autoridades-permitieron-operar-al-chapo-isidro-33275613) reported that SSPC head García Harfuch stated that corruption and official omission allowed El Chapo Isidro to operate, and announced reinforced security in Sinaloa.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/capture-of-drug-trafficker-chapo-isidro-leaves-20-dead-in-sinaloa/) reported that Operation Centella involved three months of intelligence sharing with the United States and was carried out by 371 Mexican personnel, leading to the capture of 'Chapo Isidro'.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/us-flew-drone-over-mexican-territory-to-help-capture-drug-lord-in-sinaloa) reported that the United States flew a drone over Mexican territory to help capture Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/mexico/helicopteros-artillados-fuerzas-especiales-y-un-despliegue-de-361-militares-asi-fue-la-operacion-para-capturar-a-el-chapo-isidro-en-mexico-3603443) reported that the intervention ended with 16 alleged members of the criminal organization dead and four military personnel dead.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/cronologia-del-operativo-centella-para-capturar-al-chapo-isidro-sedena-detalla-fase-a-fase-la-caida-del-capo-en-guasave/) reported that General Ricardo Trevilla stated the operation involved 361 elements and 14 aircraft.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/la-caceria-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-guasave-se-preparo-con-eu-senala-nyt/) reported that the New York Times stated the operation to hunt 'El Chapo Isidro' in Guasave was prepared with the US, sharing intelligence and using reconnaissance drones for weeks.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/23/mexico-prende-oito-suspeitos-de-integrar-quadrilha-de-el-chapo-isidro-apos-onda-de-violencia.ghtml) reported that the Mexican Army captured eight suspected members of Fausto Isidro Meza's gang following violence in Sinaloa.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/caen-ocho-presuntos-integrantes-del-grupo-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-sinaloa-militares-son-atacados-a-balazos/) reported that according to the Secretariat of National Defense, eight suspected members of the group of 'El Chapo Isidro' were arrested in Sinaloa after participating in roadblocks on November 20 and military elements were attacked with gunfire.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/suman-17-muertos-tras-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-en-sinaloa-investigan-actuacion-de-fuerzas-federales/) reported that the death toll rose to 17 following the capture of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores in Sinaloa, with ten military elements treated for gunshot wounds.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/video-viral-capta-el-fuego-cruzado-en-el-cielo-nocturno-de-guasave-vecinos-registran-los-disparos-tras-el-operativo-contra-el-chapo-isidro/) reported that viral video captured crossfire in the night sky of Guasave as neighbors recorded gunfire following the operation against Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/dea-expresa-condolencias-a-familiares-de-militares-muertos-en-captura-de-el-chapo-isidro-su-sacrificio-no-sera-olvidado/) reported that the DEA expressed condolences to the families and colleagues of four Mexican army elements killed during the operation in Guasave.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/2026/nov/22/vehicles-burn-on-mexican-highway-after-capture-of-el-chapo-isidro-video) reported that footage showed burnt-out cars and trucks on roads in Sinaloa state following the capture of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261121-mexico-captures-drug-cartel-boss-el-chapo-isidro-after-deadly-firefight) reported that Mexico's military forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores following a deadly firefight.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/mexican-special-forces-arrest-drug-kingpin-chapo-isidro/a-80010745?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the alleged leader of the Beltran Leyva gang and one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives, known as Chapo Isidro, was captured by the Mexican military following an operation.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/tras-captura-del-chapo-isidro-localizan-4-hombres-asesinados-en-guasave-investigan-posible-vinculo-con-operativo/) reported that following the capture of Chapo Isidro, four dead men were located in Guasave and authorities are investigating a possible link to the operation.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/detienen-mexico-chapo-isidro-uno-diez-criminales-mas-buscados-fbi_202611226b02b6c6c0d5c85b96c464ba.html) reported that authorities confirmed eleven deaths and eight arrests in the operation.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/mexico-captures-fbis-most-wanted-cartel-boss-el-chapo-isidro-triggering-violence), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/el-chapo-isidro-captured-fbi-sinaloa-trump-b3089155.html), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/21/le-mexique-arrete-fausto-isidro-meza-alias-chapo-isidro-un-puissant-chef-de-cartel-recherche-par-le-fbi_6814013_3210.html) reported that the arrest of the cartel boss set off violent clashes in Sinaloa.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/rfi/capturan-sinaloa-mexico-chapo-isidro-uno-narcotraficantes-buscados-fbi_1795275150) reported that Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum has increased anti-drug operations and extradited individuals to the United States.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/mexico-captures-fbis-most-wanted-cartel-boss-el-chapo-isidro-triggering-violence), [TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/0fb4e485c575) reported that the arrest of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores followed intelligence cooperation with the US.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/consulado-de-eu-emite-alerta-de-seguridad-tras-caida-del-chapo-isidro-advierte-sobre-interrupcion-de-vuelos-o-viajes-de-autobus/) reported that the US Consulate issued a security alert following the capture of cartel boss El Chapo Isidro, warning about potential disruptions to flights and bus travel.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckz749ey0r75o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Fausto Isidro Chapo Idisro Meza Flores is detained after a gunfight with authorities.

[Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/21/four-soldiers-seven-suspects-killed-chapo-isidro-capture/) reported that four soldiers and seven suspects were killed in the capture operation.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261121-mexico-captures-drug-cartel-boss-el-chapo-isidro-after-deadly-firefight), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/21/video-shows-mexican-forces-capturing-el-chapo-isidro-fbi-most-wanted-cartel-boss) reported that Mexican military forces captured suspected drug lord Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro, during a raid in Sinaloa.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/detencion-de-chapo-isidro-deja-11-muertos-y-8-detenidos-en-sinaloa-33248169), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/mueren-7-agresores-y-4-militares-durante-captura-de-chapo-isidro-en-sinaloa-harfuch-lamenta-deceso-de-soldados/) reported that four military personnel and seven criminals died during the capture operation.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/rfi/capturan-sinaloa-mexico-chapo-isidro-uno-narcotraficantes-buscados-fbi_1795275150) reported that Mexican forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro, in Sinaloa.

reports.text: [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190950/%D8%B3%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%AA%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A5) reported that Democratic US Senators Jeanne Shaheen and Brian Schatz urged President Donald Trump's administration to pressure the Israeli government to facilitate the entry of humanitarian aid and supplies into Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190919/1690-%D8%B4%D9%87%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%AA%D9%83%D8%A8-6405-%D8%AE%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%84%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that the government media office stated that Israeli forces committed 6,405 violations of the Gaza ceasefire agreement over 410 days, resulting in 1,690 deaths.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/204157/%D9%85%D9%84%D9%83-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%BA%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%B9-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A2%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%A5%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B1/), [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190867/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%87%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%BA%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AB%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%B1%D8%BA%D9%85-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B1) reported that Moroccan King Mohammed VI stated that the situation in Gaza does not meet expectations despite the ceasefire agreement.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190923/%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%A5%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that the Qatari Ministry of Foreign Affairs held Israel responsible for implementing its obligations under the Gaza Strip ceasefire agreement and called for pressure on Israel to fulfill its commitments.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190890/%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%AD-%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%B6-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%AB%D9%82-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that an exhibition documenting the genocide in the Gaza Strip was opened at United Nations headquarters in New York.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190892/%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%A7%D8%A8-%D9%84%D9%81%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A5%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%84%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D9%88%D9%87%D9%86%D8%AF%D8%B3%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%87%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2) reported that Islamic Jihad leader Dawood Shehab stated that the Peace Council is a framework for managing the war and engineering its continuation in Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190703/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85%C2%A0-%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AD%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%88%D9%85%D9%86%D8%AD%D9%87-%D8%BA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AE%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-) reported that Palestinian authorities stated the Peace Council policy has displayed complete bias toward the Israeli occupation over a year of the ceasefire agreement.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190634/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AB%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that the Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine held the Israeli occupation government directly and fully responsible for the ongoing humanitarian catastrophe in the Gaza Strip.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203866/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Hamas called on the Peace Council to stop overlooking Israeli violations and hold Israel responsible for obstructing the Gaza ceasefire agreement.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7188394) reported that Jens Laerke, spokesperson for the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, stated that humanitarian convoy trips and distribution in the Gaza Strip face numerous procedures.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190549/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AB%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%84%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%B1) reported that the Gaza Strip Union of Municipalities, the Engineers Syndicate, and the Ministry of Public Works and Housing called for opening crossings, breaking the siege, and allowing humanitarian aid.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190531/%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%8A%D8%B6%D9%84%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%82-%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%81%D8%B1-%D8%BA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B5%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%B9) reported that Hamas accused the Peace Council's report to the UN Security Council of distorting facts and providing cover for continued aggression.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203611/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%87%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B2%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA/) reported that the Peace Council warned of a possible collapse of the Gaza ceasefire agreement unless Israel and Hamas renew commitments.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190407/53-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%B1-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%B3%D9%87%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9) reported that 53 countries, led by Qatar, Jordan, and the United Kingdom, demanded the opening of all Gaza crossings and land routes alongside the facilitation of humanitarian corridors.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190312/4-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%BA%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A8%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that Australia, Canada, Italy, and Britain demanded that the Israeli occupation government immediately end delays in entering humanitarian aid into the Gaza Strip and open crossings.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7182304) reported that the foreign ministers of Australia, Canada, Italy, and Britain called on Israel to immediately and without hindrance allow humanitarian aid into the Gaza Strip.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190268/%D9%87%D8%A2%D8%B1%D8%AA%D8%B3-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%84%D9%85-%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B2%D9%85-%D8%A8%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D9%81%D9%82-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%87%D8%A7-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9) reported that Haaretz revealed Israeli data showing a wide gap between promised and actual aid truck entries into Gaza under ceasefire agreements.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203178/4-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%AF%D8%AE%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that Canada, Britain, Italy, and Australia called on Israel to immediately and without hindrance allow humanitarian aid into Gaza.

reports.text: [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-915585) reported that a former Shin Bet chief warned of Kahanist ideology in government and stated that exclusion threatens democracy.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-19/ty-article-magazine/.premium/how-shin-bet-chief-zini-cast-arab-israelis-as-a-threat-long-before-the-election/000001a1-f54a-dad7-a9fd-f74b1bff0000) reported that since taking office, Shin Bet chief David Zini and his deputy tasked units with pursuing Arab citizens changing the character of the state.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-16/ty-article/.premium/shin-bet-to-question-dozens-in-election-probe-despite-lack-of-evidence/000001a1-e557-d462-abf7-ffff7c000000) reported that sources stated the Shin Bet questioned dozens in an election probe using wiretaps and advanced tools despite a lack of evidence, while Zini accused the attorney general of tying its hands.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-914961) reported that Shin Bet Director David Zini visited Beersheba and met Mayor Ruvik Danilovich to review security threats in the Negev.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-15/ty-article/.premium/shin-bet-chief-sought-to-wiretap-arab-lawmakers-before-the-election/000001a1-e0ee-dfb8-adfd-ecee77f70000) reported that Shin Bet chief David Zini sought to wiretap Arab lawmakers before the election but failed to provide additional evidence sought by the attorney general.

narratives.label: Mexico Fair Rent Law Amendments

reports.text: [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/que-es-la-nueva-ley-de-bienestar-animal-que-se-impulsa-en-cdmx-abarca-tanto-el-bienestar-fisico-como-el-mental/) reported that a new animal welfare law being promoted in Mexico City covers both physical and mental well-being.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/diputada-del-pan-busca-incorporar-a-administradores-de-condominios-al-debate-sobre-ley-de-rentas-en-cdmx-plantea-ajustes-a-la-iniciativa/) reported that PAN deputy Lizzette Salgado received proposals from COPLAC to precise obligations, update rents, and strengthen legal security for owners and tenants in Mexico City.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/ley-de-rentas-justas-dara-certeza-juridica-a-inquilinos-pero-no-resolvera-la-crisis-de-vivienda-asegura-especialista-33222412) reported that specialists stated the fair rent law will provide legal certainty to tenants but will not solve the underlying housing crisis.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/jubilados-de-la-camara-de-diputados-liberan-san-lazaro-tras-dialogo-con-mesa-directiva-reagendan-reunion-para-atender-demandas/) reported that Chamber of Deputies retirees released San Lazaro after dialogue with the Board of Directors and rescheduled a meeting to address their demands.

[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/19/politica/004n2pol?partner=rss) reported that the Chamber of Deputies approved the creation of the General Law on Animal Welfare, Care, and Protection.

[Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/congreso-aprueba-historica-ley-de-bienestar-animal/) reported that Congress approved an animal protection law to regulate animal welfare and homogenize concepts of welfare, mistreatment, and cruelty nationwide.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/ley-de-bienestar-animal-que-sanciones-y-medidas-de-proteccion-implica-esta-iniciativa/) reported that the animal welfare regulation represents an important tool in advancing fauna protection.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/diputados-aprueban-ley-de-proteccion-animal-crea-padron-de-infractores-y-establece-multas-de-hasta-234-mil-pesos/) reported that Mexican lawmakers approved an animal protection law establishing a register of offenders and fines of up to 234,000 pesos with 470 votes in favor and two abstentions.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/debaten-ley-de-rentas-en-cdmx-especialistas-cuestionan-si-construir-mas-viviendas-garantiza-el-acceso/) reported that lawmakers and activists stated that expanding housing supply must be accompanied by rental market regulation and construction cost reductions.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/denuncian-influencers-ser-buscados-por-inmobiliarias-para-desinformar-sobre-ley-de-rentas-justas-33175917) reported that influencers denounced being contacted by real estate agencies to spread disinformation regarding the Fair Rent Law, while ADI rejected being behind the campaign.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/metropoli/proponen-inmobiliarias-ley-de-rentas-justas-solo-para-rentas-menores-a-15-mil-pesos-33183439) reported that ADI and Canadevi proposed that rents below 15,000 pesos cannot rise above inflation.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/ley-de-rentas-justas-iniactiva-privada-propone-diferenciar-aumentos-en-arrendamientos-buscan-proteger-a-las-familias-aseguran/) reported that business organizations suggested rents higher than 15,000 pesos be adjusted with each change of tenant or every three years.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/metropoli/terminan-mesas-de-dialogo-sobre-ley-de-rentas-justas-en-congreso-de-cdmx-objetivo-es-evitar-aumentos-desproporcionados-insiste-diputado/) reported that dialogue tables on the Fair Rent Law concluded in the CDMX Congress.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4186683-drones-attack-chemical-plant-producing-components-for-explosives-in-russias-smolensk-region-media.html) reported that drones attacked the Dorogobuzh chemical plant producing explosive components in Russia's Smolensk region.

reports.text: [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-25/nsw-beau-lamarre-condon-court-verdict-jesse-baird-luke-davies/107344850) reported that former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon's trial hinged on whether the jury believed his version of events regarding the morning Jesse Baird and Luke Davies were shot dead.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/ex-police-officer-beau-lamarre-condon-guilty-of-murdering-jesse-baird-and-luke-davies/JLADZ5W2ZRFWTOMCONLSKZ45BI/) reported that the jury found former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon guilty of murdering Jesse Baird and Luke Davies after just over two hours of deliberation.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/thousands-of-hours-of-cctv-footage-this-is-when-beau-lamarre-condon-knew-police-were-onto-him-20261125-p61gq2.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the former police officer said he was panicking after Jesse Baird and Luke Davies were killed, while security camera footage captured a calm and methodical man.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/25/beau-lamarre-condon-trial-jury-considers-verdict-ntwnfb), [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-25/beau-lamarre-condon-murder-trial-jury-retires-consider-verdict/107423638) reported that the jury retired to consider verdicts in the double-murder trial of former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon over the deaths of Jesse Baird and Luke Davies.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/lamarre-condon-found-guilty-of-murdering-sydney-couple-20261125-p61ezk.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that gasps and sobs broke the silence in the NSW Supreme Court as the verdict was delivered.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/jury-set-to-retire-in-beau-lamarre-condon-murder-trial-20261124-p61gyg.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the jury is set to retire to decide a verdict in the murder trial of former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/beau-lamarre-condon-trial-live-updates-judge-to-deliver-summing-up-to-jury-after-defence-closing-20261124-p61gn1.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Justice Natalie Adams told the jury they are likely to start deliberations on Wednesday in the former police officer's double murder trial.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/24/beau-lamarre-condon-trial-barrister-closing-statement-ntwnfb) reported that former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon's barrister told the court his client chose to enter the witness box rather than remain silent in his murder trial.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/beau-lamarre-condon-s-lawyer-calls-him-fool-but-not-a-murderer-court-hears-20261123-p61glf.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Beau Lamarre-Condon's lawyer told the jury that the ex-cop may have been foolish, but insisted he is not a murderer.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/love-makes-fools-of-us-all-defence-closing-address-in-lamarre-condon-trial-20261123-p61gjg.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that defence barrister John Stratton told the NSW Supreme Court jury that the fate of the accused is in their hands.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/23/beau-lamarre-condon-trail-executed-jesse-baird-prosecution-argues-ntwnfb) reported that the crown urged the jury to reject the accused's claim of self-defence and find him guilty of murdering Jesse Baird and Luke Davies.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/beau-lamarre-condon-trial-live-updates-defence-closing-address-set-to-start-after-crown-address-concludes-20261123-p61gbd.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the defence barrister stated during the closing address that love makes fools of us all in the double murder trial.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/watch-the-bag-uber-eats-cctv-footage-played-in-final-days-of-lamarre-condon-murder-trial-20261120-p61fx4.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Beau Lamarre-Condon stated he was carrying an empty Uber Eats bag minutes before Jesse Baird and Luke Davies died, while the Crown alleged it held a gun.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/prosecution-begins-closing-arguments-in-lamarre-condon-trial-20261119-p61fsj.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the prosecution began closing arguments in the double murder trial of Beau Lamarre-Condon.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/19/beau-lamarre-condon-jesse-baird-luke-davies-ntwnfb), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/beau-lamarre-condon-trial-live-updates-crown-prosecutor-delivers-closing-address-ahead-of-jury-deliberations-20261119-p61fi2.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the crown prosecutor delivered closing addresses in the double murder trial of former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/reconstruction-videos-played-in-lamarre-condon-s-double-murder-trial-20261117-p61f18.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that the Crown played two computer-generated reconstruction videos of Jesse Baird's Paddington home to the jury during the trial.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQcVdWd0JJX0wwOExoZzZ0STVSdnRWR2tPMXoyZHd2cU5wdU42bnNfRGwzRzRtaUloQjd3NWp2bUt3dlNOUzRTUTFaTTBCUkVkanZDa3RWWjFRajJNWkRweFJYUE1LaHVkSlRRRXVoNWRzaTRwN0FRMWttRC1RbkdwdnBQQjdPZVNxYW5MeFVVbU14bkdE?oc=5) reported that William and Kate are in India for their first overseas trip together since her cancer diagnosis.
