reports.text: [The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641652/ajk-cj-for-regulating-use-of-autonomous-weapons) reported that AJK CJ Khan acknowledged the potential of artificial intelligence for constructive purposes.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/22/nations-agree-to-further-talks-on-regulating-ai-killer-robots-and-drones/) reported that nations agreed to further talks on regulating AI killer robots and drones without committing to reaching binding rules.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/science/2026/nov/22/red-cross-warns-too-late-regulate-autonomous-weapons-united-nations) reported that the International Committee of the Red Cross warned that it will soon be too late to regulate the use of autonomous weapons as UN conferences fail to agree on a regulation instrument.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/nations-agree-to-draft-rules-for-killer-robots-at-arms-control-summit?traffic_source=rss) reported that members of the UN's Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons failed to agree on swift adoption of legally binding rules regarding AI-run killer robots.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/no-firm-commitment-rein-ai-killer-robots-un-talks) reported that UN-backed talks on AI-powered killer robots and drones stalled in Geneva with nations agreeing to extend discussions for two years.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046098/countries-open-path-towards-killer-robots-pact) reported that countries agreed to open a path towards finding an international agreement on regulating lethal autonomous weapons systems.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQY3JlX1Q4VXpOM1lnZ2s3aUdnSmxhOExuMl9PUlVwSUpZclY1R3RSb04wdzljcmNaQzJoOENYYmxCQ2tLaXpma2RhQ3hHeWdwYURDN2ZBaGxYT0k5MkEyVDFubm5GX2FfYWVsd2Q0VkQwTWh6X2x0SF9qZS1kWW8za2Nod0I2QV9DQlVsSHpjRnhRN3ZaUWNjb1dpRHYzdw?oc=5) reported that nations at UN talks on AI killer robots agreed to more talks but reached no firm commitment to rein them in.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPZTFDeHY0QlBhU2dnNndMa1FhdmhtUDV2eF9HYmhHU0tzRlFoM0U1a0ZuaE8zbGduLUhoTU0tWWExeDkyOWYwRi1aXzVOd0NhRGszMlU5MWFyVmdLSUJOREtvaXNYY1p3YnRIaDR5X0RwZGVPTG1GeW5wZm1Hd0dlM0RoVDVBQlZ4WFV1bU9mM3YzcDJISEpEZkI5ekdsMy1xb1BkZ0JUYw?oc=5) reported that states agreed to UN talks aiming to regulate killer robots by 2028.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/20/russia-stalls-un-bid-to-regulate-ai-killer-robots-as-talks-near-deadline) reported that Russia stalled a UN bid to regulate AI killer robots as talks neared their deadline.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/un-talks-killer-robots-weapons-russia-b3089057.html) reported that states sought to develop new rules to regulate killer robots by 2028, though the outcome was weakened by opposition from Russia.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/1a9fbcaeeb92), a state outlet, reported that contentious UN talks on regulating killer robots overran their deadline and set-up late night sessions into Saturday.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/21/world/europe/un-lethal-autonomous-weapons.html) reported that major military powers like the United States and Russia expressed strong resistance to binding restrictions on lethal autonomous weapons.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/21/nx-s1-6047916/killer-robots-un-drones) reported that UN talks in Geneva failed to deliver binding rules on autonomous weapons as humanitarian groups warned that military artificial intelligence advances faster than diplomacy.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/killer-robots-talks-at-un-end-with-no-legally-binding-ban/a-80008584?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that UN talks on lethal autonomous weapons ended with an agreement to extend discussions for two years without a legally binding ban.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168810), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582367/un-chief-demands-binding-rules-to-control-lethal-killer-robots/) reported that UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called for a legally binding instrument and strict rules to control lethal autonomous weapons systems.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/16/world/europe/un-killer-robots-autonomous-weapons.html) reported that delegates met in Geneva to discuss guardrails for lethal autonomous weapons systems while Russia and the United States resisted the efforts.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/un-backed-talks-consider-possible-rules-on-lethal-autonomous-weapons/article71707403.ece) reported that UN-backed talks considered possible rules on lethal autonomous weapons amidst scenarios involving armed drones.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/us-and-russia-oppose-talks-limiting-autonomous-weapons) reported that major arms producers the United States and Russia are set to oppose a push at a global meeting in Geneva to launch negotiations on limiting autonomous weapons.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581944/us-and-russia-set-to-oppose-un-talks-on-binding-rules-for-autonomous-weapons/) reported that the United States and Russia will oppose launching United Nations negotiations on binding rules for autonomous weapons.

reports.text: [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010704/kitty-duterte-to-appeal-sc-dismissal-of-petitions-challenging-father-s-arrest-lawyer/story/) reported that the camp of Veronica “Kitty” Duterte will appeal the Supreme Court decision dismissing the habeas corpus petitions challenging her father's arrest.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010638/icc-prosecution-to-present-100-witnesses-protective-measures-may-be-implemented/story/) reported that the International Criminal Court spokesperson stated the prosecution team is expected to present over 100 witnesses during the trial.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/expectations-opening-rodrigo-duterte-international-criminal-court-trial/) reported that more than 500 victims of extrajudicial killings in the drug war are authorized to participate in the trial through their legal representatives.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010631/sara-duterte-the-best-defense-witness-in-impeachment-trial-says-prosecutor-luistro/story/) reported that House Lead Impeachment Prosecutor Gerville Luistro stated that Vice President Sara Duterte is the best witness the defense panel can present.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010604/sc-junks-petitions-challenging-ex-president-duterte-s-arrest/story/), [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/supreme-court-dismisses-petition-rodrigo-duterte-icc-arrest/) reported that the Philippine Supreme Court dismissed habeas corpus petitions challenging the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010558/icc-sets-procedure-for-external-submissions-in-rodrigo-duterte-drug-war-probe/story/) reported that the International Criminal Court Pre-Trial Chamber I is setting a standard procedure to process submissions from external entities in the Rodrigo Duterte drug war probe.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010560/rodrigo-duterte-camp-opposes-sweeping-closed-sessions-for-icc-prosecution-witnesses/story/) reported that former President Rodrigo Duterte's defense team opposed the ICC prosecution's request for sweeping closed sessions for prosecution witnesses.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010495/pnp-considering-to-visit-sara-duterte-over-alleged-threats/story/) reported that the Philippine National Police stated on Monday that it is willing to visit Vice President Sara Duterte to gather details regarding reported threats against her.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010457/pnp-preparing-for-the-worst-ahead-of-sara-duterte-impeachment-trial-verdict-jonvic-remulla/story/) reported that Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla urged the Philippine National Police to remain impartial and prepare for possible scenarios ahead of the verdict.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/rodrigo-duterte-icc-trial-hearing-schedule-key-dates/) reported that the ICC set November 30 as the start of Rodrigo Duterte's trial, with hearings resuming on January 11.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010417/prosecution-ready-should-vp-sara-mans-carpio-testify-in-impeachment-court-joel-chua/story/) reported that House lead prosecutor Joel Chua stated the prosecution is ready should Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband Manases Carpio testify before the impeachment court.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1010362/prosecution-asks-icc-chamber-to-reject-rodrigo-duterte-defense-request-on-evidence/story/) reported that prosecutors asked the International Criminal Court Trial Chamber III to dismiss a request of former president Rodrigo Duterte's defense team regarding evidence.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/agnes-callamard-us-sanctions-vs-icc-jeopardize-rodrigo-duterte-case/) reported that Agnes Callamard stated that US sanctions against the ICC could jeopardize the Rodrigo Duterte case.

reports.text: [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261117-five-eu-member-states-open-talks-with-rwanda-on-deportation-centre) reported that Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and Greece are jointly spearheading a project to open talks with Rwanda on a deportation centre.

[The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/436787/rwanda-migrant-deportation-centre-what-we-know-about-europes-five-nation-plan/) reported that the plan involves an open welcome centre, residence permits, and a path into Rwandan society, though NGOs expressed fears.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/migration-partnership-with-rwanda-sparks-eu-backlash-over-human-rights-record) reported that Rwanda's interior minister rejected criticism regarding the country's human rights record as it prepares to host the first EU return hubs outside the bloc.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/rwanda-asylum-seekers-migrants-eu-uk-b3086442.html) reported that Rwanda's interior minister positioned the East African nation as a welcoming country for refugees and migrants.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-5-european-countries-aim-to-send-rejected-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda), [RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648950-eu-states-seek-deport-asylum-seekers-rwanda/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that five European countries announced plans to establish a return hub in Rwanda starting in 2027 to send rejected asylum seekers.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-news-plans-for-rwanda-migrant-hub-come-under-fire/live-79965639?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/why-are-five-eu-countries-reviving-plans-to-deport-migrants-to-rwanda?traffic_source=rss) reported that human rights groups slammed plans by Germany and four other EU states to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda as a return hub.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170105.html), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eu-countries-present-rwanda-agreement-to-create-migrant-return-center-hub/) reported that Rwanda and five European Union member states announced a partnership to establish a migrant return hub in Rwanda.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/world/politics/european-nations-rwanda-hub-migrants/) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands planned a Rwanda migrant hub despite human rights protests and a UNHCR warning.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-eu-states-open-talks-on-rwanda-deportation-scheme/a-79959158?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Germany joined four other EU states to open talks on establishing a migrant deportation hub in Rwanda following the approval of EU regulations easing deportations.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/rwanda-to-host-hub-for-rejected-eu-migrants) reported that five European countries are negotiating a deal to deport rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda to host a hub.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/rwanda-to-create-return-center-for-asylum-seekers/), a state-media outlet, reported that Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker announced the plan aims to avoid human trafficking networks and reduce deaths on migration routes.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxOZFh2TV8xR3JSejFkM0c0RjBIVmVsWXhkZUtTWHlsLTY4WEI0Q0hVZDJFQURQaWdpM3JtRFdocXFpcW85RTJGeVgzaGhyODNTTUxIcHc5YUl4SWVQU0dwb0d3XzRzZFB0QjBrY2VGQWFSUVRWLTZNeUZZd1dSdnNJTG1zRzI2VXN3TGFTM092MEhRMjRkblBmeXZJSVhacS1aQXg5cG5tOEw2T2MxTjNkdjVOSUtLR1dELUtSdlYwWQ?oc=5) reported that Austria stated five EU countries are starting talks with Rwanda on a deportation hub.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90286) reported that Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen defended the plan.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/cinq-pays-de-l-union-europeenne-devoilent-leur-projet-de-centre-pour-migrants-au-rwanda-20261116) reported that the project aims to facilitate the return of individuals whose asylum applications were rejected or who lack the right to stay in the European Union.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2026/1116/1599373-eu-migrant-hub-deal/), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/5-eu-nations-present-plan-for-1st-migrant-return-hub-in-rwanda) reported that five EU nations presented a plan alongside Rwandan officials to establish the first migrant deportation center in Rwanda.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/five-eu-countries-unveil-rwanda-deportation-plan-in-migration-crackdown), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/5-countries-announce-plan-to-deport-failed-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands aim to begin deporting rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda in 2027.
[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/world/1741658-5-eu-countries-plan-open-migrant-deportation-centre-rwanda-2027/) reported that rights groups raised concerns over detention and DR Congo.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/five-eu-countries-to-announce-first-ever-return-hub-for-migrants-in-rwanda), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261116-eu-nations-to-unveil-rwanda-deal-for-migrant-return-hub) reported that Denmark, Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, and Greece are set to announce a deal to establish a migrant deportation center in Rwanda.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/rwanda-asylum-seeker-deportation-eu-scheme-b3085455.html) reported that two lawmakers were shown facilities earmarked for Britain's abandoned Rwanda scheme.

reports.text: [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064376/) reported that 33-year-old Kateryna Bovtunenko and her 11-year-old daughter Kira were killed in Dymer when a Russian drone struck a multi-storey residential building.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/24/8064333/) reported that a 79-year-old woman rescued from under the rubble of a residential building in Dymer died in the hospital, bringing the death toll to 12.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90969) reported that search and rescue operations at a destroyed residential building in Dymer concluded with 11 dead following a Russian drone strike.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/90456346) reported that a Russian drone strike on an apartment building in Dymer killed at least 11 people.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/23/8064241/) reported that rescue workers found a cat completely buried under the rubble of a building destroyed in Dymer.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187821-russian-strike-on-dymer-claims-11-lives-emergency-rescue-operations-completed.html) reported that emergency rescue operations in Dymer have been completed.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/23/ukraine-dramatic-night-rescue-pulls-woman-from-rubble-after-22-hours) reported that an elderly woman was rescued alive after spending 22 hours trapped beneath concrete slabs in Dymer.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187563-death-toll-from-russian-strike-on-apartment-building-in-kyiv-regions-dymer-rises-to-11.html), [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-23-russian-attack-on-ukraines-dymer-in-kyiv-region-kills-11-official-says/) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack on an apartment building in the town of Dymer in the Kyiv region has risen to 11.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187609-two-people-still-missing-after-russian-strike-on-dymer-zelensky-says.html) reported that two people are still missing after the strike on Dymer.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-kyiv-dymer-russian-strike-b3089574.html) reported that a seven-year-old boy was pulled alive from rubble 14 hours after a Russian strike killed 11 in a residential building, and that Ukraine's interior minister reported over 70 strikes across 10 regions over the weekend.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/russian-attack-on-ukraine-dymer-in-kyiv-region-kills-11-amid-escalating-tensions-101795416493879.html) reported that a Russian attack on Dymer in the Kyiv region killed 11.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/23/russian-air-strikes-kill-at-least-15-people-across-kyiv-region-ukraine-says), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1123/1600244-russian-strike-ukraine/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90880) reported that Russian air strikes killed at least 15 people across the Kyiv region.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/apartment-building-destroyed-in-kyiv-oblast-following-russian-drone-attack/) reported that a five-story residential building was damaged in the Vyshhorod district of Kyiv Oblast following a Russian drone attack, leaving at least 2 injured.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1123/1600244-russian-attack/) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack rose to 14 in Ukraine as rescuers search for residents trapped under the rubble of a block of flats.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187483-russia-tries-to-cut-off-odesa-and-dnipropetrovsk-regions-from-energy-sources-zelensky.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russian forces are attempting to disconnect the Odesa and Dnipropetrovsk regions from their energy sources.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187471-death-toll-from-russian-strike-on-supermarket-in-vyshneve-rises-to-three.html) reported that the death toll from the Russian attack on a store in Vyshneve rose to three, with fifteen people injured.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187474-death-toll-from-russian-attack-in-dymer-rises-to-four-zelensky.html) reported that the death toll from the Russian attack in Dymer rose to four as rescue operations continue.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187456-death-toll-from-russian-attack-on-supermarket-in-vyshneve-rises-to-two.html) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack on a store in Vyshneve in the Bucha district rose to two.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187437-body-of-third-victim-recovered-from-rubble-of-building-in-dymer-kyiv-region.html) reported that the death toll from a Russian attack on Dymer in the Kyiv region rose to three after the body of a third victim was recovered from the rubble.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-dymer-russian-strike-apartment-building/33903592.html) reported that rescuers searched for victims after Russian drone strikes destroyed a residential building in the town of Dymer, leaving at least two dead.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064074/) reported that Tymur Tkachenko stated one person was killed and three were injured after a Russian strike damaged a store in Vyshneve.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187442-russian-forces-pound-dnipropetrovsk-region-with-over-40-attacks-one-killed-several-injured.html) reported that a woman was killed and several other people were injured in Russian attacks on the Dnipropetrovsk region.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064090/) reported that following a strike on a store in Vyshneve, Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported three dead and 13 injured while Mayor Illia Dikov noted 15 injured.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064075/) reported that Tymur Tkachenko confirmed a third body was recovered from a partially destroyed five-storey apartment building in Dymer following a Russian drone strike.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-ukraine-apartment-survivors-attack-war/33903536.html) reported that rescuers pulled a second body from the rubble of a Kyiv-region apartment building battered by Russian drones.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187424-woman-injured-in-russian-drone-attack-on-bila-tserkva-district-in-kyiv-region.html) reported that a woman was injured in an attack by Russian drones in the Bila Tserkva district of the Kyiv region.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/22/at-least-4-killed-in-russian-drone-attacks-on-kyiv-region-officials-say-a94345) reported that at least four people were killed in Russian drone attacks on Ukraine's Kyiv region.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187354-body-of-person-killed-in-russian-drone-attack-recovered-from-rubble-of-apartment-building-in-dymer.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064040/) reported that the body of a person killed in a Russian drone attack was recovered from the rubble of an apartment building in Dymer, Kyiv region.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064047/) reported that a 10-storey apartment building in the Peremoha residential area of Dnipro was damaged in a Russian drone attack.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064040/) reported that four people have been injured in the attack on Dymer.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187322-russians-attack-energy-infrastructure-in-zhytomyr-region-four-times-in-one-day.html) reported that Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure facilities in the Zhytomyr region four times over the past 24 hours.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064022/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated 14 people may be trapped under the rubble of a five-storey building in Dymer, Kyiv Oblast, hit by a Russian drone.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attacks-across-ukraine-injure-30-over-past-day-as-rescue-operation-continues-near-kyiv-after-drone-strike/) reported that Ukraine's Air Force said Russian troops launched 186 attack drones overnight, of which 161 were shot down.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/apartment-building-destroyed-in-kyiv-oblast-following-russian-drone-attack/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187278-residential-building-damaged-in-russian-drone-attack-in-vyshhorod-district-residents-evacuated.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90829), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064011/) reported that a Russian drone attack destroyed part of a five-story residential building in the Vyshhorod district of Kyiv Oblast.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/22/8064009/) reported that Russian forces struck 22 settlements in Sumy Oblast, injuring nine people in drone attacks.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203400/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%AB-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%83%D9%8A/) reported that European Union defense ministers discussed U.S. troop withdrawal and repositioning plans in Europe with a U.S. Department of War official.

[Al-Watan (Syria)](https://alwatan.sy/%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%aa%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%88%d8%a8%d9%8a-%d8%a7%d8%b3%d8%aa%d9%82%d8%b1%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d8%b3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d9%85%d9%87%d9%85-%d9%84%d8%a3/) reported that European Union Mediterranean commissioner Dubravka Šuica emphasized the importance of Syria's stability for regional security.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7189722) reported that South Korean Education Minister Choi Kyu-jin offered to resign following a widespread controversy over artificial intelligence cheating during university entrance examinations.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203838/%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%B3%D9%86%D8%AA-%D8%A3%D8%B2%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%84%D9%85-%D8%AA-%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AD-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%8A/) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated the Nvidia issue was not raised in talks between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping.

[Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%b1%d9%82%d8%a7%d8%a6%d9%82-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b0%d9%83%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%b5%d8%b7%d9%86%d8%a7%d8%b9%d9%8a-%d8%aa%d8%b1%d9%81%d8%b9-%d8%b5%d8%a7%d8%af%d8%b1%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d9%83%d9%88) reported that South Korea's annual exports surpassed one trillion US dollars on Thursday due to the AI chip boom.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203405/%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%82%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AE%D9%84-%D8%A5%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D8%A3%D9%86-%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D9%8A%D9%86/) reported that divisions within the Trump administration regarding policies on China and AI chips reveal a conflict between national security considerations and Nvidia's interests.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063472/) reported that French officials outlined post-war security guarantees and reviewed an 11-nation military deployment ahead of the Berlin summit.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220767), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will meet with Ukrainian and European delegates in Berlin on November 19 to discuss multilateral talks.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063498/) reported that Donald Trump's special envoys are scheduled to discuss post-war security guarantees, economic rebuilding, and multilateral negotiations with Ukrainian and European officials in Berlin.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/11/18/von-der-leyen-confident-all-eu-members-will-back-45bn-loan-for-ukraine/) reported that Slovakia, Czechia, Hungary, and Bulgaria stated they do not intend to take part in the bloc's latest round of funding for Kyiv.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/18/europe-ukraine-russia-eu-germany-serbia-latest-news-updates) reported that EU leaders will vote on the measure in two weeks and that the commission president stated Ukraine has a €70 billion funding gap for next year.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/18/8063426/) reported that the €45 billion loan is split between €25 billion for military aid and €20 billion in reform-linked funds.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185725-axios-witkoff-kushner-to-meet-ukrainian-eu-officials-to-discuss-peace-plan.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff plan to meet with Ukrainian and European officials to discuss a peace plan.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-announces-berlin-talks-with-us-european-allies-to-shape-next-phase-of-russia-negotiations/) reported that a Ukrainian official stated the meeting in Berlin could take place on November 19.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063195/), [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219295) reported that US Special Presidential Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner plan to meet with Ukrainian and European officials in Berlin on November 19 to discuss security guarantees and economic recovery plans.

reports.text: [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/24/aje-onl-nf_russian-jets-spark-air-raid-alert-in-south-korea-241126?traffic_source=rss) reported that South Korean residents were urged to seek shelter as Russian military jets approached airspace.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-war-latest-evacuation-air-raid-russian-military-aircraft-approach-south-korean-island-trigger-alert/) reported that Russian military aircraft approached a South Korean island and triggered an air raid alert.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/south-korea-tells-island-residents-to-take-shelter-as-russian-warplanes-near-its-airspace) reported that South Korea issued a rare shelter warning for an inhabited island as Russian warplanes neared its airspace.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/24/south-korea-says-russian-military-planes-entered-its-air-defense-zone-a94358) reported that Russian aircraft left the defense zone after South Korean forces took military measures, including deploying fighter jets.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/south-korea-says-russian-jets-entered-air-defence-zone/WV7XJTSF6VGBVLY3JQOVCRGCNM/) reported that the Russian aircraft entered South Korea's defence zone but did not breach its airspace.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2223801), a Russian state outlet, reported that South Korea lodged a protest with the Russian military attache over aircraft overflights.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/why-s-korea-issued-air-raid-alert-after-russian-jets-flew-near-its-airspace?traffic_source=rss) reported that South Korean authorities issued air raid warnings after several Russian jets approached its airspace.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/evacuation-air-raid-russian-aircraft-approach-south-korean-island-trigger-air-raid-alert-2/) reported that the alert was the first time South Korea's military issued a preliminary air raid alert over a possible airspace intrusion by Russian warplanes.

[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124002252315) reported that several Russian warplanes briefly flew into South Korea's air defense identification zone, prompting a brief alert on an eastern island.

[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10946997), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124002251315) reported that several Russian military aircraft entered South Korea's air defense identification zone over the East Sea and approached Ulleungdo Island.

reports.text: [The Africa Report](https://www.theafricareport.com/437231/deutsche-bank-leaks-how-ecobank-got-caught-in-the-crossfire/) reported that fifteen million internal files revealed lax checks on African clients at Deutsche Bank.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/periodismo-de-investigacion/documentos-filtrados-revelan-como-deutsche-bank-dio-la-espalda-a-sus-promesas-climaticas/) reported that leaked documents revealed Deutsche Bank turned its back on climate promises regarding emissions reduction.

[Der Spiegel International](https://www.spiegel.de/international/business/epstein-and-deutsche-bank-the-filings-identfied-payments-made-to-women-a-e8f529f6-c583-4c99-a432-d0684c6697d7#ref=rss) reported that documents from Deutsche Bank show the financial institution processed many more payments for Jeffrey Epstein than previously known.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88667080) reported that Deutsche Bank is at the center of a scandal following an investigation based on millions of internal documents leaked to the press involving Russian oligarchs, Epstein, and Trump.

[Der Spiegel International](https://www.spiegel.de/international/business/the-bank-and-the-oligarchs-how-deutsche-bank-continued-expanding-in-russia-despite-the-warning-signs-a-668c08a5-0383-4d66-86b5-671b3c348774#ref=rss) reported that Deutsche Bank decided to continue expanding operations in Russia despite Putin's aggression following the Donbas, Crimea, and European attacks.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://c-level.folha.uol.com.br/financas/2026/11/deutsche-bank-autorizou-transacoes-potencialmente-ilicitas-na-colombia-mostram-documentos.shtml) reported that documents show Deutsche Bank authorized thousands of potentially illicit transactions in Colombia.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/deutsche-bank-chair-backs-ceo-after-reports-expose-past-lapses-trump-calls-tax-leak-illegal/article71715150.ece) reported that the Deutsche Bank chair backed the CEO after leaked records exposed past financial lapses, and the German Finance Minister called for an investigation.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/los-papeles-del-deutsche-bank-exponen-operaciones-que-vinculan-a-trump-con-rusia-y-us5819-millones-nid18112026/) reported that the leaked Deutsche Bank papers exposed operations linking Donald Trump to Russia and millions related to Jeffrey Epstein.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/el-banco-aleman-deutsche-bank-es-senalado-de-procesar-transacciones-sospechosas-por-casi-600-millones-de-dolares-vinculadas-a-epstein-y-donald-trump-3601659) reported that Deutsche Bank faces accusations of allowing corruption and ignoring internal controls after being signaled for processing nearly $600 million in suspicious transactions linked to Jeffrey Epstein.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/deutsche-bank-acusada-de-permitir-corrupcion-vinculada-a-epstein-trump-y-oligarcas-rusos-33175792) reported that an international investigation led by CLIP and Barracuda Media documented Deutsche Bank links with high-risk clients and suspicious transactions based on a leak of 15 million files.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://c-level.folha.uol.com.br/financas/2026/11/deutsche-bank-falhou-em-controle-e-prevencao-a-lavagem-de-dinheiro-mostram-documentos-vazados.shtml), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-falhou-na-prevencao-a-lavagem-de-dinheiro-apesar-de-alertas-internos-revela-investigacao.ghtml) reported that an investigation based on more than 15 million leaked documents revealed that Deutsche Bank maintained serious flaws in its anti-money laundering controls and compliance.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20261117-deutsche-bank-shares-drop-after-reports-on-mass-data-leak) reported that Deutsche Bank shares plunged after international media published reports based on millions of leaked emails and documents.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-shares-fall-as-leak-reveals-trump-tax-document-error) reported that Deutsche Bank shares fell more than 6% after reports based on 15 million leaked records shed light on dealings with clients including Donald Trump and revealed a tax document error.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/17/deutsche-bank-dimissed-warnings-risky-clients-reports-claim) reported that an international investigation using leaked internal data claimed the German bank overlooked compliance concerns regarding risky clients to safeguard profits.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-deutsche-bank-shares-drop-after-reports-exposing-epstein-payments-russia-dealings) reported that Deutsche Bank shares fell more than 6% following media reports detailing dealings with Jeffrey Epstein and Russian oligarchs.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532266/Deutsche-Bank-processed-582-million-for-Epstein-despite-explicit), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648963-whistleblowers-expose-deutsche-bank-dealings-epstein/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that leaked internal documents indicate Deutsche Bank processed nearly $600 million in suspicious payments linked to Jeffrey Epstein.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-deutsche-bank-leaks-german-lender-s-dealings-with-russian-oligarchs-under-scrutiny) reported that Germany's finance minister urged full transparency from Deutsche Bank following the leaked records.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/europe/deutsche-bank-russia-oligarchs-leaked-documents.html) reported that leaked records showed Deutsche Bank courting wealthy Russian clients while bracing for sanctions.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/17/deutsche-bank-moved-wealthy-russian-clients-to-switzerland-and-luxembourg-before-the-full-scale-war-helping-shield-their-financial-records-from-the-doj) reported that Deutsche Bank moved wealthy Russian clients to Switzerland and Luxembourg after 2014 to protect banking secrecy and avoid disclosing information to the Department of Justice.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/deutsche-bank-under-fire-after-internal-documents-made-public/a-79974543?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/les-decodeurs/article/2026/11/17/inside-deutsche-bank-les-documents-secrets-qui-lient-donald-trump-a-l-argent-sale-azerbaidjanais_6812989_4355770.html) reported that an international journalistic investigation published internal records detailing Deutsche Bank's dealings with Jeffrey Epstein, Donald Trump, and Azerbaijani and Russian figures.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044722/inside-deutsche-bank-leak-of-15-million-files-exposes-secrets-scandals-and-double-standards-of-global-financial-giant), [Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/les-decodeurs/article/2026/11/17/inside-deutsche-bank-les-secrets-inavouables-du-geant-bancaire-reveles-par-15-millions-de-documents-confidentiels_6812911_4355770.html) reported that an international journalistic investigation leaked over 15 million internal files from Deutsche Bank detailing scandals, suspicious transactions, sanctioned Russian oligarchs, and Jeffrey Epstein links.

reports.text: [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611240340.html) reported that pastor Jimmy Odukoya faces jail risks over alleged disobedience of a court order and was directed by the court to appear on November 26.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/court-orders-jimmy-odukoya-to-appear-thursday-over-church-dispute/) reported that the Lagos State High Court directed Senior Pastor Jimmy Odukoya to appear before it on Thursday, November 26, over a church dispute.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-trustees-file-contempt-proceedings-against-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that the Incorporated Trustees of The Fountain of Life Church instituted contempt proceedings against Pastor Jimmy Odukoya over alleged disobedience of a Lagos court order.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742936-breaking-court-summons-jimmy-odukoya-fountain-life-church-saga-reason/) reported that the Lagos State High Court issued a fresh major order to Pastor Jimmy Odukoya amid the deepened church crisis.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-okonkwo-preaches-unity-jimmy-insists-court-order-not-served/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Bishop Mike Okonkwo urged members not to take sides while Jimmy Odukoya stated he has not been served the interim court order.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/leadership-crisis-odukoya-says-fountain-of-life-church-remains-strong-unshakable/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Jimmy Odukoya stated the Fountain of Life Church remains strong and unshakable as the leadership crisis moves to the Lagos High Court.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/leadership-crisis-fountain-of-life-members-express-hope-for-resolution/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Fountain of Life Church members voiced hope for a resolution of the leadership crisis as Pastor Jimmy Odukoya received a rousing welcome at Sunday service.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ive-not-been-served-jimmy-odukoya-speaks-on-court-injunction-amid-church-crisis/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-i-have-not-been-served-court-injunction-legally-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya stated he has not been formally served with a court injunction restraining him from acting as senior pastor.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/dont-take-sides-bishop-okonkwo-warns-fountain-of-life-members/) reported that Bishop Mike Okonkwo made a surprise appearance at The Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/cheers-jubilation-as-jimmy-odukoya-arrives-church-amid-leadership-crisis/) reported that members of the church in Ilupeju, Lagos, gave Pastor Jimmy Odukoya a rousing welcome as he arrived for the Sunday service.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/dont-take-sides-bishop-okonkwo-tells-fountain-of-life-church-members/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Bishop Mike Okonkwo urged church members not to take sides in the leadership crisis.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/photos-heavy-police-presence-at-fountain-of-life-church-amid-leadership-crisis/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported a heavy police presence at the Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos, amid the leadership dispute.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-deepens-as-jimmy-sues-sister-others/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Fountain of Life senior pastor Jimmy Odukoya took his sister Tolu and seven trustees to a Federal High Court in Lagos.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/jimmy-odukoya-sues-sister-fountain-of-life-trustees-over-church-dispute/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-church-odukoya-drags-sister-others-to-court-over-removal-as-senior-pastor/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya instituted a court action against his sister and Fountain of Life Church trustees over his removal as senior pastor.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/nigeria/1742636-breaking-jimmy-odukoya-drags-sister-pastors-court-1-demand/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya dragged his sister and pastors to court making one demand.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/jimmy-odukoya-sues-sister-pastors-asks-court-to-declare-removal-illegal/) reported that Jimmy Odukoya approached the Federal High Court in Lagos to challenge his removal from office and ask the court to declare his removal illegal.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/fountain-of-life-church-denies-being-sealed-announces-sunday-service/), [Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fountain-of-life-denies-closure-amid-leadership-crisis/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-debunks-closure-rumours-asks-worshippers-to-attend-sunday-service/) reported that The Fountain of Life Church dismissed reports that its premises had been sealed and invited members to attend Sunday service.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-church-dismisses-closure-claims-announces-sunday-service/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that The Fountain of Life Church stated it is not sealed and invited worshippers to a Sunday service.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/fountain-of-life-church-sealed-by-police-as-leadership-crisis-deepens/) reported that police officers sealed The Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos, as the leadership crisis deepened.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/20/fountain-of-life-succession-crisis-court-restrains-jimmy-odukoya-as-leadership-dispute-deepens/) reported that the Lagos State High Court restrained Jimmy Odukoya from parading himself as the Senior Pastor and Spiritual Head of the Fountain of Life Church.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/court-restrains-jimmy-odukoya-from-parading-as-fountain-of-life-pastor/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/court-restrains-jimmy-odukoya-from-acting-as-fountain-of-life-pastor/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/court-restrains-jimmy-odukoya-from-parading-self-as-fountain-of-life-senior-pastor/) reported that a Lagos State High Court restrained Jimmy Odukoya from parading himself as the senior pastor and spiritual head of the Fountain of Life Church.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fountain-of-life-church-postpones-thanksgiving-service/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the Fountain of Life Church postponed its 2026 Thanksgiving service amid a leadership dispute without providing a new date.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/how-my-sister-asked-me-to-step-aside-for-her-to-become-board-chairman-jimmy-odukoya/), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/fountain-of-life-crisis-jimmy-accuses-sisters-of-leaking-fathers-succession-video/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya alleged his sister Tolu Odukoya-Ijogun asked him to step aside as board chairman.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/my-late-father-appeared-to-me-urged-me-to-stand-firm-jimmy-odukoya/) reported that Pastor Jimmy Odukoya stated his late father appeared to him in a dream and urged him to stand firm.

reports.text: [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/at-least-490000-russian-soldiers-killed-in-ukraine-rosstat-data-leak-reveals) reported that two hacking groups extracted death certificate data from the Russian statistics agency's systems on 1 November.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/24/russian-fighters-killed-in-mali-africa-leaked-data), a British state-media outlet, reported that leaked records list 349 deaths in three years in Mali.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/24/a-leak-from-russia-s-federal-statistics-agency-made-it-possible-to-estimate-the-country-s-military-death-toll-in-the-war-against-ukraine-what-else-did-it-reveal) reported that journalists from Meduza and Mediazona reached a figure of at least 700,000 Russian service members who have died in the war.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/24/world/hacked-ukraine-russian-death-toll/), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3375557/hacked-russian-data-suggests-nearly-500000-soldiers-dead-reports-say) reported that data allegedly stolen by hackers from Russia's statistics agency Rosstat shows the recorded Russian military death toll approaching 500,000.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/russia-ukraine-war-soldiers-killed-on-battlefield-military-suicide-rates-putin-zelenskyy-latest-news-101795515459237.html) reported that a report indicated Russia lost more than 460,000 people from February 2022 to September 2026, with over 1,000 soldiers dying by suicide.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915962) reported that leaked data showed more than 1,000 Russian soldiers died by suicide since the Ukraine invasion, with experts believing the actual number is higher.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90999) reported that a study of hacked Rosstat records found at least 490,000 Russian military deaths in Ukraine by September 2026.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-ukraine-war-casualty-estimate-killed/33904373.html) reported that a new analysis found that more than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed during the war on Ukraine.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/world/europe/russia-ukraine-war-deaths.html) reported that hacked government data underscored the casualties in the war of attrition.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/leaked-data-shows-more-than-1000-russian-military-suicides-during-ukraine-war) reported that leaked data showed more than 1,000 Russian military suicides during the Ukraine war.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-war-death-toll-likely-near-700-000-media-reports-after-studying-leaked-government-data/) reported that the Mediazona investigative team reached a figure of nearly 700,000 Russian war deaths after studying leaked government data.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/23/at-least-720-000-russian-soldiers-killed-in-ukraine-by-fall-2026-meduza-and-mediazona-estimate-in-new-analysis-that-includes-missing-troops-for-the-first-time) reported that Meduza and Mediazona estimated at least 720,000 Russian armed forces personnel died in the war in Ukraine by fall 2026.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/18/russia-s-state-duma-approves-law-restricting-library-access-to-books-by-foreign-agents) reported that Russia's State Duma passed a law restricting access to books by foreign agents in libraries in its second and third readings.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/eu-foreign-policy-chief-kaja-kallas-says-russian-soldiers-data-would-be-quite-easy-to-obtain-for-an-entry-ban-russia-s-state-duma-speaker-threatens-her-with-20-years-in-prison), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648945-kallas-wants-steal-russia-data/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas proposed using intelligence services to obtain personal data of Russian soldiers for an entry ban, prompting a 20-year prison threat from Russia's State Duma speaker.

reports.text: [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915383) reported that the NSA network disruption affected its cryptologic center in Georgia.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648975-nsa-apple-services-outage/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that the NSA experienced a temporary degradation of internal systems during routine maintenance.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/pala-tajna-mreza-nsa-net-preko-koje-americki-obavjestajci-razmjenjuju-povjerljive-informacije/261117240), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1088763/pala-tajna-mreza-nsa-net-americki-obavjestajci-ostali-bez-sistema-za-razmjenu-povjerljivih-informacija) reported that the internal communication network used by the United States National Security Agency (NSA Net) suffered an outage.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNMktLaW5kdHVTN3VMZTk4bGp1WWZZZGVJLXFWa2QxOExBN25NdXNYd0F6RW1wZER4QTFDZHlZaWNpbURDdVk1UFBoT3N2ME5UcnIybFRyb0dsemJJbzNHQlJnd0lTSEs3LVJibVRCQjk1c2xNNFpHSTlia0VhRUNCbktOaWtOQlNhNzBvZURB?oc=5) reported that a defense official stated the classified communications network at the National Security Agency went down.
[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/17/nsa-national-security-classified-communications-network-down) reported that the NSA issued a code yellow after NSANet failed.

[Defense One](https://www.defenseone.com/threats/2026/11/classified-nsa-communications-network-down-people-familiar-say/417278/) reported that sources stated there are no immediate signs that the outage on NSANet is related to a cyberattack.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/cae-la-red-interna-de-comunicaciones-de-la-agencia-de-seguridad-de-eu-segun-cnn-33176495), [El País](https://elpais.com/us/2026-11-17/nueva-caida-en-las-infraestructuras-de-ee-uu-ahora-la-red-de-comunicacion-interna-de-los-servicios-secretos.html) reported that CNN sources stated the internal communication network of the U.S. National Security Agency suffered an outage.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/cae-la-red-interna-de-comunicaciones-de-la-agencia-de-seguridad-de-eu-segun-cnn-33176495) reported that sources indicated no evidence of a cyberattack against the NSA Net network so far.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/us/politics/nsa-down-network-outage-nsanet.html) reported that a classified National Security Agency network went down, causing work disruptions, with no current signs that the outage is the result of a cyberattack.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/se-reporta-caida-de-la-red-de-comunicaciones-de-seguridad-de-estados-unidos-en-la-manana-de-este-martes-17-de-noviembre-esto-se-sabe-3601665), [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/agencia-de-seguridad-nacional-de-ee-uu-sufre-caida-en-su-red-interna) reported that the US National Security Agency experienced an outage on its highly classified internal communications network.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915216) reported that the network, NSA Net, enables employees to securely share classified information within the organization.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/88294566) reported that the General Police Inspection identified a drone that crashed in a forest strip near the village of Baxani in Soroca district as a Gerbera-2 model.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90394) reported that a Russian drone was spotted over the Moldovan capital of Chisinau.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063339/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185796-seven-drones-enter-moldovan-airspace.html) reported that seven drones entered Moldovan airspace on November 17, with some crashing near settlements.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87515748) reported that three flights from Yerevan, Istanbul, and Sharm El-Sheikh were unable to land in Chisinau due to the airspace closure.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063332/) reported that Moldova closed six border crossing points with Ukraine in Ocnița, Otaci, Unguri, Briceni, Grimăncăuți, and Clocușna.

reports.text: [ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-22/fbi-database-hacked-according-to-media-outlets/107413682) reported that the FBI and U.S. Agriculture Department were targeted in apparent cyberattacks.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/probe-underway-as-hackers-breach-fbis-crime-database/) reported that hackers breached the U.S. Department of Agriculture system used to process payments alongside the FBI database.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxOX3JOVy03eEI4NG1USFRxZkwtd0FLc0tfWk1zMWJSX0xDeHR1Rmwwd0hoQ2RXMG15ejRzWEJJZFh5WU5la2tvWE9kNjJQOG9rVEh4MUlUQl9Cam5KR1FKNnl4UWhLRmVBMGVfT3Q1dXlsZ2lfUHlXLUV3a0ZjaE16ZzJTMFBSbW9RRHc?oc=5) reported that the FBI is investigating an apparent hack of a key criminal justice information database according to an AP source.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-says-suspected-fbi-database-hack-is-not-good-revives-russia-hoax-claims-maybe-we-ll-learn-things-101795277817214.html) reported that Donald Trump called the suspected cyberattack on the FBI’s National Crime Information Center troubling.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/21/usda-fbi-outages-cyber-attack) reported that hackers breached the US Department of Agriculture farmer payment system and the FBI National Crime Information Center.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fbi-probes-suspected-hack-of-us-crime-database/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the FBI is investigating a suspected cyberattack on its National Crime Information Centre database used by US police.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261121-us-agriculture-department-fbi-hit-by-cyberattacks-media-report) reported that hackers breached systems at the US Agriculture Department and the FBI.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/ef34d53c5e48) reported that the cyber intrusions reportedly target a farmer payment system and a nationwide law enforcement database.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1010305/fbi-s-criminal-information-database-hacked-report/story/) reported that the FBI is investigating a suspected breach of a nationwide database used by federal, state and local law enforcement agencies to share criminal justice information.
[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/fbi-breach-criminal-information-database/) reported that the National Crime Information Center holds sensitive law enforcement records nationwide.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/fbi-database-hacked-for-second-time-in-months-breach-targets-us-crime-records-101795228753873.html) reported that the FBI database was hacked for the second time in months, following a September targeting of an FBI recruitment website by ShinyHunters.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/fbis-criminal-information-database-hacked-reports-say/article71727198.ece) reported that the apparent compromise involved the National Crime Information Center database.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fbi-investiga-nuevo-ciberataque-contra-base-de-datos-nacional-segun-cnn-en-septiembre-indago-otro-caso/) reported that the FBI is investigating a new cyberattack against a national database according to CNN.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7324490-fbi-e-departamento-de-agricultura-dos-eua-sao-alvos-de-ataques-hackers.html) reported that the FBI and the US Department of Agriculture were targets of hacker attacks that also affected a payment system.

narratives.label: Chefe da PF explica saída de delegados do caso Master

reports.text: [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/25/ministros-do-stf-pressionam-por-nova-distribuicao-de-pedido-de-vorcaro-sobre-relatoria-do-master-entregue-a-nunes-marques.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court ministers are pressing for a new distribution of a request presented by former banker Daniel Vorcaro's defense team.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/master-relatorio-sobre-moraes-rejeitado-pela-pf-detalhava-mensagens-de-vorcaro-e-contrato.ghtml) reported that a Federal Police report detailed messages involving Daniel Vorcaro and a contract regarding Supreme Federal Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/23/pgr-analisa-relatorios-de-ministros-em-meio-a-tensao-entre-alas-do-stf-e-pressao-sobre-procuradores.ghtml) reported that the Prosecutor General's Office is set to begin analyzing Federal Police reports regarding citations of Supreme Federal Court ministers.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/lauro-jardim/post/2026/11/delegados-afastados-querem-falar-da-polemica-dos-relatorios-sobre-ministros-do-stf.ghtml) reported that removed Federal Police delegates Daniel Cola and Wedson Cajé intend to speak about the controversy surrounding reports on Supreme Federal Court ministers.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/diretor-da-pf-pos-mendonca-entre-ministros-com-indicios-de-crime-mesmo-sem-achar-contato-dele-com-vorcaro.ghtml) reported that Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues ordered reports produced on all ten Supreme Federal Court ministers and divided them into two groups.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7324407-relatorio-da-pf-tem-dialogos-de-vorcaro-sobre-mendonca.html) reported that a Federal Police report contained dialogues involving Vorcaro regarding Mendonça and were forwarded to the Prosecutor General's Office.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/inclusao-de-mendonca-em-relatorio-sobre-master-integra-estrategia-da-pf-de-questionar-volta-de-ministro-a-relatoria-avaliam-investigadores.ghtml) reported that allies of Minister André Mendonça in the Supreme Federal Court view his inclusion in the Federal Police report regarding the Master case as an attempt to wear him down.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/post/2026/11/caso-master-galipolo-relata-a-pf-suspeitas-de-vazamentos-no-bc-e-ata-fora-do-padrao-feita-por-servidor.ghtml) reported that Central Bank President Gabriel Galípolo related suspicions of leaks at the BC and an unusual meeting minutes document prepared by a civil servant to the Federal Police.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/malu-gaspar/post/2026/11/relatorios-sobre-ministros-do-stf-rejeitados-por-andrei-nao-foram-enviados-a-fachin.ghtml) reported that Federal Police reports regarding ministers Alexandre de Moraes, Kassio Nunes Marques, and Dias Toffoli, which were rejected by Director-General Andrei Rodrigues, were not sent to Fachin.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/caso-master-fachin-abre-sigilo-de-relatorio-da-pf-sobre-mencoes-a-mendonca-a-pedido-do-ministro.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court President Edson Fachin made public a Federal Police report regarding mentions of Minister André Mendonça in the Master case at the minister's request.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/fachin-deu-nova-orientacao-a-pf-para-avaliar-relevancia-de-citacoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master-diz-documento.ghtml) reported that STF President Edson Fachin gave new guidance to the Federal Police to evaluate the relevance of information regarding Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/relatorio-da-pf-sobre-mendonca-reune-mensagens-de-terceiros-sobre-terno-jantar-e-reuniao-com-vorcaro-e-nao-aponta-beneficio-a-ministro.ghtml) reported that a Federal Police report on Minister André Mendonça gathered third-party messages about clothing, a dinner, and a meeting with Vorcaro, without pointing to any benefit for the minister.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/caso-master-fachin-determina-que-concierge-de-vorcaro-apresenta-despesas-de-banqueiro.ghtml) reported that Supreme Federal Court President Edson Fachin accepted a request from the Federal Police and ordered a concierge company contracted by former banker D. Vorcaro to present the banker's expenses.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/19/investigacao-novas-diligencias-ou-arquivamento-o-que-a-pgr-pode-fazer-com-os-relatorios-da-pf-sobre-ministros-do-stf.ghtml) reported that the Prosecutor-General's Office will have to individually analyze reports produced by the Federal Police concerning the Master case.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/andrei-stf-fachin-relatorios-da-pf-sobre-mencoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master.ghtml) reported that Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues delivered investigation reports mentioning Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case to STF President Edson Fachin, who then forwarded them to the PGR.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/pf-investiga-vazamento-de-informacoes-sobre-relatorio-com-mencoes-a-ministros-do-stf-no-caso-master.ghtml) reported that Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues stated in a Senate hearing that an investigation is underway into information leaks concerning a report mentioning Supreme Federal Court ministers in the Master case.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7323452-chefe-da-pf-explica-saida-de-delegados-do-caso-master.html) reported that Federal Police chief Andrei Rodrigues met with Justice Minister Wellington César Lima e Silva regarding the departure of delegates from the Master case.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/18/oposicao-vai-pedir-esclarecimentos-de-ministro-sobre-delegados-da-pf-afastados-no-caso-master-em-audiencia-no-senado.ghtml) reported that the opposition will ask the minister for clarifications in a Senate hearing following the removal of Federal Police delegates.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/18/pete-hegseth-venezuela-nicolas-maduro-military) reported that U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth used his visit to Venezuela to assert U.S. dominance and mention Maduro's capture by the U.S. military.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/venezuela-y-estados-unidos-reanudan-la-cooperacion-militar-33194700), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/ee-uu-retoma-la-cooperacion-militar-con-venezuela-para-llevar-a-cabo-reformas-profundas_0_zaXgjUOMzT.html) reported that Venezuelan interim leader Delcy Rodríguez received US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to resume military cooperation and address common threats.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/el-secretario-de-guerra-de-estados-unidos-se-reune-con-delcy-rodriguez-en-caracas_0_BPhgudHrUA.html) reported that US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with provisional president Delcy Rodríguez in Caracas.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/venezuela/ultima-hora-venezuela-y-estados-unidos-suscriben-acuerdo-de-cooperacion-militar-tras-visita-de-pete-hegseth-al-palacio-de-miraflores-3602058) reported that the military cooperation agreement was signed by Pete Hegseth and Venezuelan Defense Minister Gustavo González López.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/pete-hegseth-visita-colombia-avion-c-130-fuerza-publica-NB43718498) reported that U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth is arriving in Colombia to discuss military and security cooperation.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/que-viene-a-hacer-el-secretario-de-guerra-de-estados-unidos-a-colombia-FA43707471) reported that United States Secretary of War Pete Hegseth will arrive in Colombia on Wednesday.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/secretario-de-guerra-de-estados-unidos-llega-hoy-colombia) reported that one of the main points on the agenda during the US official's visit is the delivery of a C-130 Hercules aircraft.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/ed071383c518) reported that Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar stated Turkey and Pakistan entered a new phase of energy cooperation with seismic exploration planned across five onshore and offshore areas after the Oruc Reis vessel arrived in Pakistan.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxOVTNmbnd3NTRHTlp4amxaWmhlYXlSMm9CRHpvMktVWFRNQjN0NHBHbVA5RGxVZVFIRkhaZDBPenFmX3owSGZONnhXT3ZycFdQaEdsaU1MSE5XWHhVVmlhTWg3QkhEZ251Rm9zSjFoUzZUNVFrVE9rQ29CUDFvMlAyR0JsdU5HcC1BeHU3OW9KaDRONXZscjVtWW1uclNsSWFzWGZRazI4NXZqZHVCS1EtZUdiTW9jNlJNOHdLemFsSWQzUQ?oc=5) reported that the Turkish energy minister reached Karachi as offshore oil exploration is set to begin.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2641003/pakistan-turkiye-explore-expanded-defence-cooperation-in-advanced-military-technologies), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1583428/pakistan-and-turkiye-expand-defence-cooperation/) reported that Pakistan and Turkey agreed to expand defense cooperation in advanced military technologies, unmanned systems, electronic warfare, aerospace development, and joint training.

reports.text: [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/gazans-return-battered-camp-after-israel-says-it-concluded-tank-raid) reported that Palestinians started returning to their Gaza camp after Israel's military concluded a tank raid.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/israel-ends-largest-gaza-ground-incursion-since-october-2025-truce), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/israel-army-says-it-completed-ground-operation-in-central-gaza/article71721554.ece) reported that the Israeli military concluded a tank raid in central Gaza, which was its first major ground incursion since the October 2025 cease-fire.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/gazans-return-after-israel-army-ends-rare-ground-operation) reported that Palestinians returned to check belongings and assess damage in central Gaza.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-915501) reported that the IDF targeted illegal Palestinian construction and land seizures in Area C during a West Bank operation.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-army-blows-up-palestinian-homes-in-central-gaza-strip-3725762) reported that Israeli forces demolished homes and facilities north of the Nuseirat refugee camp and east of the Maghazi refugee camp.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/israel-army-says-completed-central-gaza-ground-operation/) reported that Israel's military stated a ground operation involving tanks in central Gaza that began the previous day had come to an end.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israels-central-gaza-offensive-coordinated-with-us-army-radio-says-3725756) reported that Israeli Army Radio stated the military offensive in the central Gaza Strip was coordinated with the US and could last several days.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/world/middleeast/israel-gaza-war-ground-operation.html) reported that the Israeli military stated it conducted a limited raid across the Gaza cease-line into territory controlled by Hamas to address a threat.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/israeli-troops-launch-ground-operation-in-central-gaza-13613724) reported that dozens of displaced Palestinians fled their tents and shelters in central Gaza following the ground operation.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/18/what-does-israels-new-ground-offensive-mean-for-palestinians-in-gaza?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israeli tanks advanced beyond the Yellow Line, causing Palestinians to flee in Gaza.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-un-warns-over-18000-palestinians-at-risk-of-displacement-amid-israeli-offensive-in-gaza/) reported that the UN warned that the military offensive in central Gaza could displace over 18,000 Palestinians and disrupt humanitarian services.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261118-gazans-flee-shelters-as-israeli-army-launches-ground-operation-beyond-yellow-line) reported that Palestinians fled their shelters in central Gaza after Israel launched a ground operation beyond the Yellow Line.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/israeli-occupation-army-crosses-the-yellow-line-again/) reported that the Israeli occupation army launched a military operation in the central Gaza Strip aiming to neutralize alleged Hamas infrastructure.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2220803) reported that the IDF stated the operation is targeting Hamas facilities and a terror tunnel west of the Yellow Line.
[Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461650/) reported that the Israeli army announced a military operation in central Gaza in the first such move since the ceasefire agreement.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190493/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AD%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%B1-6-%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%83%D8%B2-%D8%A5%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%B9) reported that the Ministry of Social Development in the Gaza Strip warned of severe risks threatening thousands of displaced people in the central governorate due to ongoing Israeli military operations.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/hamas-condemns-israeli-army-offensive-in-central-gaza-as-flagrant-violation-3725746) reported that Hamas condemned the Israeli army's announced offensive in central Gaza as a flagrant violation.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261118-israeli-army-launches-military-offensive-in-central-gaza-despite-ceasefire/) reported that the Israeli army announced it launched a military offensive in three blocks of the central Gaza Strip and closed sections of the Salah al-Din road.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261118-israel-begins-new-military-operation-in-gaza), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/israeli-military-begins-new-thrust-gaza-witnesses-say) reported that Israeli tanks advanced in an area of the central Gaza Strip and military forces are targeting Hamas infrastructure.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86326151/Palestinian-groups-say-Israeli-military-operation-in-central), a state-media outlet, reported that Palestinian Islamic Jihad and the Mujahideen Movement condemned the operation as a ceasefire violation.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/israel-army-launches-ground-operation-hamas-controlled-area-gaza) reported that an AFP journalist saw Israeli tanks positioned in a Hamas-controlled area of central Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190471/%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B4-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D8%A8%D8%AF%D8%A3-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%B9), [Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/203564/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B0-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%A8%D8%AF%D8%A3-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B7-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9/) reported that the Israeli military began a military operation targeting residential squares in central Gaza near the yellow line.

[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/940463ac5ac5), a Turkish state-media outlet, reported that Putin said Russian retaliation over Ukrainian refinery strikes is inevitable.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/donald-trump-vladimir-putin-y-xi-jinping-en-una-historica-cumbre-trilateral-desarme-nuclear-y-las-relaciones-comerciales-entre-los-temas-clave-3602258) reported that nuclear disarmament and commercial relations were among the key topics at the trilateral summit between Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping.

reports.text: [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/gustavo-petro-veronica-estrada-pacto-historico-JC44023486) reported that former president Gustavo Petro defended Verónica Estrada and criticized the Procuraduría for suspending her.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/suspenden-por-tres-meses-congresista-estrada-por-presuntos-titulos-falsos) reported that congresswoman Estrada was suspended for three months due to allegations of presenting a false engineering diploma and professional card.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-suspension-curul-pacto-historico-titulos-academicos-CI43966567) reported that a false diploma case involving representative Verónica Estrada has triggered a wave of reviews in Congress.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/veronica-estrada-falta-reunion-del-pacto-historico-en-bogota) reported that Verónica Estrada missed an internal meeting of the Pacto Histórico in Bogotá.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-fue-suspendida-sin-sueldo-caso-titulos-falsos-MB44013906) reported that the Chamber of Representatives suspended Verónica Estrada for three months without pay following an order by the Procurator's Office.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/procuraduria-suspende-congresista-veronica-estrada-por-diploma-falso) reported that the Attorney General's Office ordered the provisional suspension for three months of congresswoman Verónica Estrada over a false diploma.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/pacto-historico-andrea-vargas-admite-que-no-se-ha-graduado-de-abogada), [El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/congresista-pacto-lios-titulos-andrea-vargas-reconoce-graduo-presentaba-abogada-BG43891770) reported that Pacto Histórico congresswoman Andrea Vargas admitted she has not graduated as a lawyer, stating she is an ungraduated alumnus of the University of the Atlantic.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-presento-diploma-bachiller-congreso-colegio-es-falso-HG43890502) reported that Representative Luz Verónica Estrada presented another high school diploma to Congress, but the school stated it is false.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-antes-del-escandalo-por-sus-titulos-falsos-PI43874920) reported that Pacto Histórico requested Representative Luz Verónica Estrada to resign from her congressional seat amidst a scandal regarding false academic titles.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-fiscalia-cito-dos-veces-por-investigacion-titulo-falso-y-no-asistio-NM43836597) reported that the Prosecutor's Office summoned Pacto Histórico Representative Verónica Estrada twice in an investigation over a false academic degree, but she did not attend.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/pacto-historico-pidio-renuncia-de-veronica-estrada-su-curul) reported that Pacto Histórico asked Verónica Estrada to resign from her congressional seat following allegations of falsified academic documents.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/luis-eduardo-llinas-pidio-oferta-veronica-estrada-contrato-dian-78-millones-KO43811319) reported that Luis Eduardo Llinás asked Luz Verónica Estrada to present an offer to sign a contract with DIAN in 2025.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/universidad-nacional-detecto-inconsistencias-titulo-veronica-estrada-fiscalia-PO43813639) reported that the National University received a request to verify Luz Verónica Estrada's university degree in October 2025.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/caso-luz-veronica-estrada-delitos-podria-enfrentar-falsificar-titulos-academicos-abogado-penalista-responde-DO43812100) reported that the case of Pacto Histórico Representative Luz Verónica Estrada reached judicial authorities following questions over her academic titles.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/consejo-ingenieria-denuncia-veronica-estrada-diploma-falso-KI43788174) reported that the National Council of Professional Engineering decided in February 2026 not to grant professional registration to Verónica Estrada and reported her to the Prosecutor's Office.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/politica/congresista-luz-estrada-habria-falsificado-diploma-de-la-u-nacional) reported that Representative Luz Estrada allegedly falsified a diploma from the National University.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/veronica-estrada-acta-grado-diploma-bachiller-antioquia-CJ43791074) El Colombiano reported that new documents raised questions regarding the high school diploma of Representative Luz Verónica Estrada.
