[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/thousands-take-to-streets-in-portugal-france-and-spain-over-rising-living-costs) reported that thousands of people demonstrated in Portugal and France calling for higher wages and affordable housing.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/thousands-protest-overs-prices-education-military-spending-in-france-and-europe), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/thousands-protest-across-europe-over-living-costs-and-housing?traffic_source=rss), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-students-and-unions-unite-for-sixth-weekend-of-protests-across-france) reported that thousands of demonstrators took to the streets across France and Europe for protests over the cost of living, housing, and government policies.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/protestas-en-europa-la-militarizacion-y-el-costo-de-la-vida-vuelven-a-sacar-a-las-personas-a-las-calles-este-fin-de-semana-3602870) reported that Spain, Italy, and Austria experienced a new wave of demonstrations over militarization and the cost of living.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/young-demonstrators-take-to-streets-across-europe-in-widespread-protests/) reported that young Europeans poured into the streets from Milan to Berlin and London to protest high living costs, military spending, and climate issues.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261120-protesters-join-forces-across-europe-against-high-living-costs), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-gen-z-protests-spread-across-europe-mass-rallies-over-cost-of-living-in-spain), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/c6dx12ppeqn4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that protesters across Europe took to the streets in coordinated demonstrations against the rising cost of living.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-italy-strike-draws-workers-students-into-nationwide-protests-over-wages-and-living-costs), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/20/italy-workers-and-students-stage-nationwide-strike-over-living-costs) reported that a nationwide strike in Italy disrupted schools, hospitals, and local transport.

reports.text: [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/24/fisioterapia-respiratoria-exercicios-motores-e-visitas-de-carlos-e-michelle-a-rotina-de-bolsonaro-na-uti.ghtml) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro follows a routine of respiratory and motor physiotherapy, medical evaluations, and family visits in the ICU.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/expresidente-de-brasil-jair-bolsonaro-es-diagnosticado-con-neumonia-y-seguira-en-cuidados-intensivos-esto-es-lo-que-se-sabe-sobre-su-estado-de-salud-3603546) reported that Bolsonaro was diagnosed with bilateral bronchoaspiration pneumonia and will remain in intensive care after experiencing chills, pain, and vomiting.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/lauro-jardim/post/2026/11/bolsonaro-melhora-mas-segue-sem-previsao-de-deixar-uti.ghtml) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro showed improvement in his condition after being hospitalized in the ICU with acute abdominal obstruction.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/bolsonaro-continua-hospitalizado-prevision-alta-paso-noche-dolores_1795372418) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro remains hospitalized without a discharge date but spent the night without pain.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-permanece-estable-en-cuidados-intensivos-fue-internado-por-obstruccion-intestinal/) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro remains stable in intensive care after being hospitalized for an intestinal obstruction while serving a sentence under house arrest.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/22/bolsonaro-segue-na-uti-e-sem-previsao-de-alta-diz-boletim-medico.ghtml) reported that former president Jair Bolsonaro remains in the DF Star hospital ICU in Brasília without a discharge date according to a medical bulletin.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/michelle-visita-bolsonaro-no-hospital-apos-voltar-de-viagem-ao-exterior.ghtml) reported that former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro arrived at the DF Star hospital in Brasília to visit former president Jair Bolsonaro, who was hospitalized in the ICU.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7324608-moraes-autoriza-filhos-visitarem-bolsonaro-em-internacao.html) reported that Moraes authorized Carlos, Jair Renan, Laura, and the stepdaughter of former president Jair Bolsonaro to visit him in the hospital without mobile devices or other electronic equipment.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/expresidente-de-brasil-jair-bolsonaro-es-enviado-a-cuidados-intensivos-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-que-se-sabe-3603041) reported that treating doctors initiated clinical hydration, oral fasting with nutritional support, and placed a gastric tube for Jair Bolsonaro.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/21/lex-presidente-del-brasile-jair-bolsonaro-ricoverato-in-terapia-intensiva_839ca9c3-f07e-4473-a141-0031f216f432.html) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to the intensive care unit and is clinically stable, conscious, alert, and breathing spontaneously.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/jair-bolsonaro-esta-internado-en-terapia-intensiva-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-y-podria-ser-nid21112026/) reported that a tomography scan detected an almost total small bowel obstruction and doctors are evaluating a possible new surgery.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/bolsonaro-esta-internado-na-uti-com-abdomen-obstruido-em-estado-estavel-e-sem-previsao-de-alta-diz-hospital.ghtml) reported that DF Star hospital stated former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro is in the intensive care unit with an obstructed abdomen in stable condition without a discharge date.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/moraes-autoriza-visita-de-filhos-de-bolsonaro-em-hospital-durante-internacao.ghtml) reported that Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized daily hospital visits for Jair Bolsonaro's children but prohibited the use of mobile phones and other electronic devices during the visits.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-en-cuidados-intensivos-por-una-obstruccion-intestinal-33247549) reported that Jair Bolsonaro is in intensive care due to an intestinal obstruction.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-internado-cuidados-intensivos-obstruccion-intestinal-dice-primer-parte-medico_0_IMGmDv1K84.html) reported that the former Brazilian president entered the hospital on Friday and there is no prediction for medical discharge.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/21/defesa-de-bolsonaro-pede-autorizacao-para-entrada-de-filhos-de-ex-presidente-no-hospital-durante-internacao.ghtml) reported that the defense of former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro communicated with Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes about Bolsonaro's hospitalization.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/21/jair-bolsonaro-hospitalised-with-abdominal-pain-while-under-house-arrest) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was taken to hospital with abdominal pain while accompanied by military police.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/21/former-brazilian-president-jair-bolsonaro-hospitalised-in-brasilia-with-abdominal-pain?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to a hospital in Brasília with abdominal pain and distension.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/brazil-ex-president-jair-bolsonaro-taken-to-hospital-over-abdominal-pain/a-80007648?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was taken to a hospital in Brasilia with intestinal obstruction.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/world/brazil-ex-president-bolsonaro-taken-to-hospital-with-abdominal-pain-son-says-3013246) reported that Jair Bolsonaro's son stated the condition was related to past injuries from a 2018 stabbing.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/brazils-jailed-ex-president-jair-bolsonaro-taken-to-hospital-son-alleges-psychological-torture/articleshow/136039037.cms) reported that Carlos Bolsonaro expressed concern for his father's well-being regarding his declining health condition.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/11/20/bolsonaro-e-internado-em-hospital-apos-episodio-de-dor-abdominal.ghtml) reported that former president Jair Bolsonaro was taken to the DF Star hospital in Brasília after experiencing severe abdominal pain.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2026/11/7324429-bolsonaro-e-internado-com-quadro-de-dor-e-distensao-abdominal.html) reported that Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to a hospital in Brasília with abdominal pain and distension while serving house arrest.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-expresidente-de-brasil-es-hospitalizado-por-fuertes-dolores-abdominales-33236011), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-expresidente-de-brasil-es-hospitalizado-de-nuevo-tiene-dolores-en-el-abdomen-dice-su-hijo-carlos/), [El País](https://elpais.com/america/2026-11-20/hospitalizado-el-expresidente-jair-bolsonaro-con-dolores-abdominales-en-brasilia.html) reported that former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro was hospitalized in Brasilia due to severe abdominal pains.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/bresil-jair-bolsonaro-quitte-sa-residence-surveillee-pour-l-hopital-en-raison-de-douleurs-abdominales-20261121) reported that Bolsonaro left his monitored residence for the hospital, having previously suffered injuries from a 2018 knife attack.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/jair-bolsonaro-hospitalizado-fuertes-dolores-abdominales-causados-obstruccion_1795222172), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/jair-bolsonaro-fue-internado-en-un-hospital-de-brasilia-tras-sufrir-un-fuerte-dolor-abdominal-nid20112026/) reported that Bolsonaro was admitted to the DF Star hospital and remains under house arrest.

reports.text: [Punch](https://punchng.com/french-cops-convicted-in-black-producer-assault/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that three French police officers were jailed for one to two years after a Paris court recognized the racist nature of their assault on producer Michel Zecler.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3375350/french-police-officers-jailed-racist-violence-against-black-man-landmark-ruling) reported that the lawyer for the Black man beaten by three French police officers hailed a historic ruling after the court acknowledged the racist nature of the assault.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-french-court-finds-racism-played-role-in-police-beating-of-black-music-producer) reported that a French court handed down prison sentences to three police officers for the assault of music producer Michel Zecler in Paris in 2020, ruling racism played a role.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/21/french-police-officers-sentenced-to-jail-for-assaulting-black-music-producer/) reported that a court gave all three men five years in prison with varying portions suspended, finding racism an aggravated factor in a landmark ruling.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/france/20261120-paris-police-officers-sentenced-to-prison-over-2020-beating-of-black-man-michel-zecler), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/french-police-officers-found-guilty-of-racist-assault-on-black-music-producer), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2026/1120/1600081-france-police-court/) reported that a French court sentenced three police officers to serve time over the 2020 beating of Black music producer Michel Zecler, recognizing the assault as racist.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/20/world/europe/france-police-brutality-black-producer.html) reported that the officers were filmed beating the music producer inside his Paris studio, setting off a national backlash.

narratives.subject: france

reports.text: [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/nuevo-sismo-magnitud-5-siente-centro-peru-reporten-danos_1795391809) reported that a magnitude 5 earthquake was registered in central Peru without any damages reported.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/peru-registra-sismo-de-51-durante-la-madrugada-es-el-segundo-temblor-en-menos-de-una-semana/) reported that Peru recorded a 5.1 magnitude earthquake during the early hours, following a 6.7 magnitude earthquake that affected Junín.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/por-que-duro-tanto-el-temblor-de-magnitud-6-7-en-peru-que-tambien-se-sintio-en-colombia-instituto-geofisico-explica-que-ocurrio-3603076) reported that the Geophysical Institute of Peru explained that the depth of the 6.7 magnitude earthquake allowed its waves to reach distant areas.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/entregan-primer-balance-de-danos-tras-el-sismo-de-6-7-de-magnitud-en-peru-reportan-15-heridos-cuatro-casas-inhabitables-y-otras-127-afectadas-3603011) reported that an initial damage balance following the 6.7 magnitude earthquake in Peru noted 15 injuries, 4 uninhabitable houses, and 127 affected homes.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/sismo-de-magnitud-67-en-peru-deja-un-saldo-de-15-heridos) reported that the Geophysical Institute of Peru stated two other earthquakes occurred in Junín.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/reportan-al-menos-15-heridos-tras-sismo-de-67-en-peru-hay-decenas-de-viviendas-y-edificios-afectados/) reported that at least 15 injuries were reported following a 6.7 magnitude earthquake in Peru, with dozens of homes and buildings affected.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/menos-mujer-herida-39-viviendas-afectadas-sismo-magnitud-6-7-peru_1795260503) reported that at least one woman was injured and 39 homes were affected by a 6.7 magnitude earthquake in Peru, with some collapses in Lima's Independencia district and the Costa Verde.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/reportan-nuevo-temblor-de-magnitud-5-0-en-peru-este-sabado-21-de-noviembre-horas-despues-del-fuerte-sismo-de-6-9-profundidad-epicentro-y-detalles-3602958) reported that the Colombian Geological Service published a bulletin on a 5.0 magnitude earthquake registered in Peru.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/videos-del-fuerte-temblor-de-6-9-en-peru-la-noche-de-este-20-de-noviembre-que-se-sintio-en-bogota-y-varias-ciudades-de-colombia-asi-se-vivio-el-sismo-3602909) reported that Colombia's Ungrd discarded a tsunami threat after the strong movement.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/sismo-de-6-7-de-magnitud-sacude-a-peru-sin-danos-por-el-momento-33237290), [El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/sismo-de-magnitud-67-con-epicentro-en-junin-sacudio-peru-este-viernes), [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/sismo-6-7-sacude-centro-peru-siente-lima-danos-momento_1795221277) reported that a 6.7 magnitude earthquake struck Peru with an epicenter 30 kilometers northwest of Junin and a depth of 127 kilometers, with no immediate damages reported.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/se-registra-sismo-de-69-en-los-andes-peru-no-se-reportan-danos-o-victimas-al-momento/) reported that a 6.9 magnitude earthquake was registered in the Andes with no immediate casualties.

narratives.title: Peru earthquake

reports.text: [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bayer-clears-major-roundup-hurdle-but-a-new-study-raises-cancer-link-again-101795490858370.html) reported that U.S. government-funded research links a common weedkiller to cancer, raising questions about litigation.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/us-judge-approves-7-25bn-roundup-cancer-settlement/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a Missouri judge approved Bayer's $7.25bn Roundup cancer settlement for users with non-Hodgkin lymphoma, with payouts ranging from $10,000 to $165,000.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/iran-orders-tighter-closure-hormuz/), a state-media outlet, reported that Army Commander Major General Amir Hatami ordered the navy chief to intensify the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/iran-rules-out-talks-with-us-until-its-seven-conditions-are-met/article71739875.ece) reported that three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite U.S. aerial protection.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86330981/No-negotiation-before-Iran-s-seven-conditions-are-met-Ghalibaf), [Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532510/Qalibaf-rules-out-action-or-negotiations-until-Iran-s-seven-conditions) reported that Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that no negotiations will take place until seven conditions set by Iran are met.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/South-Korea-Asks-Qatar-for-Priority-LNG-Once-Hormuz-Reopens.html) reported that South Korea asked Qatar to prioritize liquefied natural gas supply to the Asian nation when traffic through the Strait of Hormuz normalizes.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261122-iran-says-reopening-hormuz-not-difficult-if-us-accepts-tehrans-conditions/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said that reopening the Strait of Hormuz was not difficult if the United States accepted Tehran's conditions.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2222921), a state-media outlet, reported that the foreign minister stated the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz is off the table until Iran's demands are met, and a Qatari delegation held talks in Tehran.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328562/Enemy-spy-drone-downed-off-Iran-s-southern-coast-IRGC), [Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249585/IRGC-says-downed-yet-another-US-reconnaissance-drone), a state-media outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps announced the interception and destruction of an enemy spy and reconnaissance drone off the coast of Bushehr in the northern Persian Gulf.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86328309/Iran-s-seven-conditions-basis-for-reopening-Strait-of-Hormuz), a state-media outlet, reported that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding is no longer on the table and Iran's 'Seven Conditions' proposal forms the basis for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and negotiations.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/irans-irgc-downs-us-drone-over-hormuz-as-efforts-to-end-war-remain-stalled?traffic_source=rss), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1584857/iran-hits-58th-us-drone-sets-seven-hormuz-conditions/) reported that Iran announced seven conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and rejected any transfer of enriched uranium abroad.

reports.text: [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-25-indonesian-rescuers-recover-3-bodies-in-search-for-26-trapped-miners-agency-says/) reported that Indonesian rescue teams recovered three bodies in their search for 26 workers believed to be trapped in a flooded mine.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-25/miners-trapped-underground-in-west-java-indonesia/107426126), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/indonesian-rescuers-searching-for-possibly-dozens-trapped-in-mine/article71741002.ece), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-search-dozens-trapped-mine-workers-6580561) reported that Indonesian rescuers are searching for miners stuck in a 100-metre-deep mine after heavy rain inundated access.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/death-toll-from-indonesia-factory-fire-rises-to-26/SY2QIK3CAZEI7NGZ3Y4RIBK5E4/) reported that rescuers retrieved two more bodies from the factory on Tuesday.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxNeWdTQ2hjc1YtUzVWamFRbmNuR1hWdTZHNGxDTkNuTFludi0tb1pyVk03bnZ5Z0NWS0VjR3JMZzRPeDgtNWZpTU83Y2ZxQ2ZPbE1KMHEtMnc5ajlkNHI2SW1na3N1cU9UNTYyd01QdHNONjdDRHU3N1NSLXQ0cENXcUEwSHlOTExuOEdXVUJjaUdaU1hzZ3dBZkxBNA?oc=5) reported that most victims of the Indonesia factory fire died trying to reach an emergency exit, according to rescuers.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/world/asia/indonesia-factory-fire-deaths-missing.html) reported that the death toll from the Indonesia factory fire rose to 26 with dozens unaccounted for, and police opened a criminal investigation.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/world/asia/indonesia-factory-fire.html) reported that dozens are unaccounted for after a fire ripped through a candy factory in Indonesia following a blaze that broke out on Saturday and raged for hours.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/444771/indonesia-probes-factory-fire-that-left-34-people-missing) reported that the Ministry of Manpower has deployed an Occupational Health and Safety team to investigate the factory fire.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/444739/sar-team-recovers-26-body-bags-from-bantenfactory-fire), a state-media outlet, reported that a joint search and rescue team recovered 26 body bags from a candy factory fire in Serang, Banten.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/deadly-fire-at-confectionery-factory-in-indonesia-kills-24-as-rescuers-search-for-dozens-still-missing-13615577) reported that a deadly fire at a confectionery factory in Indonesia killed 24 people with about 30 others still missing.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/23/indonesia-rescuers-recover-24-body-bags-from-burnt-out-factory/) reported that rescue workers recovered 24 body bags from a fire that gutted a confectionery factory near Jakarta.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxNeWxmUHVQSmZGb3dYUl9UZzNOXzlEcW1hcUFTNlZzY0xNS3ZySEE5bzhTYW94eFJJTmN1RnVqLWZXeFJtUUVqUmpkaTNoS19vWlcwWHZza3hqanhPX2pGTjc2czRONGswbEJWT1Fjalh2eTNYTWJ0RjlWUnFld3JKbnUtaUpIZ1Q3RWdVQUtvSXdPajQ1cG1IejZZSQ?oc=5) reported that Indonesian rescuers are racing to find 34 missing workers after a deadly candy factory fire.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1585581/indonesia-factory-fire-kills-24-as-rescuers-search-for-dozens-missing/), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/indonesia-banten-factory-fire-death-toll-people-missing/article71733448.ece) reported that Indonesian authorities confirmed 24 people died in a weekend factory fire near Jakarta while rescuers search for dozens missing.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/indonesian-police-remove-24-body-bags-from-factory-fire-site?traffic_source=rss) reported that Indonesian police removed 24 body bags from a factory fire site while authorities searched for missing workers.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/05756b835278) reported that an Indonesia factory fire killed 24 people as rescue teams search for 30 missing individuals.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-22/news-1ShqqiAfYhG/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that an Indonesian candy factory fire in Banten province was not fully extinguished, with seven bodies recovered and about 50 missing.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-factory-fire-search-resume-body-bags-victims-6573141) reported that the search for missing persons from the candy factory fire in Cikande is set to resume as police removed 24 body bags.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE1MNDVsTUdzaTZzWThwUk5hQTR6NkVTUXlLemYyMTYzcnZRemxrMFkxczFMUGpCWDlMZjJzS0c3a1pOMFd3TERURG9SZWlwTU16dWNoamo1dndrVHVOU05NNDBPRmRDZ2l5ZHFDdU1VWlhpcGN0YXNfMA?oc=5) reported that a fire at an Indonesian candy factory left three dead and dozens of workers missing.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/indonesia-candy-factory-fire-kills-three-36-missing/) reported that authorities stated at least three workers were killed and 36 others remained unaccounted for following a fire at a candy factory in Banten province.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2046306/search-for-indonesia-factory-fire-missing-to-resume-monday-police-remove-24-body-bags), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/24-body-bags-recovered-from-indonesia-factory-fire-as-dozens-missing-3725859) reported that Indonesian police removed 24 body bags from a destroyed factory in Java or Banten province.
[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/24-body-bags-recovered-from-indonesia-factory-fire-as-dozens-missing-3725859) reported that the factory stated 29 workers remain missing.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/indonesia-factory-hit-by-deadly-blaze-three-killed-and-36-missing) reported that at least three people were killed and dozens missing following a fire at a candy and snack factory in Indonesia.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/milorad-dodik-cestitao-sinu-igor-je-moj-ponos-moja-pobjeda-i-dijete-snsd-a-tako-je-naucen/261122133) reported that SNSD leader Milorad Dodik congratulated his son Igor Dodik after he was proposed as premier-designate for the new government of Republika Srpska.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Igor-Dodik-Zelim-saradnju-sa-svima-i-trazim-odgovornost-za-propuste/993652), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/igor-dodik-ja-sam-svjestan-da-moramo-mijenjati-sebe-narocito-mi-je-vazno-uspostaviti-saradnju-s-vladom-u-srbiji/261122071) reported that Igor Dodik accepted his nomination as premier-designate for the government of Republika Srpska and stated a need to cooperate with Serbia.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Cvijanoviceva-o-mandataru-Igor-Dodik-ce-unijeti-novu-energiju-i-ideje/993656) reported that Serb Member and Chairwoman of the BiH Presidency Željka Cvijanović stated Igor Dodik will bring new energy and ideas.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/bih/Igor-Dodik-mandatar-za-sastav-nove-Vlade-Srpske/993650), [Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/bih/igor-dodik-zvanicno-predlozen-za-mandatara-nove-vlade-republike-srpske/261122059) reported that Republika Srpska President Savo Minic proposed Igor Dodik as the mandate holder to form the new government of Srpska.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/gisele-pelicot-denuncia-a-editorial-que-envio-fotos-suyas-desnuda-a-los-medios-para-promocionar-un-libro-me-encuentro-humillada-3603712), [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/gisele-pelicot-diz-que-editora-usou-fotos-intimas-sem-consentimento-para-promover-livro.shtml) reported that 73-year-old Gisèle Pelicot announced legal action against the Tinbad publishing house and the author of an essay after stating she felt deeply shocked and humiliated by the unauthorized use of her intimate nude photographs to promote a book.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261124-gis%C3%A8le-pelicot-to-file-legal-complaint-against-publisher-over-nude-photo-use) reported that Gisèle Pelicot announced she will file a legal complaint against a publisher for using her nude photographs without consent to promote a psychoanalyst's essay.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/23/gisele-pelicot-denuncia-una-casa-editrice-ha-diffuso-mie-foto-intime_81aaf534-1963-41b5-bbdf-1f1a1efac54d.html) reported that Gisele Pelicot accused a publishing house of distributing her intimate photos in a book that implies she was an accomplice.

[El País](https://elpais.com/sociedad/2026-11-24/gisele-pelicot-denuncia-el-uso-de-imagenes-intimas-sin-su-autorizacion-para-promocionar-un-libro-me-siento-profundamente-conmocionada.html) reported that Gisele Pelicot stated she feels profoundly shocked by the unauthorized use of her intimate images to promote an essay.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/gisele-pelicot-shocked-nude-photos-promote-book-b3090415.html) reported that French publisher Tinbad sent intimate images of Gisèle Pelicot to the media to promote an essay by philosopher Sabine Prokhoris.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/french-publisher-accused-of-sending-journalists-intimate-images-of-gisele-pelicot) reported that publishing house Tinbad is accused of using intimate images of Gisèle Pelicot to promote a book three years after the start of her legal fight.

[VG](https://www.vg.no/nyheter/i/vkQJ4j/gisele-pelicot-reagerer-paa-nakenbilder-dypt-sjokkert?utm_medium=rss), [Dagens Nyheter](https://www.dn.se/sverige/gisele-pelicot-chockad-over-nakenbilder-i-bokreklam/) reported that Gisèle Pelicot announced legal action against an author and publisher after nude images of her taken by her convicted ex-husband were used in book marketing.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/gisele-pelicot-shocked-publisher-uses-nude-images-book-campaign.1137564) reported that French author and sexual violence survivor Gisèle Pelicot was shocked after a publisher used nude images in a book campaign.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/gisele-pelicot-to-sue-publisher-over-distribution-of-intimate-images/MPUAVYEJGFEB5NGJPL7BYZULQU/) reported that Gisèle Pelicot's lawyer stated intimate images were sent without consent as commercial publicity.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm3eg502nxw2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the publisher of an essay on coercive control apologized for an inappropriate communication after nude photos of Gisèle Pelicot were sent to the media.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/gisele-pelicot-deeply-shocked-after-nude-photos-used-to-promote-book-13615849) reported that Gisèle Pelicot stated she is deeply shocked and humiliated after nude images of her were sent to the media without consent.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/france/20261123-deeply-shocked-gis%C3%A8le-pelicot-sue-publisher-nude-photos-used-book-campaign) reported that Gisèle Pelicot is to sue a publisher after nude photos were used in a book campaign.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/gisele-pelicot-deeply-shocked-nude-images-book-france) reported that Gisèle Pelicot stated she will pursue legal action against the publisher and author over the use of photos taken by her convicted husband.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-24/pelicot-nude-photos-used-to-promote-psychoanalyst-book/107419434) reported that the nude photographs of Gisèle Pelicot had been used without her consent to promote a psychoanalyst's essay on coercive control.

reports.text: [Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/paz-com-as-farc-e-um-fracasso-na-colombia-diz-ex-refem-ingrid-betancourt.shtml) reported that former hostage Ingrid Betancourt stated that peace with the FARC is a failure in Colombia.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10948947) reported that a bomb exploded outside regional government offices in Villavicencio, injuring 23 people.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/atentado-villavicencio-cilindros-bomba-marcados-farc-500-kilos-revolucion-CJ43971762) reported that military intelligence is analyzing whether a video featuring bombs signed by FARC dissident factions is linked to the car bomb attack in Villavicencio.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/no-habra-impunidad-por-el-carro-bomba-contra-la-gobernacion-del-meta-dice-vicepresidente-restrepo-FJ43972304) reported that Vice President José Manuel Restrepo joined voices of rejection regarding the car bomb attack against the headquarters of the Meta government in Villavicencio, stating there will be no impunity.

[El País](https://elpais.com/america-colombia/2026-11-24/el-estallido-de-un-coche-bomba-en-colombia-da-alas-a-los-detractores-del-acuerdo-de-paz-con-las-farc.html) reported that the explosion of a car bomb in Colombia occurred hours before the commemoration of the tenth anniversary of the peace agreement.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/colombia-car-bomb-attack-injures-at-least-23/a-80033956?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a car bomb attack in Villavicencio injured at least 23 people and coincided with the tenth anniversary of a peace accord with FARC guerrillas.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/at-least-24-injured-after-car-bomb-detonates-in-central-colombia) reported that Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella arrived in Villavicencio to hold a security meeting.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/atentado-en-villavicencio-deja-al-menos-23-heridos-y-mas-de-80-viviendas-afectadas) reported that a bomb blast in Villavicencio left at least 25 people injured and more than 80 homes affected.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/presidente-de-la-espriella-atentado-villavicencio-carro-bomba-gobernacion-meta-CI43969795) reported that Abelardo de la Espriella rejected the car bomb attack in a message on X, stating that the attack will not go unpunished.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/atentado-villavicencio-reacciones-iris-marin-gobernadora-meta-ministro-defensa-DJ43971507) reported that authorities and leaders strongly condemned the car bomb parked in front of the Meta Governor's Office.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/longform/2026/11/24/ten-years-after-its-2016-peace-deal-colombia-faces-a-return-to-conflict?traffic_source=rss) reported that critics fear a security crackdown under Abelardo de la Espriella could unravel gains made under the 2016 peace deal.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/international/2026-11-24/colombia-marks-10-years-since-farc-peace-deal-as-de-la-espriella-threatens-its-future.html) reported that a decade after the FARC peace deal was signed, victims and former combatants are still waiting for the agreement to be fully implemented.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cjqlq2n4np7do?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that a car bomb in a Colombian city wounded more than 20 people in a string of attacks on government offices.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/car-bomb-destroys-buildings-in-central-colombian-city) reported that a car bomb detonated in Villavicencio, destroying a local governor's office and surrounding buildings.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/colombian-president-blames-ex-farc-rebels-for-car-bomb-blast?traffic_source=rss) reported that Colombian President De la Espriella blamed the FARC for plotting the bombing and pledged retaliation.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/atentado-centro-colombia-deja-menos-23-heridos-graves-danos-materiales_202611246b053b9aff6fec29219977c3.html) reported that an attack in central Colombia left at least 23 injured and caused severe material damage, with investigators pointing to FARC dissident leader Antonio Medina.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/atentado-en-el-centro-de-colombia-deja-heridos-y-graves-danos-materiales-33283587), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/carro-bomba-estalla-frente-a-la-gobernacion-del-meta-en-colombia-deja-al-menos-12-heridos-y-danos-materiales/) reported that a car bomb exploded in front of the government building of Meta department in Villavicencio, leaving at least twelve people injured and causing material damage.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/atentado-en-el-centro-de-colombia-deja-heridos-y-graves-danos-materiales-33283587) reported that De la Espriella described the incident as a narcoterrorist attack.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/car-bomb-destroys-buildings-in-villavicencio-says-colombian-president-de-la-espriella/article71737324.ece) reported that Colombian President De la Espriella stated a car bomb destroyed buildings in Villavicencio and that no casualties were yet confirmed from the blast, which he blamed on drug traffickers.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/car-bomb-injures-20-in-colombia-ahead-of-10th-anniversary-of-farc-peace-deal/articleshow/136125201.cms) reported that a car bomb injured 20 people in Colombia ahead of the 10th anniversary of the peace deal with FARC rebels.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/nacion/carro-bomba-en-villavicencio-explosion-sacude-el-centro-de-la-ciudad) reported that an explosion shook central Villavicencio in a car bomb attack attributed by the president to narcoterrorist groups.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/videos-atentado-explosion-villavicencio-gobernacion-MI43968004), [El País](https://elpais.com/america-colombia/2026-11-24/un-carro-bomba-explota-frente-a-la-gobernacion-del-meta-en-villavicencio.html) reported that an explosion occurred near the Governor's Office of Meta in Villavicencio.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/24/car-bomb-strikes-governors-office-in-meta-colombia?traffic_source=rss) reported that a car bomb exploded in the city of Villavicencio in Colombia's Meta Department.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/car-bomb-hits-meta-government-headquarters-in-colombias-villavicencio-3725923) reported that dozens of people were injured, including five security guards.
[TRT World](https://www.trtworld.com/article/98f95e17e0ba) reported that UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres urged renewed commitment to implementing the 2016 peace deal.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/watch-armed-men-take-30-hostage-at-colombia-supermarket-after-failed-attempt-to-rob-cash-van-10-rescued/articleshow/136147326.cms) reported that armed assailants took at least 20 hostages in a supermarket following a botched armored cash van heist in Cartagena.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261124-hostages-supermarket-colombia-cartagena-flights) reported that armed robbers took roughly two dozen people hostage at a supermarket in Cartagena.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/cartagena-colombia-hostage-situation-exito-b3090950.html) reported that five older women have been released so far following a failed cash truck heist.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/armed-men-take-at-least-25-hostages-in-supermarket-in-colombia-tourist-hotspot-13616139) reported that officials stated a group of armed men are holding at least 25 people hostage in a supermarket in Colombia.

[El Colombiano](https://www.elcolombiano.com/colombia/cinco-pistas-investigacion-secuestro-30-rehenes-exito-cartagena-GA44004714) reported that an attempted robbery targeting an armored cash transport vehicle was behind the security alert at an Éxito store in Cartagena.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/svijet/porota-u-sad-u-proglasila-huawei-krivim-za-kradu-poslovnih-tajni-i-krsenje-sankcija-iranu/261125006), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/globus/1090774/huawei-proglasen-krivim-u-sad-u-otkrivena-spijunaza-kradja-tajni-i-milionske-prevare) reported that the US Department of Justice announced that a federal jury in New York found Huawei and three of its subsidiaries guilty of stealing trade secrets and violating sanctions on Iran.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/chinese-tech-giant-huawei-convicted-of-bank-fraud-sanctions-violations-industrial-espionage/) reported that Huawei was convicted in the United States on 10 criminal counts involving bank fraud, sanctions violations against Iran, and conspiracy to steal trade secrets.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/china/huawei-guilty-trump-us-iran-trade-secrets-b3091109.html), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/future/technology/2026/11/25/huawei-found-guilty-of-money-laundering-and-conspiracy-to-steal-trade-secrets-in-us-case/) reported that Huawei was found guilty in a US landmark case of multiple criminal charges including money laundering and conspiracy to steal trade secrets, while noting the company was acquitted of racketeering charges.
